Like Ravel’s Bolero, sushi here is presented with a particular rhythm, building toward a crescendo of sweetness, sourness and temperature in harmony. Destiny is in the taste and texture of every piece of sushi at Harutaka.

Name: Sushi Kanesaka
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Owner-chef Shinji Kanesaka is devoted to sushi. He charms his customers as he trains his small army of apprentices. Through the sushi he shapes, Kanesaka conveys his thoughts and understanding of the sea, the fish market, and the work of the artisan. The key to great sushi, he says, is the three-way interplay between topping, vinegared rice, and wasabi. Fixing a keen eye on the condition of the seafood, Kanesaka deftly executes his techniques, harmonising the vinegared rice with each topping.

Name: Akasaka Kikunoi
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Experience the tradition and innovation of Kyoto’s venerable Kikunoi ryotei, but in Tokyo. A watered cobblestone path along with sukiya-style furnishings make for a Kyoto-esque atmosphere. The restaurant serves beautiful, refined Kyoto-style kaiseki. Yoshihiro Murata values the beloved old ceremonial events that make up the Japanese year, as well as the changes brought by the seasons, and incorporates them into the menu.

Name: Ginza Fukuju
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The simplicity of the cuisine makes it unforgettable. Katsuhiro Onodera uses lashings of carefully selected ingredients such as abalone, matsutake mushroom and spiny lobster. Garnishing is minimal to place the flavours of the ingredients front and centre. Sometimes Japanese and Western items are juxtaposed to explore original taste sensations: Mineoka milk tofu is paired with caviar, sukiyaki with truffles. Cuisine with both pedigree and modern refinement seems quintessentially Ginza.

Name: Florilège
Address: 2F,  Azabudai Hills Garden Plaza D, 5-10-7 Toranomon, Minato-ku, Tokyo, 105-0001, Japan
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This restaurant moved to the address listed below and reopened on Sep 18th.2F Garden Plaza D Azabudai Hills, 5-10-7, Toranomon, Minato-ku, TokyoNew information will be updated after our inspection.

Name: Sukiyabashi Jiro Roppongiten
Address: 3F, Roppongi Hills Residence B, 6-12-2 Roppongi, Minato-ku, Tokyo, 106-0032, Japan
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A typical meal might begin with the subtle flavour of white fish, followed by red fish, then chu-toro. After gizzard shad for the sourness come richer flavours such as horse mackerel or shrimp, then mackerel marinated in vinegar to cleanse the palate; uni and anago follow. The changes in flavour are carefully calibrated for the aftertaste that lingers in between. Underneath chef Takashi Ono’s strict demeanour toward his apprentices lies a gentle affection.

Name: Jungsik
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Discover Card,Interesting wine list,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Touted as a pioneer of modern Korean fine dining, Chef Yim Jung-sik — with his Seoul and New York restaurants - is credited for introducing Korean cuisine to the world with an innovative flair that is entirely his own. What Yim does best is drawing inspiration from the familiar — gimbap, bibimbap, platter of nine delicacies and napa wraps with pork — and creating something unexpected yet surprisingly evocative and authentic. Whimsical desserts, a good wine list and attentive service — Jungsik has it all.

Name: Kwonsooksoo
FacilitiesAndServices: Interesting wine list,Valet parking
Description: Chef Kwon Woo-joong’s homage to tradition is evident in every facet of Kwonsooksoo, even in the name itself (sooksoo is an archaic term for professional cook). Inspired by time-honored methods of cooking, Kwon digs deep into his own roots. He tirelessly scours the country for rare finds that best represent each of the seasons and transforms even the most mundane ingredients into something special. What the diners get to experience is passion on a plate, coupled with a good dose of ingenuity.

Name: Mingles
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Chef Kang Min-goo's keen eye for detail shines in Mingles, from the ceramic ware that highlights the beauty of Korean cuisine to the warm luxury of empty space apparent in the interior design. From the beginning, Kang has marched to the beat of his own drum, breaking down barriers by marrying the old with the new, but always with a deep respect for tradition. His journey and evolution continues, with dishes like Abalone and Cabbage Seon and Fish Mandu showcasing the creativity of the chef and his talented team.

Name: La Yeon
Address: 23F Shilla Hotel, 249 Dongho-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul, South Korea
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Great view,Valet parking,Wheelchair access
Description: Time-honored traditions of Korean cuisine are given a contemporary touch at La Yeon. Located on the 23rd floor of The Shilla Hotel, this refined dining space offers stunning vistas over Namsan Park. It's the detail here that are noteworthy, from the fine tableware to the attentive service. Hansik and wine pairings elevate the dining experience to another level.

Name: Joo Ok
Address: 3F The Plaza Hotel, 119 Sogong-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul, South Korea
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Valet parking,Wheelchair access
Description: The name of the restaurant Joo Ok embodies the simple philosophy of Chef Shin Chang-ho, which is to serve dishes that are as exquisite as precious gems. Shin's culinary creations are a testament to how a city's food culture deeply rooted in tradition withstands the test of time. The restaurant's most prized ingredients consist of some 30 different varieties of fermented condiments; shots of house-made vinegar are offered as an aperitif before the meal. The restaurant's celebrated perilla oil is pressed from perilla seed harvested from his family farm in Jinju. Enjoy the great view of one of the most dynamic areas of the city.

Name: alla Prima
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: Chef Kim Jin-hyuk continues to attract discerning gourmets with his whimsically creative and modern offerings. His reverence for seasonal ingredients, his attention to balance, and his delicate yet assertive sauces come together like a symphony that pairs well with both wine and sake. The L-shaped counter with ample seating, the gleaming open kitchen, the spacious dining hall, and the private dining room each do their part to make the diners feel comfortable. Be sure to reserve ahead.

Name: Kojima
Address: 6F Boon the Shop, 21 Apgujeong-ro 60-gil, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, South Korea
FacilitiesAndServices: Counter dining,Notable sake list,Valet parking
Description: The serene and reposeful space in Kojima allows patrons to concentrate solely on their sushi. A perfect match between shari (rice) and neta (fish topping), replete with the integral taste of the ingredients, the diner’s plump sushi somehow resembles its creator, Chef Park Kyung-jae. Prepared from ingredients that change daily, the sushi has an unadorned and fine taste, that is, seemingly plain yet flavorful and brims with umami. Be sure to make a reservation if you wish to relish the art of Kojima’s elegant items.

Name: Soigné
Address: #201, 2F Sinsa square, 652 Gangnam-daero, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, 06027, South Korea
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: [This is the new address updated as the restaurant moved.]Meaning “well-groomed” in French, Soigné lives up to its name with its elegant menu, inspired by global cuisine with distinct undertones of Korea’s culinary philosophy. Chef Lee Jun’s creations are both creative and modern, but the local ingredients he uses always take on the starring roles in his meticulously curated “episodes,” each with its own unique color and lyrical flow. Try the suggested wine pairings for the full gustatory experience.

Name: Ryō-shō
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: ‘Ryō-shō’ means ‘to surpass the sky’. It could be a statement about chef Makoto Fujiwara’s ambitions. The sukiya-style building, constructed by master artisans, and the paintings, by luminaries of the artistic world, proclaim Fujiwara’s intentions. The fare preserves traditional Japanese cuisine while incorporating Western ingredients through a dialogue with French gastronomy. The very refinement of the cuisine attests to the chef’s humility.

Name: Gion Owatari
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Shoes must be removed,Visa credit card
Description: Owner-chef Mahito Owatari’s approach is about bringing original touches to classic cuisine. The wonders he weaves with his ingenious combinations of ingredients make for memorable dining. In spring, white asparagus dressed with kinome miso is used in place of bamboo shoots. The meal ends with an enjoyable zosui made by adding leftover broth and other ingredients to rice. Owatari’s service is cheery and light-hearted, and it shows in the customers' relaxed smiles.

Name: VELROSIER
Address: 2F, Good Nature Station, 318-6 Inaricho, Shimogyo-ku, Kyoto, 600-8022, Japan
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In hanakotoba or ‘flower language’, the bellerose (a type of primrose) signifies ‘telling your true feelings to your sweetheart’. Owner-chef Yuji Iwasaki chose it to convey his feelings about gastronomy, and because it’s his birth flower. Foie gras-filled monaka wafer cakes are served with roses for colour and cloves for aroma. The imaginative pan-fried gyoza dish takes apart and reassembles the recipe bit by bit. Iwasaki’s fusion of Chinese and French is an original take.

Name: Sushi Harasho
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Featuring kappo technique, the omakase is something of a story about the path that Ko Ishikawa has taken. Nimono, grilled items, steamed items and other shuko are arranged on antique Kyo ware and on serving dishes by modern artists. The sensibilities he cultivated in general Japanese cuisine can also be seen in the nigiri. The first piece is squid, and the fine scoring brings out the sweetness. He does not use sugar in the vinegared rice, so as to keep the flavours light.

Name: Kikunoi Roan
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: In winter, the masterpiece of the house is quail-and-lily-bulb dumpling with black truffle paste; in early summer, there is sorbet of passion fruit and wasabi. Accentuating Japanese cuisine with Western culinary elements is the epitome of ‘tradition and innovation’, as advocated by Kikunoi. At the counter, owner-chef Yoshiharu Murata and the other chefs are a whirlwind of activity. Taking in this bustle while enjoying the fare is the true pleasure of Kikunoi Roan.

Name: KAHALA
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: More than half a century since he founded his restaurant, owner-chef Yoshifumi Mori’s inquisitive spirit is as unquenchable as ever. As he seeks out unknown ingredients and new cooking methods, he constantly generates original cuisines. The karasumi somen is piled on lacquer plates he painted himself. The beef millefeuille, served with three flavours, is a masterpiece. ‘I just want to create a little culinary movement of my own’ he says, as he earnestly faces his counter that seats eight.

Name: Kenninji Gion Maruyama
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Shoes must be removed
Description: The culinary journey of owner-chef Yoshio Maruyama is guided by his deep knowledge of the tea ceremony and flower arrangement. His room puts diners at ease; his menu matches the seasons. This is cuisine that reverberates in all five senses. He cooks ingredients from land and sea on a hot stone grill, patiently listening to the sizzle and waiting for the moment they yield up their aroma. Such moments convey the culture and spirt of Japan in ways the eye cannot see and the ear cannot hear.

Name: Miyamaso
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Shoes must be removed,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: A devotee of the natural beauty of Hanase, Kyoto Prefecture, owner-chef Hisato Nakahigashi uses tsumikusa cuisine (cuisine using wild herbs and vegetables) to convey the food culture of the satoyama (rural villages hugging the hills). He travels into the mountains himself, gathering young herbs in spring and mushrooms in autumn. The edible wild plants in his tsumikusa basket are a signifier of spring. Each season brings its own special joy, like ayu in summer and boar and bear in winter.

Name: Numata
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Owner-chef Kazuya Numata skilfully manipulates the thickness and volume of the batter with a careful eye. He fries his tempura using techniques he developed himself. The menu, which interweaves seasonal ingredients that are just in with those on their way out, sees seafood and vegetables in alternating fashion. Start with the tiger prawn from Numata’s hometown, Amakusa. Possible conclusions to the meal include tendon, tencha, onigiri with shrimp tempura filling and tamagokake-gohan.

Name: Koryu
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The fare of owner-chef Shintaro Matsuo expresses the essence of Naniwa, another name for Osaka. He revels in talking about the culture of enjoying raw fish in Osaka, explaining that for him Naniwa means ‘garden of fish’”, from Osaka Bay being so rich in seafood. Koryu embodies that idea, stocked with seafood from nearby seas. He also explains Naniwa can mean a ‘garden of vegetables’, as the Kawachi Plain on which it sits is renowned as a vegetable-producing region.

Name: Tenjimbashi Aoki
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: “Japanese cuisine is an art comprising multiple arts”, observes owner-chef Ryota Aoki. The décor reflects this creed with its harmonious blend of cultural elements. The interior is in the style of sukiya, and the food, served on a mix of antique and modern plates, is arranged to reflect traditional events and seasonal festivals. The star items on the menu are nimono soup, richly flavourful and nutritious, and hassun that pay homage to the classics.

Name: Oryori Mitsuyasu
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Cash only,Shoes must be removed
Description: The owner-chef visits farmers and gathers vegetables to fire his culinary imagination. Consider the hassun: defying the standard practice of combining ingredients from both ocean and mountain, he serves only vegetables. In spring, sprouting buds are garnished with edible wild plants; in summer, chilled vegetables are cool to both eye and palate; in autumn, chestnuts and mushrooms are the stars of the crop; and in winter, root vegetables are cooked to express the warmth of the good earth.

Name: Fujiya 1935
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Owner-chef Tetsuya Fujiwara aspires to “a dining table of seasons and memories”. Passing through the entrance and moving through to the dining room, the guest is drawn into a unique space that titillates all senses. The fresh, seasonal ingredients are painstakingly selected, and the creative cuisine uses techniques the owner-chef made his own when in Europe. He delivers the food to guests himself and speaks sincerely about the appeal of the ingredients and their background.

Name: Yusokuryori Mankamero
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Shoes must be removed,Visa credit card
Description: This long-standing establishment boasts three centuries of history. Renowned as the home of the Ikama school of culinary arts, its traditions have been passed from father to only one child for 10 generations to the current owner-chef, Masakiyo Konishi. The menu consists of yusoku ryori, associated with the seasonal banquets and other annual functions of the Imperial court, and kaiseki based on chakaiseki. Both types of meal conclude with a tai chazuke.

Name: Otagi
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The name of the restaurant derives from the location of owner-chef Kazuaki Baba’s restaurant in Takagamine, an area formerly known as Otagi County. “Since you took the trouble to come all this way…” is a favoured phrase with which he welcomes patrons. The exuberant uniqueness of the menu delights diners, with offerings such as duck charcoal-grilled on low heat, cream croquettes of fugu shirako, and dandan noodles à la mode japonais of hand-made udon.

Name: Shunsaiten Tsuchiya
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Osaka is a textile production centre, and Yukihiko Tsuchisaka says he uses cottonseed oil to contribute to the wellbeing of his hometown. Watching him put his all into the deep-frying, mindful of all the effort that went into producing the ingredients, is a wonderful sight. He is thorough in his preparations, adjusting the batter and the way he deep-fries, and even changing the sourness of the dipping sauce, according to the weather and ingredients. He puts to work the sensibilities he cultivated in the field of general Japanese cuisine in making the tempura and beautifully arranged hassun.

Name: Ogata
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Notable sake list,Visa credit card
Description: Having your fill of Japanese cuisine stripped to its essentials, and lovingly served on antique and contemporary dishware, is the real pleasure of Ogata. Owner-chef Toshiro Ogata fills each plate with nature’s bounty. “Holding back on seasonings richly draws out the innate flavours of the ingredients”, he explains. He pairs bamboo shoots with shirako in spring and, in winter serves ebi-imo boiled in water only. His daring yet delicate cuisine is richly imbued with seasonal aromas.

Name: Shimmonzen Yonemura
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Cash only - lunch,Counter dining,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Masayasu Yonemura is rich in creativity and continues to hone his aesthetic faculties. Putting his experience to work in preparing the ingredients and serving dishes, he comes up with cuisine that defies genre. He brings Japanese and Western elements together, such as serving tapenade with hamo and serving fugu sashimi with citrus and salad. He also uses a variety of gorgeous serving dishes, some crafted by modern artists, some that are antiques, and some made in Europe. The Yonemura touch can be sensed in everything from the space to the dishes.

Name: Kyokaiseki Kichisen
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Shoes must be removed,Visa credit card
Description: This ryotei stands close to Shimogamo Shrine, a World Heritage site. Yoshimi Tanigawa, the owner-chef, describes his art as “a quest for good flavour”, while the cup of sake that starts the meal conveys his spirit of hospitality. The choice of Ma-kombu for the dashi is because of the well-rounded umami it imparts. The arrangements reflect current festivals and the season, from an aesthetic sensibility tutored in the arts of tea ceremony and flower arranging.

Name: Gion Nishikawa
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Notable sake list,Visa credit card
Description: The interior is painstakingly crafted in the style of a sukiya, for a sense of stylish elegance. Masayoshi Nishikawa is an owner-chef who treasures his establishment’s deep connection to the region. Viewing the dinner experience as a narrative arc, he interlaces Western ingredients and gastronomic methods to bring an original touch. His motto is a Chinese proverb: “True flavour is subtle flavour”: Understated flavours, he says, are truest to their ingredients.

Name: Gion Maruyama
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Shoes must be removed,Visa credit card
Description: Owner-chef Yoshio Maruyama’s take on Kyo-ryori is that it is heir to the ancient capital’s history and culture. His dishes sparkle with originality, inventively resonating with all five senses, including colour, sound, and aroma. The dining room is designed in the restrained, elegant sukiya style with appropriate seasonal decorations to convey the beauty of Japanese cuisine. Guests can be seated at the counter to observe the chefs at work or at a table to dine in a graceful atmosphere.

Name: Sojiki Nakahigashi
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Cash only,Counter dining
Description: Sojiki-ryori, literally ‘herbivorous cuisine’, is all about appreciating nature’s bounty. Owner-chef Hisao Nakahigashi plans his dishes so that nothing goes to waste. The hassun expresses the rustic beauty of the country through all five senses. To match the mood of each season, the carp tsukuri is garnished with buds in spring and mushrooms in autumn, in a presentation the house calls ‘Koi no Karasawagi’, conveying Nakahigashi’s love of hill and dale.

Name: Wagokoro Izumi
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Notable sake list,Visa credit card
Description: Owner-chef Masaki Izumi regards Japanese cuisine as the heart of Japanese culture, so approaches his work from the standpoint of wagokoro, the Japanese spirit. Naturally, he places great emphasis on dashi. The meal begins with a sour appetiser to accent the delicate flavours of the stewed dishes that follow. Ayu dried high above a fire is an early-summer speciality. Festive ingredients are arranged on the hassun to highlight the season and convey the traditions of the former capital.

Name: Gion Matayoshi
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Notable sake list,Visa credit card
Description: Owner-chef Kazutomo Matayoshi scours Japan, from Hokkaido to his native Okinawa, seeking ingredients with the right flavour and builds a relationship of trust with each producer. His cooking is distinguished by techniques that bring out inherent flavours. Originality is everywhere: lily bulbs made into a dumpling with no filler; oil-baked vegetables cooked with an evenness and thoroughness usually seen only with deep-frying; and tsukuri garnished with rock tripe.

Name: La Cime
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Yusuke Takada has dedicated his life to pursuing French cuisine à la Japonaise. Focusing on Japanese ingredients, he sources items like pork and citrus fruits from his birthplace of Amamioshima Island. The set menu sets a modern, light-hearted tone, and weaves in elements of traditional cuisine that he has brought to refinement. He sets great store by classic techniques while fusing them with innovative ideas, to foster a gastronomical world view that is all his own.

Name: Miyamoto
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Shoes must be removed,Visa credit card
Description: Owner-chef Daisuke Miyamoto’s open-minded approach to gastronomy is reflected in the unique menu. For example, when the vegetables, grown by the proprietress’s family, are delivered to the kitchen, you may be startled to find that the first dish is deep-fried. He ends the meal with rice cooked in an earthenware pot, pork miso soup and dashimaki tamago, which he calls the Miyamoto family breakfast. Some of the bowls and plates are antiques and some created by modern artists.

Name: Sumibi Kappo Ifuki
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Shoes must be removed,Visa credit card
Description: Owner-chef Norio Yamamoto calls his style of restaurant sumibi-kappo, ‘charcoal-fired cuisine’, and tends his charcoal fire with practiced ease. In summer a sumashijiru soup of ayu is served. Ayu bones are added to the dashi for extra flavour. Another unique approach that charms customers is how the ayu flesh in the soup is fragrantly char-grilled. The duck is smoked using grapevines, in a touch that reflects the cuisine of the Basque Country straddling Spain and France.

Name: Kodaiji Wakuden
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Shoes must be removed,Visa credit card
Description: The interior is skilfully crafted in the style of a sukiya and home to a lovingly tended design with beauty of form. The minimalist cuisine is prepared with great care, with unnecessary elements pruned for a memorable arrangement of rustic beauty. Seasonal flavours include Taiza crab and a grilled pairing of hamo and matsutake. These delicacies are charcoal-grilled in front of the customer, creating a feast for the senses. Simple yet subtle technique is on display here.

Name: Bottiglieria 1881
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Sophistication, depth and a wonderful purity of flavour can all be found in the cooking at this marble-floored restaurant. Choose from two tasting menus, the ‘Introduction’ or the ‘Full Experience’, both of which feature creative, well-balanced dishes. The best of the Polish larder is used throughout, while each finely crafted course is finished with an artistic flourish. Sit in the century old cellar for an intimate dining experience, or ask for a table opposite the open kitchen to see the talented team at work as they produce such stunning cooking.

Name: Deessa
Address: Plaza de la Lealtad 5, Madrid, 28014, Spain
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The gourmet flagship at the Mandarin Oriental Ritz in Madrid, Deessa is a restaurant like no other. The incomparable dining room, exquisitely laid out in the Alfonso XIII salon overlooking the garden, is the perfect setting in which to savour the intrinsic beauty of the great Quique Dacosta’s exquisite culinary vision. This celebrated chef keeps a watchful eye on everything here, closely following the magnificent cuisine created by head chef Guillermo Chávez. Their elegant dishes, exploring the flavours of the Mediterranean and the Extremadura region, are showcased on two tasting menus: one entitled “Histórico Quique Dacosta”, featuring the chef’s signature dishes from his restaurant in Dénia, and “Contemporáneo QDRITZ”. A reduced version of both menus, enticingly called “Esencia”, is also available at lunchtimes midweek.

Name: Ricard Camarena
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This magnificent place is part of the refurbished Bombas Gens factory, which also houses an arts and culture centre. Here, there is a large foyer with a contemporary feel, a private bar where hors d'oeuvres are served, and the modern dining room at the back, with an open-plan kitchen where you can enjoy a final aperitif.Along with seven other chefs, Ricard Camarena was distinguished/commended with the Cocinero del Año award (Madrid Fusión, 2021) for his "green activism". His is a coherent signature cuisine solidly grounded in homegrown vegetables and a painstaking process of research. His set menus convey a clear commitment to sustainability, as he uses every last leaf of the vegetables to make his sauces or even the occasional beverage.

Name: Il Gallo d'Oro
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Madeira is often called “paradise on Earth” and the “pearl of the Atlantic”, apt descriptions which are enhanced by a meal at Il Gallo d’Oro, the island’s very own culinary Eden.Here, French chef Benoît Sinthon conjures up fresh, delicious and creative cuisine that showcases the full flavours of the Atlantic, both from the island and its surrounding waters, reviving old recipes and reinterpreting them through the use of contemporary techniques and ingredients that support his quest for sustainability (many of which are sourced from the PortoBay organic garden). Various menus are available with varying numbers of courses, from which guests can also select individual dishes à la carte style. To make your experience even more special, why not book the chef’s table or dine on the terrace with its idyllic views?

Name: D.O.M.
Address: Rua Barão de Capanema 549, São Paulo, 01411-011, Brazil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: Without a doubt, Alex Atala is the world’s best-known Brazilian chef, a status earned thanks to cuisine that “always has lots to tell. ” He views his food as “a viable dream”—it is contemporary yet wholly engaged with the culinary roots of the country. Tasting menus (some of which are vegetarian) make full use of traditional Brazilian ingredients (tucupi, jambu, pupunha palm heart, and more) and are designed around Amazonian and indigenous cooking that predate the discovery of the New World. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Oteque
Address: Rua Conde de Irajá 581, Rio de Janeiro, 22271-020, Brazil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The surprises here begin at the entrance, since nothing gives the impression that hidden behind its discreet front door is this temple of Rio gastronomy. The attractive dining room boasts high ceilings and an informal atmosphere with a modern-industrial feel. Extraordinary chef Alberto Landgraf transports guests to a world of highly precise culinary sensations based around his consistent use of the region’s very best fish and seafood. His delicate dishes showcase a skilful fusion of ingredients and flavours. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Oro
Address: Avenida General San Martin 889, Rio de Janeiro, 22441-015, Brazil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: This is a restaurant that is well worth frequenting, as the partnership formed between chef Felipe Bronze and sommelier Cecilia Aldaz works to perfection due to their unmistakable chemistry and friendly approach. Here, the cuisine features a fusion of Brazilian roots and cutting-edge gastronomy, as reflected on two menus—both offering a wine pairing that pays homage to the country’s regions. The kitchen is upstairs, so diners can expect constant traffic—with servers cradling carefully balanced trays. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: DC. by Darren Chin
Address: 44 Persiaran Zaaba, Taman Tun Dr Ismail, Kuala Lumpur, 60000, Malaysia
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Divided into bars and dining rooms, the three-story restaurant also sports a Louis XIII-themed private room. Diners can choose from 4- to 7-course menus, plus one for vegetarians. Dishes range from modern classics, such as sole meunière and freshly made pasta, to novel creations with Japanese accents, all of which underscored by solid skills and quality international produce. Don’t miss the cheese trolley with 20 choices.

Name: Auntie Gaik Lean's Old School Eatery
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Memorabilia in show windows and a 60s soundtrack exude the charm of a bygone era. Chef Gaik Lean has been guarding her secret recipes for decades and she makes no compromises in terms of food quality. Many items are made from scratch, including her heavenly pie tee and gulai tumis that uses over eight ingredients in the curry paste, such as fresh saffron. Also try nasi ulam, an old-time recipe.

Name: Beta
Address: Lot 3 & 4, GF, Cormar Suites, 10 Jalan Perak, Kuala Lumpur, 50450, Malaysia
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: Beta offers discerning foodies an exciting way to taste Malaysia’s rich culinary heritage with a touch of finesse. The chef reimagines favourites from around the country, often jazzed up with modern techniques and soigné plating. Head to the lounge first for a round of cocktails and appetisers, before sampling the main courses in the theatrically appointed dining room with open kitchen. Fine cocktail-food pairings to complement the intelligent dishes.

Name: Au Jardin
Address: The Warehouse@Hin Bus Depot, 125 Jalan Timah, George Town, 10150, Malaysia
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,China UnionPay,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Inside a bus depot-turned art space sits this distressed building clad in corrugated metal panels. However, the interior is miles apart from the exterior, boasting a modern and sleek look. The menu changes monthly and showcases sophisticated European fare with subtle local twists. Every item served has been well thought out – the homemade sourdough with tomato butter is always a highlight. Even the palate cleanser surprises in pleasant ways.

Name: Maison Lameloise
Address: 68F, Shanghai Tower, 501 Middle Yincheng Road, Pudong, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The first Asian outpost of its French namesake in Burgundy commands 180-degree views of The Bund. The chef, who worked for Éric Pras at the flagship establishment for years, is keen to pair Burgundy recipes with local produce such as sunflower seed-fed chicken from Guangdong and sea perch from Fujian, in his own spin on authentic French cooking. The bread is baked in-house with a perfect crust and crumbly dough.

Name: Tea Culture (East Beijing Road)
Address: L201A, 2F, Yi Feng Galleria, 99 East Beijing Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: You can tell from its name that the restaurant is serious about the national beverage – professional tea masters brew the perfect cup using top quality loose leaves and natural spring water. Onto the food, the chef hails from Guangdong and displays his skills in signatures like Huai Yang-style marinated squab in herb-infused brine, and braised yellow croaker with rice cake. Double-boiled oxtail soup with whelk is a health tonic that tastes superb.

Name: Meet the Bund (Zhongshan Dong Er Road)
Address: S301, 3F, South Mall, The Bund Finance Center, 600 Zhongshan Dong Er Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,China UnionPay,Foreign credit cards not accepted,Visa credit card
Description: Brass ceiling panels and chandeliers lends a touch of nostalgic elegance to the otherwise modern room. To make the experience authentic, Fujianese is the mainstay of the menu, with the kitchen team all hailing from the province. The signature Hetian chicken steamed in salt and wine uses the famous bird from Fujian. The gourmet soup ‘Buddha jumps over the wall’ takes one week to make and lu mian noodles in shrimp tomalley broth are rich and tasty.

Name: Yu Zhi Lan
Address: 851 Julu Road, Jingan, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: There’s no sign at this discreet restaurant, but a receptionist will be waiting for you at your reservation time. As opposed to typical Sichuan stir-fries that can be numbing and spicy, Yu Zhi Lan serves up food cooked in various ways, with different flavour profiles. Set menus feature first-rate ingredients alongside some painstakingly made items such as hair-thin golden silk noodles. Dishes in the sets can be customised upon request.

Name: Cheng Long Hang (Huangpu)
Address: 216 Jiujiang Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A household name among hairy crab lovers, this restaurant runs its own farm to ensure quality and a stable supply. Their crabs have flavoursome flesh, with their shells brimming with creamy yellow roe. Try the array of hairy crab dishes on offer, including drunken crabs steeped in Shaoxing wine for a month. Each serving of steamed meringue on stuffed crab shell uses the meat and roe of three hairy crabs and is sinfully satisfying.

Name: Xin Rong Ji (West Nanjing Road)
Address: 2F, 688 Plaza, 688 West Nanjing Road, Jingan, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Among the four branches in Shanghai, this location and the one on the Bund prominently feature Taizhou cooking alongside Cantonese cuisine. The seafood stall by the entrance lets diners make their own choices from what has been shipped directly from Taizhou that day. Seasonality is key and exact ingredients of certain dishes depend on what’s in season. Don’t miss their signatures – braised yellow croaker, and sweet potato noodles with sea anemone.

Name: Moose (Pudong)
Address: 9F, L+Mall, 899 South Pudong Road, Pudong, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Moose has three Shanghai branches, all run by the same team. This Pudong one is geared towards the general public, with a Huaiyang-centric menu featuring some painstakingly made delicacies. From Anhui province, the head chef champions the pagoda version of braised pork belly in brown sauce, which shows exquisite knife work. The sautéed river shrimps are a light but umami-loaded option. Ask servers about the seasonal menu and catch of the day.

Name: Jin Xuan
Address: 53F, The Ritz-Carlton Pudong, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Interesting wine list,JCB,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: Right next to the iconic Oriental Pearl Tower is this elegant dining room perched on an upper floor of a sky-scraping hotel. It commands panoramic views of the Huangpu River and Pudong skyline and is perfect for business meals or private parties. The experienced kitchen team work closely together to skilfully prepare the freshest ingredients. The menu strikes a balance between tradition and innovation, covering seafood, dim sum and other classics.

Name: Sheng Yong Xing (Huangpu)
Address: 5F, Bund 5, 20 Guangdong Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Interesting wine list,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: The Beijing brand famous for Peking duck chose this prestigious address on the Bund for their first Shanghai outpost. Diners are greeted by a wine cellar tunnel foreshadowing the range of drinks to go with the signature bird. Each of the 45-day-old ducks roasted over jujube wood comes with a QR code that allows diners to trace its source. The views of the Bund and romantic ambiance also make for a great dining experience.

Name: Yong Yi Ting
Address: LG Level, Mandarin Oriental Pudong, 111 South Pudong Road, Pudong, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: It may be located beneath a hotel but this tastefully furnished restaurant comes with lush garden views and a charming water terrace. The décor reflects a modern classical take in Chinese context – the booths divided by diaphanous curtains with dragon motifs are particularly charming. Likewise, the experienced chef delivers Jiang Nan classics with refined touches. Look out for steamed Reeves shad with distillers’ grains that exudes winey aromas.

Name: Tou Zao
Address: Shop 211, East Wing, Shanghai Centre, 1376 West Nanjing Road, Jingan, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Unlike the typical bustling Chinese joint, Tou Zao offers the serenity and intimate service of a sushiya. But the single prix-fixe menu, featuring hot entrées and dim sum, is unmistakably Cantonese. The sautéed lobster with scallion trio has addictive aromas and springy flesh. Spring rolls and Cantonese puff pastries are made tableside, baked à la minute and served piping hot. Deft control of heat and remarkable wok hei are the hallmarks of the food here.

Name: Il Ristorante - Niko Romito
Address: 47F, Bvlgari Hotel, Lane 108, North Shanxi Road, Jingan, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Stunning vistas of the Pudong skyline, crystal chandeliers and semi-circular leather booths impart style and a sense of grandeur. The menu here, as at the Dubai and Beijing outlets, comprises creations supervised by celebrity chef Niko Romito and underpinned by well-honed skills to reflect seasonality. Handmade pasta is the must-try – the lobster linguine bursts with seafood umami. Be sure to save room for the creamy gelato di ricotta di bufala.

Name: Yong Fu (Huangpu)
Address: 12F, Cathay Building, Jin Jiang Hotel, 59 South Maoming Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Shanghainese are no strangers to Ningbo cuisine and can be hard to please. This restaurant, with lots of old Shanghai charm, fares well with wild-caught seafood shipped daily from Ningbo and meticulously prepared to highlight its natural taste. Portion sizes can be tailored to your party size and emphasis is on seasonal items, such as razor clams from Ninghai, available March to May. New items like yellow croaker roe aspic are also worth trying.

Name: Fu He Hui
Address: 1037 Yuyuan Road, Changning, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: Exuding Zen-inspired serenity, the room reflects a philosophy that veganism isn’t just about the food, but is a way of life. Only set menus are served and they change every season to make use of the best local ingredients. Masterfully crafted and plated courses include some authentically recreated recipes from the past. Tea is also closely related to Zen so do order from the extensive tea menu to complement the dishes.

Name: Ming Court
Address: Level B1, Cordis Hotel, 333 Shenhong Road, Minhang, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Weary travellers will find this airy dining room near Hongqiao airport a veritable haven. As well as serving the same classics as its namesake sister branch in Hong Kong, the experienced Shanghainese chef also imbues Cantonese dim sum with unique Shanghainese touches. Honey-glazed chai siu pork, and tofu skin beggar’s purses are both pieces de resistance here. Don’t forget to save some room for baked-to-order puff pastry egg tarts.

Name: Le Comptoir de Pierre Gagnaire
Address: Capella, Jian Ye Li, 480 West Jianguo Road, Xuhui, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,JCB,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: An appealing, remodelled Shanghai villa – part of the Capella Hotel – is the setting for this outpost from the famed French chef. Start with an aperitif at the chic bar before taking a table overlooking the central courtyard. Refined French dishes are delivered by an experienced team which cleverly incorporates subtle Shanghainese influences. Signatures include blue lobster fricassee and cocotte of frogs Poulette; be sure to leave room for dessert.

Name: Moose (Changning)
Address: No.1, Lane 119, Xinhua Road, Changning, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: While antique furniture and oil paintings complement the refurbished century-old mansion, the all-white interior exudes modern European charm. The head chef has over 30 years of experience in Huai Yang cuisine, with a focus on river fish and seasonal produce. His signatures are deep-fried anchovies, and steamed Reeves shad in aged Huadiao wine; both are meticulously prepared and perfectly executed.

Name: Phénix
Address: 2F, The PuLi, 1 Changde Road, Jingan, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Brunch,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The menu here was refreshed when the current kitchen came on board in 2022. To appreciate their vision in all its glory, opt for the 6-course seafood-heavy ‘Experience Menu’, or the 5-course lacto-vegetarian ‘Garden Menu’. Meat entrees and novel creations abound in à la carte menu; try l'oeuf de poule confit – Hokkaido sea urchin with confit egg yolk and potato risotto. The short wine list sees some good selections by the glass.

Name: Obscura
Address: Tangxiang Cultural Space, 538 Xikang Road, Jingan, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The chiaroscuro ring logo connotes completeness and the complementary relationship of the enthusiastic chef duo, who travel around China regularly to keep their prix-fixe seasonal menu fresh and inspired. With sound Western techniques, they interpret traditionally Chinese memories with unique scents, tastes, textures and a touch of whimsy, eg Cantonese roast pork disguised as ice cream. Consider pairing the food with non-alcoholic drinks. Leave your preconceptions at the door and be wowed.

Name: Amazing Chinese Cuisine (Changning)
Address: B5 Villa, 1665 Hongqiao Road, Changning, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,JCB,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant excels at high-end Chao Zhou cuisine, ranging from the classics to the creative. Several signature and seasonal dishes, such as chilled crab Chao Zhou-style and marinated raw mantis shrimps, have to be pre-ordered. Crispy sea cucumber that takes days to prepare is another highlight. Servers always go the extra mile to deliver thoughtful service but, with only five private rooms in a villa, getting a table can be a challenge in itself.

Name: Canton Table
Address: 5F, Bund 3, 3 Zhongshan Dong Yi Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Remodelled in 2019, the room exudes old-Shanghai flair with bare cement bricks, terrazzo flooring and murals of women in qipao. The head chef honed his skills in some famous kitchens for over 20 years. His menu is short but sweet, covering the quintessence of Cantonese food – barbecue meats and dim sum among other seasonal offerings. Scrambled egg with shredded fried fish maw stands out with its interesting textures and rich aromas.

Name: Oriental Sense & Palate
Address: 57 Sinan Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This multi-storey marvel in a historical mansion exudes understated luxury. Leading a team from Chaozhou and Shantou, Chef Fai creates culinary gems that entice with pretty plating and precise execution. Be sure to order the juicy, deep-fried 20-day-old pigeon with crispy skin. The sautéed dried shrimps with minced pork seduces with contrasting textures and deep, mildly spicy flavours. Seafood dishes including whelk are also popular.

Name: Jean Georges
Address: 4F, Bund 3, 3 Zhongshan Dong Yi Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Brunch,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Another dining concept from chef Vongerichten, Jean Georges features smart white-and-beige décor and an open kitchen. The menu offers plenty of items from its New York flagship, such as toasted egg yolk with caviar; tuna tartare with avocado, spicy radish and ginger marmalade; and hazelnut praline soufflé with pecan crisp and coffee Bourbon ice cream. Warm service with the right amount of attention at the right time is another plus.

Name: Da Dong (Xuhui)
Address: Shop 602, 6F, iapm, 999 Middle Huaihai Road, Xuhui, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,JCB,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Most customers come for the signature roast duck, boasting wonderfully crispy skin and succulent meat, served with steamed buns. Try also their braised sea cucumber with scallion. On top of the main menu, a seasonal one is also available, alongside new items made according to the 24 solar terms in the Chinese calendar. Come in a group to sample the variety of dishes on offer but be prepared – it’s always jam-packed after 6pm.

Name: Lao Zheng Xing (Huangpu)
Address: 556 Fuzhou Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Known locally and internationally since its inception in 1862, Lao Zheng Xing is reputedly the oldest Shanghainese restaurant in the city and was responsible for creating a number of classic dishes. It moved to its current location in 1997, which gave it considerably more space as it now occupies several floors. Come with friends to enjoy signature dishes like fried river shrimps, eight treasures in spicy sauce and braised sea cucumber.

Name: Yi Long Court
Address: 2F, The Peninsula Hotel, Bund 32, 32 Zhongshan Dong Yi Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Though styled after the golden era of old Shanghai circa 1930s, this flagship restaurant of The Peninsula serves an unmistakably Cantonese menu where excellent choices abound. The kitchen team insists in adhering to culinary traditions and classical skills for the authentic Cantonese flavours to come through. Their barbecued meats never disappoint; neither do the double-boiled soups that complement the solar terms in Chinese calendar.

Name: Fu 1039
Address: 1039 Yuyuan Road, Changning, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,JCB,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: The dining room in a heritage mansion circa 1920s is furnished in a retro style with a terrace and several private rooms. Unlike its two sisters, the original Fu focuses on home-style Shanghainese cooking, including some multi-step labour-intensive recipes. River fish is one of its strong suits, especially river eels prepared in a myriad of ways. Try also oil-blanched river shrimps that are bouncy in texture and loaded with umami.

Name: Ling Long
Address: 105, 1F, Waldorf Astoria Hotel, 2 Zhongshan Dong Yi Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The dimly lit space in a century-old building on the Bund feels mysterious and theatrical. The vibe is matched by a season-driven menu divided into acts, like a play. Neo-Chinese creations are finessed by European techniques, and presented in whimsical and ceremonious ways. For a fine dining take on the classic beef in oyster sauce, beef from Shandong is marinated then deep-fried and grilled. Creative wine pairing options add to the fun.

Name: YongFoo Élite
Address: 200 Yongfu Road, Xuhui, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: This building dating from 1930 was the British Consulate before its three-year makeover. Its heritage is matched by a menu of traditional Shanghainese dishes, including many ancient recipes rarely found elsewhere. The braised pork belly with pu'er tea exudes earthy depth and dark soy notes, and the decadent hairy crab roe and crabmeat options are loaded with flavours. The well-curated wine list is also worth checking out.

Name: Lei Garden (Pudong)
Address: L3-17 & 18, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Reservations are a must as this branch of the chain is always packed with diners craving good quality Cantonese cuisine. At lunchtime, customers come in droves for the expertly crafted dim sum and soups. The dinner menu offers premium dishes like seafood and abalone. Those wishing to avoid making too much of a dent in their wallets should opt for seasonal stir-fries, casseroles or the combos that represent good value.

Name: Lei Garden (Xuhui)
Address: Shop 401, 4F, iapm, 999 Middle Huaihai Road, Xuhui, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The chain may be spreading rapidly in Asia but quality control is strictly imposed to ensure all dim sum, roast meats and double-boiled soups achieve the same high standard as at the parent restaurant. This branch in a popular mall boasts hip décor and is always full. ‘Crossing-the-bridge’ geoduck is blanched at your table in a hot seafood stock that took six hours to make. Claypot rice with preserved meat is made à la minute.

Name: Yong Fu (Hongkou)
Address: 56F, East Tower, Raffles City The Bund, 1089 Dongdaming Road, Hongkou, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Diners Club credit card,Great view,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The swanky room overlooking the Pudong skyline and Huangpu River boasts marble walls and exquisite chandeliers. Half of the menu features Ningbo classics, while the other half presents novelty dishes made with ingredients from all over China. Live seafood is shipped daily from Zhejiang Province in the small hours to ensure freshness. Try stir-fried white crabmeat, sautéed cattail with shrimp roe, and sticky rice balls with black sesame filling.

Name: Ren He Guan (Xuhui)
Address: 407 Zhaojiabang Road, Xuhui, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,China UnionPay,Foreign credit cards not accepted,Terrace,Wheelchair access
Description: Dim yellow lights, a nostalgic décor, 1930s memorabilia, golden oldies courtesy of singers in qipao... but surprisingly the ambiance doesn’t steal the show. One highlight of the fish-heavy menu is crabs as the owner picks the best ones from his own farm; crabmeat and roe on rice is unmissable. Fried shredded finless eel with water bamboo affords a nice contrast of textures, while glutinous rice ball in distillers grain sweet soup is good to share.

Name: Seventh Son
Address: Shop E2-03, 2F, Tower 1, Jing An Kerry Centre, 1515 West Nanjing Road, Jingan, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The Hong Kong based chain opened this comfortable, traditionally decorated branch in 2014 and it’s been attracting a loyal fan base ever since. It delivers a traditional Cantonese menu, with the technical skills of the chef evident in dishes that range from dried seafood and soups to roast meats and stir-fries. At lunch they offer over 30 varieties of dim sum. Sautéed ‘osmanthus’ egg with crabmeat and shredded shrimp is the must-try speciality.

Name: EHB
Address: 11 Dongping Road, Xuhui, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: EHB are the initials of Esben Holmboe Bang. The chef's first and only dining concept outside of Norway occupies a restored heritage villa that is hundred years old. The culinary journey begins and ends in the third-floor lounge, with canapés and dessert; the other courses are served in the dramatically lit space on the second floor. Nordic in origin with subtle Chinese influences, the seafood-heavy menu is served omakase style.

Name: Yue Hai Tang
Address: Vi Park, 161 Haowen Road, Minhang, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,China UnionPay,Foreign credit cards not accepted,Interesting wine list,Terrace,Wheelchair access
Description: Yue Hai Tang is the brainchild of an experienced chef who has worked in some of the most prestigious kitchens of Shanghai. His team, which has been with him for a long time, rustles up a wickedly enticing Cantonese barbecue. Besides the main menu, you will also see seasonal offerings and a selection of painstakingly crafted dishes, such as lobster and crab meat in pastry. The wine list boasts over 500 choices. Booking and pre-ordering dishes is recommended.

Name: T'ang Court
Address: 5F, The Langham, 99 Madang Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The dining room with six smartly dressed tables may seem a bit understated when compared to the opulent corridor of private rooms, but the charm and professionalism of the staff will soon put you at ease. From time to time, the head chef adds new items to the menu – fried dumplings stuffed with shrimp and crab meat are dainty packets of umami; wok-fried prawns in black soya sauce win diners’ hearts thanks to exquisite knife work and springy flesh.

Name: Fu 1015
Address: 1015 Yuyuan Road, Changning, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: The villa’s small rooms may be furnished in an old Shanghai style but the Shanghainese classics are given a fresh, new spin. Set menus are served and regulars usually have their menus custom-made when reserving a table. Specialities include braised rice with abalone and morels in a claypot with slivers of black truffle shaved on top when in season. ‘Tofu shrimp trio’ are shrimps, their roe and tomalley on a bed of tofu stewed in shrimp soup.

Name: New Wave by Da Vittorio Bistrot
Address: 3F, UCCA Edge, 88 North Xizang Road, Jingan, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Nestled in an iconic art museum, the bright, airy space has a retractable glass roof and arched windows. The menu showcases seasonal seafood from around the world, alongside fish from Fujian and veggies from Hainan. Italian favourites are served in rotation, while handmade tagliolini and the lobster dish are permanent fixtures. Passionate about cooking, the head chef deals with small farm owners in person to ensure quality and freshness.

Name: Lu Style (Huangpu)
Address: Room 207, 2F, Uni Elite, Lane 838, South Huangpi Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The head chef is a Shandong native who started his career at the age of 18 as an army chef. The season-driven menu features the freshest catch from Bohai Sea shipped in daily and the chef fine-tunes his recipes according to the season. ‘Jiaodong cold appetiser platter’ includes four kinds of seafood in different seasonings. Braised prawn with cabbage is enrobed in a rich, golden sauce made from their tomalley. Thoughtful service is also a plus.

Name: Fu 1088
Address: 375 Zhenning Road, Jingan, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: A beautiful tiled entrance, wood panelling and striking light fittings are just some of the original features of this 1920s townhouse. Its 16 traditionally furnished private rooms evoke old Shanghai charm. The food is equally sophisticated: river shrimp are made to order; the smoked mackerel belly dressed in a mildly sweet glaze is crisp but juicy. No meal here is complete without the cashew praline puff pastry.

Name: Il Bavaglino
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: Although this restaurant now occupies new premises in an old building once used for salting fish, its style of cuisine (featured on three tasting menus, “Storie e passioni”, “Mura di Casa”, and the vegetarian “Erba Terra Foglie”, from which dishes can also be chosen à la carte style) remains unchanged. Inspired by regional traditions, chef Giuseppe Costa creates personalised and imaginative dishes that are influenced by local flavours and his past culinary experience, proving himself to be equally at ease with fish and meat options. Our inspector particularly recommends the local purple prawns, served raw with caviar and olives and a lemon and ginger coulis.

Name: Nin
Address: via Zanardelli 5, Brenzone sul Garda, 37010, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Chef Terry Giacomello has taken inspiration from his travels around the world to create his NIN menu, while his CLASSICI option focuses on Italian favourites. His cuisine features a combination of modern techniques and classic influences, with an added dose of creativity and innovation. Although the first-floor dining room overlooks Lake Garda, only a fortunate few will have a table with a view, so booking in advance is recommended!

Name: Dalla Gioconda
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Between the blue sky and the Adriatic Sea, at the highest point of Gabicce Monte, Dalla Gioconda is the gourmet rebirth of a renowned dancing venue in the town. The design is warm, conceived and created with sustainability in mind. Thanks to a long experience at the Osteria Francescana of Massimo Bottura, the talented chef Davide Di Fabio creates precise and beautiful dishes, cooked with the best ingredients of the territory and of their own garden. The cellar hides real gems, and the summer terrace offers moments of sheer beauty.

Name: San Giorgio
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: An elegant restaurant boasting careful attention to detail in its decor, San Giorgio serves top-quality local fish alongside a few meat specialities such as foie gras and suckling pig. The cuisine here is Mediterranean in style and full of colour and flavour, while the warm, professional welcome offered by the Scala brothers adds to the appeal. With a wine list of the same high standard as the food, this is a restaurant to come back to!

Name: Kitchen
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Nestled amid the greenery of a private park, Kitchen is an elegant restaurant which serves creative Italian cuisine with a focus on seasonal ingredients and a perfect balance between produce, technique and flavour. The chef uses herbs and vegetables from the restaurant’s own biodynamic kitchen garden which can be seen in front of the entrance. This natural bounty provides the basis for the Green tasting menu; the other tasting menu is called Experience; there’s also an excellent à la carte. Service is attentive plus there’s an excellent selection of wines.

Name: Ca' Vittoria
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In the heart of this picture-postcard village, the Musso family has been welcoming guests with typical Piedmontese hospitality and professionalism for generations and delighting them with their interesting cuisine. Grandmother Gemma and mother Sandra always focused on regional traditions in their cooking; today, Massimiliano continues the theme while adding a touch of creativity and an international influence to his Piedmontese dishes. Examples include his innovative and original risotto cooked in onion water with eel and vanilla, and delicious Cherasco snails served with coconut cream, grilled home-grown leeks and fermented cabbage (the sweet flavour of the coconut provides a striking contrast to the acidity of the cabbage). There are just two tasting menus, from which dishes can also be chosen à la carte, plus a few classic favourites seasoned with white truffles (in season). The wine list features renowned Piedmontese labels alongside an array of younger wines, as well as a few bottles of Barolo from the 1970s.

Name: Cannavacciuolo Bistrot
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Although you’d expect a bistro to be relaxed and informal, this casually elegant restaurant just a stone’s throw from the Po river and the Gran Madre has a particularly lively atmosphere. Here, young chef Emin Haziri (formerly at Villa Crespi) serves meat and fish dishes that pay tribute to northern and southern Italy alike, offering cuisine that is inspired by the region, the Mediterranean and elsewhere in Italy with just the right amount of creative flair.

Name: Oro Restaurant
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Temporaly closed. For visitors not staying at the legendary Hotel Cipriani (home to Oro Restaurant), the excitement of this dining experience starts with your journey from St Mark’s Square. From here, the hotel’s private boat will take you to Giudecca island across one of the most spectacular corners of the lagoon which is overlooked by some of Venice’s most famous sights and monuments. Exploring and skilfully adapting nature’s incredible ingredients, the cuisine at Oro is certainly worthy of its magnificent setting.

Name: Alpenroyal Gourmet
Address: via Meisules 43, Selva di Val Gardena, 39048, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This is the gourmet restaurant at the hotel of the same name, one of the most luxurious in the Val Gardena. The elegant, contemporary dining room has an almost minimalist feel, with a softly lit ambience that would give the impression of a private home were it not for the huge garden (snow-covered in winter) visible through its windows. Although originally from Puglia, chef Mario Porcelli has been working in the Dolomites for many years and is equally at home with local dishes as he is with recipes from his native region. In both cases, his dishes are modern and beautifully presented in a manner that leaves nothing to chance.

Name: L’Alchimia
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The parquet floor, wood-beamed ceiling and exposed brickwork lend a warm ambience to this restaurant, which is bright and airy during the day and romantic in the evening thanks to its soft lighting. The cuisine here will appeal not necessarily for its creativity but for its honest dishes in which top-quality Italian ingredients are prepared with imagination, and occasionally transformed with intense flavours. Additional features include a small, beautiful brick-vaulted wine cellar (open to visitors), plus an adjacent bar-bistro which serves quick lunches and excellent aperitifs.

Name: I Castagni
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: In the countryside outside Vigevano, this rustic country house with a portico has the feel of a private villa, thanks to its antique furniture and paintings by local artists on the walls. For more than 30 years, Enrico Gerli, together with his wife front of house, has run this restaurant with dedication and professionalism, creating classic-modern cuisine which showcases the culinary traditions of Lombardy as well as a few fish-based dishes. A wine cellar home to around 600 labels from around the world adds to the appeal.

Name: Vintage 1997
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: A hushed, stylish restaurant with a red velvet decor and tables covered with immaculate tablecloths, Vintage 1997 is one of the region’s finest addresses and has hosted some of Turin’s most famous personalities over the years. The cuisine focuses on classic-regional dishes reinterpreted using contemporary cooking and preparation methods, especially on the Luna Park menu (book in advance), while the Punt e Mes, menu showcases the specialities of Piedmont to the full. In this region renowned for its meat dishes, the excellent em>Gran Crudo di Pesce (raw fish specialities) comes as a pleasant surprise. Champagnes and other non-Italian wines are imported directly from producers.

Name: Zum Löwen
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: A charming restaurant housed in a skilfully restored old farm, where everything from the hay barn to the old stalls has been refurbished and enhanced, so that traditional old features can be seen alongside more modern additions. The cuisine here is in the capable hands of owner Anna Matscher, who creates gourmet dishes from the Alto Adige which can by now be described as “classics”.
