The combination of ingredients and the cooking methods used appear to offer a certain level of comfort, although given the precise preparation involved this is hardly a flaw. Examples include the traditional roast goat kid cooked with extra-virgin olive oil and aromatic herbs, served with roast potatoes and a second seasonal vegetable, along with its own delicious jus. Luis oversees the front of house and is always available to offer recommendations for the best wine pairings.

Name: Carignano
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Davide Scabin, one of Piedmont’s most famous chefs who was also awarded two Michelin starts at his Rivoli restaurant, continues to reinvent and apply himself with as much enthusiasm as ever. His backdrop is one of the most prestigious hotels in Turin – the historic Grand Hotel Sitea – where he serves a tasting menu that is both bold and innovative, surprising guests with the order of courses: you start with intense flavours and the dishes become lighter as the meal progresses. Scabin offers a superb gastronomic experience on one long tasting menu that includes traditional Piedmontese recipes and more creative dishes, as well as the occasional more exotic influence.

Name: Condividere
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: “The enjoyment of eating” is the mantra of this restaurant, whose name (the Italian word for “to share”) refers to an original idea dreamt up by Lavazza in partnership with talented Spanish chef Ferran Adrià. At the helm here is Federico Zanasi, also from Spain, who focuses on two key elements in his cuisine, namely produce and technique. His menus I Classici, Festival, Gran Festival are served in a modern, contemporary-style dining room with a New York feel, created by the famous stage-designer Dante Ferretti, while the friendly, young and attentive staff are on hand to ensure that guests enjoy the experience to the full, accompanied by music in the background. Dessert and coffee are served in their own dedicated room.

Name: Magorabin
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The owner-chef at this restaurant focuses on recipes firmly rooted in local traditions, using ingredients sourced only in Piedmont. These are showcased on a single tasting menu (“Im-ma-gi-nà-re”) from which guests can choose either five or nine courses. A keen globetrotter, Marcello Trentini prepares regional dishes with a symphony of flavours and a rare combination of boldness, sensitivity, gourmet touches and techniques influenced by his many travels. Situated next to the restaurant, the “Casa Mago Lounge Bar” provides the perfect setting in which to enjoy top-notch cocktails accompanied by tapas and other delicious snacks prepared by the chef.

Name: La Primula
Address: via San Rocco 47, San Quirino, 33080, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated between Pordenone and Aviano in the magical Magredi region, this elegant restaurant – still run by the Canton family – celebrates its 150th birthday in 2023. The attractive, comfortable dining room is dominated by a fireplace and provides the setting for delicious meat and fish dishes prepared by Andrea Canton, whose cuisine is carefully prepared, occasionally imaginative and full of comforting flavours. The excellent wine is divided into three sections: one dedicated to the Friuli-Venezia Giulia region, another to Italy as a whole, and the third to the rest of the world. The same building houses the Osteria alle Nazioni (also open at lunchtimes), where the cuisine is inspired by regional traditions.

Name: Moma
Address: via di San Basilio 42, Rome, 00187, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Situated between Via Veneto and Piazza Barberini, Moma is a modern, multi-faceted restaurant that serves informal dishes at lunchtime and more creative traditional fare in the gourmet restaurant on the first floor, which also includes a small outdoor dining space that allows guests to make the most of Rome’s mild climate. The balance between textures and combinations and the attention paid to presentation and top-quality ingredients are the key features here, resulting in regionally inspired cuisine that also includes creative dishes such as risotto with camomile, smoked eel, honey and oregano. This focus on the region and its fine local producers is also evident on the wine list, which leans towards labels produced by small artisanal wineries. The young staff are attentive and keen to ensure that your evening is a resounding success.

Name: Al Metrò
Address: via Magellano 35, San Salvo Marina, 66050, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Housed in what was once the family pastry shop, this restaurant run by the Fossaceca brothers is elegant and minimalist in style with a charming outdoor space for summer dining. Nicola’s cuisine is prepared using the best fish from the Adriatic combined with other carefully chosen seasonal ingredients from the region. Traditional fish and seafood recipes from the Abruzzo and the wider Mediterranean combine with modern culinary techniques to create carefully prepared dishes that are full of surprisingly simple and direct flavours. The three tasting menus also feature local specialities, such as saffron from Aquila, garlic from Sulmona and fresh produce from local farms. Front of house, Antonio and his talented team provide attentive service, putting guests immediately at ease with their friendly yet formal approach. Last but not least, the excellent wine list demonstrates an obvious focus on the Abruzzo while also offering a selection of international labels.

Name: Campo del Drago
Address: Località Castiglion del Bosco, Montalcino, 53024, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: After travelling a white and dusty − although fascinating – road, surrounded by the typical Tuscan landscape, you will find an enchanting village of medieval origins with a tower and an ancient church, as well as the splendid hotel rooms. But above all one of the best restaurants in the area: chef Matteo Temperini offers one of the most interesting and creative readings of Tuscan cuisine, with various vegetables that grow in the property's garden. The dishes are served in a contemporary elegant room with a panoramic terrace, while the wine offer lists several house wines, including the Brunello di Montalcino Campo del Drago which gives its name to the restaurant.

Name: Arnaldo - Clinica Gastronomica
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This restaurant was first awarded a Michelin star in 1959, which makes it the longest-held star (with a break of only two years) in Italy. Housed in a 15C palazzo next to the Aquila d'Oro hotel, the dining room boasts an atmospheric and nostalgic feel. The cuisine has the same traditional focus and celebrates Emilian traditions in all their glory, especially on the trolleys used to display selections of antipasti (sliced ham always features, as does spinach and cheese pie), and desserts (including a delicious zabaione served with pear in red wine and a creamy Sambuca semifreddo. But the undisputed stars of the show are the meat dishes, especially the two trolleys of specialities that are the highlight of any visit to Arnaldo. These include roast and boiled meats, including dishes not often found in a restaurant of this quality, such as calf’s head, tongue and pig’s trotters, all cooked traditionally and served with the usual sauces and gravies. Every morning, the “sfogline” pasta-makers prepare excellent fresh pastas, which are served either in a broth or simply with sage and butter. Arnaldo is not a place for fans of modern cuisine but if you’re keen to try authentic Emilian dishes full of flavour, you’ll be in your element here!

Name: D.One Restaurant
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: The location of this restaurant is certainly unique, offering different spaces for different parts of your meal (aperitif, dinner, tastings etc). Here, chef Davide Pezzuto from Salento blends simplicity with creative experimentation, sourcing his fish from the nearby Adriatic and other ingredients from the restaurant’s own farm, including vegetables, wine, olive oil, cereals (ground in a water mill) and eggs. Demonstrating commendable personal involvement, the restaurant plays an important role in maintaining the gastronomic and historic traditions of the small town. The wine selection is also unusual: although it’s presented in the traditional way, it also highlights some of the local area’s “heroic” producers.

Name: Locanda Margon
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Young chef Edoardo Fumagalli arrived in the small town of Ravina with plenty of international experience behind him. Now in his third year at the famous Locanda Margon, a restaurant with views of Trento and the Adige valley, he puts all his heart, energy and creativity into three tasting menus (one of which has been designed to combine perfectly with the Ferrari sparkling wine made by the winery that owns the restaurant). His menus showcase local ingredients, which he prepares with technical expertise, occasionally combining them with produce from other parts of Italy. Although the adjacent Bistrot is designed to be more informal in character, it offers the attraction of reliable Italian cuisine and the option of dining alfresco.

Name: Amistà
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Occupying a corner of the stunning Hotel Byblos, this restaurant is similar in style to the rest of the hotel with its colourful and harmonious blend of the old and the new, inspired by a real love of art. Echoing the decor, the cuisine served here plays with a combination of the traditional and the modern. The chef adds his own creative touches and interpretations to traditional recipes on three tasting menus which feature alternating meat and fish dishes, although guests can switch between the menus and dishes, giving them more freedom of choice. The interesting wine list includes a choice of excellent wines by the glass.

Name: sui generis.
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A modern dining room with an open-view kitchen where young Alfio Nicolosi can be observed at work, ably assisted by friendly and attentive staff front of house. When you book, you’ll be asked to choose from two tasting menus, both of which reveal exciting dishes as the evening unfolds. The chef’s cuisine is inspired by his remarkable knowledge of culinary traditions from Italy and further afield (strong Asian and South American influences are obvious), resulting in highly personalised dishes. Nicolosi is one of the most interesting young chefs in Italy at the moment and his exciting cuisine is full of intense flavours, including grilled dishes with a hint of street food and other influences apparent throughout.

Name: La Coldana
Address: Cascina Coldana, via del Costino, Lodi, 26900, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Housed in an old 18C farmhouse on the outskirts of the town on the edge of the countryside, La Coldana is run by two young business partners (recently joined by the young chef Alessandro Proietti Refrigeri) who have gradually transformed it over the years into an eatery serving top-quality and distinctive cuisine, with some dishes now established as iconic favourites. Examples include the “turnips, roots and vegetables” dish made from over 30 varieties prepared in different ways and accompanied, as recommended by the chef, by mallow kombucha. There are three tasting menus available, one of which offers a selection of surprise dishes chosen by the chef.

Name: Horto
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Norbert Niederkofler’s arrival in Milan is accompanied by his strong commitment to the environment. The cuisine here is in the capable hands of Alberto Toè, who offers two tasting menus with a focus on locally sourced ingredients (all from within an hour of the city). The outdoor terraces are an added attraction, boasting fine views which extend from the Duomo to the Castello Sforzesco, and are the perfect setting for an aperitif from the restaurant’s extensive cocktail list. The interior dining room has a simple yet elegant feel thanks to its natural-wood tables, making it a good choice for a gourmet supper or a simpler and more casual lunch.

Name: Fradis Minoris
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Originally from Sardinia, chef Francesco Stara has returned home to his native island where he focuses on completely “circular” cuisine in this restaurant situated in a protected marine area. The fish is either local or from the Nora lagoon, which also provides the chef with a selection of wild herbs, while the vegetables are sourced from small-scale producers in nearby Campidano. On its two tasting menus (one fish and seafood, the other vegetarian), this excellent restaurant focuses on the best possible seasonal ingredients, as well as protecting the environment and showcasing the island’s traditions in its new, contemporary-style cuisine. Friendly, attentive service and a wine list featuring several regional labels complete the picture.

Name: La Torre
Address: strada Spicciano 7, Tavarnelle Val di Pesa, 50028, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Il Castello del Nero, the spectacular 12C residence that is home to this restaurant, stands in a magical location that includes many of the attractions that make Tuscany such a special place to visit – a breathtaking view from its summer terrace, an elegant dining room full of history, and top-quality ingredients such as extra-virgin olive oil and wine (the attractive wine cellar boasts a generous selection of the latter). However, the main attraction here is the excellent cuisine made by friendly chef Di Pirro, which is technical, creative and at the same time full of flavour, and always beautifully presented as befits the charming setting. The property is home to a kitchen garden (cultivated organically although as yet not certified organic) which boasts up to 10 varieties of tomato alongside a number of fruit trees. The restaurant offers three menus: the “Evoluzione Vegetali” vegetarian option; “La Terra”, in which meat dishes take pride of place; and “Il Mare”, featuring fish and seafood specialities. Last but not least, the dessert menu is striking for its extraordinarily imaginative sweets, as well as delicacies such as mini cakes, chocolates and macaroons served with your coffee.

Name: La Favellina
Address: via Cosari 4/6, località San Tomio, Malo, 36034, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Signora Gianello fell in love with this delightful late-19C hamlet surrounded by the green hills north of Vicenza and bought a restaurant here, which she has renovated in an elegant, feminine style. She now runs the restaurant with her two sons: Riccardo front of house and Federico in the kitchen with his mother (the latter responsible for the delicious first courses!). The cuisine here is predominantly contemporary Italian, prepared from top-quality ingredients often sourced from the area immediately around the restaurant. Sweet chestnuts, virgin olive oil, strawberry tree berries, aromatic and even wild herbs are gathered personally by the chefs from the local area. Simple, modern cuisine which is full of flavour.

Name: Josè Restaurant - Tenuta Villa Guerra
Address: via Nazionale 414, Torre del Greco, 80059, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Leaving the traffic behind, you enter the beautifully tended gardens of this 18C villa, a reminder of the splendour of the “Golden Mile” and its luxurious residences. This golden age is now brought back to life in the kitchens of Josè restaurant, where Domenico Iavarone serves delicious cuisine inspired by the traditions of Campania, to which he occasionally adds his own imaginative twist. Browsing the menu, you’ll find many tempting options, often based on vegetables, including some excellent pasta dishes. In summer, a simpler menu featuring grilled dishes and pizzas is served in the villa gardens. The “Bourbon” wine cellar (as historic as the villa itself) houses an extensive wine selection, some also available by the glass.

Name: Il Ristorante di Guido da Costigliole
Address: località San Maurizio 39, Santo Stefano Belbo, 12058, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in a panoramic location surrounded by beautiful rolling hills, this restaurant occupies an old 17C monastery which has been converted into one of the region’s most elegant and exclusive hotels, namely the Relais San Maurizio. Here, Andrea Alciati continues with the story started by his parents, Guido and Lidia who, in 1961, opened a restaurant in Costigliole d’Asti which in a short space of time revolutionised and redefined modern Piedmontese cuisine. In 2022 Fabio Sgrò took the helm of the kitchen and joined the "Alciati project" with awareness and respect for family traditions. He continues to serve time-honoured local favourites such as ravioli del plin al sugo d’arrosto (a dish which made Lidia famous around the world) alongside more creative options. The wine list is as impressive as the cuisine, offering an extensive selection which includes a huge choice of wines by the glass.

Name: All'Oro
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated within The H’All Tailor Suite, a smart “tailor-made” hotel which offers its guests bespoke services, this restaurant boasts a pleasantly sophisticated New York-style dining room plus a second room with a vaguely English decor, both of which serve as a setting for creative Italian cuisine. Chef Riccardo Di Giacinto’s culinary philosophy can be summed up in three adjectives: sincere, delicious and tenacious! The extensive and carefully chosen wine selection favours the regions of Piedmont and Tuscany. Enjoy alfresco dining in the welcoming outdoor All’Aria.in summer.

Name: Lanterna Verde
Address: frazione San Barnaba 7, Villa di Chiavenna, 23029, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Thanks to its fireplace, the welcoming, classic-style dining room at this restaurant is perfect for winter dining, while its garden terrace attracts guests in summer. Whatever time of year you visit, you’ll enjoy cuisine which balances traditional recipes with more contemporary options, with a focus on local ingredients, especially fish from the lake. The Tonola family at the helm have been renowned throughout the province (and further afield) for their gourmet cuisine and welcoming hospitality for over 40 years. Their appeal is even greater today, thanks to young chef Roberto who provides a skilful modern touch in the kitchen, while his experienced parents oversee the front of house and make helpful wine recommendations.

Name: La Capinera
Address: via Nazionale 177, località Spisone, Taormina, 98039, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: “My cuisine reflects my region”, says owner-chef Pietro D’Agostino, “It’s full of sunshine, fresh, influenced by tradition and yet at the same time modern.” Our inspectors came to a similar conclusion: they describe this chef’s cuisine as innovative yet with regional roots, and his constant search for the best ingredients as endearingly obsessive. Fresh fish, locally grown vegetables, various types of local olive oil and snail caviar all feature on the menu which has a real Slow Food focus. The beautiful terrace overlooking the Ionian Sea adds to the appeal, as does the wine list which is impressive and surprising in equal measure.

Name: Sadler
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: A stronghold of Milanese cuisine for over 30 years, Sadler now has a new location in the Casa Baglioni hotel, a beautiful Art Nouveau-style building dating from 1913. The restaurant has a contemporary feel with an elegant dining room featuring colourful armchairs. The cuisine is precise and distinctive, with a harmonious balance of traditional and innovative flavours as well as top-quality ingredients. The wine list is also top of the range, featuring excellent Italian and international wines, including some rare and interesting labels. Although the menu at midday is lighter, the cuisine is of the same high quality.

Name: Guido
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Although from the outside this looks like a simple private beach club with views of the sea in the distance, the interior reveals an unexpected and hushed elegance. Guests flock to Guido’s for its excellent fish and seafood: the dishes sound simple on the menu, yet are actually refined, elegant and beautifully prepared, celebrating the Adriatic in all its glory, with a focus on top-quality fish dishes. The menu features long-established classics (“canocchia si ricorda il gratin”) alongside new dishes such as the pizza ai frutti di mare which are themselves destined to become staples here. There’s a good choice of sparkling wines, as well as a focus on excellent whites and renowned reds.

Name: Abocar Due Cucine
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Abocar (the word is Spanish for “to get closer”) demonstrates the Argentine origins of this restaurant’s young chef , who aims to offer his guests reasonably priced gourmet cuisine. Seasonal produce and South American influences are to the fore here, resulting in excellent cuisine focused around just a handful of recipes.The dishes are creative, yet with their roots in the classic foundations in which the young chef was trained in Michelin-starred restaurants in France, Spain and Italy – it was during this apprenticeship that he met his partner, Camilla, who assists him in the kitchen as well as overseeing the front of house. This welcoming restaurant hidden among the streets of old Rimini boasts a charming, youthful and unique atmosphere which is far from stuffy and which makes it an excellent choice.

Name: Vecchia Malcesine
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in a tranquil spot above Malcesine yet not far from the centre, this restaurant boasts fine views of much of Lake Garda. Originally from the Alto Adige, chef Leandro Luppi has been creating superb cuisine in this region for over 20 years and is now at the helm in the kitchen here. Renowned for his culinary skills and imagination, he offers three creative and highly personal tasting menus, one of which is entirely vegetarian. Most of the chef’s ingredients are sourced from the local region, while his legendary ability to transform fresh fish into delicious dishes remains unchanged.

Name: L'Erba del Re
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated in a period palazzo near one of Modena’s oldest churches (the façade of Santa Maria della Pomposa dates from the medieval period and the church was rebuilt in 1717), this bright, modern and minimalist restaurant has just a few tables set some distance apart and is adorned with contemporary paintings on its walls. Talented chef Luca Marchini focuses mainly on creative cuisine, although fans of more traditional fare will also find a few Emilian specialities on the menu. The excellent sommelier is also able to recommend interesting and rare wines from small-scale wineries, including from outside Italy and often by the glass.

Name: Gagini Restaurant
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in the lively heart of Palermo between the Vucciria and the small Cala port, this restaurant boasts a modern design and bold colours which are all the more striking for the charming old building which it occupies, the 16C studio of sculptor Antonello Gagini. The Italian-Brazilian chef Mauricio Zillo settled in Palermo after stints working in restaurants around Europe. His cuisine is highly personal, yet well-balanced and rich in flavours – not surprising, given his past experience and his dual nationality! The service is elegant and attentive yet with an informal touch that puts guests at their ease, while the carefully compiled wine list includes several labels produced by small local wineries.

Name: Stube Hermitage
Address: via Castelletto Inferiore 69, Madonna di Campiglio, 38086, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated in a tranquil and secluded location, this restaurant occupies an early-19C Stube-style dining room in the Biohotel Hermitage. Decorated with a profusion of wood and home to just a few tables, the setting is perfect for a romantic evening with a focus on fine dining. During the 2022-23 winter season, young Antonio Lepore (the former sous-chef here) took over the reins in the kitchen, where he now feels free to explore new ideas and fully express his personality on various tasting menus. Elegance is the key word here, both in the ambience and the cuisine. The excellent selection of cheeses is also worthy of note.

Name: Relais Blu
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Partially hidden along the road, this restaurant is accessed via a short descent which leads you to a breathtaking terrace boasting views of Capri and the Faraglioni rocks, Ischia, Procida, Naples and Vesuvius, all of which seem to be reflected in the beautiful Bay of Naples. In this stunning setting, Alberto Annarumma creates cuisine which is both new and traditional, regional and creative, in dishes which have solid Italian roots with the occasional nod to France and Japan. The chef’s surrounding area is a constant inspiration to him, and he even tends a kitchen garden in the hotel grounds – its citrus fruit, aromatic and wild herbs are liberally used in his recipes. There’s also an excellent selection of regional wines, a good choice of wines available by the glass, plus a fine array of liqueurs and Cuban cigars.

Name: Indaco
Address: piazza Santa Restituta 1, Lacco Ameno, 80076, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Housed in a long-established hotel (the Regina Isabella was founded in the 1950s by a famous publisher), Indaco adds to Ischia’s appeal thanks to its elegant atmosphere (there’s also a romantic candlelit lounge where guests can enjoy a coffee or digestif) and its top-quality gourmet cuisine. Overlooking one of the island’s most enchanting bays, the restaurant is home to chef Pasquale Palamaro (a native of Ischia) who takes guests on a culinary journey inspired by his love of the sea. The chef’s past experience and his passion for fish has led him to focus solely on fish-based cuisine. Starting with his dishes of dry-cured fish and seafood, you’ll enjoy an array of delicious dishes which combine flavour and creativity. Enjoy the best of the sea without getting your feet wet!

Name: Accursio
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated near the Duomo di San Pietro and the central Corso Umberto, this small, delightful restaurant occupies a historic palazzo and boasts a simple yet elegant decor including attractive floor tiles. Accursio offers three tasting menus with dishes also available à la carte. The restaurant’s symbol (an olive tree inside a boat) gives a good indication of the culinary focus here, namely a creative journey through Sicily’s cuisine on a menu that features both meat and fish options.

Name: Sarri
Address: lungomare C. Colombo 108, Borgo Prino, Imperia, 18100, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: One of the best Michelin-starred addresses in the region, this attractive restaurant is situated in the charming Borgo Prino, a row of houses facing the sea and painted in the pastel shades typical of the region. Liguria’s legendary mild climate means that meals can often be enjoyed outdoors, but if that’s not an option there’s also a charming dining room in an old warehouse decorated in impeccable contemporary style. The faultless, elegant service here is overseen with skill and charm by the chef’s wife Alessandra. We’ve left the real reason for our enthusiasm until last: owner-chef Andrea Sarri delights guests with his superb cuisine, which features light and imaginative reinterpretations of Ligurian fish and seafood specialities, inspired by the extraordinary quality of his ingredients. Examples include a perfect yet simple shellfish casserole, as well as his raw fish dish with black garlic from Vessalico and other Ligurian flavours.

Name: Signum
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in the Aeolian Islands, this charming inn is home to young chef Martina Caruso who, having practically grown up here, has returned home to take up the reins at Signum after formative experiences elsewhere. Today, this young chef leads a team of nine in the kitchen, while her brother manages the charming hotel built to resemble a typical Aeolian hamlet. Martina knows exactly how to bring out the best of the vibrant ingredients sourced from the region, her own kitchen garden and the nearby sea – she allows the power of these ingredients to shine forth yet manages to make light and playful use of their intense flavours, showcasing their qualities instead of trying to hide them. Luca and cousin Raffaele enhance this gourmet experience with excellent wines (some home-produced), also available by the glass, and superb cocktails.

Name: Il Flauto di Pan
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: It would be no exaggeration to say that this restaurant (part of the Villa Cimbrone hotel) is situated in one of the most romantic and exclusive spots in Italy, surrounded by luxuriant Mediterranean vegetation and with stunning views of the Gulf of Salerno. Once at the restaurant, you make your way to the terrace, where views of the sea with the Cilento mountains in the distance are framed by a beautiful wisteria. The chef from Campania offers guests a superb selection of local produce, prepared in traditional and reinterpreted dishes that are full of the intense and explosive flavours of this extraordinary region. Make sure you book a table in advance!

Name: Gellius
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: Gellius boasts a unique and atmospheric setting within the Antica Opitergium museum, surrounded by archaeological remains that tell the story of the town from the beginning of the Roman period. It’s just a short hop from this historic past to the present day, where chef Alessandro Breda moves away from the culinary traditions of the region to create imaginative meat and fish dishes using ingredients from his surrounding area and the Adriatic Sea. The same ambience can be enjoyed at the Nyù bistro, which serves light lunches and more elaborate dinners. If you’re looking for a state-of-the-art cocktail or a glass of good wine, make your way to the Lounge Bar, which looks out over Piazza Grande.

Name: Le Trabe
Address: via Capo di Fiume 4, Paestum, 84047, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The source of the Trabe river lies in the grounds of this restaurant (hence its name), from where it gushes into a small lake and then flows silently alongside the outdoor tables, creating a delightful space for summer dining. In addition to this beautiful setting, the restaurant also offers inviting dining rooms and champions an environmentally friendly approach, adopting various sustainable practices. However, more than anything it is Marci Rispo’s cuisine that is truly memorable. Whichever of the two tasting menus you choose, your fine-dining experience will start with a welcome aperitif and canapés offered by the chef in the beautiful wine cellar. Once at your table, you’ll enjoy a series of elegant dishes which are full of flavour, inspired by the culinary traditions of Campania and made from seasonal, regional ingredients such as the famous mozzarella di bufala, including the spaghetti dish known as “Bufala, bufala, bufala”. An excellent wine list and attentive service complete the picture.

Name: Schöneck
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: With over 30 years’ experience behind them, the Baumgartner brothers’ restaurant is an excellent choice for classic specialities from the Alto Adige, offering a menu that focuses on regional dishes yet also includes a few fish-based options. The most important feature here is that all specialities are made from top-quality ingredients (often locally sourced), prepared by chef Karl with an expertise that ignores modern trends and passing fashions. Meals are served in rooms that are elegantly decorated with local wood, including a beautiful lounge space with a piano in front of the bar, Stube-style dining rooms and a veranda, while in summer the cool, shady terrace is particularly appealing. Last but not least, the excellent wine list is as impressive as the cuisine.

Name: Lido 84
Address: corso Zanardelli 196, Fasano del Garda, 25083, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Once you’ve left your car in the car park, a slight descent leads to this small corner of paradise boasting one of the most beautiful views of Lake Garda. Run by two brothers (one in the kitchen, the other front of house), this elegant restaurant is striking for its many decorative details. The cuisine here is full of flavour, with generous portions that give the impression that every meal at Lido 84 is Sunday lunch – joyous, festive and served in a relaxed and informal atmosphere. There’s also plenty of contact with the chefs, who often bring the dishes to the tables themselves. For a special occasion, we recommend booking the table in the small stone building in the splendid garden, with its classic decor and breathtaking views.

Name: Villa Maiella
Address: via Sette Dolori 30, località Villa Maiella, Guardiagrele, 66016, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Way back in 1966, Ginetta and Arcangelo probably never dreamed for a moment that their modest tavern would become so famous. Nowadays, the Tinari family comprises mother-and-son Angela and Arcangelo in the kitchen, and Peppino and Pascal front of house, all of whom offer guests a warm welcome in their restaurant on the edge of the Parco della Maiella. Here, you’ll enjoy authentic Abruzzo dishes with the occasional surprising and creative twist on three tasting menus (chosen when you make your booking). A good choice also for beer-lovers, with over a thousand different labels available including a wide selection by the glass.

Name: Berton
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated in the heart of Porta Nuova, this restaurant has one wall made entirely of glass, allowing plenty of daylight to permeate its elegant, contemporary-style dining room which is perfectly in tune with the character of this new, futuristic district. The cuisine here continues to focus on just a few ingredients, so that it is deliberately simple in style without being minimalist. Creative and modern, the dishes are prepared with ingredients from all over Italy with no particular emphasis on any one region: the same is true of the excellent wine list. Professional, attentive and efficient service completes the picture.

Name: Il Convivio Troiani
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A long-established restaurant that was opened in the early 1990s by three brothers from the Marche: Angelo in the kitchen, and Giuseppe and Massimo front of house. Since then, this restaurant has become one of Rome’s leading restaurants thanks to its personalised cuisine with influences from Lazio and elsewhere in Italy, with more traditional dishes served alongside recipes reinterpreted with imagination, flair and the occasional bold twist. The excellent wine list boasts around 3 600 labels (wines and spirits), including fine vintages and a good selection of wines by the glass.

Name: Nostrano
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated just a few metres from the famous spherical sculpture by Arnaldo Pomodoro, this welcoming restaurant is now even more appealing following its recent refurbishment. Here, owner-chef Stefano Ciotti serves highly individualised cuisine which has its roots firmly in local traditions (the word “nostrano” means local or home-grown), combining modern techniques with regional flavours and ingredients from the Marche and Romagna on a menu that embraces fish and meat dishes alike. The excellent wine selection includes labels from all over Italy, including wines by the glass and even a few cocktails.

Name: La Pineta
Address: via dei Cavalleggeri Nord 27, Marina di Bibbona, 57020, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: You pass through a pine forest to get here, taking your car almost as far as the shoreline where you arrive at the long-established fish restaurant run by the Zazzeri family, housed in what at first appears to be an ordinary private beach club. Picture windows offer views of the waves lapping on the beach, while at lunchtime in summer there are sunshades and bathers on the beach, with the ebb and flow of the sea providing an expanse of blue in the background. The menu here features classic Tuscan and Italian dishes, all prepared using traditional methods: irrespective of whether you prefer your fish raw, grilled, steamed or baked, the quality is paramount. The atmosphere here is so relaxing that you’ll find yourself in no hurry to leave!

Name: Massimo Camia
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In this restaurant decorated with modern furnishings, the attention is drawn to the picture windows which offer fine views of the La Morra hills and surrounding countryside. Massimo Camia’s menu includes classic favourites from his much-loved repertoire, plus a few elegant dishes and some fish specialities. The excellent selection of Piedmontese cheese is also worth a mention, as is the extensive choice of Barolo wines on the wine list.

Name: Il Piastrino
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The home of Riccardo and Claudia, Il Piastrino is situated amid the beautiful Montefeltro hills. A long-held dream for this couple, which they nurtured during their formative years working in various Michelin-starred restaurants, the restaurant was finally opened in 2007. Beautifully looked after and embellished with each passing year, the house now boasts a magnificent contemporary decor that is in total harmony with the warm rustic nature of its surroundings. The restaurant’s crowning glory is Agostino’s technical, creative cuisine, which showcases the best seasonal ingredients, often sourced from the local region. This chef’s dishes are a feast for the eyes and the palate, often complex and elaborate in style yet never overly artificial.

Name: Aroma
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The open-view kitchen is the first thing guests see when they arrive at this delightful restaurant boasting views of Ancient Rome from the Colosseum to the dome of St Peter’s – a truly memorable sight! The name pays tribute to both the city and the aromas imbued in the Mediterranean cuisine served here. Local specialities also feature on the menu, often with a touch of creativity added by chef Giuseppe Di Iorio. The Aroma Bistrò next door overlooks the Parco del Colle Oppio and serves simpler, quicker versions of the dishes offered at the main restaurant.

Name: Paolo e Barbara
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Paolo and Barbara have been serving excellent cuisine in San Remo since 1987, demonstrating a real passion for local ingredients and regional specialities. This interest has culminated in kitchen gardens that now provide most of the ingredients used in their dishes, including eggs, olive oil and a small amount of wine. Along with top-quality fish, vegetables form the basis of western Liguria’s cuisine, which Paolo combines in his reinterpretations of traditional recipes. His style is showcased in dishes such as cappelletti (a type of egg ravioli) filled with San Remo crayfish and served with a vegetable and Abruzzo saffron broth, an elegant dish that is full of flavour. Barbara oversees the service front of house and provides guests with wine recommendations.

Name: Antica Osteria Nonna Rosa
Address: via Laudano 1, loc. Pietrapiana, Vico Equense, 80060, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The dining room at this restaurant has the warm ambience of an old country house, where two small niches with their own tables are perfect for a more private and romantic dinner. The decor includes dove-coloured walls, an array of lamps and even a typical nativity scene in which the chef and his mother (“Nonna Rosa”) make an appearance. The cuisine is original and creative with its roots in local traditions, and is prepared using ingredients from Campania and the restaurant’s own kitchen garden. Some years ago, owner-chef Giuseppe Guida purchased a large garden where he now grows all the vegetables used in his dishes. The restaurant describes its cuisine as “An exciting discovery of flavours from bygone days, with imaginative touches that are fully respectful of local traditions.”.

Name: La Speranzina Restaurant & Relais
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A romantic, Mediterranean-style restaurant in the heart of Sirmione, La Speranzina has an elegant and minimalist-style decor in which light, discreet colours dominate in the comfortable dining room, while in summer the terrace boasts spectacular views of the lake and castle (a few of the tables stand right over the water). Whether you choose fish, meat or vegetables, Fabrizio Molteni creates dishes with excellent technique and precision, as you would expect from one of master-chef Gualtiero Marchesi’s last students (Marchesi himself is mentioned in some of the dishes). There is also an option to head into the kitchen, where you can watch the chefs prepare either your main course or dessert. A superbly stocked wine cellar, with an excellent choice of champagnes and renowned labels, and three stunning panoramic suites complete the picture.

Name: Imàgo
Address: piazza Trinità dei Monti 6, Rome, 00187, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Imàgo, the panoramic restaurant at the beautiful Hassler hotel (which stands at the top of the famous Spanish Steps in Piazza di Spagna), provides the stunning setting for young chef Andrea Antonini, who creates beautifully presented and imaginative cuisine inspired by ingredients and traditions from Italy (and occasionally Lazio). Antonini recommends his “blind” tasting menu, which selects what he considers to be the best dishes from his à la carte. The extensive and well-chosen wine list includes a good selection of non-Italian wines, with a particular focus on France, while the superb views of Rome are the icing on the cake, contributing to what is an elegant and unforgettable dining experience. Excellent service completes the picture.

Name: Re Maurì
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in the Lloyd’s Baia hotel between Salerno and Vietri, in an elevated location overlooking the port, this restaurant offers splendid views of the bay from the floor-to-ceiling windows in the dining room which become even more stunning from the terrace where meals are served in fine weather. Specialities from Campania feature on the menu alongside dishes with a more international influence and ingredients from outside the region. Make sure you leave space for dessert: the cook worked as a pastry chef before coming here and the care he takes with his desserts is truly remarkable.

Name: Osteria Altran
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated in a small village about 40km from Trieste, the Osteria Altran offers gourmet cuisine surrounded by the verdant landscapes of the Friuli countryside. In what was once a simple farm, owner Guido Lanzellotti has brought this seemingly rustic yet delightfully romantic restaurant to life, creating modern cuisine that focuses on top-quality ingredients and careful preparation. The new lounge-cum-library adorned with cookery books is available for small private events as well as pre-dinner or post-dinner drinks.

Name: Due Camini
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This is the most romantic restaurant in the Borgo Egnazia resort, where the soft candlelight creates a hushed, magical atmosphere that makes it perfect for a special occasion, dinner with a loved one, or simply a gourmet meal. Enjoy excellent service as you embark on a gastronomic journey that introduces you to specialities from chef Domingo Schingaro’s Puglia, dishes inspired by the region, and recipes influenced by the wider Mediterranean (depending on the menu). Many of the ingredients are sourced from the hotel’s own kitchen garden.

Name: Dolce Stil Novo alla Reggia
Address: piazza della Repubblica 4, Venaria Reale, 10078, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Housed inside the Torrione del Garove, this restaurant boasts an attractive terrace overlooking the Reggia di Venaria gardens with their geometrically sculpted bushes and hedges, as well as the palace’s Court of Honour. Here, chef Alfredo Russo serves regional cuisine with a modern and appealing touch, surprising guests with the occasional fish and seafood speciality on a culinary journey that spans Piedmont to southern Italy. Don’t miss the imaginative and carefully prepared desserts, while the well-structured wine list (on an iPad) also includes a good selection by the glass.

Name: RistoranTino & C.
Address: strada principale 63, frazione Rollieres, Sauze di Cesana, 10054, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Notable sake list,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: An elegant Alpine-style ambience in a beautiful stone building on the road to Sestrière, where Martino and Chiara offer a warm welcome to guests and serve contemporary-style cuisine with a modern twist. In addition to the good selection of wines (around 300 different labels), there is also a choice of special beers and saké.

Name: Romano
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Opened in 1966, Romano is a real culinary institution in the Versilia region, serving cuisine made from top-quality ingredients, with a particular focus on local fish. Although its philosophy has not changed over the years, current chef Nicola Gronchi should be applauded for adding a hint of contemporary flavour and technical expertise to the cuisine, while still retaining everything that this restaurant does best, namely serving fish of the highest quality (there are also a few meat dishes), including the occasional typical Versilian recipe.

Name: La Tana Gourmet
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Once a mountain refuge, the red house that overlooks this plateau is now home to one of the most interesting and avant-garde gourmet restaurants in Italy. Founder Alessandro Dal Degan, who offers a long surprise tasting menu (a culinary voyage, as he calls it), will take you on a journey through his beloved mountains, the Adriatic and beyond. Entrust yourself to his care in a spirit of curiosity and openness and prepare to explore new horizons. Dishes often include combinations that will sound unusual to you, but instead of picking these apart and thinking about the individual components, try to savour their complex, contrasting and yet harmonious flavours. As a result, this new and extraordinary experience will introduce you to some remarkable and occasionally unforgettable dishes. In addition to the musical backdrop (which provides the perfect soundtrack to the cuisine), special mention should be made of the wine pairings that come courtesy of business partner Enrico Maglio, who oversees the carefully researched and surprising wine list. The partnership with various local suppliers, which helps to showcase the region’s produce, is also highly commendable.

Name: Osteria del Povero Diavolo
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant is situated in a picture-postcard setting in the foothills of Romagna, offering views of the gently rolling hills and San Marino perched on a mountain top just a few kilometres away. Here, a young chef is at the helm, breathing new life into this long-established restaurant with his creative cuisine. Meat and fish dishes feature on the 8-course menu, all prepared using local ingredients. A delightful outdoor dining space and welcoming guestrooms complete the picture.

Name: Maeba Restaurant
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Housed in a beautifully restored olive oil mill dating from the 18C and situated in the countryside just outside Ariano Irpino, this restaurant is an unlikely find in this mountainous region – elegant, decorated in contemporary style and with a menu featuring regional cuisine as well as fish and seafood dishes, all of which are decidedly modern in flavour. Good selection of wines and spirits.

Name: Contraste
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: When you make a reservation at this restaurant, you’re invited to choose between two tasting menus which are described in inspirational terms rather than in detail. The surprise continues at your table, which is laid out in a splendid dining room with historic features, and where the courses arrive unannounced in a long succession of dishes made from ingredients that often imitate other ingredients – the result is playful, surprising cuisine that is truly extraordinary. Chef Matias Perdomo also revives the South American tradition of grilling which results in dishes full of flavour. The grand finale is a delicious rose cake, plus an impressive selection of digestifs to bring the spectacle to a conclusion.

Name: Casa Iozzìa
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in the countryside outside Viterbo, this restaurant boasts a minimalist design featuring neutral colours, just a few tables and a large fireplace. Chef Lorenzo Iozzia, who was born in Lentini in Sicily and has been in Viterbo for three decades, creates modern and creative cuisine with a strong focus on his native island. He admits that his connection with Sicily is still strong, as demonstrated by the typical Sicilian ingredients (fish, almonds, carob, prickly pear, oranges etc) used in his dishes. On the floor below, the Osteria Basilicò serves traditional Sicilian specialities, plus a selection of main courses cooked over the charcoal grill.

Name: Guidoristorante
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Lidia and Guido Alciati opened their restaurant in 1961, and Italian cuisine has not been the same since – their hard work signalled the beginning of a real change which revolutionised cooking in Italy. They were among the first to understand the importance of regional ingredients, sourcing excellent produce which Lidia then showcased in her superb dishes, while Guido was responsible for the attentive service and excellent wine list. Their teachings live on in the sumptuous dining rooms in Villa Fontanafredda, where their children continue the culinary traditions established by their parents. Ugo’s sensitive skills in the kitchen and Piero’s experience front of house contribute to the success of this restaurant, where the best food and wine from the region is served in deceptively simple dishes that have few equals. One of the highlights is the plin (stuffed agnolotti pasta closed with a “pinch” by Lidia), which has drawn visitors here from all around the world and which is as delicious as ever – the pasta is stuffed with meat and vegetables and served with a velvety meat sauce.

Name: Sissi
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Situated just outside the pedestrianised area of beautiful Merano, the main dining room of this restaurant has a welcoming feel and is decorated in attractive Art-Nouveau style. Here, owner-chef Andrea Fenoglio divides his time between the kitchen and front of house so that he can take time to chat with guests. His cuisine has solid classic foundations, with a good choice of dishes on the à la carte, plus a surprise tasting menu (Settepiatti ) which changes every year (as does the ceramic tableware on which it is served!). The cuisine is comforting and full of generous flavours, to which Fenoglio adds a light modern touch with his carefully chosen accompaniments and presentation. Whatever dish you choose, you can be sure of finding the perfect wine pairing for your meal on the skilfully constructed wine list.

Name: Bros'
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Bros' is a synonym for a young, free spirit which is full of creativity and imagination: Floriano Pellegrino and Isabella Potì make the most of their extraordinary energy on two tasting menus that range from 20 to 25 small courses (note that the restaurant no longer offers an à la carte) which can be “tracked” in advance through a QR code. Their cuisine features innovative and surprising tasting dishes – many of which are finished with a theatrical flourish at your table – all the way through to the excellent desserts. To a background of modern music, guests are guided on a no-holds-barred journey through the personal gastronomic world of two exciting chefs. An interesting wine list which includes a selection of organic and biodynamic labels, and excellent service complete the picture.

Name: Il Marin
Address: Porto Antico, Edificio Millo, Genoa, 16121, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated at the old port, in the same building and on the same floor as Eataly, this restaurant is simple in style so that nothing detracts from the view through its floor-to-ceiling windows. The cuisine focuses on regional traditions while reinterpreting these with modern ideas and techniques. Examples include a “spaghetti Martini cocktail”, which is shaken at your table by the chef and made with Martini bitters and creamed olives flavoured with a misted extra virgin Taggiasca gin, and tortelli with a sauce made with fishheads, guts and bones and a pleasant hint of marjoram to add a final touch of flavour.

Name: Il Faro di Capo d'Orso - Andrea Aprea
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Although it’s almost hidden from the road, once you step out of your car and head down the steps into this restaurant, you’ll be greeted by one of the most breathtaking views of the Amalfi Coast, which takes in Ravello, Amalfi and, on clear days, even Capri’s Faraglioni rocks. The three tasting menus on offer here feature technical, complex and experimental dishes with a focus on local and regional ingredients, often from the Amalfi Coast itself. The cuisine is overseen by the famous chef from Campania, Andrea Aprea, while the quality is guaranteed by resident chef Salvatore Pacifico. The service front of house is in the capable hands of Bonny, part of the fourth generation of the owner’s family. A la carte available at lunchtime.

Name: Crocifisso
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated near the church of the same name in the upper part of Noto’s historic centre, this restaurant is one of the best in the area. In a modern and minimalist setting, Marco Baglieri serves excellent cuisine with an elaborate and Baroque feel, almost as if he were paying tribute to Noto itself, one of the most fascinating towns in Sicily. An extraordinary dining experience.

Name: Il Fagiano
Address: corso Zanardelli 190, Fasano del Garda, 25083, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Maurizio Bufi is at the helm of this restaurant, where he creates seasonal regional cuisine that is full of flavour. The extensive options include four tasting menus: Frammenti(the chef’s most iconic dishes), Sensazioni (more creative in style), Equinozio d'autunno(as the name suggests, this menu has an autumnal focus), and Dalla terra(interesting vegetarian options). The atmosphere here is elegant and stylish, whether you sit out on the beautiful terrace in summer or in the warm, atmospheric dining room with its charming coffered ceiling in winter. We particularly enjoyed the iconic fusillone pasta with cuttlefish carpaccio and a Jerusalem artichoke velouté, which was sweet and delicate, and paired with a fresh and intense white Planeta Eruzione 1614 Carricante.

Name: Vitantonio Lombardo
Address: via Madonna delle Virtù 13/14, Matera, 75100, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Minimalist furnishings and lighting contrast with the unusual setting of this restaurant, which occupies a thousand-year-old cave in the centre of the Sasso Barisano district. Creative dishes feature on the menu alongside more regionally influenced options reinterpreted with a contemporary twist, as well as new recipes on a tasting menu of between five and twelve courses. Originally from Basilicata, owner-chef Vitantonio Lombardo has the distinction of holding the first Michelin star ever awarded in Matera, a long-held personal dream for him. “I’ve worked around the world,” he says, “and now that I’ve returned to cook in the place that holds so many childhood memories for me, I want to blend these global influences with regional traditions, while ensuring that this region remains the dominant character in my dishes”.

Name: Il Cantinone e Sport Hotel Alpina
Address: via A. De Giacomi 39, Madesimo, 23024, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Working under the watchful eye of his namesake Stefano Masanti, Stefano Ciabarri is the young chef at the helm in this restaurant. He focuses on the use of natural, seasonal and regional ingredients in his cuisine, carefully seeking out small local producers for ingredients such as red bilberries from Madesimo and local beef and pork, as well as making use of the excellent homemade bresaola and other delicacies purchased from the village delicatessen. It’s well worth heading to Madesimo for two reasons: the famous gully attracts expert skiers, while the gourmet Il Cantinone is a must for food-lovers, where Raffaela, a skilful maître d’ and experienced sommelier, provides a friendly welcome front of house.

Name: Lazzaro 1915
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Although it is now home to a welcoming and contemporary family restaurant, until two generations ago this building was used as a place to rest horses and provide hospitality to workers from the sugar factory opposite. Run by siblings (the charming sister Daniela is front of house, while her brother Piergiorgio and his wife are in the kitchen), the restaurant serves delicate and creative regional cuisine on 6- and 10-course tasting menus with a focus on fish. Technical expertise and different types of preparation are the order of the day, including marinating, toasting rice, fermenting, home-made vinegars and aromatic herbs, resulting in a truly modern style but with a warm and generous soul. Daniela will recommend the best wine pairing from a well-structured wine list that includes personally selected labels.

Name: Prezioso
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Once you leave Merano, a road running through the woods leads to Castel Fragsburg, a fairytale-like residence with traditional guestrooms and public spaces full of atmosphere. Meals are served either in the elegant dining rooms or, in fine weather, outdoors on one of the most spectacular terraces in Italy, perched high above the valley. In the kitchen, Egon Heiss demonstrates his culinary talent on a tasting menu of creative dishes which are made mostly from local mountain ingredients, including freshwater fish and wild game. The excellent desserts are particularly worthy of mention.

Name: Acquerello
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The word “modern” sums up the cuisine here, although more than one word is needed to do justice to this restaurant. Housed in an old courtyard typical of Lombardy, Acquerello focuses on flavour rather than colour, with dishes created by a chef who enjoys being in the kitchen away from the spotlight. Although the restaurant offers an à la carte, our inspectors recommend the tasting menu with its fine balance of delicate flavours and original combinations that offer a hint of Eastern influence and pleasing contrasts in cooking methods and temperatures. The wine selection reflects the owner’s tastes: a slight emphasis on sparkling wines from the other side of the Alps, but also something for everyone.

Name: Zappatori
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The restaurant is temporarily closed.Hidden in an alleyway in Pinerolo’s historic centre, this restaurant offers a timeless and relaxing space in which the play of light and shade creates a harmonious ambience. The atmosphere at Zappatori is certainly romantic, with a small private room and winter garden for intimate dining adding to the appeal. In the kitchen, Christian Milone skilfully creates classic Piedmontese favourites using produce from his own farm, as well as offering a few more modern dishes. The “Mercato” tasting menu combines the influences of past and present, while the title of the “Menu 1975, le mie origini…” (“Menu 1975, my origins”) gives an indication of what to expect on the menu.

Name: Cannavacciuolo Cafè & Bistrot
Address: piazza Martiri della Libertà 1, Novara, 28100, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The historic Coccia theatre now houses a café serving sweet treats and simple, delicious salads on its ground floor, while the mezzanine and first floor are home to an attractive, well-appointed bistro with – the jewel in the crown – a spacious balcony with tables and sofas for summer dining. The menu features modern Mediterranean dishes full of creative, contrasting flavours and prepared with careful attention to different cooking methods. Our inspectors highly recommended the Ad Occhi Chiusi menu – a surprise 7-course tasting menu designed by chef Vincenzo Manicone, a “gentle giant” with real culinary skills!

Name: Joia
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant in one of Milan’s historic districts is home to the chef who first introduced the concept of natural, vegetarian cuisine to the world of Italian fine dining. Pietro Leemann is the man (and great philosopher) behind this “vegetarian restaurant” where the menu is 80% vegan and gluten free. This chef’s imaginative and dream-like dishes bear witness to the philosophical and spiritual transformation he has undergone over many years, with recipes that showcase the essence of their ingredients in colour, flavour, texture and presentation. The restaurant is minimalist and elegant in style, while its Joia Academyaims to introduce participants to all aspects of the chef’s philosophy.

Name: La Serra
Address: via Marconi 169, località Belvedere Fornillo, Positano, 84017, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Although you already get glimpses of the splendid views from the dining room, it is well worth waiting for fine weather to dine outdoors on the terrace at this restaurant in the Le Agave hotel, which boasts a truly breathtaking panorama of this magical coastline. In this delightful natural setting, chef Luigi Tramontano creates imaginative and beautifully presented Mediterranean dishes with his own individual touch, all prepared using top-quality, locally sourced meat and fish alongside vegetables which are often grown in the hotel’s own kitchen garden. Together with an excellent front-of-house team, Nicoletta Gargiulo takes care of guests’ wine choices. Passionate about wine for many years now, she has also developed her expertise thanks to different management roles held within the AIS (Italian Sommelier Association).

Name: Borgo San Jacopo
Address: borgo San Jacopo 62 r, Florence, 50125, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: Housed within the Hotel Lungarno, one of the most charming hotels in the city, this restaurant boasts the same elegant and exclusive style as the hotel. Chef Claudio Mengoni is at the helm here, having gained experience working in various Michelin-starred restaurants before returning home to Florence about three years ago. Here, he transforms carefully chosen Italian ingredients into refined fish, meat and vegetable dishes which respect the seasons and are beautifully presented. Sommelier Salvatore Biscotti is responsible for the excellent wine selection, which includes around a thousand different labels featuring renowned estates and small producers alike. It’s well worth booking one of the few romantic tables overlooking the Arno.

Name: Dolomieu
Address: via Castelletto Inferiore 10, Madonna di Campiglio, 38086, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Dolomieu is an intimate Stube-style restaurant furnished in oak which features just six tables, so booking well in advance is recommended. This is the most traditional part of the DV Chalet hotel, which otherwise boasts a modern and trendy Alpine-style decor. The tasting menu focuses on ingredients from the surrounding valleys, while the à la carte features interesting and tempting dishes such as ravioli with goat’s curd, raw Sicilian prawns and black truffle finished with a delicate chicken broth. Different wines are offered by the glass, all chosen by a maître-sommelier who is equally fond of wines from outside Italy.

Name: Ada
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This new, contemporary-style restaurant is situated in the historic centre of Perugia just a stone’s throw from the town’s Etruscan walls (3C BC). Here, the experienced female chef serves meat and fish dishes full of the colours and flavours of this region and beyond, via two tasting menus and an array of à la carte options. We enjoyed the barbecued eel served in “tegamaccio” (a local freshwater fish soup), as well as our visit to its mysterious wine cellars – once a secret passageway, but now a treasure trove of superb and varied wines overseen by an enthusiastic sommelier.

Name: Vite
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Originally from Friuli but based in the Veneto for some time, young Simone Selva is the chef at Vite (Vision Inspired Through Emotions) which is housed in the TAD (Treviso Arts District) building, a designer-style concept store. Here, he serves modern reinterpretations of traditional cuisine with a recognisable style and a careful balance of flavours on two tasting menus (“La Marca” and “Frût”, which focus on meat and fish respectively), as well as “Green Pow”, a vegetable-based menu available by prior reservation. There is also a 10-course surprise menu (“I’m a pickle, Morty!”, a tribute to the series “Rick and Morty”) from which you can order individual dishes, plus a quicker, ad hoc menu at lunchtime.

Name: Votavota
Address: lungomare Andrea Doria 48, Marina di Ragusa, 97010, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The perfect choice for those who love the sea, courtesy of the splendid views of the Mediterranean through the picture windows in the dining room. Guests can observe the two chefs at work in the open-view kitchen, where they prepare top-quality and surprisingly creative dishes, with an obvious focus on fish and seafood.
