Description: There are just eight seats and a distinctive Japanese charm at Chef Shion Uino's quiet sushi-ya, which features prized, beautiful seafood sourced primarily from Japan (including impressive amount directly from fishermen in his hometown of Amakusa). Never, at any point, does it look like the chef is cutting from a filet he’s already sliced. The product is whole and luscious every time, which is all the more reason why the nigiri sees little beyond a dot of wasabi or a dab of nikiri. Regulars, of which there are many, are treated to special pieces throughout the evening and will recognize some of his signature dishes, like hairy crab dressed with Japanese black vinegar, as well as his unrivaled tamago, which tastes as perfect as it looks.

Name: L’Abeille
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: L’Abeille reflects the luxurious charms of TriBeCa from its corner perch in this prized zip code. The restaurant is a darling space designed to the hilt with velvet cushioned seats and booths, a striking marble bar and handsome tables set with Christofle cutlery. The young Chef Mitsunobu Nagae is a calm, collected presence in the open kitchen, and years spent working at Joël Robuchon restaurants worldwide are evident. A harmonious union of French cooking with Japanese sensibilities, Nagae’s food is immediately approachable. From grilled trout with Champagne caviar sauce and scallion oil to lychee mousse with strawberry and shiso, each course is a vision of refinement. Servers in fitted suits roam the floor, keeping close watch on every seat.

Name: Oxomoco
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Brunch,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace
Description: Don’t let the easy-breezy vibe here fool you. Oxomoco is a serious dining room, capable of great things in its wood-fired oven. The attractive interior feels like a resort, with a long bar, giant skylight to maximize the sunlight of such a narrow space, and outdoor patio. The room is lively and packed but always conducive to conversation.Tacos are the main draw, especially when piled with the likes of tender flank steak or soft-shell crab. However, this kitchen team doesn’t stick to merely one dish or area of Mexico. Instead, they reach widely across a myriad of regions, always balancing abundance with fresh and vibrant flavors. The menu thereby tempts and tantalizes with such large and small items as the tropical hamachi agua chile and tlayuda crafted from smoky corn on a shell. Other standouts include the brined, fried and smoked “giant chicken."Apprised diners know never to pass up on creative and clever delicacies like the hoja santa curd, accompanied by roasted strawberries, raspberry granita, and finished with spicy olive oil. In close pursuit is the deceptively simple-looking carrot cake that is garnished with burnt cinnamon and flaunts a profound complexity of flavors.

Name: Restaurant Yuu
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Notable sake list
Description: From the seductive dark color palette and the oversized flower arrangements to the ballet-like rhythm of the open kitchen, Restaurant Yuu pours on the drama, albeit in a supremely elegant way. Chef Yuu Shimano creates dishes that are classically French, but seen through the eyes of Japanese omotenashi. Diners are treated to around 20 courses that could include decadent bites like toasted brioche, made in house by pastry chef Masaki Takahashi, topped with foie gras and a delicate cut of binchotan-seared wagyu. Expect to be dazzled if the chef brings out the still-to-be-baked pastry filled with aged duck, spinach and foie gras. Peak-season Yubari melon foam spooned over vanilla ice cream with white Port jelly and a Pernod and melon ice is hauntingly fragrant.

Name: Indienne
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: In a city where kitchens break molds and defy expectations, Chef Sujan Sarkar makes a splash of his own on this quiet strip of River North. À la carte is available, but first timers should start with the tasting menu, where Sarkar delivers an original, modern vision of Indian cuisine. His food may look like pieces of art but taste like familiar favorites pulled from across his vibrant homeland. At times showcasing a hint of French sensibility, pani puris, chats and curries arrive deftly spiced and elegantly presented. The kitchen is quick, and the overall effect is impressive refinement. All the while, the expansive room balances smooth warehouse floors and exposed ceilings with thick wooden beams, white tablecloths and rose-pink booths.

Name: Porto
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Terrace
Description: Striking, dedicated and delicious are an apt way to describe this passion project from Chef Marcos Campos and Owner Daniel Alejandro Alonso—both of whom are champions of La Brújula, the noted women-owned conserva company. A stone-carved chandelier, metallic accents and hand-painted ceramics are merely some of the flourishes of this dreamy room. Still not besotted? Think of the menu, dominated by ingredients cooked on an open flame. Find a perch at the horseshoe bar and let the team tease your taste buds with uni toast accompanied by cauliflower crema; or Galician octopus with judión bean purée. Using seaweed in place of spaghetti, pasta do mar is the epitome of invention. Close out with pan con chocolate, starring pork-fat brioche and brown butter foam.

Name: Topolobampo
FacilitiesAndServices: Valet parking
Description: This jewel in Rick Bayless' crown welcomes a rush of diners for original Mexican food with an upscale twist. While you have to walk through cacophonous Frontera Grill to get here, the serenity that greets you is well worth it. The menu, boasting a panoply of flavors and textures, spins with the seasons all the while highlighting regional cuisines and holidays. Though each dish is rooted in tradition, there's no shortage of flair, as in kampachi sashimi decked with the flavors of street corn. There's also a canon of sauces treated with appropriate reverence. To wit, Oaxacan mole chichilo is a symphony of dried chiles, nuts and spices, and makes a sublime counterpoint to lamb loin.Drinks are noteworthy, but teetotalers will relish those agua frescas.

Name: Esmé
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Together with his co-owner and wife, Katrina Bravo, Chef Jenner Tomaska lays bare lofty ambitions at this airy atelier. The minimalist, well-lit space evokes an art gallery, complete with a high-concept tasting that's aimed at blurring the boundaries between art and dining.The show begins with intriguing bites served at standing tables just inside. The multicourse meal that follows features a variety of dishes, each offered on custom pieces made by local artists. Flavorful compositions showcase unexpected combinations, as in a day lily masquerading as a taco, filled with a sweet-and-sour squash compote and green goddess cream. A plate blending smoked cashew, julienne of Granny Smith apple, heart of palm and truffle is equally delightful.

Name: Next
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Valet parking
Description: Whether you come to experience the cuisine of ancient Rome or Hollywood, a meal here is pure dinner theater. These culinary themes are unique and thoughtful, leaving diners wondering what's "next."While an earlier Italia menu showcased complex ingredients and flawless flavors and textures (think cacio e pepe and guanciale-wrapped branzino), the most recent "Paris 1906" culinary theme showcased celebrated French chef Auguste Escoffier's classic cuisine. Highlights included carrè d’agneau avec sauce choron, a well-executed plate of lamb and crispy sweetbreads with a vibrant sauce choron. The theme ran through to dessert, with a bombe Ceylan, a half-sphere of ice cream, rum and coffee with a delicate chocolate shell, served with griottine cherries and sauce anglaise.

Name: Mako
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Wheelchair access
Description: Veteran chef B.K. Park has spun out this inspiring shrine to omakase. With nothing but a lone plaque marking its entrance, this Japanese delight can be tough to spot. But once inside, the surrounding din of traffic fades and you’ll be transfixed by the team's dedication to sushi.Mako is a hot ticket, with just 22 seats from which to savor the smartly considered omakase. Throughout the evening, the chef and itamae showcase their style through unique adornments, like sudachi juice and sesame-pepper soy. Equally enticing are cooked items, like braised abalone or black cod with burnt scallion ponzu. Not to be outdone, chawanmushi stocked with mushroom and crab is the essence of elegance. Dessert is not an afterthought, as in sweet potato with whiskey caramel.

Name: Galit
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Its exterior is unassuming, but one step inside the rustic-chic hot spot and you'll be smitten by its lively vibe, warm hospitality and seductive aromas. Acclaimed chef Zach Engel brings his experience to bear on this personal brand of modern Middle Eastern cuisine. His prix-fixe allows diners to make their own selections from a range of options, but sharing is key to cover the most ground. Kick things off with salatim (spreads and pickles) accompanied by flame-kissed pita. Even familiar dishes offer surprising depth, like creamy hummus or crackling-crisp falafel with mango labneh.Dessert manages to be just as tantalizing as the savory fare. Sample an updated spin on baklava with white chocolate and raspberry for a wonderfully elegant finale.

Name: Temporis
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Wheelchair access
Description: This jewel box is the epitome of subtlety, serenity, and sophistication. Year after delicious year, the kitchen team flaunts their supreme talent. Each dish is a personal expression of their passion and vision. Playful delicacies include butter-brushed corn, dotted with an Espelette pepper and corn purée and finished tableside with summer truffle; classic-gone-grown up creations include a vanilla pasta with lobster, tarragon, black truffle sauce, and Satsuma powder. Seared Wagyu topped with curls of green papaya, drops of tamarind, jackfruit, and coconut purées displays a harmony between sweet and savory.A sphere of cherry blossom mousse arrives with a cake base, tonka bean gelée topping, and cherry sorbet for a stunning final bow.

Name: Atelier
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted
Description: This Lincoln Square boîte has always blended in with its humble surrounds, but enthusiasts know that it’s the inside that counts and where culinary excellence has long thrived. In full view of the dining room, Chef Christian Hunter and his team chart new waters, ever determined to make their own mark on this intimate space. Working quietly and seamlessly, the kitchen delivers a carefully calibrated tasting menu supported by nearby farms and packed with flavor and originality. Familiar dishes like marinated beets, pimento cheese and Caesar salad arrive remodeled and refined, astutely seasoned, and never a leaf or morsel out of place. Hope that the warm clam chowder with lamb bacon and chive oil is still available. It’s a total showstopper.

Name: Schwa
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Bring your own bottle,Credit card / Debit card accepted
Description: There comes a point when a pared-down style jumps from being easy-to-miss and becomes hard-to-forget. When a lack of any FOH staff means the service is playfully all-hands-on-deck. When the explicit rap music reflects the chefs’ ethos, going well beyond laissez-faire to the point of “we don’t give a damn.” You probably won’t either once you taste the food. The welcome cocktail and canape may be a summery concoction of watermelon and Pastis paired with a watermelon-poached oyster. Medallions of quail are dusted with jerk seasoning and plated with onion rings and candied guava for a stimulating combination of flavors, while tender beef loin is plated with a clever raspberry remoulade and accompanied by a powdered mustard-dusted milk bun, inviting diners to make a sandwich.

Name: Omakase Yume
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted
Description: This small and clean dining enclave brought to you by Chef/owner Sangtae Park is lined with planks of blonde wood and offers two nightly seatings at its eight-seat bar.Dishes tend to headline top ingredients that are smartly paired and well executed. Savor the chef's unfaltering focus on Japanese cuisine by way of deep-fried nasu hirame; Edo-style sushi featuring madai, akami, and chutoro; as well as slices of Wagyu beef atop sushi rice. Other delicacies like torigai (heart clam), correctly aged sayori, or grilled misoyaki flaunt a thorough study in product sourcing, fresh flavors, and delectable textures. Sweet and custardy tamago, followed by matcha panna cotta—deeply colorful, full-bodied and tart with creamy buttermilk—bring the meal to a close.

Name: EL Ideas
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Bring your own bottle,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Dining here is like attending an underground dinner party prepared by a merry band of misfit cooks in Chef Phillip Foss’ home (he lives upstairs). There is one seating, everyone is served at the same time, and meals are prepaid so guests can linger. The BYOB policy merely reinforces the restaurant's resemblance to a test kitchen.The cuisine works wonders by pushing—if not completely disregarding—traditional boundaries. For instance, a croquette filled with Caesar dressing and set on romaine is to be eaten by licking the plate; while oil-poached salmon with everything spice draped atop a "bagel purée" is served with dill and cream cheese meringue. The French fries and ice cream course, designed to look like a milkshake, is ingenious and unforgettable.

Name: Elske
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace,Wheelchair access
Description: A vivid neon sign signals the entry into this stylish spot. Elske, Danish for "love," is a hip and elegant offering brought to you by husband-and-wife team, David and Anna Posey, and what they do here is pure culinary magic. The spacious setting is equal parts minimal and intimate; while a lovely patio, complete with an open-air campfire, is perfect for a single sip or several.The chefs' deeply creative ethos is reflected in this menu with seasonal, responsibly sourced dishes, each rendered with impeccable skill. A night in their hands might unveil salt-cured anchovies fortified with a Meyer lemon oil or cured hamachi with kohlrabi and kombu. A compilation of charred leeks and oats is topped with a clothbound cheddar "bèchamel."

Name: Sepia
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Housed within a 19th-century print shop, this urbane dining room mixes original details with modern touches. Muted tones in the exposed brick walls and custom tile floors complement newer elements like floor-to-ceiling wine storage and dramatic chandeliers.Chef Andrew Zimmerman’s menu is a delicious amalgam of American cuisine with hints of Southeast Asian, Korean, and Mediterranean tastes. Gnocchi may seem commonplace, but this version is memorable thanks to the rich flavors of lamb sugo and ciabatta breadcrumbs. Chicken is downright exciting, served crisp-skinned with a buttery Albufera sauce, crumbly chestnuts, caramelized fennel, and sausage. Desserts keep the bar high, and may include a toffee-coconut cake with chocolate ganache and burnt caramel.

Name: Kasama
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace
Description: Husband-and-wife chefs Tim Flores and Genie Kwon have gifted diners with Kasama, which means "together" in Tagalog. Popularizing Filipino food is an important part of their vision and the result is an ambitious, clever and distinct meal. Traditional Filipino food is given a creative spin in such items as sinigang, or salmon dressed with a tamarind beurre blanc and topped with smoked roe over a bed of melting leeks; kare kare, a dish of lamb belly with a peanut "curry;" and an elegant take on "halo-halo" combining Asian pear granita, pandan ice cream and freeze-dried mandarin.The design is clear upon entry—an impressively equipped kitchen framed by a counter where diners watch the action unfold. Banquettes tucked under the windows make for plush seats.

Name: Boka
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Terrace,Valet parking,Wheelchair access
Description: ​​​​​​This is the kind of retreat where one can sink in and never leave. It exudes elegance with a bit of romance and quirk—thanks to walls covered with ornate escutcheons and whimsical paintings. Against these dark pebbled backgrounds, find plush oversized booths, banquettes, and mirrored light bulbs.Chef Lee Wolen turns out a widely appealing modern menu that uses global accents. Appetizers, like delicate ricotta ravioli with summer corn and smoked buttermilk, or an intriguing plate of lightly cured kampachi crudo with green strawberry and kohlrabi, thrill. For entrées, the roasted dry aged Rohan duck matched with roasted shallot and plum jam is a standout.Finally, hazelnut and chocolate mousse with caramelized condensed milk ice cream is delightful.

Name: Hayakawa
Address: 1055 Howell Mill Rd. NW, Atlanta, 30318, USA
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted
Description: A local legend for his Japanese cuisine on Buford Highway, Chef Atsushi Hayakawa has begun a new chapter in West Midtown. Located in a sparkling office structure, the slick lair hosts a mere handful of diners per seating. His stage is a backdrop of dark-streaked stone and a silken wood counter; and the use of a microphone to banter with guests amplifies Hayakawa's buoyant personality.The meal is a procession of small courses and hews toward the structure of kaiseki. After items such as an appetizer trio with clear fish soup, scallop sashimi with miso-mustard sauce and simmered monkfish, it's time for sushi. The chef crafts nigiri from imported fish that needs little embellishment and is amply sized in the tradition of Hokkaido style in deference to the chef's hometown.

Name: Bacchanalia
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Dark wood, a black industrial ceiling set with a constellation of Edison bulbs, and brown leather banquettes give Bacchanalia a handsome sophistication, yet there's nothing too precious about this longstanding spot. The multicourse prix fixe involves a bit of flair, with some dishes arriving on carts or nestled inside glass cloches, and the cheese course is a wonderful surprise. Rather than an expected slice, the team presents a clever take with a crumbly oat date cake and a dot of black garlic sauce surrounded by rings of parmesan. Chilled lobster in a ponzu sauce with bright English peas and horseradish oil is also memorable but it may just be the delicate grapefruit soufflé garnished with spicy pistachio crumble and rose crème anglaise that takes the cake.

Name: Mujō
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Notable sake list,Valet parking
Description: Located in West Midtown, Mujō is an intimate setting with a moody elegance. A U-shaped counter crafted of Southern cypress pops in this square room with dark walls and low lighting. This is the domain of Chef J. Trent Harris and his skilled team who make all feel well cared for. Here, tradition has been replaced with a rollicking good time, where the always-surprising interpretation of omakase begin with an array of zensai like a morsel of Florida cobia grilled over binchotan, dressed with a red miso sauce and some local pattypan squash. After some cooked bites, it's time for the raw. Nigiri needs little to impress, while supplemental dishes offer the likes of Hokkaido hair crab, tosazu and mozuku. Regulars know dessert isn't an afterthought; so save room.

Name: Lazy Betty
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Terrace
Description: Betty was far from lazy. Just ask her children, Howard, Anita and Ron Hsu, the co-owners of Lazy Betty, who drew inspiration for their restaurant from their mother's hospitality. Chef Ron Hsu and Chef/co-owner Aaron Phillips oversee a contemporary tasting menu with clever flavor combinations that highlight regional ingredients. Causa is given a Southern slant with sweet Georgia shrimp, avocado purée and potato foam infused with aji amarillo pepper, while seared Hudson Valley foie gras is sided by Granny Smith apple, sweet potato and dots of pumpkin butter. Cod, poached in a ham hock broth, rests atop fava bean and zucchini succotash with a green tomato relish for an especially flavorful plate. From the pre-dessert lemon sherbet with a coconut crumble to the elegant rosewater panna cotta, they impress to the end.

Name: Atlas
Address: 88 W. Paces Ferry Rd. NW, Atlanta, 30305, USA
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Valet parking
Description: When the night calls for a grand celebration, few places fit quite like Atlas. Snuggled inside the posh St. Regis Atlanta, this restaurant is impossibly elegant. Fine art graces the walls—it's home to The Lewis Collection and its works by Japanese-born painter and printmaker Léonard Tsuguharu Foujita—but it's not just the artwork that impresses. Order à la carte from this seasonal American menu with European influences or celebrate with the tasting menu for dishes like tender lobster plated with smoked paprika butter sauce and heirloom summer squash, and poached halibut composed with a trio of beet preparations. Wagyu beef from Australia is a decadent end to the savory courses. Impressive cocktails, a cheese cart and whimsical desserts complete the well-rounded experience.

Name: Hytra
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: If you’re looking for a restaurant with plenty of innate charm, this could be the perfect option for you. Hytra is located on the 6th and 7th floors of the Onassis Cultural Centre, a modern building with views of the Acropolis that in summer relocates to the rooftop terrace from where you can enjoy dinner beneath the stars while admiring the incredible Parthenon as a backdrop. The contemporary-style Greek cuisine on offer here, featuring fine textures and meticulous presentation, is based around Greek ingredients and herbs grown in the restaurant’s own kitchen garden, all of which are very clearly evident in its sauces, creams, seasonings, and even its cocktails. Choose between the à la carte and two enticing tasting menus, one of which (Think Green) is vegetarian. Access is via Leontiou Street, where you’ll find a security guard directing you to the lift.

Name: Hervé
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: Hervé’s three co-owners are heavily involved in the smooth running of this modern restaurant, situated a little way from the centre but well connected thanks to its location next to the Petralona metro stop. Herve Pronzato is the French-born executive chef who has lent his name to the business, ably assisted by Grigoris Kikis (a young Greek chef who is constantly seeking excellence in his cooking) and George Efthimopoulos (an expert in hospitality and the restaurant’s general manager). One of the special features of this young, informal eatery is the elegant French-style yet Japanese-inspired counter where guests can watch the chefs at work (the latter serve dishes personally and are happy to explain their preparation in detail). The cuisine is centred around a single tasting menu featuring fusion dishes influenced by French, Asian and Italian cooking. You’ll need to book ahead, and when you do you’ll receive a digital code that will let you through the front door!

Name: Patio
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Located in Vouliagmeni (an upmarket beach area on the shores of the Saronic Gulf just half an hour from Athens), this restaurant occupying a delightful internal patio in The Margi luxury hotel will come as a pleasant surprise. Here, in a verdant setting away from the centre of Athens, it is much easier to showcase the restaurant’s “From Farm to Fork” philosophy and concept. Chef Panagiotis Giakalis’ cuisine is presented on two tasting menus that champion modern Greek cooking of a high technical level, with particular emphasis on flavours from Greece and from the wider Mediterranean, wherever possible using ingredients (eggs, vegetables, fruit, olive oil, wine etc) sourced from their own estate. The covered side porch, the olive trees planted in huge pots, and the romantic candlelit ambience at night are particularly impressive, plus the hotel also owns a farm that guests can visit and enjoy a meal in beautiful natural surroundings.

Name: CTC Urban Gastronomy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A restaurant that is highly sought after during the summer months thanks to its delightful urban terrace dotted with verdant trees and bushes. Here, chef Alexandros Tsiotinis, who is well supported by his kitchen team, focuses on Mediterranean-based cuisine featuring modern techniques and meticulous presentation, showcased on a single 11-course surprise menu that is gradually revealed by staff as if they were unveiling a secret. Dishes change according to the availability of seasonal ingredients with the exception of one or two that are mainstays throughout the year, such as “sweetcorn velouté flavoured with lobster, truffle and a bergamot espuma”. A gastronomic experience in which guests should also sit back and savour some of the tasting menu’s superb wine pairings!

Name: Spondi
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In this elegant restaurant close to a busy square behind the ancient Panathenaic Stadium, enjoy highly professional service, attractive vaulted dining rooms, and two Mediterranean-inspired terraces perfect for alfresco dining and a romantic candlelit supper. The cooking here is centred around elaborate and highly visual contemporary French cuisine that is showcased via an array of à la carte dishes as well as on an enticing “Discovery” tasting menu. Seasonal produce is very much to the fore here, although some ever-popular ingredients (crab, langoustine, lamb, chocolate etc) feature all year round. Particularly friendly and attentive service is a constant here!

Name: Tudor Hall
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: If the idea of having lunch or dinner on the elegant rooftop of a hotel, with piano music in the background and the eternal Acropolis as a backdrop sounds appealing, then Tudor Hall is definitely the place, especially for a romantic candlelit supper – but make sure you book a table in advance. Here, on the 7th floor of the King George Hotel, next to the central Syntagma Square, chef Asterios Koustoudis (who is also executive chef of the adjacent Hotel Grande Bretagne, home to the GB Roof Garden restaurant) showcases his contemporary take on Greek cuisine that is built around a concise à la carte and one tasting menu. The end result is a superb mix of slick service, sommelier recommendations and meticulous cuisine featuring delicious dishes that are surprisingly technical and pleasing on the eye. Make sure you try the superb cod.

Name: Botrini's
Address: 24b Vasileos Georgiou B street, Athens, 152 33, Greece
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A modern, elegant restaurant occupying a former school in the up-and-coming Chalandri district and located slightly away from the city’s tourist hotspots. The cheery entrance and intimate tree-shaded terrace come as a pleasant surprise. Here, half-Greek, half-Italian chef Ettore Botrini offers two extensive tasting menus which showcase creative Mediterranean-focused cuisine with constant references to the two countries that are part of his DNA. He always works with locally sourced ingredients and creates several dishes with a specific connection to the island of Corfu, where he spent his childhood. To elevate the gastronomic experience even further, why not dine at the exclusive chef’s table, with seats for just four guests?

Name: Pelagos
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: If you’re keen to get away from the hustle and bustle of Athens, why not head to the Four Seasons Astir Palace Hotel, a luxury resort on an archipelago to the south of the Greek capital? At Pelagos, a restaurant that delights guests with its spacious sea-view terrace, enjoy Mediterranean cuisine featuring an Italian touch and classic French influences. Its successful fusion of ingredients is showcased on two tasting menus: “The Classics 360°”, featuring the restaurant’s most successful signature dishes; and “Pelagos On Tour”, a culinary project developed between chef Luca Piscazzi and manager Cédric Vinckier, that champions the country’s cuisine and has seen them scour the islands of Tinos, Lesvos and Kalymnos, as well as the region around Athens, in search of the very best artisanal ingredients.

Name: Varoulko Seaside
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: If you’re looking for a restaurant with an authentic maritime flavour, this eatery overlooking the small yet attractive port of Mikrolimano will come as a pleasant surprise thanks to the superb views of the fishing boats moored out front.Traditionally, Piraeus is known as the port of Athens, hence the plethora of tavernas and restaurants specialising in fish and seafood located here. Varoulko Seaside follows the same influence, although chef Lefteris Lazarou takes his maritime cuisine to another level! The freshest ingredients are key to his cuisine which is based around the catch of the day (sea bass, red mullet, grouper, tuna, shrimp, prawns etc) and presented on an à la carte and two tasting menus. His hot dishes, including a delicious fish patty, are accompanied by cold specialities in the shape of ceviches, carpaccios and tartares.

Name: The Zillers
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This was once the family home of German architect Ernst Zillers, who came to Athens to design some of the city’s public buildings, fell in love and then spent the rest of his life here. The building, situated next to the city’s Orthodox cathedral and converted into a hotel (Zillers Boutique Hotel), boasts a rooftop terrace and a multi-purpose Roof Garden with fine views of the cathedral and Acropolis. During the day it serves light meals and snacks; however, in the evening the space is transformed into the culinary realm of chef Pavlos Kiriakis, who offers two contemporary tasting menus on which he showcases his “creative philosophy that reinterprets high-quality ingredients and traditions in a contemporary way ”. He also hosts his renowned ‘Four Hands Dinners’, working with other leading chefs.

Name: Soil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Soil occupies a delightful house with a romantic patio-terrace, in the shade of leafy orange trees in the Pangrati district, a stone’s throw from the famous Panathenaic stadium – the venue for the first Olympic Games of the modern era. Here, chef Tasos Mantis (co-owner along with Alexandros Mouridis, who runs the front of house), creates contemporary seasonal cuisine featuring classic techniques, a solid basis in Greek cooking and a Nordic touch. This is showcased on a menu of well-presented small plates that reaffirm the restaurant’s “farm to table” concept, with a special focus on vegetables, herbs and edible flowers from the chef’s kitchen garden in Alepochori (cultivated by his father). At the end of the experience, guests are even given a bouquet of the herbs used in their meal.

Name: The Beijing Kitchen (Jianguo Road)
Address: D6007, 6F, SKP Beijing, 87 Jianguo Road, Chaoyang, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: With over 20 years of experience, this owner-chef from Hong Kong samples what his team makes daily to keep improving the quality. While he is most proud of his Cantonese barbecue (crispy deep-fried squab, in particular), double-steamed soups, dim sum, and original creations such as steamed tofu with shrimps and goji leaves also impress. And of course, nothing ends a Cantonese meal better than a serving of sago and pomelo in mango purée.

Name: Sheng Yong Xing (Chaoyang)
Address: 5 Xindong Road, Chaoyang, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,JCB,Maestro,Mastercard credit card
Description: The sleek east-meets-west interior is light years from its nondescript façade. The signature roast duck comes with a “birth certificate” proving it is 45 days old. Grilled in a stone oven over jujube wood, it boasts crispy skin and juicy meat. Order caviar to go with it if you fancy a splurge. Sautéed, springy prawns from Bohai Sea with shrimp roe are packed in serious umami. Also check out the reasonably priced wine list.

Name: Xin Rong Ji (Jinrong Street)
Address: B1 Level, Financial Street International Hotel, 11 Jinrong Street, Xicheng, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This is the first Beijing branch of the Taizhou brand famous for its fresh seafood shipped from the East China Sea daily. The dimly lit dining room dotted with bird cages and other Chinese motifs feels chic and sophisticated. The menu changes according to availability, but the star of the show remains the wild-caught yellow croaker – pre-order the flavourful and umami-loaded yellow croaker soup with matsutake mushrooms, as it takes hours to double boil.

Name: Jing Yaa Tang
Address: LG Level, The Opposite House, Taikoo Li Sanlitun North, 11 Sanlitun Road, Chaoyang, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In a serene hotel amidst the busy Sanlitun area, this high-ceilinged dining room exudes understated luxury. The menu changes from time to time and is mostly Beijingese, with occasional offerings from elsewhere. Watch your 45-day-old Peking duck browning for an hour in the jujube wood-fired oven before being carved table-side. Osmanthus-scented lotus root stuffed with glutinous rice, and dishes made with fresh mushrooms are also popular.

Name: Jing
Address: B1 Level, The Peninsula Hotel, 8 Jinyu Hutong, Dongcheng, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: What this basement dining room lacks in scenery, it more than makes up for with eclectic art and a chic bar. The chef hailing from Bayonne has worked in some prestigious kitchens in Europe; he puts a new spin on French classics with novel creations like 52 degree egg with potato foam and white truffle. Try also wild-caught scampi from New Zealand, or the velvety spring lamb. Consider booking the chef’s table in advance to be close to the action.

Name: The Tasty House
Address: Block 21, 4 Gongrentiyuchang North Road, Chaoyang, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Nestled in Jing Yard, a tree-lined entertainment and dining complex converted from a heritage factory site, this elegant dining room is a subtle nod to the building’s industrial past. A skylight on the gable wall and glass doors flood the space with natural light. The large menu is dominated by Jiangnan cuisine, with crispy Peking duck roasted over jujube wood being the highlight. There are five private rooms available. Make sure you book ahead.

Name: Mansion Cuisine by Jingyan
Address: 22 Jianchang Hutong, Dongcheng, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,JCB,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: The high-ceilinged courtyard mansion was remodelled in 2013 to house this classy restaurant. In a similar vein, traditional Beijing dishes have been given a modern and eclectic makeover. Peking duck is served three ways that feature caviar, black truffle or carved into 108 slices the traditional way, boasting crispy skin and juicy flesh. Most dishes are made to order, some with tableside service. The sea cucumber with Peking style pork sauce is phenomenal.

Name: Furong
Address: 1F, The Westin, 9C Jinrong Street, Xicheng, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Named after the provincial flower of Hunan, it makes perfect sense that this new brand under the Xin Rong Ji Group focuses on the Hunanese cuisine. The Hunanese chef delivers authentic classics such as fish head covered in chopped chillies that pack a punch of flavour – make sure that it’s ordered in advance. Porcini-pork tripe soup with pickled radish is cooked in a casserole over charcoal. Bonus tip—you may order certain items in smaller portions as well.

Name: Zijin Mansion
Address: 3F, Waldorf Astoria Hotel, 5-15 Jinyu Hutong, Dongcheng, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Though its name means purple and gold, this cosy dining room is clad in hand-embroidered orange fabric on a bird theme. The menu features a fine mix of Cantonese classics and bold creations, thanks to the head chef’s globetrotting background. The must-try goldfish shrimp dumplings taste as good as they look. Lotus root puff pastry with turnip filling is flaky, flavourful and exquisitely crafted. Wine buffs should check out the cellar.

Name: MO Jasmine
Address: L307, 3F, CP Center, 20 Jinhe East Road, Chaoyang, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The dark green façade and warm grey room impart sophisticated taste. The jasmine centrepiece on each table exudes a pleasant scent and befits the restaurant’s name. On the menu, Beijingese melds with Shandong in refined masterpieces that look and taste divine. The signature classic Peking duck can be ordered in individual portions – in addition to pancake, scallion and cucumber, chargrilled duck breast with crispy skin is luxed up with caviar.

Name: Fu Chun Ju
Address: 3F, The Puxuan Hotel, 1 Wangfujing Street, Dongcheng, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Designed by the German architect Ole Scheeren, this dining room seamlessly blends pared-down modernism with hutong tradition. Imagine circular booths that create an array of semi-private spaces. The experienced head chef from Hong Kong showcases his solid and astute skills in signature dishes like the roast pigeon. The revamped menu includes many items that are available in individual portion sizes, so diners may sample the length and breadth of his repertoire.

Name: Lamdre
Address: Room 04, 1F, Block 14, Courtyard 4, Gongti North Road, Chaoyang, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A pitched roof skylight illuminates the main room naturally; the private rooms and balcony also feel cosy. Chef Dai, former head chef of a renowned vegetarian restaurant, serves a season-driven tasting menu. His famous tofu is steeped in a matsutake and wakame broth and seasoned with soy sauce house-brewed with rice, kombu, honey and shiitake. Choose between the two wine pairing options with natural, organic, sustainable and biodynamic varieties.

Name: Giada Garden
Address: 3F, China World Hotel, 1 Jianguomenwai Street, Chaoyang, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In line with the image of the fashion brand, the airy, elegant space exudes feminine sensibility with a pale colour scheme and warm neutrals. For a full-on experience, order the set menu and go for classics like veal Milanese or their house-made pastas. The array of freshly baked Italian bread on offer is also amazing and a wide range of quality Italian wines are available by the glass. Service is formal and precise, but not too uptight.

Name: Gastro Esthetics DaDong
Address: 1-2F, Nanxincang Business Tower, 22A Dongsi 10th Alley, Dongcheng, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Discover Card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: The Peking duck chain’s flagship in town got a makeover in 2021 and was re-branded as the chain’s most exclusive branch. The signature roast duck only uses 22-day-old birds, and is served with condiments like pancake, cucumber, scallion, minced garlic and bean sauce. Braised sea cucumber is a sensational tour de force – spiny sea cucumber from Kanto, Japan is prepared tableside à la minute. Seasonal seafood and mushroom dishes are also the highlights.

Name: Lu Style (Anding Road)
Address: 5F, Uni Elite, Building 6, Courtyard 5, Anding Road, Chaoyang, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This elegant restaurant has built up a loyal fan base with its friendly service and quality food at affordable price points. Instead of typical Shandong classics, the chef, who hails from the province, champions a menu that prominently features seafood shipped from Weihai port daily. Try the braised sea cucumber with scallion, which takes five days to prepare. Certain items tend to run out early: pre-order your favourites to avoid disappointment.

Name: Lei Garden (Jinbao Tower)
Address: 3F, Jinbao Tower, 89 Jinbao Street, Dongcheng, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Lei Garden hails from Hong Kong and specialises in traditional Cantonese fare. The décor feels festive and joyous. Most ingredients are sourced from their own farm to ensure quality and freshness. The signature roasted pork belly boasts alternate layers of fat and meat, with crispy skin and juicy flesh. Slow-cooked and double-boiled soups are also recommended. Sago and pomelo in mango purée is the perfect end to the meal.

Name: Ling Long
Address: 3F, STEY-Sanlitun Hotel, BEI Zhaolong, 2 Gongrentiyuchang North Road, Chaoyang, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The dining room feels airy, minimal and fresh, with just one wisteria plant as the centrepiece. In the semi-open kitchen, the young head chef with around ten years of experience deftly prepares his seasonally inspired menus, consisting of up to seven artfully plated inventions that taste unmistakably Chinese. Most of the ingredients are sourced locally, including the beef from Shandong, oyster sauce and fermented condiments which are all made in house.

Name: Forum
Address: 2F, Empark Prime Hotel, 2 Wangfujing Street, Dongcheng, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Forum has long been an institution of deluxe Cantonese fare in Hong Kong. Its first outpost in Beijing is helmed by Chef Lee who perfected his skills throughout his career of over 30 years. The menu offers many of the same dishes as its Hong Kong flagship, such as sauteed lobster with crab meat and pigeon egg that boasts velvety texture and briny-sweetness. The signature fried rice packs rich wok hei whereas braised abalones are not to be missed.

Name: Il Ristorante - Niko Romito
Address: 1F, Bvlgari Hotel, Building 2, Courtyard 8, Xinyuan South Road, Chaoyang, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This dining concept by the eponymous Milanese chef epitomises all that is Italian luxe. Lit by Murano glass chandeliers and clad in marble, warm wood and leather, the high-ceilinged dining room overlooks a manicured garden. Classic recipes are given a subtle and modern twist that adds sophistication and depth. The à la carte menu changes every season, while degustation menus change every month. The wide array of Italian wines on offer match the food well.

Name: Poetry‧Wine (Dongsanhuan Middle Road)
Address: 61 Dongsanhuan Middle Road, Chaoyang, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The bamboo bush, jade ornaments, ink paintings and cut flowers may prime your brain for a hefty price tag, but a meal in this modern restaurant doesn’t break the bank. With a daily limit of 100 orders, its signature braised fish head is juicy and tender, nicely braised in an aromatic brown sauce. Roast duck uses 40-day-old birds that are chargrilled to perfection and plated gorgeously. Always save room for the creamed yam and osmanthus sweet soup.

Name: In Love (Gongti East Road)
Address: Next to East 2 Gate, Workers' Sports Complex, Gongrentiyuchang East Road, Chaoyang, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This is a Hunanese restaurant, but its décor easily passes for a modern bistro with sleek furniture and a muted palette, punctuated by lime green banquettes. The same degree of eclecticism is at work on the menu, as the Hunanese chef puts a new spin on the classics. Steamed fish head with pickled chilli duo uses bighead carp shipped daily from Qiandao Lake in Zhejiang. Pre-order this dish alongside others when booking a table.

Name: Opera Bombana
Address: Shop 21, LG2 Level, Parkview Green Fangcaodi, 9 Dongdaqiao Road, Chaoyang, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,JCB,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Umberto Bombana stunned the world with his 8 1/2 Otto e Mezzo in Hong Kong. This is his latest brainchild, after ventures in Macau and Shanghai. The classic degustation menu is the best way to sample his signatures, which are rooted in tradition but jazzed up by modern touches. They go big with the wine list featuring great selections of Piemonte and Tuscan reds. The spacious and striking dining room befits the art-themed shopping mall it is in.

Name: Xin Rong Ji (Jianguomenwai Street)
Address: 5F, Tower A, Yintai Centre, 2 Jianguomenwai Street, Chaoyang, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Having started life as a small shop selling seafood dishes, this chain now has branches in most large cities in China. At the heart of the CBD lies its second outpost boasting butler service for diners – reserve a table ahead and pre-order the freshest seafood flown in from Taizhou every day. Besides the famous wild-caught yellow croaker and fried hairtail, also try blanched baby octopus, braised radish slices, and bean noodles in sea anemone soup.

Name: Lu Shang Lu
Address: 2A01-2A03 / 2A05-2A13, 2F, Sunshine Financial Center, No.1 Tower, 33 Jinghui Street, Chaoyang, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This new brand from the restaurant group specialises in Shandong cooking, especially Confucius cuisine, sea cucumber and live seafood shipped from Jiaodong peninsula daily. The young chef from Yantai knows the food from his home province inside out. Try his roast 45-day-old duck served with caviar, prawn crackers and Shandong pancakes, combining the characteristics of both Beijingese and Shandong cooking. Consider booking a room for more privacy.

Name: Trb Hutong
Address: 23 Shatan North Street, Dongcheng, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: Nestling in a maze of alleyways, the restaurant is difficult to find, but is well worth the effort for the lavish dining experience in a temple courtyard-turned dining room. Local ingredients are cleverly crafted into polished dishes with a novel twist; three tasting menus change according to the season, but all culminate in Le Grand Dessert finale. The plating is stunning and the subtle contrasts in tastes and textures are delightful.

Name: Huaiyang Fu (Dongcheng)
Address: 198 Andingmenwai Street, Dongcheng, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This period mansion, complete with a stone garden, brick walls and carved wood windows, befits the refinement and subtlety that define this restaurant’s cuisine. Thanks to a renovation, booth seats are the prized spot for a truly comfortable experience. The menu celebrates the greatest hits in Huaiyang cooking, such as braised pork belly in brown sauce and tofu chrysanthemum in matsutake stock. Seasonal offerings like crystal yellow croaker aspic are also worth saving room for.

Name: Cai Yi Xuan
Address: 2F, Four Seasons Hotel, 48 Liangmaqiao Road, Chaoyang, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Having worked with various teams within the hotel group for years, Chef Li hailing from Tianjin makes sure every top-notch ingredient is prepared meticulously in his kitchen. The main menu focuses on Cantonese fare, but regulars may refer to another menu for popular dishes they miss. Chef Li is especially proud of his signature wok-fried prawns with fermented black garlic and dried chillies. The wine list also features some great selections.

Name: Zhiguan Courtyard
Address: 12 Jinyu Hutong, Dongcheng, Beijing, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,JCB,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This restaurant, annexed to an art gallery, sports a dining room complete with historical garden views through its floor-to-ceiling windows. Liaoning fisherman’s-style dishes are re-created here, with produce from Changbai Mountains and fish from Bohai Sea and Liao River. Signatures include green willow clams, and stir-fried sea snail with green onion—both flavoursome and full of umami.

Name: iDen & QuanJuDe Beijing Duck House
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Terrace,Wheelchair access
Description: It has a pedigree that traces back to an original location in Beijing from 1864, but the latest outpost in Vancouver proves that this legacy hasn't lost any of its luster. Indeed, the gold-accented dining room is a feast for the eyes, blending classic opulence with strikingly modern design.They are best known for their superlatively crispy and juicy duck. Delicious as the signature fowl may be, there is plenty more: a bevy of other delicacies are on offer, including bird's nest, sea cucumber and even a whole king crab if you're up for a splurge. It's not all razzle-dazzle, though. The cooking displays a deft hand with ingredients of all stripes from simple stir-fried mustard greens with garlic to a broth of abalone and matsutake.

Name: Masayoshi
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Chef Masayoshi Baba brings Japan's luxurious, jewel-box sushi counters to Vancouver with this eponymous restaurant. The best seats are always at the counter, and guests seated there are in for a treat as the chef ceremoniously crafts each course. Fret not if you're seated at one of the four tables though, as the meal will be equally enjoyable. Chef Baba lets British Columbia's bounty guide this omakase, spotlighting locally sourced fish in his Edomae-style nigiri. But first, a chilled dish of uni, junsai, mountain yam, crab and tomato dashi gel starts things off. Supple sea bass folded over snappy wakame; steamed monkfish in a tart broth; and abalone rendered soft as pudding—it's one hit after the next.

Name: Barbara
Address: 305 E. Pender St., Vancouver, V6A 0J3, Canada
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Wheelchair access
Description: Chef Patrick Hennessy spent time at many top spots, including Eleven Madison Park in New York, but he is clearly at home at Barbara. The kitchen feels like a stage, with guests perched at the L-shaped bar watching with bated breath as he performs culinary magic. Should you wonder where each item hails from, Chef Hennessy is happy to oblige (hint: it's local and sustainable), but most are focused on the here and now thanks to his refined techniques and sensational flavors. Oysters with local Northern Divine caviar are impeccable; crisply fried slices of Japanese eggplant with local honey and chimichurri are delightful. Simple-sounding broccolini is cooked to precise tenderness, then plated with perfectly toasted almond romesco sauce for a sensational bite.

Name: Okeya Kyujiro
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Hosts dressed in stunning traditional clothing guide you to a dark room, lit only by the faintest glow from votive candles. A black curtain is raised ceremoniously only when the clock strikes the precise minute of your seating. These are the first clues that this is far from your typical omakase. From the premium, hyper-seasonal fish to the demonstration of sasagiri (traditional Japanese bamboo leaf carving), it is a memorable show from start to finish. Highlights include chawanmushi with cherry blossom, shatteringly crispy tempura sandbar fish, spicy firefly squid on a bamboo skewer, and a presentation of two uni petals from different Japanese waters served with seaweed jam. Sweet courses garner attention, especially wagashi, fashioned into a rose here.

Name: Burdock & Co
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This Mount Pleasant charmer straddles a corner of Main Street in an area rich with top spots, but Burdock & Co stands out with its rustic appeal and Chef Andrea Carlson's farm-to-table cooking. The concise menu highlights the best of the season. First, grilled sourdough, herb-flavored gougère and nori cornbread with aged sake kasu butter prove that this is not your average bread basket. Then, miniature Hazelmere radishes roasted with house-made shio koji deliver unexpected glee. Morels stuffed with halibut mousse resting beside delicate gnocchi in a green garlic sauce embody the fleeting beauty of spring. Finally, the deconstructed chocolate soufflé with miso caramel and smoked mascarpone is a decadent delight.

Name: Kissa Tanto
Address: 263 E. Pender St., Vancouver, V6A 1T8, Canada
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Inspired by the jazz cafes of 1960s Tokyo, Kissa Tanto seduces with a moody vibe complete with white mosaic floors, antique Japanese panels and steely colored walls loaded with artwork and photos. If the stack of vinyl records by the bar didn't offer enough of a hint, the terrific music certainly will. There is a definitive laidback vibe here, but the ambitious kitchen pulls no punches with its mingling of Japanese and Italian cuisine. The region's bounty is on full display in dishes such as roasted and fried celeriac served with  onion and mushroom dashi. The cultural collision is best seen in dishes like the tajarin, hand-cut pasta dressed with butter, miso-cured egg yolk and parmesan. Tiramisu takes an Eastern turn with an ethereal, plum-wine soaked tofu-filling.

Name: Published on Main
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Timing is everything, but Chef Gus Stieffenhofer-Brandson and his team have a preternatural ability for sensing when produce is at its peak. Whether showcasing it on the plate or pickling and preserving it (those jars even double as decor), they're sourcing and foraging from local farms and forests.The contemporary fare bears the chef's distinct imprimatur. This is food that is at once familiar and surprising. A small dish of asparagus with brown butter crouton and a sauce gribiche is the very essence of spring, while an artful bowl with a pinwheel of side-striped prawns, refreshing apple and cucumber and a cool touch of horseradish delivers a sweet-tart, one-two punch. The roasted halibut's lush and buttery "broth" is unlike anything you anticipated.

Name: AnnaLena
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Don't be fooled by AnnaLena's unassuming atmosphere, as dining here is a polished experience from top to bottom. Beginning with the graceful service and carrying through to the impeccably prepared dishes, this is a restaurant that aims to impress—sans the fuss.Begin with an expertly prepared cocktail or opt for their wine pairings, which display unusual care and thoughtfulness. The seasonally inspired tasting menu highlights exceptional ingredients prepared with an outward simplicity that belies technical precision. The cooking employs pitch-perfect flavor combinations lifted with modern touches, like a delicate olive-oil-poached Chinook king salmon paired with crunchy dill-marinated kohlrabi and an airy hollandaise enhanced with the subtle sweetness of koji.

Name: St. Lawrence
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: There is so much to love about St. Lawrence with its textured walls, mosaic-tiled floor, antiques and open kitchen. A hit ever since opening, this charming Québécois bistro shares a true sense of place—it's even named for the region's mighty river. Sit close enough to Chef/owner Jean-Christophe Poirier's kitchen to experience the heady aromas of his rustic and hearty French-Canadian cooking. Begin with oreilles de crisse, a plate overflowing with crispy pork ears tossed in maple syrup and Montreal spices. Here, split pea soup takes on next-level flavor thanks to the addition of smoked bacon and foie gras. Finally, tarte au sucre is buttery and flaky, but it's that sweet maple syrup, vanilla and brown sugar filling that wins your heart.

Name: Hôtel de Ville
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: In the centre of the village, near the bell tower, this country house upholds tradition in all its simplicity – it is the owner herself who does the cooking. Beneath the vaulted ceiling of the restaurant room, you'll find seasonal French cuisine with a choice of multi-course menus. Some of the fine combinations on offer are: asparagus, grapefruit and pistachio, or lobster from Brittany, red beetroot, blackberry and bisque. The desserts are also seasonal, for example the medley of apricots in different forms (stewed, jellied, grilled), accompanied by a coconut mousse. Artists' paintings and sculptures are dotted about the interior, and there is a pleasant terrace outside for a final flourish. The café section has a brasserie-style menu.

Name: Verve by Sven
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This restaurant subscribes to the interesting concept of health-and-lifestyle cuisine, which places the emphasis on sustainability and fair trade. Here, they make a point of using seasonal produce sourced from the local region and are keen to exchange ideas with local growers and producers. Their international produce also comes from sustainable farming. The dishes, which are inspired by nature, can be ordered à la carte or enjoyed as a set menu. Then there is the friendly, attentive and professional service, and the modern and refined decor with its soothing, warm tones and pleasing natural materials – the design also reflects the establishment's connection to nature. The glass-walled wine cellar is particularly elegant.

Name: La Dispensa
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Just the ticket for fans of fresh and down-to-earth Italian cooking and a modern, casual atmosphere! This appealing restaurant is located at the upper end of the old town, and in summer spills outside onto a lovely terrace on the street side. The space occupies two floors and has an open kitchen on the lower level. Here, Gerardo Metta, previously in charge of the kitchens at the Michelin-starred Da Mimmo restaurant in Brussels, is now the chef behind the top-quality and flavoursome dishes, such as capocollo raviolo, roast mushrooms, pecorino romano, taggiasca olives. You can also purchase delicatessen ingredients to enjoy at home – sourced directly from Italy. A very pleasant place to eat! Tip for motorists: the nearby Parking du Seyon.

Name: elmira
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This modern restaurant is located in the basement of a former silo on the Löwenbräu brewery site. The open kitchen, which is practically integrated into the dining area, delivers creative dishes with a focus on sustainability and seasonality, often using ingredients sourced from the immediate vicinity. A set menu of five or seven courses is proposed – this can be vegetarian or include meat/fish. To accompany your meal, there is an interesting selection of wines, or you could sample the house-made juices – the charming, laid-back staff will gladly talk you through your options. The overall atmosphere is pleasingly relaxed and informal, and the chefs might even come to your table for a chat. N.B. There is a reservation system and you pay in advance.

Name: Denis Martin
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Chef Denis Martin's ethos could be summed up as experimental and playful! A genuine wizard in the realm of molecular cuisine (cryogenics, in particular) without ever falling into the trap of gimmicky, the chef puts a new spin on Swiss favourites, with dishes such as béton fribourgeois, sii de Savièse (an iconic local dessert), cryogenic black pudding, and langoustine… Each bite brings another surprise and the original marriages of flavours just keep coming; the multi-course set menus are served in respectable portions. The interior is elegantly unshowy, to ensure that the food enjoys the full limelight. Charming welcome.

Name: Le Chat-Botté
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: This amusingly named restaurant ("Puss in Boots") is housed in one of Lake Geneva's luxury hotels (the Beau-Rivage), which sports a blend of Art Nouveau and baroque styles. Get ready to savour contemporary French fare that is tailored to modern appetites and pays tribute to local producers, in the form of dishes such as Swiss beef tenderloin with a grilled onion jus, grilled leeks and puffed potatoes. The whole experience is enhanced by the admirable work of the sommelier, who guides you through an impressive 1 400-bin wine list.

Name: La Riva
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: If dining out on the terrace isn't an option, you should opt for one of the tables next to the huge front windows, so you can enjoy the view of the Heidsee and the mountains as you sample Dominique Schrotter's ambitious classic-cum-modern set menu, which is also available in a vegetarian version. Hailing from a family of restaurateurs, he spent some years teaching and travelling, which led him to Bangkok, among other places. Consequently, he has developed a real soft spot for East-Asian cuisine, hence the regular "Sushi Festivals". The dedicated service staff are also able to provide savvy wine recommendations.

Name: Aux Trois Amis
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A narrow road leads up to this wonderful restaurant surrounded by vineyards and boasting a pleasantly shaded terrace overlooking Lake Biel – dining al fresco here is an absolute joy! Excellent service comes courtesy of a charming front-of-house team headed up by the lady of the house. Diners are treated to a "menu surprise" featuring modern dishes that are sophisticated and delicious. Alternatively, you can order à la carte. Tip: it's best to park in their own car park and walk the last few metres.

Name: Le Berceau des Sens
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Great view,Wheelchair access
Description: Lausanne's EHL Hospitality Business School can be proud of this top-notch restaurant. A crack team of chefs (several Meilleurs Ouvriers de France are on the teaching faculty) work with the students to orchestrate a series of dishes that abound with coherent flavours, bringing their classroom learnings to the table! The dishes, which are perfectly poised between classic and modern, demonstrate a mastery of technical skill. From start to finish, each bite is bliss, and the setting also enhances the experience: the bright interior has a superb view of the surrounding mountains. Hats off!

Name: Table de Mary
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A few minutes from Yverdon-les-Bains, this restaurant enjoys an ideal location overlooking Lake Neuchâtel. It has been run with passion and dedication by Maryline and Loïc Nozahic since 2007. Their simple and beautifully executed take on classic French cuisine is replete with forthright flavours and pronounced aromas and always in tune with the seasons. Example dishes include ballotine of rabbit with mustard seeds and Puy lentil royale. On sunny days, head to the shady, flower-decked terrace, with its magnificent views of the Jura Mountains. Good value for money and regional wines. An inviting establishment.

Name: LA CHAVALLERA in der Krone - Säumerei am Inn
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: The pretty Swiss pine dining rooms range from traditional to modern minimalist. What better to accompany this regional Gemütlichkeit than flavoursome Swiss specialities such as home-made capuns (stuffed chard leaves), as well as fish and meat from the Swiss-pine smoker?

Name: EquiTable
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Here it's all about sustainability. Fairtrade, organic and – wherever possible – locally sourced produce is used to create imaginative dishes featuring innovative combinations that are full of expression and punchy flavours. The set menu composed of four to seven courses also comes in a vegetarian version. In addition to fine wines, you can opt for alcohol-free pairings in the form of high-quality juices. In keeping with the modern cuisine, this small corner restaurant has an appealingly pared-down interior. Indeed its urban and international feel attracts many younger guests. The front-of-house team is extremely attentive while remaining unobtrusive. Some of the dishes are brought to the table by the chefs themselves, who talk you through the ideas behind them.

Name: Alpine Gourmet Prato Borni
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: You will find this elegant gourmet restaurant in the magnificent Grand Hotel Zermatterhof, located in the centre of town. The classical setting done out with fine wood panelling affords a splendid view of the church. Choose between two appealing set menus: "Heimat" ("Home") and "Fernweh" ("Wanderlust"). One seeks inspiration in the region while the other looks to foreign climes. Chef Heinz Rufibach, who previously worked in this kitchen years ago, incorporates interesting ideas and skilfully brings out the flavours of the top-quality ingredients. The well-coordinated front-of-house team ensures attentive and competent service and the sommelier's recommendations are excellent – the wine list here is impressive.

Name: Capri
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Sophisticated classic Italian food is not only available at the Capri Palace on Capri, because in winter the staff from this Italian ristorante decamp to Zermatt. On the fourth floor of Le Petit Cervin (adjoining the Mont Cervin Palace), the kitchen team brings flavour, punch and aromas to your plate. The choice ingredients are top-notch. As for the atmosphere, in an elegant interior, premium materials and warm, light-toned wood combine to create a pleasant and stylish feel to go with the attentive, professional and very slick service. Tip: Be sure to take in the view from the tables by the window!

Name: Cà d'Oro
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: The restaurant in the impressive Grand Hotel des Bains Kempinski St. Moritz exudes classic elegance. From the comfort of your table, beneath the high ceiling with striking chandeliers and moulding, enjoy obliging service in the time-honoured tradition of fine-dining culture. Leopold Ott decamps to Locanda Barbarossa in Ascona in the summer season, and in winter proposes classic-modern cuisine with Mediterranean and international influences – the Cà d'Oro caviar selection is also a mainstay here. Fantastic wine selection.

Name: Jägerhof
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Jägerhof is an establishment steeped in culinary history! Since 2016, former sous-chef Agron Lleshi has been at the helm, delivering modern seasonal cuisine that seeks inspiration in the local region and abroad. The chef's mother makes the fresh bread rolls. At lunchtime, the food is somewhat simpler. When you enter the elegant restaurant, take a peek into the kitchen – this is also where the "Küchentisch" (Kitchen Table) is located, which diners can book. An attentive service team does sterling work, and impressive wine advice is also dispensed. A large selection of home-made chocolates is served with coffee.

Name: Traube
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Interesting wine list,Terrace
Description: Since chef-patron Arno Sgier took over the reins in 1993, this establishment in the little town of Trimbach has developed into a real gem of the fine dining scene. Traube is a really lovely place to be, with its chic and modern interior done out with high-quality furnishings, and its well-trained front-of-house team attending to your every need. Then there is Arno Sgier's technically ambitious cuisine. His dishes give a modern twist to classic fare – he enjoys putting his own spin on traditional recipes. Those who like a glass of good wine or two to go with a first-class meal are in for a treat, because the wine list really does have many treasures in store, especially in the bottles section. In the evening, you can choose between the "Traube" set menu and a set menu of appetisers. At midday there is the three-course lunch menu.

Name: THE VIEW
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Great view,Terrace,Wheelchair access
Description: Not surprisingly, the highlight of this elegant and modern restaurant – which bears the same name as the hotel to which it belongs – is its panoramic terrace. Modern and creative cuisine, with a more informal choice available at lunchtime.

Name: Tosca
Address: Rue de la Mairie 8, Geneva, 1207, Switzerland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
