Description: Tosca, an emblematic address of the Eaux-Vives district, famous for its fountain, takes la cucina very seriously! The interior by a contemporary Italian artist pays a distinctive tribute to the art and culture of the Italian Renaissance in a Florentine-inspired romantic setting. The food is the inspired work of Ivan Baretti, born and bred in Florence, who trained at Arpège in Paris and was a former chef at Il Lago, no less! With a magnificent supporting cast of top-class ingredients, his delicate, refined dishes unveil a strong Tuscan bias and hit the spot every time. Amiable, professional service and knock-out selection of Tuscan wines.

Name: Seerestaurant Belvédère
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Since Fabian Inderbitzin and Yvonne Chapuis opened this modern and elegant establishment in 2011, it has gone down a treat with diners. The fantastic view of Lake Lucerne alone makes the visit worthwhile – head out to the wonderful terrace to make the most of it! Happily, you don't have to miss out if you're seated inside either – thanks to the floor-to-ceiling windows. Fabian Inderbitzin's cuisine focuses on the region and takes the outstanding quality of the produce as its starting point. This gives rise to dishes brimming with sophisticated touches and original ideas. Simpler menu at lunchtime. The service is professional, friendly and attentive. Good to know: there are five spaces available at the jetty.

Name: Tsé Fung
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Born in Shenzhen, Frank Xu represents the third generation of a cooking dynasty, and the Cantonese and Chinese culinary arts have found a peerless ambassador in this veteran chef. His authentic, flavourful creations are meticulously prepared using top-notch ingredients: the langoustine dim sum, the sea bass fillet with ginger, the Peking duck (two courses) and the Sichuan aubergine cannot fail to impress. Don't hesitate to ask for advice when it comes to choosing your dishes – the front-of-house team will be happy to talk you through them. As for the setting, the pleasant interior has a classy, exotic feel and is done out in a red, black and gold colour scheme; the elegant bay windows command a view of the pool and lake.

Name: the K by mauro colagreco
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The fine dining restaurant in the distinguished Kulm Hotel St Moritz is only open to guests during the winter season. This is a great pity, for seated here at exquisitely set tables under a beautiful white vaulted ceiling you can indulge in some first-class food, brought to you by an extremely friendly and professional service team. It goes without saying that one would like to be able to sample this multifaceted, perfectly balanced and always surprising cuisine more often, delivered as it is under the supervision of Argentinean culinary grandmaster Mauro Colagreco, but without having to travel all the way to his three-star restaurant in Menton on the Côte d'Azur. It's best to opt for the surprise menu – but you can also order à la carte. Reservations are a must!

Name: Löwen - Apriori
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: You can feel the dedication of hosts Rita and Domenico Miggiano-Köferli, who have been running this lovely historical inn since 2000. As well as tasteful, individually decorated rooms and the Gaststube, Löwen is also home to Apriori, a fine dining restaurant that has held a Michelin star since 2018. The modern and elegant interior is characterised by warm dark tones, designer lamps and exquisitely laid tables. Chef-patron Domenico Miggiano puts his heart and soul into his cooking. His style: classic with Mediterranean touches. There is a gourmet set menu in the evening and the popular business lunch at midday. The wine list is beautifully put together and features a brief profile of each winemaker. Your charming and accomplished front-of-house team is supervised by the lady of the house.

Name: Vivanda
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Vivanda hits all the right notes: as well as its views of the national park and the garden, it boasts a chic interior comprising modern design and warm wood. Indeed, the Cadonau family has its own woodworking shop – hence the hotel's name: "IN LAIN", which means "made of wood". The affinity for the region makes itself felt in the decor as much as it does in the cuisine, which is based on local produce and presented in the form of a modern surprise tasting menu. Chef-patron Dario Cadonau is intent on implementing his own unique style here, showcasing excellent ingredients in unusual combinations. There's a wonderful assortment of cheeses – head to the ripening cellar yourself to make your choice! The attentive and charming service is second to none.

Name: Wirtschaft im FRANZ
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Etwas versteck in einem Innenhof liegt das «Franz» - der Name steht für «Frauen im Zentrum» und ist ein Ort für Kultur, Arbeit und Essen. Letzteres bietet man in der «Wirtschaft im Franz» in Form eines durchdachten Überraschungsmenüs. Die ambitionierten modern-kreativen Speisen sind angenehm reduziert und legen den Fokus auf Produktqualität, wobei Gemüse im Mittelpunkt steht. Schön auch das Ambiente dazu: Mit seiner offenen Küche und dem trendigen Bistro-Stil versprüht das Restaurant eine sympathisch-unkomplizierte, freundliche und urbane Atmosphäre.

Name: Lucide
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The central location on the first floor of the Lucerne Culture and Congress couldn't be better – not least because of the view of the lake and the city. The interior is stylish and chic with an open kitchen. A friendly front-of-house team serves you dishes that are pleasingly pared down and based on first-rate produce. In the evening there are two set menus, one of which is vegetarian. At lunchtime, you can order à la carte. Excellent wine selection.

Name: META
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated near the lakefront with stunning views visible through its picture windows, Meta is a friendly restaurant with an informal atmosphere and an attractive modern and minimalist decor (convenient parking is available at nearby Palazzo Mantegazza). A partially open kitchen allows guests to watch excellent chef Luca Bellanca at work as he prepares creative seasonal dishes rooted in Mediterranean traditions with the occasional international and exotic twist. Choose between three tasting menus (Vegetariano, Med-Fusion and Grandi Classici), plus a small à la carte selection.

Name: La Micheline
Address: Avenue de la Gare des Eaux-Vives 3, Geneva, 1207, Switzerland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This restaurant opposite the new station sports a magnificent bistronomy concept over two floors. The Mediterranean cuisine has been stripped of superfluous frills so shine the spotlight on the ingredient and flavour. The service is as smooth as a bearnaise sauce and the vibe is smart and upmarket. La Micheline refers to the first train from Annemasse to Eaux-Vives – equipped with Michelin tyres.

Name: Gasthaus zum Kreuz - Bijou
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Dietmar and Nicole Sawyere call this "micro-restaurant experience" what awaits you in the evening at the "Bijou" in the neat inn dating from 1570. The atmosphere here is pleasantly personal and intimate, the service attentive and cordial. An exciting culinary combination of Swiss and Asian cuisine is offered in the form of a surprise menu with six courses. The menu is called the "Hintersassen Menu" - a reference to the settlers of Dallenwil who moved here from further afield and integrated new ideas. As an alternative restaurant, the house also runs the regionally oriented "Stübli".

Name: Wöschi
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Wöschi is located directly at Wollishofen harbour and boasts a magnificent view of the Zürisee, as the locals call Lake Zurich. You may know head chef David Klocksin from 20/20 by Mövenpick, where he delivered Michelin-starred cuisine. Here, he serves up dishes that are a little lower-key, but still punchy, with an emphasis on vegetables. The three- to five-course surprise menu reflects this with pleasingly pared-down yet full-bodied creations such as baked cauliflower with curry and peanut. However, the more "conventional" options, such as the Valais pike-perch or Zurich beef, are just as delectable. This is a truly stylish restaurant, where charming and attentive service comes courtesy of Stephanie Ospelt and team. Gorgeous terrace overlooking the lake.

Name: Du Bourg
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: This 16C town house is one of Biel's architectural monuments. After careful renovations, it became the premises of this restaurant run by Fiona Liengme and Christian Aeby, both of whom previously worked at the restaurant Eisblume, in Worb. They serve vegetable-based cuisine that is full of finesse; you can opt to add in freshwater fish or selected meat from Switzerland, or stick with the set menu in its vegetarian version. Wherever possible, produce from the immediate vicinity is used. The manager has up her sleeve interesting wine recommendations and tasty non-alcoholic accompaniments made on site. It also has a fantastic "aperitif cellar", which dates back to the 12C.

Name: La Rôtisserie
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Located on the first floor of the Hotel Storchen, La Rôtisserie is every bit as tastefully decorated as the establishment that houses it – which was first mentioned in the 14C. It has a beautiful dining room with high ceilings, large arched windows and elegant, high-quality furnishings – this is a traditional yet contemporary affair. In the kitchen, the chefs work with precision and great skill to produce their own modern, international take on classic cuisine. In fine weather, be sure to head out onto the fantastic terrace – from this wonderful old-town location you can take in views of the Limmat River and the historical buildings laid out on the other side of the water.

Name: Eden Kitchen & Bar
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: "Upscale brasserie" is a good description of this restaurant in the elegant hotel La Réserve Eden au Lac. The atmosphere is relaxed, the interior chic and elegant, and the focal point is the visible green-tiled kitchen… not forgetting the windowed front overlooking the lake! Classic Italian, French and internationally influenced cuisine is concocted by a professional team from Italy. They operate under the direction of Marco Ortolani, previously at the Tuscan Trattoria Enrico Bartolini, as well as Alain Ducasse in London and Hong Kong. For fans of the classics, there are also dishes such as Zürcher Geschnetzeltes (stew) with sweetbreads. In addition, the front-of-house staff are well-trained. Take your pick from an exclusive wine selection or great cocktails.

Name: L'Aparté
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The Hotel Royal is home to a minimalist, Lilliputian restaurant with seating for only 15. Take a seat at one of the four tables and let yourself be guided. The chef personally serves his elegant, delicately crafted dishes, taking the time to describe and explain the ins and outs of each ingredient. A culinary pageant of outstanding produce including Swiss veal and beef, fish straight from Brittany and Bresse poultry, at the service of food sodden with rippling ambition and character. Book well ahead, particularly in the evenings as the handful of tables are snapped up fast. Bogie’s Bar next-door is ideal to begin or finish this superlative fine dining experience.

Name: Gasthaus zum Kreuz - Stübli
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Dietmar Sawyere, whom many will know from Andermatt's The Japanese by The Chedi at Gütsch and The Japanese Restaurant, has taken over the reins at this 500-year-old inn. In the charming wood-panelled Stübli, Alpine produce takes centre stage and is put to work with original ideas and a pleasing blend of modern, classical and traditional approaches. A prime example of this is the Arctic char served with garden peas, smoked ham, pine needles and beurre blanc. Diners are invited to choose from an array of options to put together their own menu of four to six courses. To accompany your meal, there is a decent wine list featuring Swiss and French labels. Maître d' Nicole Sawyere heads up a well-coordinated and professional front-of-house team. In summer, make a beeline for the shaded terrace – it's a perfect spot for an aperitif! For overnight stays, this inn – considered to be the oldest in the Engelberg Valley – has attractive modern guestrooms.

Name: Bayview by Michel Roth
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: With its thoughtfully designed urban chic vibe and jaw-dropping lake view, the President Wilson’s restaurant offers an idyllic setting to sample the bang-on yet delicate dishes of chef Michel Roth, MOF and Bocuse d’Or with stints at the Ritz and Lasserre. Michel creatively adds a new twist to polished French classics, such as Swiss Beef Rossini, silver thorny cardoon and Périgueux sauce or curry flavoured crab from Brittany served with Sologne caviar – exquisitely and intelligently modern.

Name: Truube
FacilitiesAndServices: Bring your own bottle,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Very inviting from the outside, this typical Appenzell country inn is no less beautiful on the inside. Come here to enjoy Silvia Manser's classic cuisine with Mediterranean influences in a pleasingly simple yet upscale setting. This is a chef who isn't averse to spicing things up, infusing her refined dishes with the perfect balance of potent flavours. It goes without saying that her ingredients are of the highest quality. Silvia Manser runs this place together with her husband Thomas, and the two of them work together like a well-oiled machine: while she is at the helm in the kitchen, he competently and cordially takes care of service, making suitable wine recommendations from their excellent selection.

Name: Neue Blumenau
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace
Description: What a lovely place! This attractive building may be a bit out of the way, but it's worth the journey, especially in summer if you can secure a spot on the wonderful garden terrace! It is also pleasant to dine inside, in the elegant restaurant. Whichever space you plump for, you will be treated to courteous service – Bernadette Lisibach, the extremely friendly owner, also makes frequent appearances at the tables. She really puts her heart and soul into running this place, using select ingredients in her fuss-free, tasty and expressive cooking, which leans towards the classical. Diners choose between two set menus. There is a good wine list and a nice selection of cheeses to round off the whole experience.

Name: Auberge de la Croix Blanche
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The epitome of calm, serenity and good food. Located in a village called Villarepos (loosely translated: "Restful Villa") and overlooking Lake Morat, this Auberge is a haven of the tranquillity that is so emblematic of Switzerland. With its flower-decked window boxes, this gorgeous house is like something straight out of a fairytale. Christa and Arno, who bend over backwards to make you feel at home, usher you into an elegant, wood-panelled dining area. Classical cuisine and premium regional produce are the watchwords when it comes to the menu. You'll leave feeling sated and happy. Bistro offering and guestrooms available.

Name: Löwen
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Tanja and Franco Körperich run this traditional inn – she ensures the warm and friendly service, while he is at the helm in the kitchen. They propose a classically oriented surprise menu that draws on top-notch ingredients. Guests are served in a charming and elegant wood-panelled dining area. You can also dine al fresco in the pretty "stone garden" located on the opposite side of the street.

Name: After Seven
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: A lift takes you up to the fine dining restaurant of the Backstage Hotel. After a relaxed aperitif on the comfortable couch stationed beneath an originally designed chandelier made up of musical instruments, you can look forward to a creative surprise menu composed of four to seven courses, which is prepared in the open kitchen by Florian Neubauer's dedicated team. You will be handed a menu listing some of the main ingredients of the evening – it's up to you to just choose the number of courses! The modern and elegant interior is brimming over with artworks – this is the hallmark of the owner, artist and hotelier Heinz Julen. The centrally positioned fireplace also adds atmosphere. You might like to opt for one of the dishes given the finishing touch at your table!

Name: Torkel
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: With its winning combination of historical and modern features, this restaurant has a really appealing look. The dominant feature of the dining room is a lovingly preserved old wine press (or "Torkel" in the local dialect), which blends in well with the modern decor that surrounds it. There is a fantastic conservatory-like dining area to the front, whose walls can be opened up. The gorgeous terrace affords magnificent views of Vaduz and the mountains. Owner Ivo Berger and his team propose a contemporary take on modern cuisine. Presented without fuss or frills, the dishes are replete with first-class produce and harmoniously balanced flavours. An attentive and charming front-of-house team provides excellent wine recommendations.

Name: Talvo by Dalsass
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Martin and Andrea Dalsass are a congenial father-and-son duo: Martin, a longtime dedicated Michelin-starred chef, likes to keep things simple, delivering unfussy dishes that are full of flavour; his son Andrea is the ideal host, with a passion for wine – here you have a fabulous selection to choose from. The beautiful setting is provided by a delightful Engadine farmhouse dating from 1658, which boasts a remarkable culinary history. Talvo successfully brings together cosiness and rustic elegance. Some of the seating is in the gallery overlooking the lower restaurant area. Good to know: both the pretty decorative cows adorning the tables and a range of delicacies are available for purchase. Closed Mon to Tue in summer.

Name: Le Murenberg
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Denis and Melanie opened Le Murenberg in March 2012, fulfilling their dream of running their own restaurant. He is in charge of the kitchen, while his wife – a pastry chef by profession – is not only the charming head of service, but also takes care of the desserts. As a native of Alsace, the owner feels a close connection to French cuisine – and the "Breton Weeks" in October are well received. His classic dishes, which draw on modern influences, are as much about the excellent craftsmanship as they are about the high-quality produce. Incidentally, the chef hails from a winemaking family, so you can look forward to a splendid selection – the half bottles are definitely a good option.

Name: Schlüssel
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A meal here is a real pleasure, thanks to Felix Suter and Sandra Marugg Suter, who are truly passionate about what they do – he in the kitchen, she front of house. There are no menus: your extremely cordial hostess will acquaint you with the set menu and explain the dishes. Always on hand, she has a delightfully natural way with guests. Chef-patron Felix Suter (who might be familiar from Säge in Flüh) shows the same passion in his cooking, delivering down-to-earth dishes that prize one thing above all else: flavour! His cooking draws on classical foundations and spurns fleeting modern trends. At lunchtime, a three-course lunch set menu is served. Lovely garden terrace.

Name: Locanda Barbarossa
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Food-lovers and fans of elegant gourmet dining will be in their element at this restaurant, which is one of the best in Ticino. Made from seasonal produce (much of which comes from the restaurant’s own land), Mattias Roock’s cuisine is a successful mix of local dishes and Mediterranean influences which nonetheless remains fundamentally rooted in classic recipes, both on the à la carte and on his two delicious tasting menus. Our inspectors also highlighted the pleasant, tranquil ambience of the setting (the beautiful outdoor terrace is particularly appealing in fine weather) and the wide choice of wines offered by sommelier Sergio Bassi. Excellent service.

Name: Sonne
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The idyllic setting alone makes the trip to this remote hamlet worthwhile. A pretty historical farmhouse bordering fields and meadows is home to this gourmet restaurant, whose stylish yet comfortable decor extends onto the terrace with its pergola and great view of the surrounding greenery. Then there are your warm and friendly hosts, Iris and Kurt Mösching. While the lady of the house adds a personal touch to proceedings front of house, heading up the professional yet appealingly relaxed service team, the chef-patron focuses on producing modern cuisine that draws on classic foundations. He wins diners over with quality ingredients, technical skill and attention to detail. The fabulous wine list boasts some 600 labels. Alternatively, you can order from the excellent bistro menu in the rustic Gaststube.

Name: Alpenblick - Stuba
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Alpenblick proposes two exciting dining options: there is the lively bistro, where you can tuck into down-to-earth cuisine such as steak tartar or Wiener schnitzel, or you can head to Stuba for its ambitious, high-quality set menu of four to seven courses, including vegetarian options. Here, chef-patron Björn Inniger serves up cosmopolitan modern fare, sourcing much of the produce from the region. His dishes feature subtle nuances, bold contrasts, and they are packed with flavour. The atmosphere is pleasantly laid back, and the setting is warm and welcoming with a touch of elegance. Friendly and attentive service comes courtesy of the charming waitstaff.

Name: Locanda Orico
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A focus on sustainability is much more than a simple slogan at this restaurant housed in a historic palazzo in the old town. Since 1998 here, the owner-chef works with excellent local suppliers in order to provide the best possible experience for his guests, talking them through each dish and the provenance of its top-quality ingredients. There’s nothing mysterious about the process, which results in healthy Mediterranean cuisine with a combination of French and regional influences, and where the menu changes at the beginning of each season and the tasting menu every month. Dishes here are carefully presented, with meticulous attention to detail and a perfect combination of colours. An interesting selection of renowned wines adds to its appeal, including an excellent choice of local and international labels. A simpler business menu is available at lunchtime, when dishes are announced at your table. A stronghold of fine Ticino cuisine! The restaurant has recently installed a recharging point for electric cars.

Name: Du Cerf
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Set in the heart of the peaceful village of Sonceboz, this establishment is a culinary landmark in what is known as the Jura Arc and also throughout Switzerland. Chef Jean-Marc Soldati, at the helm for many years now, has played a major role in the restaurant's success. For this alumnus of Crissier, where he worked alongside Fredy Girardet and Philippe Rochat, tradition is a serious business. His classic cuisine is rigorous and harmonious, drawing mainly on local and French ingredients and even the chef's own kitchen garden. The wine list features a selection of regional, Swiss and French wines, as well as terrific picks by the glass. Book yourself into one of the modern, well-appointed guestrooms and stay on after dinner.

Name: Regina Montium
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A great place to experience nature untamed – in a sensational location at an altitude of 1 550m! Under the direction of Benedikt Voss, the cuisine is well devised and very technically sophisticated; refined yet brimming with ideas, it steers well clear of gimmicks and ostentation. Only high-quality, mostly organic produce from Switzerland is used, as well as over 400 different herbs from their own garden. Opt for the alcohol-free drink pairings, which include house-made lemonades. Why not book one of the simple but well-kept guestrooms at the Kräuter Hotel Edelweiss, in which the restaurant is located? To get here from Vitznau, take the Rigi-Bahn railway, which stops just outside the building (station: Staffelhöhe).

Name: Fahr
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Clad in Swiss hardwood, the building housing this tasteful restaurant stands right by the recreation area and close to the Reuss River. Chef Manuel Steigmeier skilfully toes the line between classic and modern, resulting in convincing, unpretentious dishes that make an impression. You will find the right pairing on the decent wine list. The intense sauces and delicate desserts are also worth a mention! They use first-class produce, the majority of which comes from Switzerland. The interior is sleek and chic – the impressive designer lamps by the owner's son draw the eye – and outside there is a wonderful terrace. On weekdays there is a simpler menu at lunchtime, and on Saturdays and Sundays some dishes from the evening menu are served.

Name: Neue Taverne
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Nenad Mlinarevic, who is also the man behind Bauernschänke, has called for reinforcements at the helm of his second Zurich restaurant: Fabian Fuchs, previously of EquiTable, is now head chef at the Neue Taverne. This pleasingly straightforward restaurant is done out in the style of a modern inn. The open kitchen turns out vegetarian cuisine – some of it 100% vegan – that is designed to be shared. The menu features 12 wonderfully creative dishes that change with the seasons – opt for three to four per person. For those who have trouble deciding, there is a surprise menu on offer in the evening. Choose from a selection of organic wines, homemade lemonades and kombuchas to accompany your meal. The service is extremely friendly and well-trained. At lunchtime the choice is more limited, but you will also find one or two dishes from the evening menu.

Name: Chesa Stüva Colani
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Absolutely up to the minute in technical terms, Paolo Casanova's cooking is elaborate and anything but "off the peg". This is a chef who is extremely dedicated to his cause, seeking inspiration in the region and the seasons, gathering and growing his own herbs, fermenting and pickling... All of which gives the dishes a personal touch as well as extremely interesting nuances of flavour. The setting in this gem of a hotel is fantastic too. The restaurant showcases an exquisite blend of warm, local wood furnishings and elegant minimalist design. The upmarket and stylish guestrooms with their chalet charm are fully in keeping with the atmosphere. As an alternative to the fine dining restaurant, there is also a bistro.

Name: KLE
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Zineb ("Zizi") Hattab proposes something out of the ordinary in her charming pub. Not only is the modern-creative food entirely vegan, but it also draws on interesting Moroccan and Mexican influences. The chef – the daughter of Moroccan immigrants – was born in Spain and grew up in Barcelona. Originally an engineer, she followed her passion for cooking, gaining work experience with Andreas Caminada in Switzerland and in Mexican restaurant Cosme in New York, to name but two. Choose three to five courses for the surprise menu served in the evening. Great importance is attached to regionality and sustainability, and that also applies to the wine.

Name: GÜTSCH by Markus Neff
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This restaurant high up on the Gütsch mountain (2 344m above sea level), after which it is named, can be reached on the Gütsch Express cable car – hop on at the lower terminus (departing from Andermatt railway station). Chef Markus Neff and his team, along with the restaurateur trio of Müller, Gruß and Neumüller, put their heart and soul into this venture. The best place to sit is on the spectacular terrace – you could even call it a viewing platform! And if the weather isn't playing ball, it's just as pleasant to sit inside. The decor is modern and simple, which is entirely in keeping with the no-nonsense culinary style and relaxed atmosphere. Markus Neff's classic cuisine encompasses dishes from French haute cuisine as well as more regionally influenced fare – the beef tartar is a must on the à la carte menu – and goes well with the wonderful wines. A tip for your journey back down to the valley: get off the cable car at the middle station and continue on foot – it's a great walk!

Name: La Pinte des Mossettes
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Here, the mountains reign supreme: the vertiginous journey to reach this historical farmhouse with a panoramic terrace, fireplace and creaky wooden floors, but most of all when it comes to the food. Herbs, flowers and aromatic plants are the focal point of this inspired cuisine that scrupulously respects the seasons, the landscapes and those who work in them. Examples of this vegetable-based cooking include beetroot confit, seed praline and red berries; buckwheat noodles with king trumpet mushrooms and aubergine. A carefully curated wine list and the possibility of making your own alcohol-free plant-based beverage.

Name: OZ
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: OZ, another restaurant by Andreas Caminada, is to be found in the beautiful grounds of Schloss Schauenstein. The name is derived from the Romansh word for "today" and refers to the contemporary food on offer. The entirely vegetarian cuisine is something of a novelty in Caminada's portfolio of eateries. It is made with produce grown in the restaurant's own permaculture garden or sourced from long-standing partners. You will certainly not miss meat as you savour the vibrant and delicate dishes in the extensive set menu. Diners sit at a U-shaped counter and watch the chefs in action – it's a great place to strike up a conversation.

Name: Sushi Shin
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: In the centre of Zurich, right next to the historical Münsterhof square, this compact sushi restaurant is tucked away in a side street. Seated at the counter in a sophisticated yet informal interior, guests are treated to a seasonal omakase menu. The charming proprietress will guide you through the evening (in English), and you can also watch chef Masami Okamoto prepare the sushi. In the evening, the set menu is served at two sittings. At lunchtime, there is also a short sushi and sashimi menu. Whether you prefer wine or sake with your meal, there are some real gems to be had – but with a price tag to match. Be sure to reserve, as the restaurant has only eight seats! Given the location just a stone's throw from the River Limmat, you should not miss the opportunity to take a stroll while you are here.

Name: Bad Balgach by Schützelhofer
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Bernd Schützelhofer is well known for his work in the kitchens of Kronenstübli, in Pontresina, and Paul's, in Widnau. Since late 2020, the Vorarlberg-born chef has been managing this inn steeped in history. Here, diners feast on a truly typical and unpretentious take on classic cuisine; focused entirely on flavour, it is prepared using excellent produce. The chef-patron's style, cultivated over the years, is distinctive and expressive. Friendly hostess Jackie Pedregal, Bernd Schützelhofer's partner, is also on hand front of house. This smart establishment is elegantly done out in a chic and modern style, and boasts a lovely terrace in summer.

Name: Colonnade
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Dating back to 1906, the Mandarin Oriental, situated on the lakeshore, is certainly a stylish setting in which to dine. This restaurant exudes the charm of yesteryear with contemporary elegance. With wonderful Art Nouveau light fixtures suspended from the high ceiling, striking marble columns and an almost floor-to-ceiling glazed wine cabinet, the interior is a sight to behold. Chef Gilad Peled and his enthusiastic team showcase their modern take on French cuisine – their signature dish is turbot served with fregola sarda, chard, mussels and a seaweed beurre blanc. The eight-course tasting menu also comes in a vegetarian version. There is an excellent selection of wines from around the globe, and head sommelier Moritz Dresing provides the most astute recommendations. A nice touch: The tasting menu includes a brief visit to the kitchen.

Name: Osteria Enoteca Cuntitt
Address: Via alla Chiesa 8, Castel San Pietro, 6874, Switzerland
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated just above Mendrisio, a charming small village with a delightful historic centre and church, this elegant restaurant occupies a beautiful Lombardy-style farmhouse. Popular with locals and visitors alike, the restaurant serves regionally inspired Italian cuisine, including several dishes featuring caviar. The impressive and varied wine list includes bottle from the restaurant’s own winery, while two charming terraces provide the perfect setting for alfresco dining in summer.

Name: Njørden
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: In addition to an exquisite boutique hotel, “Hemma” and the “Njørd Café”, Philippe Deslarzes also owns a gourmet restaurant, “Njørden “, where he mingles Swiss and Swedish influences. His cooking is modern and highly contrasted, featuring many regional as well as Scandinavian ingredients and culinary techniques. The service is enthusiastic and professional, as is the savvy sommelier.

Name: UniQuisine Atelier
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant certainly achieves its goal of making guests feel they are "dining at a friend's place". The "unique" location alone ensures this: the relatively small dining area is laid out in a modern apartment done out in a minimalist chic style on the third floor of a residential and restaurant block. A pleasingly informal and intimate atmosphere prevails, not least thanks to the central open kitchen. Diners are in good hands with head chef Christoph Oliver Aebersold and restaurant manager Agron Tunprenkaj – two consummate professionals who provide friendly, high-quality service. The meticulous cuisine is pared down to the essentials and served in the form of a five- or seven-course set menu drawing on excellent, seasonal ingredients. Enjoy an aperitif on the lovely balcony terrace as you take in the view of the Pilatus and Stanserhorn mountains.

Name: Birdy's by Achtien - The Nest
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A restaurant within a restaurant. In the middle of Birdy's by Achtien - Sharing Restaurant you will find The Nest. The cosy setting is friendly, with pleasing floral touches and enjoyable relaxing background music. Diners can also interact directly with the team working in the open kitchen, which makes for a delightfully communicative atmosphere. Together with partner Jeroen Achtien, chef Christian Vogel creates a modern surprise menu with five courses that change according to the season. Thanks to the Big Green Egg grill, the juicy, tender Ennetbürgen beef, for example, has a wonderful barbecued note. No less interesting is the very special cooking technique that gives the salmon from Lostallo a fantastic texture. There is space for 12 guests at this gourmet food bar, and the set menu is served to all of them at the same time.

Name: Wiesner Mysterion - Zauber
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: For the culinary wizardry he displayed at Rössli, the family restaurant in Escholzmatt, Stefan Wiesner earned a name for himself as the "Hexer", as well as a MICHELIN star. Now he has moved on to Weitsicht, a hotel 1 052m above sea level, which hosts special seminars, and first and foremost showcases the chef's very own philosophy of "alchemical natural cuisine". And what could be a more fitting location than the Entlebuch Biosphere Reserve? With mountains and valleys, meadows and forests all around, this environment is a source of the most diverse ingredients and flavours. Pure nature is the essence of Stefan Wiesner's cuisine. His set menu changes to reflect the seasons, and he introduces each of the nine courses with a little story. To do justice to the wonderful view, this unique culinary experience starts at noon. His son Jo's cutlery workshop is also located on the premises.

Name: Osteria dell'Enoteca
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in a quiet residential district, this charming, elegant and modern restaurant is run by a friendly and professional young couple who serve delicious and imaginative contemporary-style cuisine. The dining room is dominated by a large fireplace, while in summer meals are also served alfresco in the flower-filled garden. Works of art grace the premises both indoors and out. Interesting selection of wines from Ticino.

Name: Sternen - Badstube
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Terrace,Wheelchair access
Description: Located in the sleepy town of Wangen, this pretty inn with its attractive 16C barrel vault is a wonderful meeting of the historical and the modern. A committed couple have been plying their trade here since 2005 – Matthias Brunner is in charge in the kitchen, while Bettina Brunner-Schill oversees the friendly front-of-house team. Choose between the seasonal tasting menu (omnivore or vegetarian option) and classic dishes, made with only the finest ingredients. Savvy wine recommendations. The cosy, rustic-style Gaststube, serving traditional cuisine, is a nice alternative to Badstube. Comfortable guestrooms at Gasthof Sternen.

Name: La Miranda Gourmet Stübli
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Complex, elaborate and visually gorgeous – this is how chef Bernd Fabian's dishes come across. His craftsmanship, original ideas and skilful approach to balancing the flavours of his individual ingredients are showcased in dishes such as Norway lobster served with tomato, celery and vanilla cream, purple gnocchi and dashi. The surprise menu, available in three, four or five courses, creates a real sense of anticipation! Here in the beautiful fine dining restaurant of Hotel Chasa Montana, the head chef is apt to head to your table in person and talk you through the story behind his creations. You might like to peruse the very well-put-together wine list, which offers a top-class selection. Your host and sommelier, Daniel Eisner, embodies the passion for wine that the whole team here shares.

Name: Brasserie Uno
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A bustling little restaurant of the sort you could easily expect to find in Berlin or New York. The tables are set close together, in a pleasingly laid-back atmosphere. You can peek into the open kitchen, where the two chefs prepare a surprise multi-course tasting menu. They cook with regional ingredients, attach great importance to seasonal references and are mindful of the origin of the produce they select. The dishes are cleverly devised and their flavours and aromas are convincing. Vegetarian and vegan tasting menus are also available by advance booking. N.B. There is no À la carte menu and no children's menu.

Name: Le Pérolles
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: Chef Pierrot Ayer is the darling of the residents of Fribourg, whom he dazzles with his talent and flair in this elegant, designer venue. Downstairs in a striking contemporary setting, he crafts delicate, high-flying dishes, whose expressive generosity reflects his personality, particularly in his inspired reinterpretations of Gallic classics. At lunchtime, there is a more accessible 3- or 4-course menu and, in the evenings, there is also a vegetarian menu. Splendid cheese trolley. For a “simpler” experience, head upstairs to the bistro-cum-grocery store, le Petit Pérolles, and dig into fresh regional produce in a more casual vibe.

Name: Stéphane Décotterd
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Exquisitely located on the heights of Montreux, the restaurant of the Glion Institute of Higher Education commands a fantastic view of Lake Geneva and the mountains. The modern, elegant interior is tasteful, and the service is friendly and professional. Stéphane Décotterd's well-defined, unpretentious cuisine gives pride of place to Swiss ingredients. By prior arrangement, the chef serves his signature dish, dry-aged duck reared in Walzenhausen, roasted whole in wine vinegar (for two people).

Name: Sihlhalde
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The location is somewhat rural, with the drive there taking you down a small road that leads past green pastures and grazing cows... But the journey to this idyllic little hamlet is well worth it, for Gregor Smolinsky has a special talent: his ability to strip things down to the bare essentials. The focus is squarely on the produce. His style of cooking is classic, clear-cut and free of unnecessary frills; nothing distracts from the superior quality of the ingredients. Only a few components are ever used, and they are always brimming with intense flavours. You should definitely try his brasato ravioli or his soufflé – they almost have cult status! It's no wonder that the cosy restaurant in this charming historical farmhouse (which was actually once his parents' farm) is often fully booked.

Name: Il Lago
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The iconic Four Seasons hotel, Geneva’s oldest luxury hotel (1834), dripping with pilasters and frescoes, is the setting of Il Lago, or Lake Geneva’s classy remake of the dolce vita. Italian chef Massimiliano Sena, whose star-studded CV features a dazzling line-up of world-class establishments, curates high-flying Italian cuisine, with the odd Mediterranean accent, rich in aromas, subtlety and delicacy. The quintessence of fine dining.

Name: Ackermannshof
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Terrace
Description: Housed in a lovingly restored and converted printing house that dates back centuries, this restaurant is run by a well-coordinated team that many guests will be familiar with from Osteria TRE in Bubendorf – chef Flavio Fermi and maître d' Roland Tisch. Seated in the extremely chic and tastefully decorated interior, you can look forward to their fine, thoroughly Italian take on Mediterranean cuisine; made with a wealth of Swiss ingredients, it is served as a set menu. This is accompanied by on-point wine pairings or your own choice from the extensive wine list, which includes a nice selection of champagnes. The stylish bar area is the perfect spot for a nightcap. There is also a lovely terrace.

Name: Damien Germanier
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: After consulting with tattooed chef Damien Germanier as to the number of courses of our meal (4-10), we then give him carte blanche. His culinary hallmark reveals a strong weakness for veggies and a creative streak that hits the spot every time. You can expect to taste inventive, bold, even surprising dishes in a stripped-back setting, adorned with striking photos that is as off-kilter, vibrant and buzzy as the food and its chef. Slick, yet unstuffy service.

Name: L'OURS
Address: Route du Pas de l'Ours 41, Crans-Montana, 3963, Switzerland
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A modern, stylish vibe, depicted by high-quality fixtures and fittings and a profusion of wood and stone, sets the alpine tone of this luxurious mountain venue. The quality of the ingredients is equally superlative and chef Franck Reynaud reverently respects the seasons. His classical recipes with a modern twist are proposed in a surprise menu of 5 to 8 courses. Enticing list of Valais wines. The slick service is as smooth as a silky béarnaise sauce without being stuffy or starched.

Name: Sommet by Martin Göschel
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: As if the exclusive The Alpina Gstaad were not an impressive enough hotel, it also comes up trumps with this appealing restaurant. Sommet is something special in several respects: first, there is its distinctive decor, which is an elegant blend of rustic charm and modern elegance; second, the fantastic panoramic terrace and, last but not least, the elaborate seasonal "Signature" set menu created by Martin Göschel. The Mannheim-born chef, who previously earned Michelin stars at the Paradies hotel in Ftan and the Alte Post in Nagold, successfully combines classic cuisine with modern influences. As an alternative to the set menu – which is also available in a vegan version – you can order classics à la carte.

Name: Gasthaus Zum Gupf
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Perched 1 083m above sea level and reached by a steep, narrow path, this place is a little slice of heaven! The pretty inn with a wood-panelled interior exudes regional charm and boasts a view of the mountains or the lake, plus a wonderful terrace. Walter Klose cooks up aromatic classic cuisine that follows the seasons and combines finesse with a certain unpretentiousness. When it comes to the service, you are in good hands thanks to the excellent team led by the lady of the house, who serves diners with a warm and easy manner. The wine list is sensational – a tour of the wine cellar with over 30 000 bottles is a real experience! You can also spend the night in the pleasant guesthouse.

Name: Wirtshaus Zur Säge
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The "Sägi" has long been known for its great food, and Michelin-starred chef Patrick Zimmermann, who has been running this long-established inn for years together with his wife Corinne, is continuing this tradition. He prepares classic French cuisine, sets great store by seasonality and has a knack for contrasts and textures. His fine sauces also testify to his cooking skills. Excellent produce forms the basis of his delicious dishes. And the atmosphere? In addition to the cosy, rustic and elegant interior with its wooden panelling and old ceiling beams as well as pictures and pretty floral decorations, there is also the attentive front-of-house team headed up by the charming lady of the house – who will also be happy to recommend wines by the glass. In summer, make a beeline for the charming terrace with its vines and chestnut tree!

Name: Maison Manesse
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A wonderfully down-to-earth restaurant! It enjoys a somewhat inconspicuous location, at a remove from the city centre, and its pared-down, unpretentious decor is almost pub-like, a little on the rustic side, but also modern – "vintage" probably sums it up best. The service is relaxed but well drilled. The "Menu Surprise" comes in a vegetarian, vegan or "I-eat-everything" version. There is also a small selection of à la carte dishes. The kitchen team uses top-notch ingredients to cook up dishes brimming with original ideas – creative, but not outlandish. A great example is the red cabbage in a salt crust, served with Jerusalem artichoke, morel and apple. As well as fine wines, they have some interesting alcohol-free alternatives. Reduced lunchtime menu.

Name: Domaine de Châteauvieux
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Courtesy of chef-patron Philippe Chevrier, this institution that is full of soul and character has had a youthful makeover. All the more reason to come to this culinary landmark in the vicinity of Geneva in an ideal location surrounded by vineyards and off the beaten tourist track. Assisted by a seasoned team, Philippe Chevrier crafts refined French cuisine, ranging from modern to classical, based on outstanding produce and instantly identifiable flavours. Attentive service and a wine list that turns out to feature plenty of treats. Enjoy your meal on the idyllic terrace overlooking the hills. Finally, to digest this culinary experience in style, take advantage of the charming, tastefully decorated guestrooms.

Name: La Table d'Adrien
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This smart stylish chalet overlooking Verbier serves tasty, inventive Italian cuisine in a cosily appointed elegant hotel. Chef Sebastiano Lombardi, who hails from Puglia, pays particularly attention to the quality of the noble ingredients, which he crafts into superlative dishes. A treat for the eye and the tastebuds, each dish reveals consummate precision, high-flying creativity and spot-on flavours. Insightful wine-food pairings, dutiful service and a knock-out view add the final flourish to this snug, yet swish chalet in the mountains.

Name: Segreto
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: You may be surprised to discover such a fine place on company premises, but you will immediately be transported to the Mediterranean. You can enjoy an aperitif in the relaxed lounge looking out over the pretty garden. In keeping with the setting, Martin Benninger cooks up traditional Mediterranean cuisine, which he enhances with Asian touches. The interior is modern and elegant – in summer, with its glass front open, the conservatory almost feels like a terrace. The attentive and experienced front-of-house team also provide excellent wine recommendations, and the digital wine list is really well curated. Al Covo is a charming alternative – for pizza, pasta etc (Fri-Sun evenings).

Name: La Chaumière by Serge Labrosse
Address: Chemin de la Fondelle 16, Troinex, 1256, Switzerland
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Feel like a breath of fresh air and getting out of the town centre? This Cottage by Serge Labrosse (who also gives cookery lessons in Geneva) is just the ticket. An elegant, contemporary vibe sets the scene for artfully presented dishes based on painstakingly selected ingredients by a chef who has knocked around a bit…, without forgetting the pretty terrace in fine weather and very convenient private car park. Whether you prefer traditional fare or more modern creations, there is something for everyone.

Name: Le Cigalon
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Judging by the fresh fish on the menu, you could be forgiven for thinking that this restaurant is on the doorstep of the Brittany coast. For over 20 years, the Bessire couple has been shining the spotlight on produce that comes straight from the fish auctions of Roscoff and Audierne, without forgetting scallops fished by divers in Norway. A dedication to excellence that has earned Le Cigalon star status for some 25 years! Intelligently crafted, generous dishes that highlight first-rate produce. In fine weather, meals are served on the terrace. Table d'hôte meals for five guests, served in the kitchen, can also be booked for an extra special experience.

Name: RICO'S
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: Rico Zandonella's restaurant stands out from the crowd! It is charming, cosy, colourful and packed with art – a tastefully eclectic mix of styles and highly individual decorative details. In addition, the service is pleasingly laid-back and professional. Served in the form of a set menu comprising three to eight courses, the food has an international flavour; to accompany it, choose from the nicely curated wine list, which has a particularly good selection from Switzerland and France. There is a set lunch menu Wed-Fri. For anyone looking for a venue for private events: you can book Rico's Privé.

Name: I Due Sud
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Housed within the beautiful Splendide Royal hotel, this small, welcoming restaurant serves gourmet cuisine showcased on different tasting menus: IL POMODORO CHE NON C'È (Ticino and Calabria), IL RESTO DEL MONDO (Peru, Japan, Italy, France, Switzerland, Puerto Rico, Germany), DOMENICO A MANO LIBERA (the chef’s surprise menu), and ESSENZA DELL'ORO (vegetarian, available by prior booking only). In the dining room, the excellent maître-sommelier will guide you through the extensive wine list which is full of useful background information, especially on wines from Ticino. Make sure you book ahead to guarantee a table with a view.

Name: Château Attisholz
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This is a rather grand establishment located just outside Riedholz. A truly splendid historical property houses the exquisitely elegant and tastefully designed fine dining restaurant le feu, with the garden and courtyard outside being a draw in themselves. Chef-patron Jörg Slaschek proposes a sophisticated modern-classical set menu (also available in a vegetarian version), but there is also an à la carte selection. It goes without saying that the Bavarian-born chef uses only select produce. A well-curated selection of European wines makes for the perfect accompaniment to your meal. Overnight accommodation is also available: There are two really appealing guestrooms that fit perfectly into the overall picture of sophistication.

Name: Panorama - Cayenne
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This establishment has been run by the Fuchs family for 35 years, and these days, it is Rolf and Manuela Fuchs who are in charge. The modern, elegant restaurant atop Hartlisberg boasts not only a chic atmosphere but also a truly magnificent view of Thun and the mountains – a spot on the terrace is a must! The chef-patron's cuisine is no less of a draw. It is modern, yet clearly classical in its foundations, making for dishes that are robust and expressive. As a matter of course, the ingredients are sourced locally as possible. There is a decent wine selection, and astute recommendations come courtesy of the friendly, professional waitstaff.

Name: Alpenblick
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This quintessential Swiss inn makes for a seriously appealing culinary experience. It is all down to Richard and Yvonne Stöckli, who have been putting their heart and soul into this long-standing establishment since 1980. Friendly and efficient, she heads up the service team in the charming little dining room (judicious wine recommendations from a great selection), while he showcases his skills in the kitchen, conjuring up dishes distinguished by their craftsmanship, quality ingredients and punchy flavours. His interesting modern and seasonal set menu comprises four to seven courses. Delightful garden terrace – ask for one of the seats beneath the old plane tree. Tip: Cheese lovers should try the Nessleren Alpine cheese! The rustic bistro and pretty guestrooms complete this charming picture.

Name: Bel Etage
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Lovely old parquet flooring, beautiful double doors and high ceilings with crystal chandeliers, as well as decorative art on the walls... Here on the first floor of Der Teufelhof hotel, the stylish salons of the Bel Etage blend harmoniously into the historical setting. In the kitchen, the focus is on the classics. Since Michael Baader opened the place in 1989, he has maintained impeccably high standards. He steers clear of culinary fads; instead, the chef at the helm wins diners over with straightforward, produce-led dishes full of expression and flavour. The front-of-house team is friendly and professional, providing savvy wine recommendations – the fabulous list is very well put together. In good weather, make a beeline for the pretty terrace and grab a table under the sun awning in the hotel's garden.

Name: Schlüssel - Nidbergstube
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: A real institution in the canton of St Gallen. Since 1974, the Kalberer family name has been synonymous with exquisite fine dining. Son Roger has now taken over the reins and continues to run the kitchen in the same vein. Dishes brimming with robust flavours are complemented by a fabulous wine list including a decent selection of Swiss wines and an abundance of French labels. Friendly and well-drilled service team. The cosy, refined interior also hits the right notes, with the small Nidbergstube doing full justice to the historical setting of this elegant patrician house dating back to 1811. This restaurant is named after the Nidberg hill in the village, where wine has been grown since the 15C.

Name: Wein & Sein
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Hostess Daniela Jaun and chef Pascal Melliger (partners both professionally and privately) put their heart and soul into running this pleasant restaurant, nestled in a cellar space with a beautiful vaulted ceiling. The chef cooks modern cuisine with vim and vigour, but also finesse; plus he has a knack for coming up with clever combinations. He uses select produce (preferably produced regionally and sustainably) to prepare an evening set menu comprising four to six courses – a vegetarian version is also available if you pre-order. When it comes to wine, you can rely on the charming and extremely committed young owner to help you choose – her recommendations from the interesting selection are excellent.

Name: Zur Gedult
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This place goes to show that a simple setting and upscale cuisine don't have to be mutually exclusive. In one of the oldest inns in Burgdorf (dating back to 1716), diners sit at bistro tables in a pleasingly relaxed and informal atmosphere and are waited on by a friendly, professional and well-organised service team. The building may be historical, but the menu proposes contemporary cuisine. This is the domain of Lukas Kiener. The young chef has a modern and creative culinary style that sets great store by using seasonal produce that is sourced from the region. A four- to six-course menu is on offer, and for those who would rather skip the meat, there is also an alternative vegetarian set menu.

Name: Steinhalle
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This hotspot of the capital's fine dining scene is undoubtedly a new take on high-end gastronomy! "Casual dining" is the name of the game here. In the evening, diners take their seats in a lively bistro setting to sample an exceedingly interesting and creative surprise menu that is constantly exploring different themes, countries and regions. This is where chef-patron Markus Arnold draws inspiration from his travels. To complete the picture, this undisputedly cool establishment boasts a fine historical interior complete with high ceilings, a gallery and large arched windows – the open kitchen is the real attraction. The menu is completely different at lunchtime, when the concept is called "easy lunch".

Name: Au 1465
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: With a wealth of experience at MICHELIN-starred restaurants under his belt, Mariano Buda now heads up the kitchen here. Although his style of cooking has been aptly described as a modernised take on classic cuisine, he incorporates authentic traditional cooking techniques as well. A prime example of this is the impeccably crafted classic pâté served alongside tender poulard fillet. Last but not least, abundant flavour is also provided by carefully selected ingredients, most of which are sourced from the region. The well-curated wine list is presented to you on a tablet – Swiss and French labels are well represented. Incidentally, the name of this chic, modern restaurant is a reference to the altitude of the exclusive little hotel Au Club Alpin in which it is housed – with its breathtaking view of the surrounding mountains is truly delightful.

Name: Les Montagnards - Le Sommet
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: At the small fine dining restaurant of the hotel Les Montagnards, diners enjoy modern cuisine that hits the mark with premium ingredients and precise technical know-how. Dishes focus on flavour and steer clear of gimmicks: hamachi, daikon, avocado, ponzu; saddle of Landes lamb, aubergine, tomatoes, black garlic. Highly competent service and judicious wine recommendations. The chic interior, all warm wood panelling and clean lines, affords lovely views from the seats near the windows. Guestrooms are available for those looking to hike in the surrounding area.

Name: The Japanese by The Chedi at Gütsch
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit cards not accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,Notable sake list,Terrace,Wheelchair access
Description: Those who wish to enjoy terrific Japanese cuisine high up in a stunning Alpine setting should head to this restaurant, located 2 344m above sea level, and preferably bag a table on the wonderful terrace set against this grandiose mountain backdrop! Working in tandem, twin brothers Dominik Sato and Fabio Toffolon create classic Japanese cuisine with subtle European influences. Choose from an "Omakase Kaiseki Menu", "Shidashi Bento" and their excellent sushi and sashimi selection. A children's menu is also available. Smooth service is provided by a friendly and attentive team. The setting is minimalist yet inviting, and the open kitchen draws the eye. You can reach the restaurant with the Gütsch Express from the lower terminal at Andermatt railway station).

Name: Restaurant GERBER WYSS
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Laurena and Grégory Wyss, along with Séverin Gerber, are the team behind this restaurant in the heart of the town, just a stone's throw from their boulangerie-chocolaterie – the two men were previously chocolate-maker and baker, respectively, at the renowned Restaurant de l'Hôtel de Ville in Crissier. The chef serves up creative dishes that showcase the Swiss terroir: for example, crayfish from Lake Neuchâtel, fennel kimchi and oyster leaves are among the various "instants" comprising the "Signature" set menu. You will be served by an attentive and charming team, and a sommelier who is a fountain of knowledge.

Name: Des Trois Tours
FacilitiesAndServices: Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In this 19C patrician house near the centre of Fribourg, diners can savour a harmonious set menu comprising five to seven courses. Stripped back to home in on the essentials, the dishes are also pleasing to the eye. The food is served in a stylish, refined and modern atmosphere, and the service is professional. The interesting wine list focuses on Switzerland and France.

Name: 1910 Gourmet by Hausers
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus
Description: The fine dining restaurant of the Hotel Belvedere welcomes diners in a compact space with just six tables. In the kitchen, Hungarian chef Dávid Imre Rózsa runs the show. His technically modern and pleasingly pared-back style conveys emotions through its flavours, and comes into its own in dishes such as dry-aged pike perch with Oscietra caviar from Frutigen – this also exemplifies the firm focus on using local produce. There is a choice of two set menus, one of which is vegetarian, as well as a good wine selection with the option of ordering by the glass. The kitchen team provide back up to the friendly waitstaff.

Name: Radius by Stefan Beer
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In his kitchen in the restaurant of the time-honoured Victoria Jungfrau Grand Hotel, Stefan Beer only uses ingredients sourced within a 50km radius (the clue is in the name!). He proposes a conventional set menu and a vegan set menu, as well as a menu for two people sharing, which includes classics finished at your table and large cuts of meat. Diners are talked through the pleasingly uncomplicated dishes – sometimes by the chef. Produce that they harvest themselves is used, as well as local shrimps or caviar from the region. The high standards are also reflected in the tasteful and upscale interior.

Name: Krone
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This long-established restaurant is all about Italian food, and this is entirely down to Samuel Carugati. The young chef takes it right back to basics, a philosophy that extends to the pleasingly unostentatious presentations. The classic sauces are elegant and have great depth of flavour, which, along with the subtle aromas, hints at the French foundations of the dishes. In short, the chef combines the best of Italian and classical cuisine, and does so using excellent-quality produce. The attractive interior comprises charming dining spaces, and the cordial front-of-house team overseen by proprietor Fabio Rovisi provide competent and attentive service. Very good wine list including numerous large-format bottles.

Name: Gilles Varone
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Located in the heart of this quaint village overlooking Sion, this restaurant may appear unassuming from the outside. You would never suspect such culinary delights to be served at the simple wooden tables, showcasing a cuisine that is entirely dedicated to Switzerland and bursting with rich flavours! Following stints with Anton Mosimann, Gordon Ramsay and Claude Bosi in London, owner and head chef Gilles Varone has returned to his homeland to serve up a pleasantly pared-down cuisine, complete with a focus on sustainability. The restaurant itself, with its unpretentious and simple decor, is a perfect match. The front-of-house team win diners over with their charm and expertise. The wine list is exclusively Swiss – alternatively, you could opt for the house-made kombucha.

Name: ZOE
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: United by the motto "Vegetables in various facets", restaurateur duo Fabian Raffeiner (kitchen) and Mark Hayoz (service) are following their passion, concocting vegetarian dishes that are modern and creative, meticulously prepared and rich in flavour, such as king oyster mushroom, fermented garlic, parsley and buckwheat. We recommend opting for the seven- to ten-course set menu, but alternatively you can dine à la carte. Beverage accompaniments include natural wines, beers and non-alcoholic drinks. Lunchtime options are limited to a three-course "business lunch" and a "bowl". This two-storey restaurant with its charming minimalist interior is located in the heart of the old town. Laid-back, professional front-of-house team. Pleasant little terrace.

Name: Alo
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Everyone has a good time at Chef Patrick Kriss’s beloved Alo. You can sense this much at the lively bar, where walk-ins are treated like VIPs by personable servers.Basking in the light of the open kitchen, the cozy dining room sees just as much excitement, and the talented beverage team offers spot-on suggestions from the well-chosen wine list. The kitchen team seamlessly merges European and Asian sensibilities onto a single tasting menu with dishes like creamy Koshihikari risotto boosted with porcini emulsion or rack of lamb with Thai green curry. They can cook the classics too, like Dover sole with caviar beurre blanc. Showcasing flexibility and talent, Alo is the rare high achiever that never takes itself too seriously.

Name: Kaiseki Yu-zen Hashimoto
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: There is something special about this place and it's not just because it's connected to the Canadian Japanese Cultural Center. Instead of a traditional dining room, it's more like walking into a park, with guests tucked away in private rooms. Chef Masaki Hashimoto's traditional kaiseki eight-course menu showcases the seasons while celebrating Japanese ingredients.
