At Brass Boer Thuis, the chefs are not afraid to use bold flavours, but they always manage to strike the right balance. As a result, the extensive menu is full of mouthwatering options. Who says fine dining can't be a relaxed affair?

Name: Eden
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Eden is the playground of chef Herman Cooijmans. His little piece of paradise has a nice vintage feel and exudes warmth thanks to the use of natural elements and colours. The cuisine displays artistry and subtlety, flavoured with global influences – the chef likes to use spices from the Middle East to add a touch of exotic flair.His talent is also apparent from the contrasting combinations he brings to the plate. Although dishes such as watermelon with spicy curry and skate with strawberry might sound a bit unusual, the tastes and flavours this chef manages to create are remarkable.The exquisite wine pairings further highlight the fine cuisine, ensuring that wine-lovers will find their own little Garden of Eden here!

Name: Brienen aan de Maas
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: René Brienen feels right at home on the River Meuse. This former ferryman's café with large windows affords spectacular views of the river. A table on the terrace is a must! The setting inspires the experienced chef to create indulgent dishes that showcase regional produce such as Limburg asparagus and Livar Kloostervarken pork – ingredients that lend his cuisine a distinctive character. Chef Brienen also combines classical techniques with the occasional flash of inventiveness, such as making use of low-temperature cooking and a Big Green Egg barbecue – on which he prepares trout in hay, for example. Or how about a hearty dish of various cuts of veal served with a fantastic veal jus infused with curry and ginger? The chef's mastery of his craft makes itself felt in all the appealing set menu options. When it comes to choosing a wine to go with your meal, you can turn to the practical app or seek advice from your hostess. A firm favourite.

Name: 't Raedthuys
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Here, art and gastronomy go hand in hand with striking contemporary art that brightens up the walls of this classic house dating back to 1863. The sommelier will guide you through the different wines that complement Hans den Engelsen’s classic creations, full of modern textures which come as a pleasant surprise. The appetiser menu is a particular highlight.

Name: Au Coin des Bons Enfants
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Au Coin des Bons Enfants is an important part of Maastricht's culinary history, with the restaurant first being awarded a MICHELIN star in 1957. Today, Timo Reichelt and sommelier Lino de Vrede are writing a new chapter that pays all due respect to the past, maintaining the establishment's elegant and romantic ambience, including a fabulous secluded terrace to the rear. The cuisine of chef Reichelt, who for a long time presided at Im Schiffchen in Düsseldorf, puts the ingredients front and centre.He has a rather classic cooking style, enhanced by his knack for seeking out the very best in quality ingredients and his talent for spectacular sauces. The expressive smoky flavour of a rich and buttery beurre blanc, for example, is the ideal accompaniment for a perfectly grilled North Sea turbot served with unripe mango for a hint of freshness.Veal sweetbreads are fried until golden brown, unctuous and crispy, and served alongside aromatic black truffle and a particularly creamy Chablis sauce. This is rich, traditional fare prepared by a young chef with a sound grasp of flavours.The finesse of the dishes is accentuated by the wines (also available by the glass). Ask the sommelier, a devotee of Pinot Noir and Old World wines, for recommendations.

Name: Codium
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Zeeland shows its international side at Codium. The Scandinavian/Japanese zen vibe of this restaurant reflects the understated exuberance of the cuisine. Codium (named after a type of seaweed) is committed to Zeeland's terroir, yet open-minded when it comes to fresh, creative ideas. Delicacies from the Eastern Scheldt and the North Sea are, of course, staples of the menu. But Wouter Kik is equally happy to work with beef from Holstein dairy cows, which he serves rare with an oil and pickled kombu chutney for depth and freshness; an intense jus made from the beef emphasises the intensity of the meat. This chef does not shy away from surprising contrasts, but doesn't go overboard either. Think different textures of onion – sweet, delicate, intense, zesty – harmoniously combined with the tang of Belper Knolle cheese.The dishes at Codium are often characterised by salty flavours, acidity and spice, but chef Kik's creativity makes for new impressions every time. A special mention goes to the unique wine pairings, which intensify the flavours.

Name: Versaen
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: Creativity doesn't have to be synonymous with showmanship. Diners need not expect outlandish combinations or countless processes from Hans Derks. His ingenuity lies in striking a balance between a limited number of ingredients. Think fresh langoustine tartare served with a ponzu dressing, dots of miso mayonnaise for that subtle fermented note, and the crispness of sliced radish and green apple. It may sound simple, but this approach demonstrates his technical skill and knowledge of flavours. Chef Derks likes to dabble in the flamboyance of Mediterranean cooking and the intensity of Asian cuisine, and dares, for example, to give tournedos Rossini a modern twist. He chooses his (often local) suppliers carefully and focuses on his sauces, eschewing unnecessary frills in favour of distinct and multifaceted flavours. In this former butcher's shop, with its trendy, pared-down vibe, diners can enjoy an experience that showcases understated creativity and Brabantian hospitality.

Name: Daalder
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: With its neon lights, bold graphics, street art and night-club atmosphere, Daalder's new home in Het Sieraad will leave a lasting impression. In this hip spot, Dennis Huwaë says he can really do his thing. He has long been known for his dishes that are creative without being pretentious, and you can see him in action on his 'cooking podium' as he continues to work in this vein. The chef's strong personality is evident in every detail. Chef Huwaë draws on his Indonesian roots and other Asian influences to add pep to his inventive creations, and he is certainly not averse to contrasting flavours. This chef's talent lies in the harmony he achieves with combinations such as chicken satay, anchovies and vadouvan. Sometimes he keeps things a little more traditional, serving up langoustine cooked to perfection with a butter sauce with champagne, orange and Grand Marnier. Subtle, intense, explosive – this is what Dennis Huwaë is all about.Meticulous but generous, he is always looking for variety and the element of surprise. Every plate is designed to be fun. At Daalder, you are guaranteed a blissful dining experience.

Name: Aan de Zweth
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This elegant restaurant right on the Delftse Schie is at one with the water—from the terrace you can almost touch the bobbing boats. Thanks to the attentive service and attention to detail, you will not want for anything here. Chef Joris's creations are sophisticated, even innovative at times, without going overboard. Plus he knows the importance of sauces. Unpretentious fine dining at its best.

Name: Flavours
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Sweet. Bitter. Salty. Sour. Umami. These five flavours are the basis of every cuisine, but what Ron Lemmens creates with them can certainly be described as unique. His precise cuissons and the depth of his sauces are testament to his expertise. His ability to bring in international influences to produce exciting creations speaks to his knowledge of flavours.For example, he pan-fries cod to perfection and harmoniously combines it with sauerkraut, cream of Jerusalem artichoke, roasted capers and lovage and, most importantly, a jus made from cod in an intensely flavoured beurre blanc. Chef Lemmens does not go in for gratuitous surprises, but resolutely opts for robust flavours. He delighted us with his langoustines, crispy pork belly and carrot with the exotic nuances of ginger, tandoori and curry. His secret lies in the balance of flavours and combinations.At Flavours, you have a choice between one dining area done out in dark tones and a second space decorated in golden hues. Whichever you opt for, the stylish decor is further proof of the restaurant's good taste, right down to the last detail – this place really lives up to its name.

Name: Restaurant Wolfslaar
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The Wolfslaar experience begins as soon as you drive onto the magnificent estate. As you approach the former coach house, you will be struck by the natural beauty of your surroundings. The terrace is understandably very popular, but the contemporary restaurant interior is also inviting.In this enchanting setting, Maarten Camps takes you on an exciting adventure with intricate dishes in which each ingredient is meticulously prepared in a multitude of ways. He serves red cabbage in a marinade, for instance, and incorporates it into a jus and a compote. In doing so, he creates an intriguing interplay of flavours and textures. The sommelier will also have the perfect pairing in store, making your time here all the more wonderful.

Name: De Woage
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Perfectly fried foie gras topped with a very fine brunoise of green apple and dried pink peppercorns; underneath, expertly fried beetroot and mouthwateringly crisp apple. These elements are accompanied by a warm beetroot coulis, apple and curry with a subtle piquancy that elevates all the flavours, along with a delicate oil infused with dill. This dish is typical of De Woage: seemingly simple creations that are generous, without any unnecessary frills and packed with flavour.Jelle Jansen is by no means workshy, as his fine à la carte offerings prove – he pulls out all the stops for his diners. The quality of the produce comes first. Sauces play a leading role, such as the wonderfully sharp/spicy curry sauce that takes the cod fillet served with a mussel and tomato tapenade to the next level. At De Woage there's no fuss, just the pleasure of authentic flavours.Elegant and warm, this listed building has a certain romantic charm. Diners can feel totally at ease here, which is in no small part down to your charming maître d', Corine. Be sure to check out their "Special Sundays" – you won't regret it!

Name: Basiliek
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Born and bred in Harderwijk, Yornie van Dijk has taken over the restaurant of his former boss Rik Jansma and made it his own. The interior combines specially commissioned drawings, exposed brick walls and high-end materials. In short: a cosy place where the open kitchen draws the eye. Chef Van Dijk makes the nuances of contemporary cuisine his own, with a sure touch when it comes to balancing acidity and seasonings. It is clear that he is a proponent of Nordic Cuisine, a purist cooking style to which he gives his own spin.Details such as unripe and green strawberries in dry-aged hamachi lend his dishes that extra dimension. Sourced as locally as possible, vegetables and herbs play a key role. And whether it is a delicate beurre blanc to accompany skrei, or red gurnard served with a lemon zest cream and a sea buckthorn berry jus with a robust jus made with the bones, the chef has a unique way of dealing with intense flavours. Rest assured: Basiliek is as much a top destination for foodies as it ever was!

Name: MOS
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The interior is relaxed and chic, the large windows offer a fantastic view of the IJ river, and the food is delicious. MOS is sublime. The chef shows how a little creativity conjures up a variety of prominent flavours, producing balanced combinations that are both rich and refined. Guests are advised to ask about parking when reserving.

Name: Rijnzicht
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Using first-rate produce and drawing on an array of influences to delight diners with diverse textures and flavours, the playful inventiveness of Mike and Jim Cornelissen's cuisine is truly exciting! The fourth generation to run the family restaurant, they have made Rijnsicht completely their own. The decor is now sleek and atmospheric, while the terrace has retained its charm. But above all, it is the brothers' creativity that never ceases to amaze. The spectacular little dishes are extremely captivating. Their inspiration seems to know no bounds. Local delicacies such as cheese and beef are meticulously married with international flavours. A thrilling culinary adventure.

Name: De Burgemeester
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A contemporary restaurant in Linschoten’s old town hall, run by an ambitious team led by chef Spruijt. His excellent technique and keen eye for top - quality produce is evident in the dishes. The variety of tastes and textures is playful, intriguing and even more delicious in combination with the sommelier’s choices.

Name: The Millèn
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The Millennium Tower is a landmark in Rotterdam and, thanks to the arrival of this elegant design restaurant, it is now also a destination for foodies. Wim Severein shows his knowledge and inventiveness here by bringing together top quality ingredients and allowing them to interact with one other with a certain playfulness. His colourful compositions really are delicious!

Name: Da Vinci
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus
Description: Da Vinci is a beautiful modern restaurant where you enjoy the good care of Margo Reuten. Thanks to the large glass pieces, you can see how controlled she works, which also proves her dishes: well - prepared, technically well - groomed and highly flavored. The sommelier knows perfectly what tasty wine fits with.

Name: Restaurant Smink
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Jan Smink is proud of his heritage as the son of a farmer and a Frisian. He is very much at home in charming Wolvega, where he has transformed a former bank branch. The interior is done out in black and incorporates natural materials to create warmth. This is certainly a charismatic and daring chef. His cuisine is carefully considered, challenging and exciting. With a wealth of experience and technical skill, he bends textures, temperatures and flavours to his will.Take one of his signature dishes: Delicate slices of steamed Jerusalem artichoke are placed in layers over a puree of the vegetable mixed with smoked eel to add punch and depth. This is topped with crispy bacon, a spoonful of caviar and also a bubbly sauce based on an aromatic oil. This is Jan Smink all over: creative, thinking outside the box without overcomplicating things. His use of tomato in various ways to enhance yellowtail with umami flavours is typical of his personal cooking style. This is a chef who is going places.

Name: Meliefste
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Detail-focused, creative and passionate, Thijs Meliefste takes guests on an extraordinary gastronomic journey, creating authentic and elaborate dishes using a wide range of culinary techniques such as glazing, roasting and slow cooking. The intimate setting is as enticing as the food, with the terrace in the marina stealing the show.

Name: Het Koetshuis
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The Löhr family offers a top - notch experience at this classic establishment in the magnificent natural surroundings of the Veluwe. The cuisine is rich without being heavy; sophisticated and full of well - balanced flavours. Danny, the sommelier, gives excellent advice on wines to accompany the delicious dishes.

Name: Marrees
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Jan Marrees's trademark is his relaxed approach to gastronomy. A glance at his extensive menu (there are also two set menus, one of them vegetarian) will bring a smile to the face of any foodie. You can opt for one of the chef's specialities such as the crispy fried sweetbreads with an intense veal jus and fruity notes of apple and melon. Alternatively, there is a variety of small, modern delicacies. Zesty and bitter, powerful and delicate, creamy and crispy: every dish is an exciting interplay of flavours and textures made with top-quality ingredients. This is a chef who certainly does not shy away from contrasts and really showcases his talent in the process. The way he puts his own spin on a dame blanche sundae while respecting classic flavours cannot fail to impress.With labels from around the globe, the fantastic wine list certainly has the perfect accompaniment in store, including some attractive pairings by the glass. As for the modern interior – an atmospheric interplay of leather, marble and striking copper chandeliers, adorned with the shells of Gillardeau oysters by hostess Patricia. A visit to Jan Marrees version 2.0 is a must!

Name: Lars Amsterdam
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Combining an industrial vibe with an intimate living room feel, Lars is situated at the end of the Houthavens and boasts stunning views across the water. In the kitchen, the ambitious Lars Scharp plays with French traditions and fresh Asian flavours to create bold contemporary dishes that are a world away from traditional cuisine.

Name: Beluga Loves You
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Start with an aperitif in the trendy lounge before entering the elegant dining area with interior design inspired by the River Meuse. Servais Tielman is a resolutely modern chef who, together with his team, has mastered the art of turning bright ideas into bold flavours. With the playful application of different textures, his dishes come to life courtesy of beautiful presentations and masterful technique.

Name: Sense
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Respect for the seasons and a penchant for fresh Asian flavours – that is Dennis Middeldorp's creative cuisine in a nutshell. Deep down, however, he is a classical chef, which is evident in his beautifully risen soufflé or the turbot fillet fried in butter and accompanied by a mousseline made in time-honoured tradition. Meanwhile, the modern techniques that he implements for his garnishes and meticulous presentations reveal the chef's playful side.Of course, it is the eating that really counts at Sense. The flavours are full-bodied and powerful yet do not linger on the stomach. The option of ordering both full and half portions is something that many diners appreciate. Chef Middeldorp prefers to work with Dutch produce and also shows his creative streak when it comes to conjuring up dishes without meat and fish.This large, trendy establishment is perfect for those who wish to enjoy a casual meal out. Why not give yourself the time to explore the surrounding city centre at a leisurely pace by booking one of their comfortable guestrooms?

Name: De Bloemenbeek
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: An aperitif in the cosy salon, followed by attentive service in the stylish restaurant makes for a promising start. The flavourful sauces and well - balanced seasoning reveal the chef's classic training, while also applying modern techniques to achieve variety and finesse.

Name: De Kromme Dissel
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: De Kromme Dissel represents a piece of Dutch culinary tradition and has had a Michelin star since 1971. Located in a 17C Saxon farmhouse, the restaurant's rich history can immediately be felt in the ambience and the rustic-style interior is extremely cosy and charming. The attentive waitstaff are always on hand and also provide expert wine recommendations.Experienced chef Tonny Berentsen does not rest on his laurels. Although he is classically trained, he dares to show his creative side, drawing on his travels in Asia for the inspiration behind the modern ideas he brings into his dishes. Think fleshy langoustine flavoured with curry panko, combined with sea bass tartare and subtly spicy pumpkin. Diners are just as bowled over by the traditional game jus that accompanies his wild duck or his rich shellfish broth.Chef Berentsen now continues the story of De Kromme Dissel with his own culinary style. This perennial favourite continues to reinvent itself – much to the delight of every foodie!

Name: De Moerbei
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Works of art and a stylish interior give this old farmhouse a special aura, where the charming hostess welcomes guests as if they were old friends. The chef has mastered the skill of bringing out the very best in top - quality ingredients through food prepared with close attention to detail, while striving for simplicity to keep flavours as pure as possible.

Name: O&O
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Welcome to the elegant restaurant of the Tsang family, which has built up a good reputation since opening in 1982. Monica, the daughter, provides matching wine suggestions for the delicacies of her father Danny. His creative approach to Asian preparations is great. It is a feast full of subtlety, where sweet and sour, and fresh and powerful flavours, are deliciously unified.

Name: Cheval Blanc
Address: Jan van Goyenstraat 29, Heemstede, 2102 CA, Netherlands
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: As soon as you step through the door, you can feel that Cheval Blanc is run by an efficient, ambitious team. They source top quality produce and use it to create delicious contemporary dishes where the flavours are skilfully balanced. It’s a wonderful place and following a refurbishment, has a suitably classy feel.

Name: Olivijn
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The renovation of this charming 16C building is a dream come true for talented Menno Post (ex - Bokkedoorns), who has used a deep - blue colour scheme and art to decorate his restaurant, as well as creating an attractive, cosy terrace to the rear. Talented and creative chef Post delights his guests with dishes full of flavour, with each ingredient adding nuance and intensity.

Name: FG Food Labs
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This "taste laboratory" led by one of the Netherlands' best chefs has an exceptional experience in store for diners. It all starts with the vibrant, hip location: a converted train tunnel! The curing hams you see hanging add to the Spanish-style ambiance. There is nothing stiff about this place — it's all about feasting on surprising flavours in a casual atmosphere. François Geurds is on a quest to find new ideas, try things out and make discoveries. For example, he will play with sweet and savoury flavours until he finds the right balance. The flavours and textures that turn up on your plate at FG Food Labs are intriguing. Chef Geurds's dishes have solid French foundations and he draws on aspects of Spanish and Japanese culinary traditions, pushing the boundaries in an effort to get the best out of his ingredients. For example, his gently steamed halibut forms a beautiful alliance here with hearty ossenworst (Dutch ox sausage), an intensely flavoursome raw garlic froth and a deep shellfish bisque. Get ready for an adventure! Please note that these creative options are only served at dinner. For lunch, FG Food Labs offers street food dishes and a special that changes weekly. Reservations are not required at lunchtime.

Name: Bij Jef
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: As soon as you step into Bij Jef, you are struck by a sense of peace and space. The minimalist interior has been specifically designed as a setting in which guests can enjoy Texel's bounty of produce – the local suckling lamb is world famous and, needless to say, also a firm fixture here. But Jef Schuur draws much more from his surroundings. Salty herbs, crustaceans and shellfish… the list goes on. Chef Schuur puts his terroir first – be sure to take a look around the impressive vegetable garden behind the restaurant – and he showcases it elegantly in contemporary-style dishes. His innovative creations often feature invigorating sweet and sour nuances. This is a chef who likes to surprise. Sauces are key: think a rich lamb jus and herb-infused oil to pair with crispy slow-roasted lamb neck. The refreshing flavours of Texel are paired with some real gems from the world of wine, selected by maître d' Nadine, for example the delicate Madeira Rainwater Reserva that brings out all the flavours of the subtle dessert based on blood orange. Divine! You'll also be hard pressed to resist the trolley of pastries to go with your coffee. And as a cosy finale to this wonderful experience, you should definitely consider booking one of the designer guestrooms.

Name: Kasteel Heemstede
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Welcome to the 17C château of talented chef Ollie Scuiling, with its attractive mix of historical features and contemporary luxury. You can expect some real surprises on the menu here, including some great European wines and dishes full of intense flavour. The chef’s secret lies in his use of fresh products, sublime sauces and inventive preparations.

Name: Tout à Fait
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: Tradition and originality are combined with a sure touch at Tout à Fait. Outside, you have the charm of Maastricht's centre, while inside you can enjoy the ambience of this chic restaurant, where the minimalist design underscores the character of the historical building. This is definitely a place where diners can feel comfortable and all the more so once the food arrives.Bert Ausems is a passionate chef who has accumulated years of know-how when it comes to the classics – you don't need to teach him how to make a beurre blanc sauce to serve with brill. The lightness of the sauce, which also possesses a fine acidity, denotes a real awareness of modern influences. He combines langoustine with an intense sauce made from the carcasses, but also with playful garnishes such as pickled vegetables. This is a chef who also likes to demonstrate his mastery of cuissons by cooking top-notch produce such as pigeon on the rotisserie. The mainly French wine selection makes this experience tout à fait special.

Name: De Vlindertuin
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This Saxon farmhouse dating back to 1719 turns out to be a wonderful spot for a culinary experience. The interior is elegant, the farmyard terrace beautiful. Diners enjoy contemporary dishes in which each component adds something. The sauces and garnishes elevate the flavour of the main ingredient to create a delicious balance.

Name: De Heeren van Harinxma
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Brunch,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Drive onto the sprawling estate, follow the driveway through the rolling countryside and admire the stately mansion. What a first impression! Inside, the high ceilings, marble fireplace, large chandelier and period stylistic features are enchanting. The terrace affords fantastic views over the golf greens. Everything is perfect down to the last detail, which also goes for the food. Arjan Bisschop is a meticulous chef who makes every ingredient work hard. He has a knack for creating a sense of depth with his sauces, creams and marinades. Classic French flavours and local produce are often accompanied by surprising trimmings. The perfectly fried turbot fillet, for instance, is served with delicious vegetable sides such as sautéed girolles and a light mousseline with just the right amount of zing. Divine! The sommelier responds with some well-chosen gems to pair with these captivating flavours. A top-flight dining experience awaits you here. Even at teatime, this luxurious hotel has plenty of surprises up its sleeve!

Name: Apicius
Address: Van der Mijleweg 16, Castricum, 1901 KD, Netherlands
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Modern restaurant run by two passionate brothers, one in the kitchen, one in the dining room. Refined atmosphere, comfortable lounge and international selection of wines including some vintage burgundy wines.

Name: Kaatje bij de Sluis
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Blokzijl is a picture-perfect little slice of the Netherlands. Opt for a table by the window to enjoy the delightful view of the lock and the quintessential brick houses. The wall decorated with cartoons is also sure to draw the eye. When it comes to the food, the dishes on the menu are testament to the creativity of the talented chef. With an eye for detail, he bends organic and local produce to his will. Fine classic flavours are shaken up in occasionally daring combinations. Lobster with blue cheese? Sardines and beetroot? It is the meticulous dosing that creates exciting nuances of flavour. The cheese and wine selections are equally tempting. It is no accident that, bar one year, Kaatje bij de Sluis has retained at least one Michelin star consistently since 1978. Quality reigns supreme here.

Name: Spetters
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Eating at Spetters is like sitting with your head in the clouds. Thanks to its location on the first floor of a building on Breskens marina, you have a fabulous view of the boats bobbing about on the Western Scheldt. The lounge atmosphere is nice and relaxed, and perfectly suited to Laurent Smallegange's cooking: original and fun, without pretension.This young chef makes a point of working with local produce such as eel and crab, which he enhances with fresh tangy notes and influences from around the globe. Each ingredient is given its chance to shine. Every dish is well thought out. An inventive Carabinero prawn dish brings out the saltiness of the shellfish, perfectly cooked veal sweetbreads are daringly combined with chives and the subtle oiliness of Eastern Scheldt eel: chef Smallegange's technique is certainly masterful but also playful. No frills, just an abundance of sparkling flavours.If you would prefer to drop by in summer for a slightly simpler, casual lunch, do try Eb & Food just next door.

Name: Monarh
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The subtle luxury of this restaurant, which occupies the vaulted cellar of an old monastery dating back 125 years, comes as a surprise. The menu features spectacular dishes which are beautifully presented and full of intense flavours. Chef Kappé’s modern cuisine has real style thanks to his use of different techniques, combined with careful and elegant preparation. A fascinating dining experience!

Name: Merlet
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A restaurant with a chic, modern - cum - classic interior that matches the chef’s refined style of cooking perfectly. Delightful terrace commanding superb views of the countryside.

Name: Ratatouille Food & Wine
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: With Jozua Jaring, not everything is as it seems. He pays great attention to detail in the meticulous presentation of his dishes and likes to surprise diners with contrasting colours and forms. This is a restaurant with a real wow factor – chef Jaring puts his own exciting spin on classical flavours, taking your taste buds on a culinary adventure.Conjuring up vegetable ice cream concoctions, dabbling with Asian citrus notes or rounding off a dish with a classic, deeply flavoursome vegetable jus. Such inspirations take this chef's top-quality ingredients to the next level. Think sea bass with a delightfully crispy crust, topped with a vin jaune sauce, caviar and razor clams. This chef has mastered the art of working with fish and seafood, and his creativity does not lose any momentum when it comes to devising vegetarian dishes.This characterful building has an equally tasteful decor: a little rustic, a tad eclectic, but very much on trend – with the open kitchen serving as the hub of the action. And then there is the cosy waterside terrace (specify when booking).

Name: Rantrée
Address: Het Wilhelmus 30 L, Maastricht, 6211 EN, Netherlands
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: Take the lift to the eighth floor of the Dormio Resort hotel (free parking at the door), step into the restaurant with its eclectic design that radiates a golden glow, and admire the magnificent view of Maastricht and the surrounding countryside. It makes quite a first impression! Ralph Hermans ramps up the excitement with his tempting selection of dishes and a vegetarian set menu. Here they still really cook à la minute.Top-notch produce such as turbot and lamb are served in dishes with modern, highly elaborate garnishes and sophisticated sauces. This is a chef who knows perfectly well how to slow-cook langoustine until the flesh is butter soft. In one of his elaborate creations, flavourful Anjou pigeon is combined with a sambal and fennel cream and the delicate sweetness of peach. This is a testament to his technical skill and culinary nous.The diversity of flavours and textures creates a real sense of abundance. And to top off this delightful experience, your dedicated hostess proposes a fantastic selection of fine wines.

Name: YAMA
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: YAMA offers you a very personal introduction to Japan. The sober, minimalist decor ensures that all your attention is focused on Hiroaki Yamamoto's creations, often served up on ceramic tableware made on site. There is room around his dining table for eight guests to join him on his culinary adventure. The subtlety and finesse of Japanese tradition is expressed, for example, in sushi, tempura and meat cooked on the binchotan grill.Diners look on as the chef prepares sushi with fine-grain rice, just lukewarm, with a delicate vinegar and top-notch ingredients such as lacquered eel and yellowtail cooked à la minute. A masterclass in finesse! The amazingly crispy tempura spring roll with a nori sheet filled with eggs and crabmeat deserves a special mention. Here and there you will discern European influences, such as the use of Dutch produce (wild garlic is firm favourite here), with which the chef subtly puts his own spin on familiar recipes. Tradition and modern skills go hand in hand at YAMA. Need we say more? Then don't forget to make a reservation!

Name: ML
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: On their Restaurant ML’s new location, Mark and Liane Gratama have gone to town with a chic retro modern decor and a cuisine that has kept its high standard. The chef's creativity is well thought out bringing as much excitement to your plate as possible with an interesting and well - balanced variety of flavours that guarantees an exemplary experience.

Name: Joelia
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Joelia proves that refinement does not need to be complex. Her eclectic decor beautifully combines vintage and design to unique effect. Her cuisine is creative without being fussy, and serves one aim: to achieve a harmony of subtle perfumes and intense flavours.

Name: AIRrepublic
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: AIRrepublic is a sensational restaurant housed in a sleek building in Cadzand Marina, surrounded by dunes and boats. From here you can take in sweeping views of the North Sea and truly breathtaking sunsets! The adjoining AIRcafé is a delightful spot in which to enjoy sophisticated snacks and drinks. The Zeeland terroir, especially fish and seafood, is showcased here in truly original ways. For example, beurre blanc enriched with plankton accompanies gently cooked cod and mussels to lend the dish an intensely briny quality. It is the subtle crispness and the modern, elaborate take on the traditional local seafood cuisine that make AIRrepublic, a proud ambassador for Zeeland, unique. That same sentiment applies to the thoughtfully curated wine list, which includes a number of interesting bottles from the New World, Slovenia and Switzerland.

Name: Perceel
Address: Dorpsstraat 3, Capelle aan den IJssel, 2902 BC, Netherlands
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: At Jos and Sharon’s Perceel you will experience the talent of a couple with an impressive list of achievements. She takes care of the excellent service, while he focuses on pure and natural flavours, using produce from his own garden. Flowers take pride of place in this beautiful establishment, both in the décor and on your plate!

Name: La Provence
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: With its verdant surroundings and scents of lavender, the terrace at this stylish restaurant has an almost Provençal feel. Although the chef here has a traditional background, he also likes to add creative garnishes to his dishes which add depth and flavour. Meanwhile, the charming female owner front of house offers guests a selection of excellent wines.

Name: Bolenius
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Luc Kusters is an ambassador of Dutch cuisine who lays the focus squarely on vegetables and local produce. On a daily basis, he harvests delicious produce from his kitchen garden, located close to the restaurant in the Zuidas business district! Bolenius's elegant minimalist style and urban vibe reflect the purity of the cuisine. The ethos behind this sustainable vision is regularly explained when the kitchen team serve their dishes themselves.The head chef's ingenuity comes to the fore in the stunning presentation and flavour combinations of his dishes. His cuisine is light but brimming with intensity. He prefers to express himself with vegetables and herbs – beetroot grown in clay soil with morels is a signature dish for good reason – but he also works with meat and fish, eg Dutch Kamper lamb or pike-perch from the North Sea. Whether you opt for his plant-based set menu or the "Dutch Menu" (à la carte also available), the versatility and nuances he draws out of treasures from Dutch soil is uncommonly captivating: aromatic cauliflower, green peppers and textures of buckwheat with a clear broth that brings everything together and adds depth. The way chef Kusters turns 'simplicity' into memorable cuisine is truly remarkable.

Name: 't Vlasbloemeken
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: (Temporarily closed due to fire) Your visit to ’t Vlasbloemeken promises to turn into a wonderful culinary experience with high expectations as Eric van Bochove’s goal is to offer you the “best of the sea, soil and livestock” and his honest cuisine does not disappoint. The chef has struck gold here with regional produce such as lobster from the Eastern Scheldt estuary and lamb from Zeeland, which he prepares in the traditional way in order to respect their wonderful flavours. His garnishes give your plate a more contemporary look, while his delicate textures complement the main ingredient perfectly.In the dining room, the charming Bianca van Bochove takes excellent care of guests, providing astute wine recommendations and ensuring that they can relax and enjoy the colourful artwork on the walls and the cosy terrace to the rear of the restaurant.

Name: Flicka
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Flicka is the epitome of a modern restaurant. Thomas van Santvoort boasts a wealth of experience gained at top-flight establishments such as Parkheuvel and Boreas. It was there that he learned, for example, how to cook perfectly crispy sweetbreads. His flawless technique is highlighted by his own unique style. He combines the sweetbreads with kombu for a salty undertone, black garlic for extra punchiness, and fennel for a dash of anise freshness – the way he succeeds in balancing all these flavours demonstrates his talent.Chef Van Santvoort has a predilection for enhancing his dishes with a touch of acidity, giving top-notch produce like sea bass and langoustine a real boost. The sommelier cleverly plays on this with exciting wine pairings.Your journey to Flicka will also be rewarded with a splendid view of the green surroundings and the River Meuse. The cosy decor also incorporates some charming designer touches. Last but not least, delightful suites are available for overnight stays.

Name: Latour
Address: Koningin Astrid Boulevard 5, Noordwijk aan Zee, 2202 BK, Netherlands
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The opulent decor at Latour looks out over the sea and is a paragon of classical elegance, as is the excellent service, making this a real luxury establishment. The experienced chef works exotic influences into modern dishes, playing with fresh, strong flavours and subtly contrasting textures to create depth.

Name: Noble Kitchen
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Housed in a round building resembling a UFO, this excellent restaurant occupies a unique setting on a golf course. Here the talented chef prepares contemporary dishes with significant Asian influence, including exquisite sushi and delicious fish and meat grilled on the robatayaki. The restaurant is also home to the atmospheric Bernardus Café.

Name: De Gieser Wildeman
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Picture the scene: you are sitting under the thatched roof of a converted farmhouse, surrounded by stylish interior design and pleasing decorative features, looking through the conservatory out onto the beautiful garden and the river. A delightful setting for a culinary escapade! With his mastery of classic culinary techniques, René Tichelaar is not to be outdone by the surroundings.He picks up creative ideas here and there and has a good feel for the current zeitgeist, but the basis of this cuisine lets tradition speak for itself. This is evident, for instance, in the Mediterranean garnishes that give a nice piece of lamb from the Pyrenees the necessary depth of flavour. Or how about scallop ravioli combined with the salty nuances of caviar, the generosity of a beurre blanc sauce and the tanginess of chives? This chef works meticulously and is adept at structuring his dishes.Speaking of harmony, the acclaimed sommelier deserves a mention. Drawing on an extensive selection of wines from around the globe, he comes up with some amazing pairings. The cheerful front-of-house team provide excellent service, as befits this elegant setting. You might want to pinch yourself to check you're not dreaming!

Name: Bougainville
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: In Bougainville, a top-class fine dining experience awaits you. Warm fabrics, luxurious design and bronze tones come together in a setting that is intimate and romantic. The contrast with the features of this historical building is indeed something to behold, and the magnificent view of Dam Square is equally remarkable. Tim Golsteijn's cuisine is in keeping with the sophisticated surroundings.He marries flavours from East and West with a creativity that is all his own. For this chef, technical skill and culinary instinct go hand in hand. He effortlessly balances the intensity of ingredients such as Thai green curry and za'atar spices with delicate French aromas. Chef Golsteijn does not shy away from daring combinations, but always ensures that the flavours enhance each other. A fine example of this is the perfectly pan-seared foie gras served with a Madeira wine jus and frozen raspberry pearls. An interplay of flavours, textures and temperatures that you won't be able to get enough of!Every visit to Bougainville brings a fascinating discovery. And it is made all the more exciting by the sommelier's amazing discoveries.

Name: Central Park
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The stately national monument that houses Central Park is quite a sight to behold. This magnificent palace with breathtaking views of the surrounding grounds is the perfect setting in which to enjoy sophisticated fine dining. Luxury is the name of the game here, but there's nothing stuffy about this place. The service staff are attentive, and the selection of wines and champagnes is really impressive. An overnight stay at the hotel is the perfect way to round off your experience. But first, take the chance to savour a finely crafted take on classic, coherent dishes.Traditional cooking techniques and intense sauces make for wonderfully crisp and vibrant culinary creations. Clever new twists produce surprising results. The earthy, sweet and sour nuances of beetroot combined with fresh blackberries, foie gras and a robust jus with sweet notes of sherry form the perfect accompaniment to duck cooked on the carcass. Grilled fillet of turbot is elevated by textures of carrot, mussels and a beautifully aromatic mussel nage. Come to Central Park for no-nonsense cuisine packed with subtle yet pronounced flavours.

Name: Voltaire
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A restaurant in a historic building, situated on an impressive estate, where classic and subtly contemporary design blend together beautifully. The clever associations of flavour, technically controlled and boosted with fresh acidity, reveal the hand of consulting chef Jacob Jan Boerma. A superb dining experience.

Name: Château Neercanne
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This terraced castle is full of character and historical charm. From the herringbone parquet flooring to the impressive chandeliers, this place is a classic restaurant at heart. The views over the Baroque gardens and the Jeker Valley are simply stunning! An aperitif or coffee in the historical Marl Caves is an experience in itself. With a feel for the zeitgeist, Robert Levels breathes new life into French classics. Vegetables are harvested from his own garden (an appealing vegetarian set menu is available), and the sauces are always outstanding. A masterpiece in its own right, his foie gras terrine is served with a compote that provides a refreshing sweetness, along with a rich veal jus vinaigrette. His jus made from seasonal vegetables lends depth to the crispy blade steak. Chef Levels tempers the intense flavours of classical cuisine with exciting exotic touches, giving vegetables the attention they deserve and focusing on palatability. A castle fairy tale par excellence!

Name: Atelier
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A visit to Hans Kinkartz’s workshop is always rich in exciting surprises. This veteran chef adores innovating and deploys his consummate culinary skill and flair to introduce you to unusual flavours steeped in subtlety and plates that seem art directed. Heaven for foodies!

Name: Vista
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Not only does the cosy room have a magnificent view of the marina but, at the same time, the modern dishes will bring a smile to your face – how wonderful! The chef enhances his creations by using fantastic sauces or vinaigrettes; they are pronounced, refined and surprising; you are in for a treat!

Name: De Kas
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: De Kas has grown steadily since being established in 2001 and has now reached maturity. "From plant to plate" has always been the motto here, a vision of sustainability that seemed anything but easy to achieve at the outset. But they persevered and today are a standard-bearer of the MICHELIN Green Star. They grow about 300 varieties of vegetables, herbs and fruit both on site and in their larger field in the Beemster Polder. What is harvested in the morning from the imposing greenhouse will take pride of place a little later, in light, modern creations. Tip: Make a beeline for the great garden terrace. Wim de Beer and Jos Timmer are masters in the art of delicately balancing sweet and sour flavours. Subtle sauces highlight the creative vegetable preparations (sometimes with meat or fish). For instance, they will create a foam out of oyster leaf in order to give a cod fillet some salty pep. Roasted hazelnuts provide texture, rapini a leafy bitterness. If they have any Jerusalem artichoke left over, they will slow-cook it and combine it with yoghurt cream infused with nut oil and parsley. The wealth of natural produce that these chefs have at their disposal is a constant source of inspiration for their creativity. And that is what gourmets really revel in.

Name: Pieters Restaurant
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: You’ll feel very much at home when you dine at Pieter and Paula’s pleasant restaurant. Here, the welcoming interior provides a perfect backdrop for a delightful gastronomic experience created by chef Pieter who calls upon all his experience and an abundance of enthusiasm. Far from being show cuisine, his cooking demonstrates a classical finesse in keeping with traditional techniques, coupled with attractive, playful and highly original touches.

Name: Derozario
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Self-taught Jermain de Rozario continues to develop his streamlined vision, demonstrating a youthful playfulness that is increasingly balanced and bringing his own style to creative cuisine which focuses on Asian delicacies. His new address boasts an urban panache which suits him to the core, from the music to the plant-based decor and bamboo features. An exciting development!

Name: Fitzgerald
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: "Too much of anything is bad, but too much Champagne is just right." This is the line that inspired the owner to name this restaurant after the author F. Scott Fitzgerald, and it is the motto of the establishment. The audacious wine pairings are as remarkable as the dishes and keep us coming back for more.Michael Verhagen likes to give those great wines a run for their money by juxtaposing them with modern French cuisine. The sauces showcase his conventional culinary skill, and he builds his dishes on this foundation. For instance, his scallops come into their own in a dish with chicory and different textures of Parmesan, as well as a spicy creamed sauce. The subtlety with which he does this and the tantalising interplay of flavours and textures demonstrate this chef's command of his subject.Fitzgerald has panache, as does the decor. Italian marble merged with design and vintage features, the large glass windows, the beautiful courtyard garden. A vibrant restaurant!

Name: Yamazato
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: Yamazato made history when it became the first traditional kaiseki restaurant outside Japan to be awarded a MICHELIN star thanks to Masanori Tomikawa's subtle cuisine that is full of velvet-smooth flavours. The chef showcases his highly accomplished technique in dishes such as precisely cut tuna sashimi and a seemingly simple, yet impressive green bean soup. This place is all about the depth of the flavours. The menu always features owan (Japanese soup) with white fish. Start with the highly aromatic consommé, then tuck into the vegetables and perfectly cooked fish to fully enjoy the classic kaiseki experience. This is food that will stop you in your tracks. The intimate, pared-back decor will take you on a journey to the Land of the Rising Sun; the sight of the Japanese garden and staff dressed in kimonos create a sense of serenity. Yamazato is an ode to tradition.

Name: Karel 5
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Leave Utrecht's bustling city centre behind for a while and let yourself be swept away by Karel 5's medieval charm. Luxury meets authenticity in this historical oasis, where you can admire old paintings and sculptures as you dine beneath crystal chandeliers, and, when the weather is fine, have lunch on the beautiful garden terrace. Leon Mazairac and his team conjure up cuisine that does justice to the setting, for a true fine dining experience.Game from the Veluwe, Belgian endive, saffron from Herentals: Chef Mazairac makes a point of working only with top-quality produce that he sources as locally as possible, and he is also passionate about vegetables. As an amuse-bouche he serves a bouquet of seasonal vegetables accompanied by a classic, delicately acidic vinaigrette. The freshness of nature and the richness of the sauces are the hallmarks of this chef's cooking. He has a penchant for vegetarian dishes, and a meat- and fish-free set menu is always available. But when he serves sole, for example, it is poached to perfection and comes into its own thanks to a beurre blanc sauce with vin jaune and fresh trimmings. Karel 5 embodies a marriage of tradition and innovation.

Name: Calla's
Address: Laan van Roos en Doorn 51a, The Hague, 2514 BC, Netherlands
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: ‘Calla’ refers to a Mexican lily, which derives its name from the Greek word for beauty. To continue with the international theme, the cuisine is French and the wine list a combination of the Old World and the New. The delicious, simple yet refined cuisine served here provides a truly memorable dining experience.

Name: The White Room by Jacob Jan Boerma
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: You can imagine yourself as an Austrian prince or princess in this white and gold dining room, which dates from 1885 and magnificently combines classical elegance with modern furnishings. Citrus flavours and exotic spices are combined in a creative interplay. The chef is a strong technician and understands what refinement really means.

Name: Coulisse
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: You will find this vibrant restaurant waiting in the wings – in the foyer of the NewWerktheater, to be precise. This place run by a creative collective has a warm and laid-back atmosphere. Easy fine dining is the concept here: enjoying on-trend, sophisticated dishes in an informal setting. The sommelier proudly shares her passion for natural wines; behind the scenes, childhood friends Simon and Tim work hard on their cosmopolitan creations featuring local produce.Their cuisine is flavourful and sensual. After easing you in with some delicious amuse-bouches, they ramp things up, for example, adding pep to a zesty sea buckthorn berry sauce with pimento and other spices to subtly contrast with the powerful flavour of the smoked leeks. The creativity and masterful technique of these chefs is captivating. Among the main dishes they propose is an Anjou pigeon cooked on the carcass, the skin coated with reduced red beetroot juice. Roasted beetroot, refreshing tomatillo, fermented shiso leaf and an intense gravy accentuate the flavours. To bring proceedings to a close, the chefs serve a delicately sweet dessert. All in all, a remarkable performance!

Name: LIZZ
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The exquisite Weeshuis Hotel is housed in THE landmark edifice of the historic city of Gouda. The chic COCO champagne bar is the perfect spot to sample a lavish breakfast, a casual lunch, a wickedly tempting tea or a glass of champagne! Oozing with character, thanks to historic vaults, fresh bouquets of flowers and LIZZ’s signature luxury, you can expect a global experience in the capable hands of gifted Remco Kuijpers.The seasoned chef unveils his culinary sensitivity and flawless technique. Spices and subtle Asian acidity add a new dimension to first-class Dutch produce. He embarks you on a fascinating and occasionally amusing journey. For example, sweetbread acquires a new range of nuances thanks to an clever blend of sherry, umeboshi plums, cumin, sakura vinegar, shiso and pumpkin. High-flying craftsmanship that is rich in surprises, originality and expression without falling into the trap of cloying or staid – an instinctive sense of balance pervades every dish.One final word for the excellent service, attentive yet not fawning and for the mind-blowing wine-food pairing suggestions.

Name: 't Lansink
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Warmth and character fill this house, which was created in 1916 in the heart of the historic district of Tuindorp. Enjoy excellent service as you enjoy the gourmet culinary delights created by Lards van Galen, whose wonderful dishes (including local game) simply excel. The Chef’s Table is truly an exciting culinary spectacle!

Name: Amarone
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Elegant, gentle and luxurious in style, Amarone boasts a delightful 3D wall in its open kitchen. Female owner and sommelier Yoshiko offers an excellent choice of wines, while in the kitchen Jan van Dobben demonstrates his passion for classic Japanese cuisine by combining his technical expertise and creativity to produce exuberant and harmonious dishes.

Name: De Swarte Ruijter
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This characteristic villa with its natural decor and view of a pine forest is a magnificent spot. The plates are beautifully turned out and absolutely delicious, achieving a remarkable balance between pronounced flavours and varied textures. The chef proves that a jus can elevate an entire dish. Pure luxury.

Name: Ron Gastrobar
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Ron Blaauw is something of a culinary mastermind. In 2013, the popular chef transformed his two-MICHELIN-starred restaurant into this down-to-earth gastrobar, and it was an instant success. This hip urban establishment offers a diverse atmosphere in which to discover chef Blaauw's relaxed fine dining concept.Eschewing any unnecessary frills, the focus lies squarely on original combinations and distinct flavours. Here, you can enjoy simple yet imaginative cuisine that is intelligent, elaborate and bold. Think veal sweetbreads cooked in time-honoured tradition, a spicy blend of lentils, textures of pumpkin and yoghurt with lime zest for body and freshness. The dishes here are brimming with flavour. The impressive menu features classics such as beef Wellington, vegetarian options and premium produce such as wagyu and turbot cooked on the barbecue, as well as an amazing onion Martini (with a Comté foam). You will likely want to order the lot! At Ron Gastrobar, the flavours of the Amsterdam metropolis come alive.

Name: Studio
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Talented chef Gilbert von Berg made a name for himself at Château Neercanne, but here he can really do his own thing. The hip interior of his restaurant features natural materials and exposed brick walls; there is also an open kitchen, where he showcases his vision of gastronomy. He has surrounded himself with a great team so that he can focus on his cooking. The apparent complexity of his sophisticated creations at times belies their simplicity. The intensity of the flavours is key here.His ingredient-led cuisine takes its cue from the seasons: more Asian in summer, more French in winter etc. Local produce is given pride of place, and non-native ingredients only feature if they make a valid contribution. Fermentation and zesty flavours are astutely incorporated. For instance, he elevates sea bass fried on the bone with the intense, full flavour of an anchovy and fermented asparagus sauce. Delicious! A punchy xo sauce made with Dutch shrimps accompanying a succulent skate wing has the same effect. Contrasts of a robust shellfish sauce with tandoori spices and a salsa of thyme and Angostura only deepen the nuances. A captivating culinary adventure courtesy of Gilbert von Berg.

Name: Sinne
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: East meets West at this restaurant, where chef Alexander Ioannou spices up familiar flavours with subtle touches of acidity and an interplay of exotic seasonings. This is creative cuisine that packs a punch, but for all the complexity of its flavours, it is very easy to enjoy – just take a look at all the happy faces around you. The chef likes to come to the table to present his signature celeriac dish. You might want to congratulate him on his fabulous creation: He imbues thin slices of celeriac with smoke on the barbecue and combines them with a celeriac cream, a perfectly runny egg and a robust hollandaise sauce. A creamy garlic sauce provides the necessary finesse, shavings of black truffle add their distinctive fragrance. The open kitchen, to the rear of this trendy establishment, means you can watch the spectacle of the chefs at work. This is a laid-back setting place in which to discover a host of new flavours – and that goes for the wine too; the dedicated sommelier will enthusiastically guide you through the list. One final tip: Be sure to book because this place has plenty of fans.

Name: THE DUCHESS
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The grandeur of this former ticket office is impressive. This is a magnificent venue, where the use of dark marble and the Belle Époque atmosphere lend The Duchess real flair. The beautiful Molteni kitchen turns out generous, classic dishes. Where else would you find such a delicious, traditional beef Wellington?

Name: 't Ganzenest
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Erik Tas has given a new lease of life to this well-known restaurant, which has retained its full authenticity. The service is attentive and the dishes well designed around just a few top-quality ingredients, intense sauces and sides that provide added panache. Pure cuisine that is straight to the point but also deliciously nuanced.

Name: Vigor
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Vigor is the pinnacle of classy. Set in this elegant 17C Bleijenburg villa, Lars Albers combines his culinary prowess with Randy Bouwer’s extensive wine know-how (excellent range of sherries). A consummate technician, Albers surprises diners with the intensity he brings to well-known flavours and his reluctance to opt for play-it-safe recipes. A delicious newcomer!

Name: Maeve
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: Chef Tommy and maître d' Vera take you on a compelling culinary voyage in this characterful and stylishly designed building. She woos diners with her personable manner, he with his expressive homage to the terroir. Sourced as locally as possible, vegetables play an essential role here, lending depth to the dishes. This is a chef who cooks his ingredients to perfection, shows a light touch with fresh acidic flavours and has fun with temperatures and textures.Veal sweetbreads are briefly fried and then brushed with a reduced veal gravy. A fine brunoise of various vegetables provides a pleasing bite. Tender onion stuffed with Thai basil, strips of white onion and black truffle provide subtle aromatic touches. An excellent sauce based on veal gravy with citrus makes for a fine base. This is a chef who manages to translate interesting ideas into intensely flavoursome creations. The combination of miso and koji in a dessert with quince and chocolate demonstrates his mastery of flavour nuances.The wine list is equally impressive (you can see the wine cellar next to the restrooms), with a particular focus on Dutch and Belgian labels here too.

Name: Pikaar
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: From the moment the exquisite amuse-bouches are served, Cas Pikaar's talent is plain to see. This young chef fuses classic craftsmanship with unbridled creativity. The young chef was previously to be seen in action at the Bib Gourmand-awarded DOYY in Eindhoven, but now he is striking out in Hilvarenbeek. His restaurant is inviting and stylish, his youthful enthusiasm compelling. Chef Pikaar's culinary skill is beyond question; his Anjou pigeon, for instance, is cooked to perfection and sliced. The meat melts in the mouth, the confit legs and the heart are deliciously intense, the creaminess of the liver is full of depth – a true labour of love! He is more playful with the garnishes, using different vinaigrettes or adding a touch of spice. This is a chef who likes to put his own spin on classics such as tournedos Rossini, but might also elevate a scallop dish with a kombu beurre blanc. As he himself says, he enjoys creating contrasts, but within limits. And that is exactly how he demonstrates his talent. The key ingredient is showcased against a backdrop of nuances.

Name: Bistro de la Mer
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: In this cosy bistro it is easy to imagine that you're in Paris instead of Utrechtsestraat, in the heart of Amsterdam. The large oyster bar, the walls adorned with the menus of legendary French brasseries, the vintage crockery on the tables: this place is a celebration of a bygone era. Traditional fish recipes are given a fresh but down-to-earth twist with a sure hand. Richard van Oostenbrugge and Thomas Groot are once again making their mark here with no-nonsense dishes that you can feast on every day of the week – including at lunchtime!For example, a generous portion of perfectly cooked mussels are served, dotted with vadouvan mayonnaise and calamansi jelly, which add freshness and nuance without spoiling the seafood's distinctive flavour. As a nod to the traditional recipe, a creamy vadouvan soup and green celery provide the finishing touch to this delicious reinterpretation. A beautiful piece of turbot roasted on the bone is topped with morels incorporating a mousse created from the fish's barbel, fine slices of lardo di colonnata and a rich beurre blanc. This is next-level fish cuisine. Old school. Original. And it can all be ordered à la carte!

Name: Noor
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: Having sold De Loohoeve, Marleen and Jeroen Brouwer moved a little further north to Groningen, where they have given the Theresia Chapel a facelift. The sobriety of the church has been preserved, as have the beautiful stained-glass windows, which are now complemented by a stylish interior design. This is not your run-of-the-mill restaurant: upon entering, you are led through the state-of-the-art kitchen. The couple working side by side in the kitchen have joined forces to better express their creativity. We already know them to be chefs whose originality and sense of inventiveness know no bounds, and here at Noor, they continue to refine their personal style. Their celeriac dish – cooked in a salt crust and combined with ingredients including yoghurt and salted lemon – is a firm favourite with diners. Another tempting option is the Anjou pigeon served alongside the subtly contrasting flavours of blueberry, fried kale and a potent jus infused with ras el hanout. Words like "exuberant", "meticulous" and "adventurous" spring to mind here. That also applies to the carefully devised vegetarian set menu, which showcases "everyday" vegetables. Head to Noor for an inimitable dining experience!

Name: Herberg Onder de Linden
Address: Burg. van Barneveldweg 3, Aduard, 9831 RD, Netherlands
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Chef Klein Nijenhuis and his team carry on the tradition of this elegant, long - standing restaurant. The quality of the produce and the refinement of the preparations are fantastic. The chef’s modern style of cooking includes some interesting Asian influences and his dishes both surprise and seduce.

Name: Tante Koosje
Address: Kerkstraat 1, Loenen aan de Vecht, 3632 EL, Netherlands
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Today, Koosje Edema's former home is a beacon for gourmets. The old-world interior is cosy and charming, and in summer the terrace exudes a Mediterranean feel. The versatile Roland Veldhuijzen gives his dishes a new twist every now and then, but really it is good old-fashioned culinary expertise that sets him apart.

Name: De Nederlanden
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: De Nederlanden bears its name well. The decor, the charming service and the culinary style lend this former country hotel a quintessentially Dutch atmosphere. This building has plenty of character, combining historical charm with contemporary sleekness.
