Book a private room with friends or be prepared to wait in line.

Name: Polux
Address: No. 5, Xintiandi Beili, Lane 181, Taicang Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Brunch,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Don’t be perplexed if certain items on the menu seem familiar – this all-day dining bistro is from Paul Pairet of Ultraviolet and Mr & Mrs Bund fame. Some dishes echo the signatures from those establishments, albeit rendered in simpler forms. Onion soup is recommended – rich and well-balanced, with a nice contrast of textures. The classic Parisian décor with an industrial twist works perfectly. Reservations are recommended.

Name: Ho Hung Kee
Address: L324, South Building, HKRI Taikoo Hui, 288 Shimen Yi Road, Jingan, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: For a noodle shop, the Chinese-inspired faux-industrial décor is quite lavish – think brushed brass ring pendant lamps and black wrought-iron arches perforated with floral motifs. The menu is almost the same as at its Hong Kong counterparts. The must-order shrimp wonton noodle soup comes with springy noodles, crisp sweet shrimps enrobed in translucent skin, and rich flavoursome soup made with dried plaice and pork bones. Also try the fried ribbon noodles with beef.

Name: YongFu Mini (Pudong)
Address: Shop 910, 9F, L+Mall, 899 South Pudong Road, Pudong, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A spin-off from Yong Fu, this restaurant serves only seafood caught in the East China Sea the same day, such as Miiuy croaker and hairtail, but at a lower price point. The must-try signature '18 chops' – raw crabs marinated in spiced soy and wine – is only available from November to April. Other Ningbo favourites like Shaoxing wine chicken and grilled cabbage are also well executed. Reservations aren’t taken so arrive early to beat the crowd.

Name: Chun
Address: 124 Jinxian Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Cash only
Description: After a hiatus of a few years, this famous joint re-opened at the same address and former regulars flocked back for the sorely missed classics. The room has few bells and whistles to steal the spotlight from the food, and the friendly owner always makes the best recommendations. In her 60s, she still hand-picks the freshest ingredients from the market daily. Try deep-fried river shrimps, and stuffed paddy field snails, both meticulously done.

Name: Rong Cuisine
Address: 1-2F, 128 Taicang Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A spin-off of Xin Rong Ji, targeting a younger audience at a lower price range. Service may not be as formal and refined as its pricier sister, but is still pleasant and friendly. Both share the same sources of ingredients so freshness is guaranteed. On the menu, grilled fish, seafood and farm-style Zhejiang cooking dominate. Seasoning tends to be light to allow authentic flavours to come through. Reservations are accepted for private rooms only.

Name: Qiao Ai Lai Lai Xiao Long (Huangpu)
Address: 506 Tianjin Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Cash only
Description: This simple little shop tucked away in a bustling alley has been packed with hungry diners ever since it opened its doors 20 years ago. The chefs are always busy in the kitchen making xiao long bao, the crab roe variety being the most popular. Brace yourself for an even bigger crowd in hairy crab season, when wontons, spring rolls and soups are generously loaded with crabmeat and roe. The classic soupy pork buns are another must-try.

Name: A Niang Mian Guan
Address: 36 Sinan Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Cash only
Description: If you arrive at this very popular noodle shop at peak time the first thing you’ll notice is the queue. When you get to the front, place your order and pay at the counter at the entrance before finding a seat. The standouts are yellow croaker noodles, and noodles with stir-fried eels. To better experience the skills of the chef here, it’s also worth ordering side dishes, such as shredded pork with pickled vegetables.

Name: Tasty Congee & Noodle Wantun Shop
Address: S-B1-05, Stone Zone, Taikoo Li Qiantan, Lane 500, Dongyu Road, Pudong, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: After moving from Shanghai IFC to this address in 2021, this branch of the Hong Kong-based chain got a fresh lick of paint in light pink and mint green. Regulars were reassured that the menu, food, kitchen and service teams all stayed the same. As always, wonton noodle soup fascinates with its springy noodles, briny-sweet broth and the freshest shrimp filling. Other famous items like pineapple buns and barbecue meats are also made fresh in-house.

Name: Yangzhou Fan Dian (Huangpu)
Address: 345 Middle Fujian Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,China UnionPay,Foreign credit cards not accepted
Description: This senior member of the Shanghai dining scene is as busy as ever, especially after a facelift in 2017 that added a private room. The dining room is decorated with paintings and wood carvings, while the floor-to-ceiling window on the second floor frames the gorgeous city views. As always, it serves authentic Huai Yang food, impeccably made and reasonably priced. Must-tries include shredded tofu in soup and braised pork balls.

Name: The Lakeside Veggie
Address: L2-016-017, Sunny Walk, 230 Ruiping Road, Xuhui, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted
Description: The brand started on the banks of West Lake, Hangzhou, hence the name. This outpost near Longhua Temple is especially popular among worshippers. The room is furnished in a modern style, with a show kitchen where diners can see the chefs making dim sum. Try their matsutake soup dumplings, with three mushrooms enrobed in translucent skin. Seared tofu is loaded with smoky peppery flavours. The desserts and drinks are also popular.

Name: Xiao Tao Mian Guan
Address: 222 Jiashan Road, Xuhui, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Cash only
Description: This long-standing neighbourhood noodle shop was renovated a few years back. Noodles are either tossed in shallot oil or served in broth, but the former are more popular. They come with a heap of fried scallion, but you can also add an array of toppings, like spicy ground pork with diced potato, fried pork ribs, braised pork belly, or eel. You can also ask for a free refill of noodles. Come early to beat the peak-time queues.

Name: Chic 1699
Address: L807, 8F, Times Square, 500 Zhangyang Road, Pudong, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,China UnionPay,Foreign credit cards not accepted
Description: The Chic 1699 brand started out in Xiamen and this is their first venture in Shanghai. In the kitchen, a team of Fujianese chefs prepares authentic dishes with produce and fish mostly from their home province. Steamed mangrove crab with black sticky rice wrapped in lotus leaf boasts briny-sweet crabmeat and buttery roe. The airy, yet cosy room is great for all kinds of get-togethers. Top marks for the thoughtful, attentive service.

Name: Yunhe Noodle (Huangpu)
Address: 344 Changle Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Cash only
Description: Tucked inside a residential neighbourhood, this noodle shop with a subtle sign may not draw much attention from the outside. But the interior is a different world – where neon signs and graffiti murals subvert your expectations. House-made spinach noodles are topped with crabmeat with roe, or ‘shrimp trio’ (shrimps, tomalley and roe), with the option of adding clams or matsutake mushrooms. Seaweed crusted yellow croaker is also good.

Name: Hao Sheng
Address: 156 Guangyuan Road, Xuhui, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Cash only
Description: The décor is nothing to write home about, but the authentic home-style Shanghainese fare – Dongpo pork, shredded celtuce, blanched pork liver – keeps the regulars coming. An à la carte menu is not available but the chef chooses for you according to your budget, allergies, preference and what’s fresh. With only a few tables and one room, Hao Sheng fills up very fast, so reservations are recommended.

Name: Da Hu Chun (Middle Sichuan Road)
Address: 136 Middle Sichuan Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Cash only
Description: Queues stretch down the street thanks to the pan-fried pork buns which are cooked to perfection, with a crisp base and a juicy filling. Besides the buns, you can find mini wontons and Shaobing with a meat filling. The original shop opened here in 1932; it moved, subsequently returned to the same street, and now has several other shops scattered across Shanghai. You can also buy uncooked dim sum to take home.

Name: Gong De Lin (Huangpu)
Address: 445 West Nanjing Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: When you see that sweet and sour pork and fried shredded eel are on the menu you may doubt if the food is truly vegan but fear not – all the mock-meat and fish is made with either veggies, soy product or mushrooms. This institution of Shanghainese vegan cooking has been serving plant-based dishes in disguise since 1922. Its annexed shop now sells cake and snacks freshly made in-house, such as the tasty mugwort rice dumplings.

Name: Lu Bo Lang
Address: 115 Yuyuan Old Street, City God Temple, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: After a makeover in 2019, the room now boasts wavy silvery panels on the ceiling and recessed lights emitting a subtle green glow. Despite the update in décor, the menu stays the same so expect food that is as tasty and reasonably priced. Shanghainese dim sum is still the key draw - turnip pastry, osmanthus glutinous rice cake and ‘eyebrow’ pastry are the must-try items. Private rooms on the 2nd and 3rd floors can cater to parties of various sizes.

Name: Mi Thai
Address: 2F, 195 Anfu Road, Xuhui, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: In a neighbourhood well stocked with cool cafés and stylish boutiques comes this popular, pared-down Thai restaurant. It’s split between two rooms: one has an open kitchen; the other, an attractive timbered ceiling. The Thai chef keeps things fairly traditional so expect all the classics, from tom yum soup to green curry; but look out too for the deep fried shrimp patty or seafood yellow curry. The set lunch menu is great value.

Name: Lan Xin (Jinxian Road)
Address: 130 Jinxian Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Cash only
Description: There’s a plethora of places to eat on Jinxian Road but one worth searching out is little Lan Xin. It’s a popular place with a diverse clientele – just be ready to join the queue, which usually snakes down the street. It was once a residential home and the modest look matches with the traditional, homely style of Shanghainese food on offer. The braised pork; braised duck with brown sauce; and yellow croaker in sweet vinegar sauce are all good.

Name: Rongjia Noodles Soup with Yellow Croaker (Jingan)
Address: L105A-1, 688 Plaza, 688 West Nanjing Road, Jingan, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,China UnionPay,Foreign credit cards not accepted,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Xin Rong Ji is famous for its exclusive source of yellow croakers – this is a spin-off from the brand specialising in handmade noodles in the same rich milky fish broth, but priced a bit more wallet-friendly. The signature is obviously yellow croaker noodles, but the assorted seafood is also good. Don’t miss the Chaozhou-style marinated goose and Taizhou-style dim sum made fresh daily.

Name: Mao Long
Address: 134 Jinxian Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Cash only
Description: Since 1989 this little gem has been serving no-frills Shanghainese home-style dishes made with the best ingredients available. Converted from a residential home, it’s a 20-seater place with five tables and is run by a mother in her 80s and her daughter – they make sure recipes passed down from grandpa are strictly followed. Seafood makes up a big part of the menu, but they are especially proud of their braised pork.

Name: La Cerreta Osteria
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Immersed in nature, La Cerreta Osteria is a rural inn where you can sleep, relax in hot springs and enjoy fine cuisine. The daily menu at the restaurant here is prepared using biodynamic ingredients grown on the property itself (wine, olive oil, cheese, vegetables from the kitchen garden etc). House specialities often include the particularly delicious suckling pig.

Name: Ostaria Tyrol
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Regional dishes including home-made pastries and desserts, as well as meat and salumi from the family’s own farm, are to the fore in this typical restaurant with beautiful wooden furnishings created by a local artist. Part of the Post Hotel situated in the centre of the village (in the traffic-limited zone), the restaurant is open non-stop from 11am-10pm and doesn’t take bookings.

Name: Estrò
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in the pedestrianised area of the city centre, this simple, informal restaurant serves excellent cuisine with a focus on classic Italian meat and fish dishes. One of the best restaurants in Pescara when it comes to value for money.

Name: Dalla Rosa Alda
Address: strada Garibaldi 4, San Giorgio di Valpolicella, 37010, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The undoubted star of this restaurant is the Enbogonè tagliatelle – a pasta made entirely by hand and seasoned with a sauce made from borlotti beans, local extra - virgin olive oil and rosemary – although the menu features many other dishes. Simple, honest cuisine made mainly from carefully selected regional produce, accompanied by an excellent selection of local wines.

Name: Osteria Borsò Gambrinus
Address: via Capitello 18, San Polo di Piave, 31020, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A wine bar-cum-osteria with a warm, rustic decor and a menu offering fish and meat dishes, including specialities such as fried scampi, squid, crayfish and vegetables, all seasoned with olive oil. There’s also a good choice of wines by the glass, with a focus on natural wines.

Name: Oberraindlhof
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The family that run this restaurant occupying an old farmhouse with origins dating back to the 16C has a relationship with the region that goes back decades. In later years, the farm became an inn and it has now been run by the same family for five generations, all motivated by a desire to introduce their guests to the best recipes and ingredients from the Senales valley. Dishes include an excellent roast lamb (raised on the restaurant’s own farm), which is stewed with bones and potatoes and served at the table from a copper cauldron. An excellent wine list and the hotel’s warm and friendly ambience add to the appeal.

Name: Tre Noghere
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in a peaceful location amid fields and vineyards, this attractive country restaurant run by the same family since 1965 boasts an outdoor space where three walnut trees (“tre noghere”) provide shade in summer, plus a neat and simple dining room. The skilful owner is at the helm in the kitchen, while the younger generation provide a warm and professional welcome front of house. Traditional cuisine, including home-made pastas, are to the fore here – we particularly enjoyed the bigoli with ragu and rosemary, as well as the glazed duck breast with apricots. We asked for recommendations when choosing our wine and we didn’t regret it!

Name: Trattoria Ceriati
Address: Località Cangelasio Ceriati 18, Salsomaggiore Terme, 43039, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This attractive modern trattoria in a tranquil out - of - town location is run by two young partners with experience in the restaurant business. The cuisine is rooted in the traditions of Parma, with a choice of boiled meat specialities in winter and meat cooked over the barbecue grill and served on the outdoor veranda in spring and summer.

Name: L'Acino
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This small trattoria run by friendly staff serves delicious Piedmontese cuisine which is the perfect accompaniment to the restaurant’s excellent choice of wines. Be warned – if you haven’t made a booking, you’re unlikely to get a table.

Name: Fracia
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Park the car and walk up a short track (about 50m) to this rustic stone farmhouse with panoramic views of the surrounding valley. A traditional oasis serving delicious local cuisine with a light touch and the occasional Mediterranean influence where, in summer, meals are served at stone tables in the delightful outdoor area with stunning views of the surrounding countryside.

Name: Salotto sul Mare
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The upper floor of the building that houses Il Bavaglino restaurant boasts spectacular views that are almost part of the decor. Good, honest traditional cuisine that is simply prepared from top-quality ingredients and is full of flavour. In addition to the à la carte, there are three tasting-style menus that are perfect for sharing. Open at lunchtime only.

Name: Osteria Platzegg
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This comfortable and informal “Gasthaus” with a simple yet welcoming and contemporary feel is run by talented chef Herbert Hintner, the undisputed master of Alto Adige cuisine. Housed within a historic building in the town’s pedestrianised centre, the restaurant serves simple cuisine with a focus on regional recipes and ingredients (such as potato ravioli filled with speck ham and spleen crostini in broth) alongside a few Mediterranean-influenced dishes such as arancini in a gorgonzola sauce. The wine list, on the other hand, focuses uniquely on the Alto Adige.

Name: Mezzolitro Vini e Cucina
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated amid the attractive alleyways in the centre of Rho, this simple yet pleasant and friendly restaurant serves delicious local cuisine. Abruzzo specialities are to the fore, including dishes such as spaghetti alla chitarra with meatballs in sauce, various mutton recipes (grilled on skewers, tartare, steaks etc), lamb and different types of ham.

Name: ChiaroScuro
Address: corso Vittorio Emanuele II 380, Cagliari, 09123, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: In this small neighbourhood restaurant, chef Marina Ravarotto pays tribute to some of Sardinia’s iconic dishes, such as Su Filindeu – a home made pasta very difficult to prepare. The excellent 4-course “Le Radici” menu introduces guests to some of the island’s most typical dishes.

Name: Osteria Ophis
Cuisine: Cuisine from the Marches, Modern Cuisine
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in the beautiful historic centre of Offida, this restaurant with a brick-vaulted ceiling is housed in the former stables of an old palazzo with a modern, inviting decor. Near the entrance, a small window offers a glimpse of the kitchen. The regional cuisine is reinterpreted with individual flair by the chef, showcased on an à la carte that changes regularly (including truffles in season) and two excellent tasting menus.

Name: Al Bersagliere
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A long - established restaurant overflowing with memorabilia, from the juke box to the old coffee machine dating from the 1960s, run by a family which has been here for generations. Guests can visit the wine cellar dating back to the 13C, there’s a good selection of spirits, and the cuisine showcases the best of the Veneto. Specialities include pasta and beans, bigoli pasta with duck and risotto all'Amarone.

Name: Antica Trattoria Gianna
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A delightful family trattoria offering simple, reasonably priced dishes at lunchtime and a copious tasting menu in the evening. The latter features dishes from the Lower Po valley, such as hams and salami, fresh pasta and the excellent beef entrecote with salt and aromatic olive oil.

Name: Le Antiche Sere
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A small restaurant overlooking the lake in Lesina, where everything revolves around the professionalism and experience of the owner - chef, who selects the best produce from the lake region, including fish and aromatic herbs, and even produces his own mullet roe. Regional flavours are to the fore here, with the occasional modern twist.

Name: Antica Locanda al Cervo - Landgasthof zum Hirschen
Address: via Schrann 9/c, San Genesio Atesino, 39050, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Enjoy generous, regional cuisine influenced by the family’s involvement in the cattle and horse farming business, either in the restaurant’s welcoming dining rooms or on its sunny panoramic terrace. “Zero food miles” produce is much more than a simple slogan here!

Name: Buscone
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The difficulty, which perhaps you may encounter when trying to reach this trattoria, is compensated by the very pleasant family atmosphere and genuine home - made cooking.

Name: Antica Trattoria La Toppa
Address: via del Giglio 43, San Donato in Poggio, 50028, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In the heart of a small, romantic medieval hamlet, this typical Tuscan trattoria opened in 1964 and continues to celebrate regional cuisine in all its glory. Highlights on the menu include soups and fresh pasta dishes. In summer, meals are served outdoors on the attractive street which is full of character.

Name: Dalla Libera
Address: via Farra 52, Sernaglia della Battaglia, 31020, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: At this restaurant, an American-style barbecue garden (in summer) and a smart, rustic dining room provide the backdrop for carefully prepared local cuisine with a personalised, gourmet twist, such as the home-made gnocchi served with three different types of tomato. The wine list features top-quality labels from Italy and further afield, including a few vintages that will delight wine-enthusiasts.

Name: Rosselli 77
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: An interesting and unusual restaurant - cum - antique shop, where the owner (who is also the chef) restores the furniture and other items that make up the decor and which are available for purchase. Piedmontese specialities take pride of place on the menu, which changes daily depending on market availability. Highlights include the potato salami ravioli on melted Taleggio cheese, the cappello del prete beef and the cremino al gianduiotto chocolate dessert.

Name: Krone
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The past retains its fascinating appeal in this traditional restaurant situated in a small mountain village, where modern trends are ignored in favour of authentic dishes from the South Tyrol. Originally opened as an inn, the restaurant still offers a few simple and discreet rooms furnished in traditional style, as well as a new and modern sauna.

Name: Locanda delle Grazie
Address: via San Pio X 2, Grazie, 46010, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: There’s been a change of management at this restaurant, where long-established couple Daniela and Fernando have passed on the baton to a local restaurateur. However, regional classics such as fresh pasta, meat dishes and charcuterie all still feature on the menu, while the excellent value for money also remains unchanged.

Name: Domenico dal 1968
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A small neighbourhood restaurant with an attractive, vaguely vintage decor and just a few tables, giving it the atmosphere of a private home. The cuisine changes daily according to market availability, with a focus on seasonal ingredients and traditional recipes from Lazio.

Name: Sa Mandra
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated on the Azienda Agrituristica Sa Mandra, this restaurant allows guests to savour one of Sardinia’s emblematic ingredients, namely delicious roast suckling pig which is the focus of the single menu offered here. Once seated at your table, you’ll be served a host of small bites and courses, all of which are based on this main ingredient. Make sure you arrive early to watch the pig being cooked – the owners are happy to explain the procedure, right down to the smallest detail. Guestrooms are also available.

Name: Clemente
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A welcoming restaurant housed in the stables of a palazzo dating from the early 19C, which also includes a bistro where you can enjoy an evening aperitif. The menu features authentic dishes from the Abruzzo, with a focus on meat dishes, vegetables and generous portions!

Name: La Villa
Address: Contrada Cavallerizza, SS 303 verso Rocchetta Sant'Antonio, Melfi, 85025, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This country restaurant owes its welcoming atmosphere to the special attentions of the family management. The menus are based on traditional recipes that do full justice to the local produce.

Name: Locanda del Capitano & Tipico Osteria
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The Locanda and the Tipico offer two menus showcasing traditional Umbrian cuisine (one gourmet, the other traditional); guests can then choose in which of the restaurants they would prefer to eat. The wine selection has recently been extended to over 400 labels, while the olive oils now have their own dedicated menu which includes the best oils from the region. With Giancarlo Polito at the helm, there’s no doubt that you’re in excellent hands!

Name: Da Marchesi
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated on a road that climbs through the Apennines between Romagna and the Marche, this small restaurant serves good, simple and traditional Romagna cuisine. The menu features home-made pasta and local meat dishes, as well as daily specials which focus on seasonal ingredients (don’t miss the “fossa” cheese from Perticara and the tortelloni with butter and truffles). Excellent value for money, making this one of the best trattorias in Italy!

Name: QuarantunoDodici
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated on the banks of the river, this seaside osteria run by chef Lele Usai (the Michelin-starred Tino is on the first floor of the building) is the perfect setting for a business lunch or an enjoyable dinner thanks to its excellent fish-based cuisine which is firmly rooted in traditional recipes. As well as the à la carte, the “Diario di Bordo” lists the daily specials, which showcase the freshest fish on offer here.

Name: Trattoria alla Ruota
Address: via Proale 6, località Mazzano, Negrar, 37024, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Don’t be misled by the word trattoria – this is an elegant restaurant offering superb views of the surrounding hills. The cuisine here is constantly changing, with a use of local produce which is transformed into imaginative and elaborate dishes.

Name: Zeb
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A new take on traditional cuisine in this unique restaurant in the delightful San Niccolò district. Diners sit side - by - side around a central table, as in a sushi bar, enjoying a selection of delicious homemade dishes.

Name: Da Burde
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Opened at the beginning of the 20C as a grocer’s shop and trattoria, this historic restaurant is a long way off the usual tourist trail. The two brothers who now run Da Burde have kept everything as it was, with cured hams on sale and a bar selling tobacco. The dining rooms to the rear are full of decorative detail, with wine bottles and a dessert trolley adding to the pleasantly convivial and informal atmosphere. Not surprisingly, the cuisine focuses on authentic local specialities.

Name: La Cuccagna
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: There are many reasons to visit this excellent family - run restaurant in the village centre, the most important of which is the food – fresh vegetables, delicious first courses (the fresh troccoli pasta with wild chicory, cherry tomatoes and broad beans is excellent) and carefully selected meat dishes (the father was once a butcher! ). Close attention is also paid to the wine, with more than 500 labels just waiting to be opened in the beautiful wine cellar.

Name: Da Giannino - L'Angolo d'Abruzzo
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A warm welcome combined with a simple but lively atmosphere and typical dishes from the Abruzzo region make this a popular place to eat. Generous portions and excellent roast dishes.

Name: Terme
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in the Ligurian hinterland, this simple, rustic - style restaurant - trattoria serves a selection of well - prepared dishes which are full of flavour. Our favourites include the Pigna white bean soup, the milk - fed lamb with herbs and the zabaione mousse.

Name: Al Vecchio Faggio
Address: via Garibaldi 8, località Borgnana, Cuasso al Monte, 21050, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A rustic restaurant offering a warm and friendly atmosphere. The cuisine focuses on local and regional ingredients, while the experienced and enthusiastic owner-sommelier is at hand to help with wine choices.

Name: Il Sogno
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant (once a cultural club) in the Miranese countryside serves simple yet delicious cuisine at reasonable prices. Although the dishes have their roots in the region, they are also influenced by Slow Food traditions from elsewhere in Italy and further afield and boast the occasional personalised touch. In winter, the trolley of boiled meats served with sauces and mostarda makes an appearance.

Name: Trattoria da Paeto
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This small trattoria hidden among the canals in the countryside is run by a couple of partners who showcase the specialities of the region with professionalism and enthusiasm. The menu includes delicacies such as fish and vegetable couscous, and sfoglia pastry with cream and flakes of chocolate, as well as a few more modern dishes.

Name: Antica Osteria
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A pleasant restaurant with three charming dining rooms, where the whole family pulls together with spectacular results. Delicious regional cuisine is to the fore, with dishes such as venison carpaccio with pineapple and raspberries on the menu.

Name: Osteria Piazzetta Cattedrale
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Run by a married couple with the wife in the kitchen and the husband front of house, this gem of a restaurant just a few metres from the cathedral stands out for its top - quality produce (mainly from Puglia), in dishes such as broad bean purée with seasonal vegetables. Other specialities include sformatino (a type of soufflé) with courgette flowers, spring onions and date purée; suckling pig with baked potato and wild greens; and warm sfogliatina pastry with vanilla cream.

Name: Veneziano
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated just outside Randazzo, one of the villages with typical lava-stone buildings dotted around Mt Etna, this restaurant serves excellent local cuisine. Recipes featuring mushrooms and meat take pride of place on the menu, from antipasti such as the excellent mixed mushrooms to first courses of mushroom soup and mains that include a highly recommended “asado” (mixed grill) and an unmissable Nero dei Nebrodi capocollo ham.

Name: Stella
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Dining options at this restaurant include an attractive outdoor terrace with views of the surrounding area (in summer) and a friendly bistro-style dining room. We particularly enjoyed the linguine with carp roe, as well as the stuffed pigeon.

Name: La Brinca
Address: via Campo di Ne 58, Ne, 16040, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The little village of Ne has become synonymous with La Brinca, a restaurant occupying an old farmhouse surrounded by greenery which in the past 30 years has become one of the best trattorias in Liguria and the whole of Italy. The restaurant tells the story of the Circella family – parents and offspring alike put all their heart, energy, passion and dedication into their work here… and it shows! The excellent local, seasonal cuisine is generous and tasty, accompanied by equally superb wines (over 1 000 labels are stored in the wine cellar) which are presented to guests with proper courtesy and attention.

Name: La Campanara
Address: via Borgo 24/a, località Pianetto, Galeata, 47010, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in a village near Galeata, this restaurant boasts a charming small inner courtyard – you walk through here into an idyllic outdoor dining space next to the church surrounded by trees and with views of the hills. The regional cuisine focuses on specialities from Romagna as well as the nearby Marche and (especially) Tuscany. If you’re looking for somewhere to stay, there’s an inn with rooms next door to the restaurant.

Name: Vascello d'Oro
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: In business since 1887, this restaurant with warm traditional decor is situated in the town famous for bue grasso (“fat ox”), which you’ll find on the menu here from November to Easter. Enjoy typical, popular dishes from the Piedmont, such as meat and vegetable filled ravioli, finanziera stew, fried dishes, Russian salad and, of course, the famous boiled meats, all skilfully prepared in the traditional way. Desserts such as hazelnut cake and bonet provide a final flourish for the tastebuds.

Name: Trattoria Lanzagallo
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Don’t be fooled by the simple decor and unfussy ambience at this restaurant – the Trattoria Lanzagallo is one of the best places in the province for top-quality fish served in delicious, generous and imaginative dishes. The menu is striking for its reasonable prices.

Name: Podere San Faustino
Address: via San Faustino 33 (SS Emilia Nord), Fidenza, 43036, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Notable sake list,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In the heart of the Bassa Parmense region, this old farmhouse has retained romantic reminders of bygone days. The menu also has a traditional feel, featuring dishes such as egg tagliolini with a salami, sun - dried tomato and onion sauce, and braised pork cheeks with a fennel carpaccio in an orange marinade. There’s also a good choice of delicious desserts.

Name: Borgo Spoltino
Address: strada Selva Alta, Mosciano Sant'Angelo, 64023, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Borgo Spoltino occupies a 19C farmhouse amid hills and olive groves with views of the sea and mountains. Bright and with plenty of space inside and out, this restaurant is highly recommended for its local specialities and creative dishes, accompanied by vegetables grown in its own garden. The wine list offers a surprising snapshot of the region’s best wines – selected province by province – alongside a few labels from further afield. A good selection of extra virgin olive oil from the Abruzzi completes the picture.

Name: Josto
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in the centre of Cagliari near the charming Piazza del Carmine, this restaurant offers two small dining rooms furnished in designer style. The setting provides the perfect background for the cuisine, which is modern yet inspired by Sardinian recipes and ingredients.

Name: Osteria La Torre
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated right in the historic centre, this restaurant pays tribute to local produce in its authentic dishes which are full of flavour, prioritising market-fresh ingredients in its daily specials. The choice of wines, the outdoor area for summer dining and the warm family welcome are further reasons to eat here.

Name: Osteria Zanchetti
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated at the top of a steep slope in Fossombrone’s beautiful historic centre, this osteria takes guests back to the 1920s thanks to its romantic decor. Here, having risen through the culinary ranks, the owner-chef makes full use of his expert techniques to create dishes that hover between tradition and a sense of fantasy using the best seasonal ingredients that the region has to offer. The concise wine list favours micro-producers and natural wines.

Name: Osteria La Solita Zuppa
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in Chiusi’s historic centre, this restaurant has the feel of a typical Tuscan trattoria with its traditional vaulted ceiling. The chef’s love for regional cuisine is demonstrated by the revival of traditional recipes (including the use of a wood-fired oven), resulting in the full flavours that are so characteristic of this region.

Name: U.P.E.P.I.D.D.E.
Address: vico Sant'Agnese 2, angolo corso Cavour, Ruvo di Puglia, 70037, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Undeniably characteristic and refreshing! Dug out of the rock that once formed the old Aragonese walls, the four dining rooms in this restaurant run one into another under brick arches and then lead to the wine cellar, which is open to guests. The regional cuisine is as traditional as the decor, with specialities such as barbecued local meat and beef fillet in a plum sauce with wine and caramelised shallots on the menu.

Name: Contesto Alimentare
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A tiny modern trattoria with simple tables set close together, where the fine cuisine on offer is the real attraction. Using regional produce, the female chef prepares delicious specialities inspired by Piedmontese classics, such as tajarin pasta and plin ravioli which always feature on the menu. Other options such as salt cod with vegetables and lavender panna cotta with meliga biscuits (a typical shortbread from the Piedmont) occasionally make an appearance.

Name: Impero
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Now a culinary landmark in the province, this restaurant is run by two enthusiastic sisters who serve cuisine with its roots in local traditions and prepared using seasonal ingredients. Renovation work over the past few years has added to the style and character of the restaurant, which boasts a small garden for summer dining plus a good selection of wines.

Name: Luna Rossa
Address: via Marconi 18, Terranova di Pollino, 85030, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This rustic, convivial restaurant in the village centre boasts a panoramic terrace overlooking the valley. A constant search for recipes from Italy’s peasant tradition combines with the passion and talent of the chef to create specialities such as raviolo della memoria.

Name: 13 Comuni
Address: piazza della Vittoria 31, Velo Veronese, 37030, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in the village square, this restaurant is run by a couple – she’s front of house, while he’s in the kitchen – who use top - quality local produce to prepare a mix of traditional and modern dishes. House specialities include gnocchi with sheep’s ricotta cheese and hazel butter (the butter isn’t actually made with hazelnuts but is simply melted), and confit pork ribs in beer. The mountain - style decor continues in the simple guestrooms.

Name: Nuova Roma
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A friendly and long-established family-run restaurant on the road between Calderino and Sasso Marconi, which serves generous portions of traditional, regional cuisine with a contemporary flavour. House specialities include fresh pasta, dishes cooked on the authentic wood-fired grill, as well as classic recipes such as Bolognese cutlet. There’s also a comprehensive wine list, with a natural focus on labels from Emilia Romagna. A spacious car park and attractive terrace for summer dining complete the picture.

Name: Lerchner's In Runggen
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Typical of the Alto Adige and situated right next to its own farm from where the beef on its menu is sourced, this restaurant pays careful attention to detail both in its decor (the staff wear local costume) and in its delicious regional cuisine, which is made from the best local ingredients. The house specialities change with the seasons and include geröstl (grilled beef and pork with potatoes, onions and speck ham), tirtlan (rye pancakes), and the unmissable apple strudel. The Alto Adige region also takes centre-stage on the wine list.

Name: Osteria della Chiocciola
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant has a wine bar on the ground floor and a dining room on the first floor, both simple yet attractive in style. The food is resolutely regional and traditional with an emphasis on local, seasonal ingredients. The tajarin pasta served with butter and sage is a perennial favourite on the menu.

Name: Roma
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant embodies tradition with a capital T – a family tradition which dates back to 1870 and which has now passed into the hands of the fifth generation. The menu features meat and fish dishes alike, with the current chef adding a modern twist to some of his creations.

Name: Il Sottomarino
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: An elegant dining room and a delightful terrace with sea views – it’s worth making a reservation ahead of time in high season. Excellent fish at reasonable prices, with specialities such as potato gnocchi with baby squid and sage, and mixed fish stew on the menu.

Name: La Piazzetta
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in the attractive upper and historic part of town overlooking industrial Brianza, this restaurant with two bright dining rooms occupies a restored building, where interesting classic and contemporary dishes feature on the menu. An intimate place to dine midweek; however, booking is essential on weekends and holidays.

Name: Da Giocondo
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: An authentic restaurant, where the owners themselves are at the helm in the kitchen and front of house making sure that the rustic, regional cuisine served here is full of flavour. Daily specials, which vary depending on market availability (thus ensuring the freshest possible ingredients), are announced at your table, in addition to a small selection of dishes on the menu. House specialities include traditional hand-made pastas, each of which has its own name and which is typical of the Abruzzo.

Name: Serendib
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Serendib, the old name for Sri Lanka, means “to make happy” – an ambitious promise but one which this welcoming restaurant serving typical Indian and Sri Lankan dishes manages to keep. The tasting menu introduces guests to different specialities and comes highly recommended (especially if it’s your first time here).

Name: Dell'Alba
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: In business since 1850, and now run by the sixth generation, this traditional and historic family trattoria is a mecca for fans of Bassa Padana cuisine. The simple yet authentic ambience is warm and welcoming, while the delicious cuisine – an extraordinary combination of specialities from Cremona and Mantova – is a real treat for the tastebuds.

Name: La Locanda del Colonnello
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: If you like walking, our advice is to approach this restaurant on foot from the lively Corso Umberto, taking the steps up to the Duomo di San Giorgio and then enjoying a pleasant stroll through the alleyways of picturesque Modica Alta, where the restaurant is situated. In this simple setting, the focus here is on the remarkable quality of the cuisine, which includes an eclectic array of Sicilian dishes alongside more creative options, all of which showcase expert technique and stunning flavours.

Name: La Baita
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated in the historic centre, this trattoria-cum-delicatessen focuses on top-quality traditional cuisine. Take a seat in the simple, informal dining room and choose from a vast selection of cheeses and salumi, as well as home-made pasta and meat dishes.

Name: Locanda Pincelli
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Named after the village’s former postman, an important and charismatic character in this small community, this former workers’ club is housed in a rustic restaurant with a beautiful porch where you sit in summer beneath cooling fans. The cuisine steps away from local tradition to offer creative yet never overly fanciful dishes which are always generous and beautifully presented. We particularly enjoyed the mezze maniche pasta with stewed white onion, sour butter and burnt lemon, as well as the leg of guinea fowl browned with paprika, its own juices and horseradish mayonnaise. When choosing your wine, you might like to ask owner Danilo for his recommendations from a list which is not extensive but is certainly interesting and carefully chosen.

Name: Rosmarino
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Located just a few metres from Piazza De Ferrari, this restaurant offers an outdoor space and three dining rooms with a pleasant and informal ambience. It is the quality of the cuisine that strikes you at Rosmarino, where the classic Ligurian meat and fish dishes are prepared from top-quality ingredients. Highlights include the “brandacujun” salted cod, the borage ravioli, and the “sbira” tripe.

Name: Trattoria Pomposa - Al Re gras
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This trattoria is the more casual version of the nearby Michelin-starred L'Erba del Re. Although the cuisine is simpler than at the restaurant, the dishes are carefully prepared, the welcome is friendly and the female service attentive and professional. The restaurant is situated in the attractive historic centre, with parking (clearly marked with blue stripes) nearby. A taste of Emilian simplicity with a contemporary twist.

Name: Cile's
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated near the sea, this bright little restaurant with an almost shabby feel uses plenty of wood in its decor, along with a blue and white colour scheme that makes it feel like a corner of Provence in the heart of Fano. The cuisine, however, remains firmly rooted in the local region with simple, very reasonably priced fish dishes and specialities from the Marche featuring on the menu. An amusing imaginative touch comes in the original names given to these dishes.

Name: Boivin
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Occupying an old house in the town centre, this restaurant is strongly influenced by the character and ideas of its owner-chef, Riccardo, who offers an original mix of traditional Trento cuisine and influences from around the world (including Korean kimchi and Japanese cooking methods such as tataki). Regional wines are to the fore on the reasonably priced wine list.

Name: Apollonia
Address: via Sant'Apollonia 3, località Sirmiano Sopra, Nals, 39010, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Following a road that twists and turns uphill, surrounded at first by vineyards and fruit trees and then by woodland, you climb to an altitude of 900m to reach this restaurant run by the Geiser family, who have been serving simple yet delicious regional (and Italian) cuisine here for three generations. With a focus on seasonal ingredients from the Alto Adige, the restaurant’s emblematic dish is Val Passiria char with Termeno polenta and Sirmiano saffron. The beautiful views take in Terlano in the middle of the valley and the majestic Dolomites (including Sciliar, Catinaccio and Latemar) in the distance.

Name: Romanè
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The decor is simple, almost spartan, and the service unpretentious in this new restaurant situated on the noisy Via Cipro (there is an outdoor space but we recommend eating indoors), where the main attraction is the seasonal, Roman-influenced cuisine. Full of flavour, the dishes are generously portioned and characterised by personal and imaginative touches.

Name: L'Osteria della Trippa
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The name of this simple, family-run restaurant speaks for itself, with at least five different types of tripe included on the menu alongside a choice of other dishes and traditional Roman recipes. A typical neighbourhood osteria, where the owner offers a friendly welcome.

Name: L'Ortone
Address: piazza Lorenzo Ghiberti 87 r, Florence, 50122, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This Tuscan-style bistro next to Sant'Ambrogio market is simple both in its decor and cuisine, offering a menu which features a few regional dishes alongside imaginative Italian-themed options prepared from seasonal ingredients. Grilled specialities are also available, alongside an interesting wine list. Excellent value for money, although if you order the steak you’ll end up spending a little more.

Name: La Locanda Gesù Vecchio
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant right in the historic centre oozes authentic Neapolitan style thanks to its friendly atmosphere and the warm welcome from its young owner. Here, guests enjoy the best Neapolitan cuisine, including specialities such as the delicious Genovese ragù, a white sauce which, despite its name, is a speciality of Campania. The restaurant also boasts an interesting wine list.

Name: Osteria del Miglio 2.10
Address: via Patrioti 2, Pieve San Giacomo, 26035, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Although the town may not be of major importance, the cuisine served at this modern restaurant (with a convenient car park) certainly is! Focusing on traditional local recipes and using seasonal ingredients, the carefully prepared dishes are both generous and full of flavour. Fair prices complete the picture and make this a restaurant a must.

Name: Su Gologone
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: It is difficult to choose between the three delightful rooms in this restaurant. One has a huge fireplace used for roasting the famous porceddu (suckling pig); another, more intimate in style, is dedicated to a well-known ceramist; while the third is adorned with works by a Sardinian artist. Whichever you choose, you’ll enjoy traditional cuisine from inland Sardinia with the option of dining on a panoramic terrace overlooking vineyards and olive groves in fine weather. House specialities include suckling pig roasted on the spit, maccarones de busa (pasta), and culurgiones (a type of ravioli).

Name: 53 Untitled
Address: via del Monte della Farina 53, Rome, 00186, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Two enthusiastic young women, a welcoming bistro with a few small tables on the street, and a very contemporary approach to its cuisine, including its selection of wines and cocktails, all combine to make this informal restaurant a good choice. Despite the casual ambience, the cuisine here is excellent and includes various tapas dishes to share. Traditional Roman recipes feature on the menu alongside more classic and internationally influenced options.

Name: Spoon
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Located in the heart of the historic centre, just a stone’s throw from the beautiful 13C cathedral, this small but welcoming restaurant has a contemporary feel. The generous, modern cuisine, full of colour and flavour, focuses on meat dishes only and is prepared by a young owner-chef who trained with Niko Romito.

Name: Nerina
Address: via De Gasperi 31, località Malgolo, Romeno, 38010, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Simplicity, hospitality and informality are the keywords to describe this restaurant in the verdant Val di Non, which has been run by the Di Nuzzo family for more than 50 years. Guests come to Nerina time and time again to enjoy excellent Trentino produce, such as the casolèt cheese, Valsugana maize and mortandela salami, as well as its authentic house specialities, often made with ingredients from the restaurant’s own vegetable garden and occasionally with influences from elsewhere in Italy.

Name: Buca 18
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Three young brothers and their mother run this restaurant situated inland from Rimini with real passion, offering a small à la carte and three tasting menus (meat, fish and vegetarian) that feature cuisine that is plentiful, exuberant and full of flavour. Meals are also served outdoors in summer, while the dining room is often embellished with art exhibitions by local artists.

Name: Al Palazzon
Address: via Ca' Onorai 2, loc. Mottinello Nuovo, Galliera Veneta, 35015, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Housed in an early 20C farmhouse, this restaurant boasts the typical ambience of a traditional multi-generational trattoria, while the cuisine focuses on classic dishes that are typical of the Veneto. Highlights include bigoli pasta, bean soup, Vicenza-style baccalà cod and mallard duck.

Name: Edelweiss
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A real bastion of local cuisine for over 60 years thanks to the hard work of an entire family. The menu features mountain-style cuisine, including game dishes, a small selection of local cheeses (we highly recommend the Bettelmatt) and home-made ice cream. Relaxed and informal ambience.

Name: Antica Trattoria Cattivelli
Address: via Chiesa di Isola Serafini 2, Monticelli d'Ongina, 29010, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: As its address indicates, this restaurant is situated on an island formed by a loop in the River Po. Since 1947, the Cattivelli family have been celebrating the best of the Lower Po valley’s cuisine here in a rural, river setting that is typical of the region. Highlights include the pisarei e fasò and fish from the river, although you can’t really go wrong here whatever you choose!

Name: Caffè Grande
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Housed in a charming palazzo with an Art Nouveau façade overlooking the main square of the village, this restaurant has an unexpectedly modern and minimalist-style interior, while the menu features classic favourites from Piacenza, such aspisarei (gnocchi) and anolini (stuffed pasta).

Name: Buatta Cucina Popolana
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A lively restaurant housed in the historic rooms of an old shop, where the traditional dishes change regularly in line with the seasons. Highlights include the bucatini alle sarde (pasta with sardines) and fish involtini.

Name: Andrea - Sapori Montani
Address: via Gabriele Judica 4, Palazzolo Acreide, 96010, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated on the main street of the fascinating town of Palazzolo Acreide, this restaurant occupies the first floor of a period building. The restaurant takes its name from its chef Andrea, while the phrase “Sapori Montani” (mountain flavours) gives a good indication of the type of cuisine served here, from the local truffle-flavoured sausage – which has made Palazzolo Acreide’s name famous throughout Sicily – to trout, black suckling pig and excellent cheeses.

Name: Burro & Alici
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: With just a road separating it from the beach, this simple restaurant is similar to the many others dotted along the seafront in Marotta, the inspiration for the famous Italian song “Il mare d’inverno” (“the winter sea”) by Enrico Ruggeri. However, it’s the food that is the main attraction here – the colourful, generous cuisine of the Adriatic, with fish served in classic recipes occasionally finished with an imaginative and personal twist. Pizzas cooked in a wood-fired oven are available in the evening.

Name: Osteria Madonnetta
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A simple family - run restaurant with a friendly, welcoming ambience. Housed in a historic palazzo behind the square with the famous chessboard, the restaurant boasts an old, beamed ceiling, just a few wooden tables and an inviting open fireplace; a section of the old town walls can be seen from the attractive outdoor area. Signora Annamaria is at the helm in the kitchen, serving good, home - style dishes from the Veneto with an emphasis on seasonal produce and vegetables.

Name: Il Ciabot
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Warmed by an open fire in winter, this welcoming family-run restaurant celebrates the cuisine of Piedmont, although a few fish dishes also feature on the menu. Traditional, time-honoured and overlooked dishes take pride of place, such as boiled meat terrine with a salsa verde, Fassone beef in a crust, plus an excellent giandujotto chocolate mousse. Booking ahead is recommended.

Name: Taverna dei Caldora
Cuisine: Cuisine from Abruzzo, Meats and Grills
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated amid the maze of narrow streets in the old town of Pacentro and occupying the wine cellars of an imposing 16C palazzo, this restaurant celebrates regional cuisine in all its glory in specialities such as spaghetti with saffron and truffles.

Name: Al Piave
Address: via Cormons 6 - Fraz. Corona, Mariano del Friuli, 34071, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This welcoming family - run trattoria comprises of two attractive dining rooms and a beautiful summer garden. It specialises in regional dishes that vary according to the seasons. Guinea fowl cooked with chives is one of the house specialities.

Name: Vecchia Lama
Address: via XXIV Maggio 24, Lama Mocogno, 41023, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Enjoy a friendly welcome and excellent food in this restaurant that only serves meat dishes. The focus is on mountain specialities from Emilia, as well as truffles in season. Dine alfresco on the terrace overlooking the garden in summer. House specialities include ricotta and nettle tortelloni with porcini mushrooms and the slightly more expensive Fiorentina steak cooked on a hot stone.

Name: Taverna del Grappolo Blu
Address: scale di via Moglio 1, Montalcino, 53024, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Accessed via a steep, narrow flight of steps, this restaurant boasts a traditional and friendly ambience. The cuisine is traditionally Tuscan (pici pasta with ragu and tripe are among the most popular dishes on the menu), while the interesting wine list includes a selection of Brunello wines arranged by year, as well as some top-quality vintage options which will delight wine-enthusiasts. The owner oversees the informal yet attentive service.

Name: Osteria Storica Morelli
Address: piazza Petrini 1, località Canezza di Pergine, Pergine Valsugana, 38057, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The cuisine served at this restaurant is made from carefully selected ingredients and has its roots firmly embedded in the local region. Specialities include gnocchi di polenta with a sausage ragù and Rosada pudding, a typical dessert from the Trentino region. Good value for money!

Name: La Dispensa di Armatore
FacilitiesAndServices: Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A very small and unusual restaurant with a bistro feel and tables outside only, either at the counter with stools overlooking the sea or in the more traditional outdoor dining space. Although the menu is relatively small, the quality of the fish (including options such as bluefin tuna, anchovies, squid etc) is excellent – which is hardly surprising, as the restaurant owners have been involved in the fishing industry for four generations. The menu features just one dessert, “spumone”, which is made for the restaurant by a nearby artisanal ice-cream parlour, and the restaurant doesn’t serve coffee, but people flock here for the excellent fish and the attractive prices, which are very reasonable given its coastal location.

Name: L'Oste Dispensa
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The focus at this restaurant is on local ingredients, including sustainably caught fish and seafood. The set menu changes in line with the seasons and the availability of ingredients, while the excellent wine list boasts an impressive selection of organic and biodynamic labels. The wine cellar can be glimpsed through the floor near the cash till, and uninterrupted views of the sea can be enjoyed from the dining room.

Name: Osteria del Gallo e della Volpe
Address: piazza Umberto I 14, Ospedaletto d'Alpinolo, 83014, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant in the centre of this small town is run by the Silvestro family (father and son). In summer, book one of the tables in the charming outdoor space overlooking the square. The menu focuses on local traditional cuisine with the occasional personalised twist, while the wine list features labels from the Irpinia region (and elsewhere) with a good choice of vertical wines and top-quality names such as Aglianico and Taurasi.

Name: Italia
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: It's a pleasant surprise to discover the well - maintained and friendly modern establishment in this house in the centre of town. Creative dishes of Piedmontese cuisine.

Name: Osteria la Fefa
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated under the arcades, this restaurant has the relaxed, friendly ambience of an urban trattoria. Here, the female chef serves an extensive selection of dishes with fresh pasta and meat options taking pride of place on the menu (don’t miss the gnocco fritto with charcuterie), while her son skilfully oversees the front-of-house team. Make sure you leave room for one of the many delicious desserts!

Name: Osteria dal Moro
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A lively fish and seafood restaurant on the seafront, which is always busy thanks to its excellent value for money – booking ahead is highly recommended! Fish-based dishes only, all of which are announced at your table and which change regularly depending on market availability. The dishes are simple, rustic but full of flavour, which is why it’s easy to forgive the rather restricted choice of wine.

Name: Trattoria Ai Due Platani
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: If you’re looking for a traditional restaurant with the ambience of a typical country trattoria, then Ai Due Platani is the place for you. The menu features Emilian specialties such as tortelli pasta stuffed with pumpkin, pecorino pappardelle pasta with a duck and pine nut ragù, and veal fillet with a traditional tuna sauce. All highly memorable!

Name: La Pineta
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: You will need a certain amount of patience to tackle the winding road through woods and hills to get to La Pineta, but the food makes the journey well worthwhile. There is a restricted choice – just one tasting menu, although the number of courses can be reduced – with the famous house speciality, fritto misto alla piemontese, taking pride of place. Spacious, welcoming guestrooms are also available.

Name: Dalie e Fagioli
Address: via Campagnola 45, Manerba del Garda, 25080, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Having opened this restaurant some ten years ago, owner-chef Fabio draws on all his experience from working at various Michelin-starred restaurants during his career. Using regional produce and local recipes, this technically adept chef creates delicious dishes with an imaginative twist, all accompanied by a discreet choice of wines.

Name: Ahimè
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Situated near the typical Mercato delle Erbe, Ahimé serves imaginative regional cuisine with a careful focus on seasonal, sustainably produced ingredients. Organic wines, plus service which is friendly yet at the same time professional add to its appeal.

Name: Il Casolare dei Segreti
Address: contrada San Lorenzo 28, San Lorenzo, 62010, Italy
Cuisine: Cuisine from the Marches, Traditional Cuisine
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A family - run restaurant with young, enthusiastic staff. Four rustic dining rooms provide the setting to enjoy delicious regional dishes, such as the ever - popular Marchigiana veal steak.

Name: Carnal
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Carnal is the most informal and liveliest of famous chef Roy Caceres’s restaurants, with its music, colourful decor, smart service and even some dishes that are eaten with the hands! The restaurant has a young vibe, focusing on Latin-American cuisine such as tacos, ceviche and mango desserts made from seasonal ingredients (mostly from Italy) and accompanied by a choice of wine, beer and excellent cocktails (in the evening).
