Name: Moi
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Moi is a small yet decidedly smart restaurant which stands out for its quality in the Fleming district in north-west Rome. With years of culinary experience behind him, Thomas uses modern techniques to prepare dishes made from fresh, seasonal ingredients which can change on a daily basis, including meat, fish, vegetables and herbs, all of which are full of flavour and reasonably priced.

Name: La Bucaccia
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: One of the best places to discover Tuscan cuisine, and that of Arezzo in particular, this restaurant serves exquisite dishes full of flavour. Just a few tables are laid out along the main street in the historic centre, while the two interior dining rooms are rustic and romantic in feel. Friendly and exuberant owner Romano merits a particular mention, providing guaranteed entertainment in between courses.

Name: Osteria dei Segreti
Cuisine: Cuisine from the Marches, Meats and Grills
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated amid hills in a secluded and panoramic location, this farmhouse offers guestrooms, a spa and a restaurant, where meat (often cooked over the grill) takes pride of place on the menu, alongside various local specialities such as stuffed pigeon, roast goose and “coniglio in porchetta” (stuffed rabbit).

Name: Dei Cantoni
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in a picturesque historic hamlet with a castle once inhabited by the Malatesta dynasty, this restaurant boasts a charming traditional dining room. The delicious cuisine is the star of the show here, featuring specialities from Romagna, including meat, fish and fresh pasta dishes, as well as tempting desserts. Not to be missed!

Name: Palmerino - Il Bacalà a Sandrigo
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated just outside the village, this unusual restaurant now run by the fourth generation of the same family is dedicated to baccala (dried cod). This features not only on the menu but also in much of the decor.

Name: Scannabue Caffè Restaurant
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This local trattoria is decorated in a deliberately traditional, vintage style. All the focus here is on top-quality local ingredients, with a special good-value-for-money menu at lunchtime which is particularly appealing.

Name: Green T.
Address: via del Piè di Marmo 28, Rome, 00186, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Not far from the Pantheon, this original restaurant arranged over four floors serves the type of fine Chinese cuisine which has graced official banquets in China ever since the time of Chairman Mao. The menu also features some surprisingly modern Asian dishes, making this restaurant a must for fans of Chinese cuisine!

Name: La Cucoma
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Situated on the town’s main street, just 10min from Ravenna, this restaurant has been run by the Amadori family for over 40 years. Enjoy fish specialities in a classic-style restaurant with a friendly, family atmosphere, plus a few daily specials announced at your table, on a menu which is totally dedicated to fish and seafood. Apart from the raw fish dishes which are more expensive, the restaurant is renowned locally for its value for money.

Name: Lokanda Devetak
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Just two kilometres from the Slovenian border as the crow flies, this restaurant with its dual influences serves top-quality cuisine rooted in the gastronomic traditions of this border region. In business since 1870 and now run by the four children from the sixth generation of the same family, Devetak is an absolute must for anyone visiting the Friuli region.

Name: Lo Stuzzichino
Address: via Deserto 1/a, Sant'Agata sui Due Golfi, 80061, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated near the church in the heart of the village, this restaurant, with its pleasantly informal setting, showcases products and recipes from Campania, including vegetables from its own kitchen garden. Meals are served either outdoors (in fine weather) or in the dining room (with an open-view kitchen) decorated with local ceramics.

Name: La Fossa del Grano
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A must for anyone looking for traditional home cooking and authentic cuisine from Puglia. Make sure you try the antipasti, and then move on to a first or main course.

Name: Antica Trattoria da Miculan
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A small bar busy with locals acts as a sort of “antechamber” to this typical trattoria with a summer terrace on Tricesimo’s main square. The restaurant, which boasts traditional regional features, such as the wood-burning stove known as a fogher, serves local specialities alongside a few fish dishes. In summer, there’s a tasting menu which focuses exclusively on fish.

Name: Il Conte Matto
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The castle’s 14C hunting lodge has been converted into a showcase for Tuscan produce with a panoramic terrace overlooking the hills and glimpses of the surrounding countryside from the guestrooms. Specialities include pici pasta in a Chianina beef ragù, veal tagliata seasoned with three salts and herbs from the garden, and cantucci biscuits served with dessert wine.

Name: Villa Aurora
Address: via Ciucani 1/7, Soiano del Lago, 25080, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A typical restaurant in the province of Brescia not far from Lake Garda, Villa Aurora serves Italian cuisine with an equal focus on meat and fish dishes, as well as a few traditional specialities with a light modern twist. A bastion of local cuisine, the restaurant is run by a welcoming and experienced family. Don’t miss the desserts!

Name: Antica Trattoria la Grotta dal 1918
Address: via Tignano 3, Loc. Mongardino Grotta, Sasso Marconi, 40037, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: It takes a while to get here, along a road which wends its way through the hills, but the cuisine more than compensates for the journey. The food here is based on a careful choice of ingredients (including produce from the restaurant’s own farm) from as far away as the Apennines, with a few ingredients from elsewhere in Italy, with a focus on traditional recipes. Don’t miss the tortellini in brodo, or the game and truffles available in season.

Name: Del Belbo - Da Bardon
Address: valle Asinari 25, San Marzano Oliveto, 14050, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This traditional restaurant has been taking good care of its guests for generations. The delicious, authentic cuisine served here is accompanied by an extensive wine list that will delight fans of wines from the Langhe, Asti, elsewhere in Italy and France. There’s also an attractive outdoor space that is ideal for alfresco dining in fine weather. In short, this is the sort of restaurant you’d love to have as your local!

Name: Romani
Address: via dei Ronchi 2, Vicomero di Torrile, 43056, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant has a traditional feel, both in its richly decorated dining room and in its cuisine, the roots of which are firmly planted in the region. This is the place for guests who aren’t keen on reinterpreted dishes or exotic fare but prefer the classic flavours of Parma such as cured hams, fresh pasta, and roast and grilled meat, all served in a typical country farmhouse.

Name: Osteria de Börg
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Borgo San Giuliano is situated just a stroll from the sea in old Rimini, a district of narrow alleyways and brightly painted houses that once provided homes for local fishermen. It is also home to this excellent osteria-style restaurant with an outdoor space on the small square for summer meals and two smart dining rooms decorated with rustic vintage furnishings. This is the setting for typical Romagna cuisine which features top-quality cured hams, fresh home-made pasta (don’t miss the cappelletti in chicken broth) and meat including Mora Romagnola pork in various dishes.

Name: Alla Pace
Address: via Sauris di Sotto 38, Sauris di Sopra, 33020, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Sauris is situated in a slightly secluded location which adds to its appeal. Occupying a beautiful 17C house near a charming little lake and picturesque mountain village, this restaurant has been run by the same family since 1804. This enchanting setting acts as the backdrop for a menu featuring delicious regional specialities.

Name: Profumo di Mirto
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This is a classic, simple neighbourhood restaurant where guests will immediately feel at home. Fish specialities take pride of place here, but it’s also worth taking your time over the copious buffet of appetisers which gets your meal off to a fine start. A few Sardinian dishes pay tribute to the owners’ native island.

Name: Locanda da Condo
Address: via Fontana 134, Col San Martino, 31010, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in the delightful Prosecco wine-growing region, Condo is a well-established trattoria which has been in the same family for generations, and which remains faithful to the gastronomic traditions of the Veneto. The dining rooms are welcoming and full of character, while the elegant veranda adorned with climbing plants is an attractive option in summer. The cuisine is both excellent and good value for money, making this restaurant an excellent all-round choice.

Name: Le Miniere
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This restaurant stands on the main square of a delightful village. It serves excellent cuisine that focuses on Piedmontese traditions, while at the same time being creative and reasonably priced. Don’t miss the superb brasato al barbaresco (braised meat in a wine sauce).

Name: La Chioccia d'Oro
Address: via Novi 2, loc. Pietra dei Correnti, bivio  Novi Velia, Vallo della Lucania, 84078, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: For over 40 years, La Chioccia d'Oro has been renowned for its delicious, bountiful cuisine inspired by the Cilento region, including excellent pasta dishes (fresh and dried pasta served with tasty sauces) and equally delicious meat-based main courses. The ambience is decidedly unpretentious and the prices are some of the most reasonable you’ll find in Italy!

Name: Trattoria da Marino
Address: via Provinciale Lucchese 102, località Ponte di Serravalle, Serravalle Pistoiese, 51030, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In business for a century, this simple yet successful trattoria serves traditional Tuscan cuisine. There’s just one modest and informal dining room, which is overseen by the capable owner who delights in guiding his guests through the regional options on the menu.

Name: Trattoria da Fagiolino
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: To get to the dining room at this restaurant you walk past the kitchen, where its stoves are lit and its chefs hard at work. This is the sort of restaurant that you’d love to have as your local, serving delicious traditional cuisine in a simple yet friendly setting. The dishes are resolutely Tuscan and the ingredients are of the highest quality.

Name: Foresta
Address: strada de la Comunità de Fiem 42, Moena, 38035, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in front of a dense fir wood, this restaurant comes as something of a surprise. The dishes are prepared with genuine local ingredients, resulting in food that is full of flavour. Don’t get up from the table without having tasted the pappardelle pasta with mushrooms and speck ham or the fillet of venison with a redcurrant sauce.

Name: Cantina dei Cacciatori
Address: località Villa Superiore 59, Monteu Roero, 12040, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The original sign painted on this restaurant’s façade hints at a history which dates back over a century. Situated outside the village and surrounded by sweet chestnut trees and tufa rock, what was once an old trattoria now serves typical Piedmontese specialities, such as meat and borage ravioli with butter and crispy pancetta, as well as dishes from further afield. Charming outdoor area for summer dining, plus an early - 20C wine cellar which can be visited by guests.

Name: Raieü
Address: via Milite Ignoto 23, Cavi di Lavagna, 16030, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Authentic fishing lamps hang above the tables in this typical trattoria, where one dining room boasts wooden furnishings and tables divided by benches, and the other is more traditional and brighter in feel. Regional cuisine takes pride of place, including highlights such as fish gnocchi with clams and cuttlefish stew. Freshly caught by the restaurant’s own boat, the fish is prepared following local recipes.

Name: La Torre
Address: piazza Annunziata 7, Santa Maria Annunziata, 80061, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Gragnano pacchero pasta with a tomato and fish sauce is just one of the Neapolitan dishes served in this genuine trattoria. It is situated just a few metres from a belvedere and has views of Capri.

Name: La Cucina dei Frigoriferi Milanesi
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: An interesting location in the artistic-cultural setting of the Frigoriferi Milanesi industrial complex for this restaurant with a modern feel both in its decor and its market cuisine.

Name: Taverna 58
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A well - kept restaurant serving interesting cuisine with its roots in the culinary traditions of the Abruzzo region. Delicious, generously portioned dishes such as fried mutton from Maiella which are difficult to find elsewhere. Guests are welcome to visit the medieval and Roman remains in the wine cellars.

Name: Osteria Le Panzanelle
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This pleasant rural trattoria has a simple, informal ambience. It serves generous portions of delicious regional cuisine, including homemade pasta and excellent meat.

Name: Vecchio Porto
Address: lungomare Cenide 55, Villa San Giovanni, 89018, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Although travellers may know Villa San Giovanni for its ferry port to Sicily, fans of gourmet cuisine are familiar with the port as the home of the “Vecchio Porto”, one of the best restaurants in the region and one which boasts spectacular views of the Straits of Messina from its second-floor terrace. The menu features classic dishes including fish cooked on the grill and more imaginative options such as the raw antipasti (snapper flavoured with sea-urchin sauce, lumpfish roe, onion and diced cucumber). The remarkable quality of the fish is a constant theme here.

Name: Aurora
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The experience and professionalism of this chef, combined with his policy of keeping prices competitive, are among the attractions which draw dinners to the restaurant – and make sure that they return. Typical trattoria menu.

Name: Trippa
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Simple, informal and with a slightly retro feel, this restaurant serves a range of dishes from all over Italy, including the tripe which gives the restaurant its name. Unfussy and uncomplicated, the cuisine prepared by the skilful young chef using top-quality ingredients makes this one of the best trattorias in Italy. House specialities include Milanese risotto with grilled marrow, vitello tonnato and, of course, the ever-present tripe!

Name: Dongiò
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: If you enjoy Calabrian cuisine and you want to keep to a budget, then Dongiò is the place for you! The menu here offers a good selection of regional specialities, all full of intense and satisfying flavours and served in a simple yet friendly ambience.

Name: Da Flavio e Fabrizio "Al Teatro"
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Choose the ground floor for a quick meal and the first floor for a special dinner in this restaurant near the cinema - theatre. In both cases, the menu focuses on traditional fish dishes from the Veneto, such as black and white tagliolini with squid, scampi and courgettes. The honey semifreddo with caramel is the perfect way to round off your meal.

Name: Osteria della Villetta
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A bulwark of Brescian cuisine for over a century, this restaurant has Art Nouveau - style furnishings, a retro decor and an authentic family atmosphere. It serves delicious specialities such as lake fish, onion soup, tripe, meatballs and beef in olive oil.

Name: Tipamasaro
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Halfway between the historic centre and the lake, this restaurant is run with passion and enthusiasm by an entire family. Friendly ambience, and a cool summer pergola beneath which you can enjoy delicious regional cuisine. The house specialities include the local whitefish (lavarello).

Name: Casa Gallo
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated near the centre of Pompei, Casa Gallo is a quiet, informal restaurant with an open-view kitchen. The talented owner-chef creates traditional dishes from Campania, paying careful attention to the use of regional and, more specifically, local ingredients. Charming outdoor area, plus a good selection of wines from small local producers.

Name: Vecchia Marina
Address: lungomare Trento 37, Roseto degli Abruzzi, 64026, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated just a stone’s throw from the beach, this Abruzzi restaurant has developed legendary status among fish-lovers in the past 20 years thanks to a few key features – the flavour and freshness of its fish, the simplicity of its recipes and a value for money which is almost unequalled in Italy. Given its huge popularity, you would be advised to book well in advance!

Name: Mingone
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Once, in 1890, a post house on the road to Abruzzi, today a many - sided restaurant with a fireplace and murals depicting the Ciociara lifestyle; there is a wine bar and the rooms are stylishly furnished.

Name: Boccondivino
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated on the first floor of a typical building in the historic town centre, this restaurant has two small dining rooms and one larger room lined with bottles. The cuisine is typical of the Langhe region, with braised veal in a Barolo sauce, tajarin pasta in a Bra sausage sauce and many other specialities.

Name: Battaglino
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant run by an enthusiastic, friendly family has been serving traditional Piedmontese cuisine since 1919. Particular attention is paid to special food requirements, such as allergies, intolerances and ethical choices.

Name: Locanda Mariella
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: You need to book at least 24hrs in advance at this restaurant by sending an email and your choice of the three menus on offer (traditional, meat or fish). This long-established, legendary restaurant is one of the best trattorias in the province, if not the region. Still run by the same family, it has been delighting guests in this corner of the Apennines since the 1960s.

Name: Il Fiorile
Address: via XXV Aprile 6, frazione Castel Ratti, Borghetto di Borbera, 15060, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A picture - postcard hay barn immersed in the silence of the woods provides the perfect setting to sample traditional recipes. Choose from specialities such as Montebore flan with acacia honey, tajarin pasta with black truffles and apple crème caramel with Moscato granita.

Name: Palazzaccio
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This traditionally rustic restaurant situated in the historic centre serves cuisine which is firmly anchored in the region, including numerous specialities made from typical ingredients from the Madonie, such as meat and mushrooms.

Name: Magnagallo
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This restaurant appeals on so many levels! It is easy to get to (just a few metres from the motorway exit) and offers a fine Emilian welcome and delicious local cuisine, including fresh pasta and its famous roast meats. Plus there is a tempting display of cakes laid out to greet you when you arrive.

Name: Aciniello
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A simple, authentic trattoria with a family atmosphere and two small dining rooms. One is quieter than the other with bright colours and tables arranged close together. The restaurant’s popularity with locals and the friendly nature of the owners give it a lively atmosphere. Regional specialities on the menu.

Name: Osteria Magona
Address: Località Vallone dei Messi 199, SP 16/b km 2,400, Bolgheri, 57020, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: You are certain to fall for the charm of this rural restaurant, whose excellent value for money attracts food - lovers from far and wide. Situated among olive groves and vineyards, the Osteria Magona serves a whole host of meat specialities with tartare, beef delicacies and roast dishes all featuring on the menu.

Name: Osteria Bartolini
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This young, attractive and friendly restaurant brings the maritime influences of Romagna to Bologna, upholding its traditions of fresh fish dishes which are simple yet full of flavour. “Fritto misto” (fried fish) is still the house speciality, although other classic fish and seafood dishes also feature on the menu. In fine weather, enjoy your meal in the shade of a huge century-old plane tree.

Name: Violetta
Address: via Valle San Giovanni 1, Calamandrana, 14042, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A friendly welcome awaits in this historic family restaurant serving authentic, traditional Piedmontese cuisine, where dishes such as peppers stuffed with tuna and anchovies, agnolotti monferrini (a type of ravioli), finanziera stew and bonet (a typical dessert) feature on the menu. At Violetta, you not only eat well, you’re also made to feel extremely welcome.

Name: Antichi Sapori
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: For the past thirty years, this fine restaurant with a charming and beautifully kept dining room has been serving regional dishes from the Murge, all prepared using top-quality ingredients. The desserts, in particular, are truly delicious and not to be missed. Given the restaurant’s popularity in the region, booking is highly recommended.

Name: Altavilla
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The best way to enjoy the delicious cuisine served at this restaurant in the upper part of town, surrounded by woods and vineyards, is to ask for recommendations from Signora Anna, the owner and life and soul of the property. Beautiful panoramic terrace.

Name: Da Alighiero
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Hidden in the picturesque centre of Anghiari (famous for the battle with which it shares a name), Da Alighiero serves delicious cuisine prepared by chef Silvia. Highlights include bringoli (an elongated local variety of egg pasta) served with a meat ragu or mushrooms in season, as well as the region’s typical meat dishes, such as tripe in a spicy red sauce and pan-fried liver with sage and white wine.

Name: Fonte alla Vena
Address: via Dante Alighieri 137, San Quirico d'Orcia, 53027, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated alongside the road that leads to the picturesque historic centre, this restaurant with simply furnished, informal dining rooms serves excellent cuisine full of intense, delicious flavours. The emphasis here is on Tuscan traditions, with a particular focus on rustic dishes and ingredients such as offal, Cinta Senese pork and fresh pastas. An address to return to time and time again.

Name: Nida
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Located just outside the city walls close to a roundabout, this restaurant is home to a young Japanese chef who follows traditional recipes with impeccable tenacity. The raw fish dishes are highly recommended, although if you’re looking for a surprise menu then the omakase is a good choice. Two small, quiet and brightly decorated dining rooms provide the setting.

Name: Da Pode
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This restaurant occupies an old far that has retained some of the architectural features typical of its rural past. It serves delicious Tuscan cuisine prepared by Signora Lucia. If you are on a diet, beware!

Name: Laghetto
Cuisine: Cuisine from the Aosta Valley, Italian
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This restaurant serves typical cuisine from the Aosta valley alongside more modern dishes (but still inspired by local traditions). Dine in the attractive wood - clad dining room with large windows offering views of the delightful surrounding countryside. Don’t leave without visiting the beautiful wine cellar!

Name: Locanda del Barone
Address: Località San Vittorino, Caramanico Terme, 65023, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated in a district of Caramanico, this typical stone house is home to an attractive restaurant that is the perfect choice for anyone keen on typical Abruzzo specialities. Prepared from regional ingredients, the dishes are delicious and substantial.

Name: Osteria Expanificio
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in the historic centre between the Pirandello theatre and the belvedere, this former bakery has been transformed into a modern, welcoming restaurant, with models of bread and rolls on the walls recalling its previous life. The menu features a selection of some of the island’s most famous dishes, including stuffed sardines, Robiola goat’s cheese ravioli, caponata and “involtino alla Siciliana” (Sicilian veal rolls).

Name: Namo Ristobottega
Address: via Giovan Battista Marzi 1, Tarquinia, 01016, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This simple, tiny restaurant stands just outside the walls of Tarquinia, barely a kilometre from the splendid necropolis of Monterozzi (UNESCO World Heritage Site). The female owner-chef pays tribute to the Viterbo region with her imaginative use of seasonal ingredients in light dishes which are full of flavour, while the à la carte demonstrates a wide use of vegetables. The outdoor space offers views extending as far as the coast.

Name: Ai Burattini
Address: via Madaschi 45, Adrara San Martino, 24060, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Run by the fourth generation of this family, with the same focus on seasonal, regional cuisine as always, this warm, informal restaurant is housed in a building which once hosted puppet shows. Good selection of cured meats, including an excellent Bergamo mutton bresaola.

Name: Consorzio
Address: via Monte di Pietà 23, Turin, 10122, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This simple, informal restaurant with two dining rooms designed in a blend of old and modern styles acts as a backdrop for traditional cuisine which includes dishes such as pasta, offal, finanziera stew, Fassona beef and other Piedmontese specialities, all carefully prepared and cooked using top-quality ingredients. The nearby Banco Vini e Alimenti bistro is run by the same owners.

Name: Il Cedro
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A few kilometres from the monastery of Camaldoli, Il Cedro celebrates home-style Tuscan cooking, which is simple yet full of flavour. Two sisters are at the helm here: one in the kitchen, and the other offering friendly service front of house, where she announces the daily specials at your table. Fresh produce and specialities from the Casentino are to the fore.

Name: FØRMA contemporary restaurant
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated in a secluded, residential district that is part of L’Aquila’s historic centre, this delightful restaurant serves excellent bread, classic sauces and delicious creations prepared by a young chef who gained experience working abroad and now showcases the best of his region. An informal feel, excellent music and original cuisine in a modern setting.

Name: Osteria Acqualavica
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated just a stone’s throw from Piazza del Duomo, this evocative restaurant with a wine-tasting cellar occupies a charming old boathouse. Typical specialities from the Etna region feature on the menu, as well as a choice of pizzas (evening only). The dishes here are traditional and comforting, including an excellent caponata, “fuori della Norma” pasta, fried fish and fish carpaccio, as well as other seafood options among the main courses.

Name: Da Sapì
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Contemporary-style cuisine with a regional focus and carefully selected local produce are the hallmarks of this restaurant now run by the fourth generation of the same family. The menu features dishes prepared using seasonal vegetables, plus artisanal ice cream made from 100% natural ingredients.

Name: Caffè La Crepa
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Overlooking a picturesque Renaissance square, the café here dates back to the early 19C and the trattoria shortly after. Today, the decor is a nostalgic mix of styles from the mid-19C to the mid-20c, including Art Nouveau. The restaurant not only appeals to the eyes but also to the tastebuds, thanks to its expertly prepared traditional dishes made from carefully chosen top-quality ingredients which are full of flavour. And if you’d like to take a souvenir home with you, there’s also a shop here selling food specialities and wine.

Name: Trattoria Pennestri
Address: via Giovanni Da Empoli 5, Rome, 00154, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: You’ll feel immediately at ease in this restaurant, which has the warm, simple atmosphere of a typical trattoria. The menu features seasonal Roman specialities to which the chef has added a contemporary flavour – a hint of how Roman cuisine might look in the future!

Name: Trattoria Margherita
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated in the village centre, this charming, welcoming family-run restaurant has a friendly ambience. The cuisine here is predominantly traditional with Mediterranean touches and a decidedly interesting choice of ingredients. The wine list focuses mainly on regional labels.

Name: Futura Osteria
Address: largo Garfonda 10, località Abbadia Isola, Monteriggioni, 53035, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated along the Via Francigena near Monteriggioni the small medieval village of Abbadia Isola boasts a superb Romanesque church and a group of old buildings that once housed a monastery and its outbuildings. The Futura Osteria occupies the cellars where the monks once stored their wines, which now provides the setting for simple, delicious and resolutely seasonal Tuscan-inspired cuisine offering good value for money. The refined wine list, simple service and secluded terrace complete the picture.

Name: La Locanda del Falco
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This restaurant may have changed management but its location in an old, carefully restored coach house with barrel vaults and brick walls remains the same. The regional cuisine has its roots in mountain traditions with specialities such as snails, lamb and local pastas on the menu. Young staff, plus a good selection of wines with a focus on bottles from Piedmont.

Name: Dentella
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Good food is guaranteed at this restaurant, which has been run by the Dentella family for almost a century. In a simple yet welcoming ambience enjoy homemade hams and salamis, casoncelli pasta, meat - based dishes, black Bracca truffles (in season) and game. Good selection of local cheeses. The best of Bergamo cuisine!

Name: Accademia Ristorante
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The Inspector's thought was: too bad it's not in my neighborhood, I would come more often! In a historic building, with a classic decor and magnificent frescoed dining rooms, Accademia serves simple but well personalized and surprisingly modern Piedmontese cuisine. The friendly owner will welcome you graciously and provide you with relevant and passionate wine recommendations.

Name: Castagneto
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: On the first hills of Lake Maggiore, a rustic and particularly panoramic building; inside there is a warm, relaxing and traditional atmosphere (the restaurant has been in business since 1969), while the cuisine ranges across the entire Peninsula even if it remains predominantly local and regional.

Name: Trattoria Porteri
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This long-established family restaurant dates back 150 years, while the old town of Borgo Trento in which it is situated, although now surrounded by the modern city, has a much older history. Having run the delicatessen for many years (some of its products are used in the restaurant), the Porteri family has also been in charge of the trattoria here for decades. Renowned for its traditional Brescia cuisine, the restaurant serves specialities such as polenta, cheeses and meat dishes. Inspired by local recipes, the cuisine is made from top-quality ingredients sourced from small-scale producers from the region.

Name: Osteria San Giulio
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: With its delightful location in an old rural abbey, warm welcome, friendly atmosphere and excellent “home-style” cuisine which focuses on the region’s classic dishes, this restaurant appeals to all the senses. Tastings of cured hams and cheeses from the surrounding area can be arranged in the beautiful garden by prior arrangement.

Name: Da Fausto
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This typical restaurant with a stone façade has superb views of the Alps on a clear day. Agnolotti pasta in a thick meat sauce and generous portions of other beautifully presented home - cooked dishes feature on the menu.

Name: Borgo Poscolle
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Home - style cooking with a focus on regional specialities is served in this attractive family - run trattoria, which has its own organic vegetable garden and an educational "pet therapy" farm. The search for ingredients produced as close to home as possible is something of an obsession with the owner - chef, who is also passionate about his desserts. Make sure you try the millefeuille with strawberries and cream.

Name: Al Borgo
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Housed within an 18C villa in a small traditional hamlet, this restaurant with a warm rustic ambience serves regional cuisine. The Gioie del Borgo (home produced salami and sausages), barley and bean soup, and homemade ice cream are all highly recommended.

Name: Gassenwirt
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Visa credit card
Description: Situated next to the village church, this restaurant has been serving excellent South Tyrolean cuisine since as far back as 1602. House specialities include canederli pressati (dumplings) and Buchteln (a type of sweet bun).

Name: Osteria Bartolini
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Eat out along the charming canal port at this restaurant, or indoors in the simple yet attractive dining room with the typical ambience of a seaside trattoria. Dishes are listed on paper placemats and include fried fish, alongside a few additional options not highlighted on the menu. Delicious traditional fish and seafood takes pride of place here – in terms of value for money, this is one of the best fish restaurants in the area.

Name: La Gioconda
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in the heart of the historic centre, this restaurant pays tribute to the Cagli region and the Marche hinterland. Dishes feature the best local ingredients, such as truffles in season (both black and white), as well as a dessert in memory of local sculptor Eliseo Mattiacci (the “fabbrica del cosmo” made with yoghurt, wafers and strawberries). The wine list shows a strong preference for the Marche, but also features wines from further afield.

Name: Gabbiano 1983
Address: piazza Vittorio Veneto 10, Corte de' Cortesi, 26020, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Overlooking the main square of this small village in the Lower Po valley, this restaurant prides itself on its love for local, traditional specialities such as cured meats, stuffed marubini pasta, goose and boiled meat dishes, with many recipes having been handed down over the years. If you’d like to take some food or wine home with you, there’s a well-stocked shop at the entrance.

Name: Trattoria Losanna
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This friendly restaurant has a pleasantly convivial and lively ambience. Try a selection of homemade antipasto to start, followed by generous portions of traditional cuisine from Monferrato.

Name: La Tradizione - Cucina Casalinga
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A famous trattoria in the historic centre, next to the Immacolata church. Pleasant, rustic atmosphere with period photos on the walls and typical regional dishes such as troccoli alla murgese (pasta with ricotta and cherry tomatoes) on the menu.

Name: La Fratanza
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Follow your satnav and you’ll easily find this private residence situated just outside the village. The restaurant is family run and furnished in classic style, with an attractive veranda room overlooking the garden. The friendly owner serves regional cuisine, all carefully prepared using top-quality local ingredients, some of which (such as the delicious lemons and excellent San Marzano tomatoes that appear in a number of dishes) are grown in the restaurant’s own orchard and kitchen garden.

Name: Locanda Cacciatori
Address: località Mistadello di Castione, Ponte dell'Olio, 29028, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Opened in 1945 by the parents of the current owner in a charming setting surrounded by hills, this trattoria specialises in dishes from Piacenza, served in generous portions which are full of flavour and which introduce guests to the region’s simple yet excellent cuisine. To make sure you don’t get lost, set your satnav for Ponte dell'Olio, Viale San Bono and then drive for 2.5km.

Name: Trattoria Cibrèo - Il Cibrèino
Address: via dei Macci 122 r, Florence, 50122, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This trattoria is named after the famous cibreo, a typical stew from Florence that Catherine of Medici was said to enjoy so much that she even attempted, unsuccessfully, to export it to France. It is often crowded, but there is no point in trying to book a table as they don’t take reservations. Roast rack of beef (gran pezzo) is one of the specialities.

Name: Angiolina
Address: via Passariello 2, località Marina di Pisciotta, Pisciotta, 84066, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This trattoria is situated at the end of the marina in Pisciotta, a location which ensures a quiet, tranquil ambience. The excellent, reasonably priced seafood cuisine is another reason that we heartily recommend eating here. With a focus on local fish, the menu features a wide array of specialities from Campania, including anchovies served in different ways (stuffed, “alla scapece”, salted and served with butter, and with spaghetti).

Name: Nana Piccolo Bistrò
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Spanish influences are evident in the cuisine served at this lively restaurant situated in the heart of this bustling town. After years spent working in Spain, the owner-chef has returned to Senigallia where he delights guests with dishes such as Iberian carbonara (made with Pata Negra ham and Manchego cheese) and potato and salted cod omelette. In high season, it’s best to book ahead and maybe even get here early to avoid parking problems – you can always work up an appetite with a stroll through Senigallia’s beautiful historic centre. Young, friendly and efficient female staff add to the appeal.

Name: Hosteria Grappolo d'Oro
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Since the turn of the century, this long-established restaurant near Piazza Navona and Campo de' Fiori has been run by five local business partners, one of whom is the chef. Top-quality, classic and generous Roman cuisine (cacio e pepe pasta, roast lamb, salted cod etc) is to the fore here, served in an attractive, rustic-style dining room. The background music – a nostalgic 1970s mix of rock and blues – also deserves a mention.

Name: Trattoria Antichi Sapori
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Just a few kilometres outside the town and yet already in open countryside, this typical local trattoria offers a simple yet warm and friendly ambience and excellent cuisine focused on regional specialities. The stuffed pasta and veal brisket are two of the dishes that we enjoyed the most here.

Name: Casa del Vino della Vallagarina
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A standard-bearer for local cuisine, this restaurant housed in the 17C Palazzo de Probizer in the town centre offers an outdoor area for alfresco dining in fine weather. Although the restaurant only offers a restricted set menu, this changes on a daily basis (single dishes can also be ordered from the menu) and there’s an extensive choice of desserts. All the bottles on the wine list, which showcases local wines, are also available by the glass. Attractive guestrooms on the top floors.

Name: Bruxaboschi
Address: via Francesco Mignone 8, San Desiderio, 16133, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: You’ll need to allow plenty of time to get to the inland village of San Desiderio, where Bruxaboschi has been run by the same family and delighting guests since 1862, but the journey is certainly worth it. Justifiably famous, the cuisine pays tribute to local traditions (almost exclusively based on meat), starting with an excellent cima alla Genovese (a type of meat loaf), picagge and pansotti pasta dishes, and fried rabbit. Don’t miss the mushrooms in season.

Name: Forma
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated away from the sea at the foot of a medieval district, this intimate restaurant boasts a historic decor dotted with modern details such as black parquet flooring and industrial-style pipes. The cuisine created by the owner-chef demonstrates the same blend of traditional style and modern touches in imaginative meat and fish dishes with a personalised twist. The tasting menu offers excellent value for money.

Name: La Barca
Address: litoranea Salentina, Marina di Pulsano, 74026, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Nestled between splendid beaches and bays, this restaurant focuses on the sea, not only in its views but also in its cuisine. The owner takes centre stage in the dining room, while the dishes prepared in the kitchen are varied, generous in size and reasonably priced, featuring classic recipes which allow the full flavours of the top-quality fish to shine through.

Name: Il Latini
Address: via dei Palchetti 6 r, Florence, 50123, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Perhaps not the best choice if you’re planning a romantic, intimate dinner, Il Latini has tables pushed close together, creating a lively atmosphere, and is often packed. But this is part of the charm of this historic trattoria where conviviality combines with simple, delicious traditional cuisine to provide an unforgettable dining experience.

Name: L'Acquario
Address: via Vittorio Emanuele 69, Castiglione del Lago, 06061, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Located in the historic centre of an attractive village by the lake, this restaurant is a good option for anyone wanting to try Umbrian cuisine. Dishes made from freshwater fish (pike, carp, tench, eel and crayfish), as well as the famous beans from Lake Trasimeno and meat such as lamb and wild boar, take pride of place on the menu.

Name: Osteria Mondo d'Oro
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Described as an “osteria” (inn) by its famous, multi-Michelin-starred chef Giancarlo Perbellini, this restaurant provides a relaxed setting in which to enjoy delicious (and reasonably priced) Italian cuisine, including a few vegetarian options. Choose between the cosy dining room and an outdoor space (weather permitting) in a side street off the central Via Mazzini.

Name: L'800
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Period furniture, regional cuisine and a cheerful ambience are some of the characteristics of this old farmhouse which is named after the 1800s when it was built. Some of the ingredients used, such as snails and frogs’ legs, may come as a surprise: the restaurant specialises in these unusual delicacies, even offering a tasting menu totally dedicated to snails.

Name: Al Convento - Casa Torrente
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Following renovation work, the frescoed dining room at this restaurant now has the feel of a contemporary osteria, while its attractive terrace boasts tables overlooking the picturesque village’s small square. The menu focuses mainly on fish and seafood (although a few meat options such as tomahawk ribeye and steak also feature), including raw fish, tartares, fried anchovies stuffed with smoked provolone cheese, grilled dishes, and pasta including spaghetti with the local anchovy sauce. If you choose fish from the dry ageing cabinet, you’ll add a little extra to your bill.

Name: Gerani
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A journey through colourful inland villages brings you to this restaurant, which serves delicious sourdough bread and home-grown vegetables in its tempting dishes and where a simple, yet friendly welcome awaits. Gerani serves excellent cuisine at reasonable prices, all just a stone’s throw from the main tourist routes.

Name: Kanton Restaurant
Address: via Antonio Gramsci 17, Capriate San Gervasio, 24042, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A far cry from your standard Chinese restaurant, as its owner - chef, Weikun, is proud to point out, the Kanton offers creative and experimental cuisine which combines the flavours of Asia with innovative cooking methods. Ask the waiters for recommendations when choosing your meal and you won’t be disappointed!

Name: Il Moro
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Occupying a 17C palazzo in the village centre, this restaurant showcases regional cuisine in all its glory, including specialities such as leek and saffron gnocchi, boiled tongue, pumpkin in the autumn and truffles in season, all accompanied by wines chosen from an extensive wine list. Friendly, informal service, plus an open fire in winter.

Name: Ca' d'Frara
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated in the historic centre, this restaurant has a strikingly elegant and contemporary feel, with a menu divided between local specialities and more creative dishes. If you’re visiting fascinating Ferrara, we recommend the restaurant’s traditional cuisine, from the pasticcio in crosta di pasta frolla to the salama da sugo. Excellent cuisine and reasonable prices.

Name: Perbacco - Vini e Cucina
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant began life as a wine - bar, before transforming into an establishment where you can enjoy genuine local cuisine. The onion reigns supreme in this eatery! Two cosy rooms, with frescoed walls.

Name: Al Becco della Civetta
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The owner - chef of this restaurant in a small village nestling in the Lucane Dolomites focuses on regional cuisine, serving dishes inspired by her two muses – her mother and grandmother. Dishes are often announced at your table and specialities include the delicious ficotto (fig wine). Stunning views of the grandiose mountain scenery from the guestrooms, which are quiet and welcoming.

Name: Rimulas
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: At this restaurant situated just a stone’s throw from Piazza Duomo in the historic centre of Voghera, a young chef and his charming wife (who supervises the front of house) are renowned for their reasonably priced excellent cuisine. The chef’s skilfully and imaginatively prepared dishes bear witness to his extensive experience working elsewhere in Italy and further afield. The decor is contemporary, with just a few minimalist-style tables and a hushed ambience.

Name: Sot'Ajarchi
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: An informal atmosphere in a small trattoria where you can really feel at ease, perhaps in company, eating tasty seafood dishes, based on the daily fish catch.

Name: Osteria Bartolini
Address: via A. Boito 26, Milano Marittima, 48015, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated near the canal port, shipyards and sailing centre,this fully refurbished restaurant now offers a welcoming internal dining room in additional to its two outdoor terraces overlooking the sea, with views of the coast extending from Cattolica to the Ravenna promontory. The restaurant boasts a winning combination of top-quality fish, a friendly atmosphere and a final bill with no hidden surprises. Takeaway dishes are also available.

Name: Osteria Didù
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated on an attractive pedestrian street lined with the historic palazzi of Porto San Maurizio, this simple yet pleasant restaurant offers an excellent choice of Ligurian specialities. Highlights include stuffed mussels and Genoese-style borage ravioli.

Name: I Tri Siochètt
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The sister and two brothers who once ran this trattoria, as well as the grocery next door, were considered a little mad – hence the name, which means ‘three madcaps’. The building has retained its attractive country feel and is now popular with gourmets for its fine local cuisine, such as tortelli (a type of ravioli) with herbs and parmesan.

Name: Coxinendi
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Coxinendi (“cooking” in the Sardinian dialect) is a recently opened restaurant run by talented chef Davide Atzeni, who has plenty of experience behind him. Here, he focuses on creating authentic Sardinian dishes full of traditional flavour.

Name: Nole
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated near the seafront in one of the iconic streets of this Adriatic resort town, Nole offers guests two different dining options: one section of the restaurant serves excellent dishes, light lunches and snacks, while the other specialises in gourmet dinners. Our inspectors particularly recommend the tomato, goats’ cheese and basil soup, the Abruzzi cheese and pepper tortello pasta with a ginger sauce, and the “pizzaiola”-style tuna.

Name: CUCINA.eat
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Bring your own bottle,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This gourmet bistro with a modern design and multifunctional dining space also boasts a well-stocked wine cellar, a shop selling kitchen utensils, and a delicatessen. The menu here showcases the scents and flavours of Sicily, featuring dishes made from ingredients purchased daily from the city market; at lunchtime, there’s a business lunch with a reduced choice of dishes. It’s worth noting that CUCINA.eat is, for the moment, one of the few restaurants in the city where you can bring your own wine to accompany your meal. You won’t even be charged corkage, although you may well be asked for a tasting!

Name: Podere 39
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Housing just a few tables (booking is recommended), this restaurant is attractively decorated with an original melting-pot of features which give it a rustic yet elegant feel despite its small size. Some of the ingredients come from the restaurant’s own farm (hence the name “podere”, the Italian for farm), with both meat and fish dishes featuring on the menu.

Name: Le Nove Scodelle
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Now available everywhere in Italy, ethnic cuisine is gradually becoming more specialised, as is the case in this restaurant serving specialities from the province of Szechuan in south-west China. Exciting and original cuisine full of spicy flavours.

Name: Da Gregorio
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A family-run trattoria which is simple in style yet offers professional and courteous service. The menu focuses mainly on Umbrian specialities, fresh pasta, grilled dishes and an impressive selection of vegetables.

Name: Antiche Sere
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This renowned osteria situated in a district off the tourist trail is run by attentive and friendly female staff. Its dishes have a regional and traditional focus and are served in three small dining rooms, one of which shares space with the bar. Pleasant outdoor dining in the garden to the rear in summer.

Name: Cibus
Address: via Chianche di Scarano 7, Ceglie Messapica, 72013, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant situated in the maze of alleyways that makes up the historic centre of Ceglie boasts tables in a small atmospheric inner courtyard. The restaurant has long been famous for its traditional, regional cuisine and is a must for anyone keen to try typical Puglian specialities. The lamb with roast potatoes is particularly delicious, while the wine list features an interesting selection of regional labels.

Name: Antica Fattoria del Grottaione
Address: via della Piazza, località Montenero d'Orcia, Castel del Piano, 58033, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Once a farm, this trattoria has an attractive rustic feel with colourful decor in the dining room and stunning panoramic views from the outdoor terrace in summer. House specialities include il peposo (braised beef with black pepper).

Name: La Pignata
Address: viale Dei Tigli 7, Ariano Irpino, 83031, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: For over 40 years the Ventre family have been championing the flavours of Irpinia, seeking out the region’s best seasonal ingredients. These are then used in traditional dishes such as soups, as well as in more personal reinterpretations of local specialities (their “post-modern” arancino is now renowned in the region) that nonetheless retain all their original flavour with influences from both Campania and Puglia. The pizza here is excellent and there’s also a good selection of wine.

Name: Vögele
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant is a Bolzano institution. It is a typical inn whose origins are lost in the mists of time, and is still furnished in traditional Biedermeier - style. The menu focuses on regional cuisine, with an occasional hint of the Mediterranean.

Name: Il Ritrovo d'Abruzzo
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: If you’re not already in the area, it takes time to get to this family-run restaurant situated amid the rolling hills of rural Abruzzo, but the journey through some of the most beautiful scenery in the region more than compensates for the effort. Two brothers are at the helm (one front of house, the other in the kitchen), serving traditional regional cuisine often prepared using home-grown vegetables and with the occasionally more creative dish featuring on the menu. A pleasant outdoor space for summer dining completes the picture.

Name: Trattoria da Zamboni
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Famous country trattoria: interiors in modern style with a view over the Berico Hills from the large windows; traditional innovative dishes, service outside in the summer.

Name: Alla Pasina
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In this beautiful, warm and welcoming country house, fresh pasta dishes take up much of the space on the menu – and deservedly so: whether you opt for more traditional or creative dishes, the pasta here is excellent. The region’s famous chicory also makes an appearance, alongside a selection of meat and fish dishes. Guestrooms are available for visitors looking to extend their stay.

Name: Me Cumpari Turiddu
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: With its old chandeliers, chairs and tables, this original and attractive restaurant offers its guests a feel of traditional Sicily. The cuisine focuses on typical Sicilian specialities, as well as offering a simpler, less expensive bistro menu. There’s also a shop selling food produce and a cocktail bar, which is open non-stop from 11. 30am until the early hours of the morning.

Name: Al Monastero
Address: via Ristori 9, Cividale del Friuli, 33043, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Enjoy excellent local hams and salami and other delicious regional specialities in this welcoming restaurant. The room with the typical fogolar stove is particularly charming, as is the one embellished with the fresco of Bacchus; the romantic terrace in the historic palazzo’s inner courtyard is also perfect in fine weather. Five delightful apartments with a mezzanine and cooking area are also available.

Name: Trattoria al Parco
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This elegant house built in brick and stone boasts extensive tree-shaded grounds, a wine cellar next door, plus personalised, welcoming dining rooms. Here, the menu focuses on meat dishes, many of which are cooked over the grill, while the wine list features just a few labels produced by the restaurant’s own winery. A choice of excellent desserts completes the picture.

Name: Al Cambio
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Despite its out-of-town location, this contemporary, simply decorated restaurant is extremely popular. Fans of traditional cuisine will be in their element here, thanks to the perfectly prepared cuisine which is unfussy yet delicious and full of strong flavours.

Name: Il Tirabusciò
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant in the heart of the old town is a must for anyone keen to try the cuisine of the Casentino region. The friendly chef is more than happy to provide information on his ingredients and to offer recommendations – the strong flavours in evidence and his delicious cuisine are sure to leave a lasting memory.

Name: Osteria dai Coghi
Address: via Alcide De Gasperi 9/13, Albarè di Costermano, 37010, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in Albarè, in a residential area where you would never expect to find a restaurant, Osteria dai Coghi is run by a young and enthusiastic team. Real care is taken both in choosing ingredients (often locally sourced, including fish from the lake) and in adding a few personal, more unusual touches to its dishes. Warm, friendly service.

Name: Agritur El Mas
Address: strada de Saslonch 176, località Col de Soldai, Moena, 38035, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated above the village, this authentic farm-restaurant raises cows, horses and pigs and produces its own meat, hams, salamis and cheeses (all on sale in the farm’s Cajelo Shop), which can be enjoyed on a menu which also features typical, often Ladin-inspired dishes from the valley. Attractive dining room decorated with old wood, plus pleasant guestrooms housed in the same building designed in line with environmental construction techniques.

Name: Old Friend
Address: via Giuseppe Cesare Abba 51, Cagliari, 09126, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated slightly away from the city’s main shopping district, this restaurant has a fresh and trendy feel with music playing in the background and friendly, efficient service in the dining room. Although the dishes change with the seasons, quality and flavour are constant throughout. Our inspector recommends the raw fish with  pico de gallo (a Mexican sauce) and bottarga or the conchiglioni pasta with mutton ragu, bechamel sauce and samphire.

Name: Trattoria da Probo
Address: via Provinciale Nord 13, Bagnolo in Piano, 42011, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A bulwark of traditional local cuisine, this trattoria serves antipasti such as erbazzone (a savoury pie), fried gnocchi and cured ham, followed by fresh pasta (the cappelletti in broth are excellent), a choice of boiled and roast meat dishes, and a selection of desserts.

Name: Il Turacciolo
Address: piazza Vittorio Emanuele II 4, Andria, 70031, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This informal wine bar in the town centre features paper tablecloths and a menu chalked up on two blackboards. Delicious regional cuisine, including the occasional dish with surprisingly modern and imaginative flavours.

Name: Trattoria di Via Serra
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: It’s well worth heading off the traditional tourist trail to experience this simple and informal trattoria in Bolognina, the city’s historic working-class district which now has a very multicultural feel. Run by a friendly owner, with his talented business partner at the helm in the kitchen, the restaurant boasts a welcoming and friendly ambience that has made it popular, so booking ahead is recommended, even at lunchtime. Top-quality regional cuisine is celebrated here, from fresh pasta (excellent tortellini in broth) to zuppa inglese (a type of trifle).

Name: Antica Filanda
Address: SS 157, contrada Raviola, Capri Leone, 98070, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: Although the view from this restaurant takes in the sea and the mountains alike, it’s the latter that inspires the menu. It features inland specialities cooked with the best local ingredients. Suckling pig is a particular favourite, appearing in a number of different guises, including cured ham and meat sauces. The restaurant also offers new, welcoming guestrooms.

Name: Hostaria Viola
Address: via Verdi 32, Castiglione delle Stiviere, 46043, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The Viola family has been running the Hostaria since 1909, skilfully bringing local gastronomic traditions back to life in the typical vaulted dining room, much to the delight of their guests.
