Description: In this 300 year-old chalet with charming wood-panelled rooms, the cooking is down-to-earth and regional. Whether traditional Grisons dishes such as Capuns and Maluns or classics such as "Norbert's Stroganoff" and cordon bleu - this is tasty fare and, furthermore, prices are very reasonable. It's best to book. Locals also dine here.

Name: Eintracht
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: There has been a restaurant here since 1870 and the current owners, the Meier family, have retained the restaurant's traditional feel while also introducing contemporary influences, both in the bistro and in the more elegant restaurant area. The same is true of the cuisine, with classics such as veal cordon bleu and gourmet set menus composed of three to five courses. Excellent wine selection. Simple daily specials are also available in the bistro.

Name: Zum Pflugstein
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Considered the largest erratic boulder in the canton of Zurich, the Pﬂugstein is located close to this distinguished vineyard farmhouse and lends its name to its fabulous restaurant. The interior comprises an attractive wood-panelled space and a room with a fireplace, while outside there is a truly idyllic terrace. The service team overseen by the charming Jeannine Meili also deserves a mention. Tip: Try the tender boiled beef!

Name: Le Bologne
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: Next to the Fine Arts School, this vintage bistro cuts a fine figure with its cement tiles, globe lights and bare bulbs, as well as its bar, banquettes and bistro chairs. The dishes are carefully prepared with good seasonal ingredients: celeriac risotto and foie gras, lamb shoulder confit, cumin, asparagus and labne...

Name: Muntanella
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This is one restaurant offering two different types of dining: at lunchtime, a simple menu for skiers in a hurry (rösti, pasta dishes, burgers etc), and in the evening a more sophisticated menu with an emphasis on sustainability and regional produce, with dishes such as salmon trout from the Brüggli trout farm cooked in Arosa hay with Riesling-Sylvaner wine sauce, black salsify and Albula mountain potatoes. Don’t miss the glazed walk-in wine cupboard.

Name: au violon
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This place exudes brasserie appeal thanks to its charming, stylish atmosphere and unfussy, honest seasonal menu, which also includes classic dishes. Despite its proximity to the centre, the location is pleasantly quiet – outside, an attractive terrace with shady trees beckons. There are well-kept guestrooms for overnight stays. Tip: Take the opportunity to visit Basel Historical Museum opposite.

Name: Albrun
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The journey up to this enchanting mountain village is something of an adventure, but the food is worth it! The rustic chalet-style interior belies an ambitious menu including roast black nose lamb with artichokes and chickpeas, as well as poached char with curly kale. There are even a couple of simple but well-kept rooms for overnight stays.

Name: Le Bistro by Décotterd
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This alternative to the gourmet establishment also offers diners a knockout view. In a modern setting, the food is simple, but fully the equal of its sibling in terms of taste and culinary know-how. Don’t miss two house specialties: porkpie and chocolate tart.

Name: Les Curiades
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A truly historic restaurant which has been serving food since 1850. The present chef has experience in some of the finest restaurants, and it shows! His cuisine is elegant and refined, including dishes such as chuck beef braised in beer (paying tribute to the chef’s Belgian origins) and a delicious vegetarian menu which is always available. An unqualified success!

Name: Nest- und Bietschhorn
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This cosy, rustic restaurant is located in a hotel first opened in 1868, which makes it the oldest hotel in the Lötschental valley (the modern, Alpine-style rooms are particularly attractive). Excellent cuisine including Valais specialities such as duo of veal, braising jus with cooked wine, Hokkaido pumpkin and smoked potato gnocchi on the menu. Fine views from the terrace.

Name: Alla Cantina
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: All the staff hail from Sicily at this beautiful historic restaurant on the village square but have been working in Switzerland for years. Authentic Sicilian cuisine is served in a rustic and welcoming setting that also hosts regular musical events: the only concession to Ticino are the polenta-based recipes. There’s a cool, tranquil outdoor space for summer dining, plus four attractive, inviting guestrooms on the top floor.

Name: Myò Sushi Bar
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Notable sake list,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in the heart of the Esplanade de Montbenon park, this Japanese restaurant offers a summer terrace overlooking the lake, where guests can enjoy authentic Japanese cuisine which includes much more than just sushi. The desserts are equally delicious.

Name: Grotto Valmaggese
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in a slightly elevated location above the road, this traditional grotto-style restaurant with a large car park is quiet and cool in summer, with a dining room warmed by a fireplace in winter. Classic, well-prepared and generous cuisine with personal touches made using top-quality, seasonal ingredients. Sculptures by a local artist adorn the premises. Make sure you try the risotto with organic cheese, as well as the pancetta-wrapped Patanegra pork fillet with sweet peppers and patate sabbiate (roast potatoes coated with breadcrumbs).

Name: Barranco
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Eat, drink, make merry, meet friends… the Kreis 4 district is to Zurich what the Barranco district is to Lima. Nestled among a host of other restaurants and bars, the Peruvian district's namesake serves authentic modern Peruvian cuisine that is bursting with flavour, zing and spices. Equally appealing is the pleasantly unpretentious atmosphere complete with relaxed, nimble service. Great cocktail selection.

Name: La Bottega di Mario
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: With its mix of ristorante and salumeria in a historical building (1913), La Bottega is wonderfully inviting and lively. The tasty dishes, clearly influenced by Ticino, and the wonderful selection of salami and ham at the counter are equally tempting – here, the friendly mastri salumieri also take care of the cold cuts. Tip: try the house wine, a Ticino merlot from a six-litre bottle!

Name: Le Café Valrose
Address: Place de la Gare 2, Rougemont, 1659, Switzerland
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Part of the same establishment as La Table de Valrose, this bistro has a comfortable rustic-style Alpine atmosphere, both outside, on the terrace shaded by chestnut trees, surrounded by mountains, and inside, by the fireplace, in the wood-panelled space. Relax in the lounge bar with a coffee or cocktail in hand. The menu features tasty seasonal fare in the form of simple dishes, while classics such as Valrose fondue (champagne version available), malakoffs and Valrose burgers (meat or veggie) are permanent fixtures on the menu. The dessert trolley is available all afternoon, for teatime.

Name: Auberge Communale Le Mont
Address: Place du Petit Mont 4, Le Mont-sur-Lausanne, 1052, Switzerland
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Burgundy ham terrine, gherkin and fresh herb condiment; Jorat veal belly, pistachios and green asparagus: the Burgundian chef and Meilleur Ouvrier de France definitely knows his stuff. This is a fine dining version of modern French cuisine that highlights local and fresh ingredients and showcases small-scale producers. He successfully pulls it off, and keeps it affordable. Fine selection of wines by the glass.

Name: Café de La Plage
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit cards not accepted,Terrace,Wheelchair access
Description: Part of the magnificent theatre dating from 1879, this restaurant can boast a unique setting. The decor successfully combines historical features with modern, trendy details. The tasty, top-notch cuisine comprises an interesting mix of international and classic dishes made using seasonal ingredients. Pleasant terrace. Don't forget to book!

Name: L'Écorce
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In this convivial, tastefully furnished restaurant in Carouge’s old town the chef conjures up fresh, aromatic cuisine that combines classic and modern dishes such as mi-cuit tuna with a beetroot and watermelon bouillon and raw and cooked vegetables. Charming service, plus a small summer terrace.

Name: AuGust
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant with its charming brasserie atmosphere is located in what was once the "butcher's quarter" – and the meat theme has been taken up here accordingly. Besides design features such as lamps and wall tiles, the open kitchen is what really draws the eye. They use meat from their own production or from Swiss producers. Vegetarian alternatives are also available.

Name: Aroleid Restaurant
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Located right next to the ski slopes, this restaurant is housed in a modern and stylish chalet that exudes rustic charm. Here, a varied array of flavoursome dishes inspired by the chef's international travels is served. Incidentally, this place has its own coffee roastery, and the tableware is also made in-house.

Name: Fischerstube
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Following a complete conversion this long established restaurant is now newly resplendent. Fish specialities are served in traditional or modern style dining rooms.

Name: DAR
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Brunch,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This trendy, understated place is the charming sister restaurant of KLE. Here, the tasty plant-based dishes with Spanish and Moroccan roots, as well as other international influences, are ideal for sharing. There are two dinner services each evening, and drinks are served at the adjoining bar – before or after your meal. Sat and Sun brunch.

Name: Schönbühl
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Reserve a window seat at this restaurant so that you can take in the lake and mountain views as you tuck into tasty regional-seasonal dishes. In summer, a spot on the terrace is highly coveted. At lunchtime, choose from the affordable Tagesmenü (set menu of the day) and a handful of classics – but you can also order the regular à la carte dishes. Note: closed on Sundays Oct-Mar. There are inviting, well-kept guestrooms, should you need overnight accommodation.

Name: Mont-Rouge
Address: Route de la Télécabine 23, Haute-Nendaz, 1997, Switzerland
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The standout features of this mountain-style restaurant are its pleasant, elegant atmosphere and its chef, who has been dedicated to his work here for 20 years. He invites you on a culinary journey, with Swiss, French and international dishes inspired by local produce. Another option is the small adjoining brasserie and its daily specials, including poached sole roulade with home-made sauerkraut and champagne beurre blanc… a real treat! Pleasant guestrooms available.

Name: SALZHAUS
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: At this restaurant you will find an attractive mix of urban cool and historical setting, including some unusual exposed old masonry. The cuisine also combines international, regional and seasonal fare. There is a simple selection at lunchtimes and something more ambitious in the evenings. Try the Thai curry soup or the venison entrecôte with walnut malfatti.

Name: Pensiun Aldier
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: If you like your food straightforward and pared down to the essentials without compromising on taste, then you'll love the excellent Engadine cuisine at the pleasingly unpretentious restaurant of the charming little hotel of the same name. The dishes forgo any frills and instead focus on select, fresh local produce. Good wines at fair prices. Smaller menu at lunchtime.

Name: Die Rose
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In the basement of Die Rose, you can enjoy typical Italian cuisine in a really pleasant rustic atmosphere. In summer, make a beeline for the delightful terrace. For groups of four or more, we recommend heading to Tavolata, where various dishes for sharing are served. Tip: the lunch menu in the form of the "Pranzo-Box" – as with the Japanese bento box, the dishes included in the set menu come in one box.

Name: La Parenthèse
Address: Rue de l'Hôtel-de-Ville 114, La Chaux-de-Fonds, 2300, Switzerland
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: An opportunity to enjoy an unpretentious gourmet interlude in a pretty little restaurant offering a warm welcome on the outskirts of town. The cuisine features regional produce, such as raw and cooked Seeland vegetables and beef from the Franches Montagnes district. Head to the cellar to choose your cheese, which you can wash down with a 10- or 20-year-old Tawny Port. A most charming front-of-house team.

Name: Rigiblick
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In this restaurant overlooking the city, a rather soigné yet relaxed atmosphere awaits you. The kitchen team focuses on in-season regional produce, which is used to create really delicious dishes. You can order à la carte or opt for the "Genuss Menü" comprising four or five courses. In summer, head for the leafy terrace. Tip: It is easy to get here by taking tram no 10 or the Funicular Rigiblick.

Name: Osteria della Bottega
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This lively osteria is located on a steep little street in Geneva's old town. Against a chic industrial backdrop with an open kitchen, diners enjoy modern, seasonally inspired Italian cuisine and fine wines, as well as attentive and friendly service. It's best to book, as Osteria is very popular! Across the street there is a lovely terrace.

Name: Linde
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The secret of Linde's success is a formula of classic Swiss cuisine made from good ingredients coupled with reasonable prices. A lively atmosphere reigns in this attractive, well-run place with its various dining spaces, large bar area and glassed-in kitchen. Steak tartare and Zürcher Geschnetzeltes (veal) are among the permanent fixtures on the menu. The wonderful terrace comes into its own in summer, and there are well-kept guestrooms too.

Name: Grotto della Salute
Address: Via Madonna della Salute 2A, Massagno, 6900, Switzerland
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A rustic grotto-style restaurant with a warm and welcoming ambience, where staff are happy to advise you on the seasonal dishes on offer. A whole page of the menu is dedicated to classic favourites, all of which are Mediterranean in style. The terrace shaded by huge plane trees provides a pleasant setting for summer dining, while an excellent wine list adds to the appeal.

Name: Collonge Café
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This modern restaurant boasts a great location next to the historical town hall – the terrace laid out in the garden is charming. It successfully brings together modern Italian and French cuisine with seasonal influences, and also keeps an open mind when it comes to international ingredients. The service is friendly and competent. Tip: the great-value lunch menu.

Name: Bären
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Come here to enjoy seasonal cuisine that is straightforward, prepared with fresh produce and, above all, utterly delicious. You can dine à la carte or opt for a set menu. Here, the house specialty is spaghetti alla parmigiana. The lovingly decorated Gourmetstübli makes for a particularly appealing setting. At lunchtime, the choice is more limited but includes a rather sophisticated set menu.

Name: Bären
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Closed for renovation until spring 2024.Bären serves up flavoursome traditional fare made using local produce – try the fillet steak goulash with pappardelle or the home-made asparagus ravioli with morels – in the lovely setting of the 16C Berner Haus, complete with wood-panelled dining rooms and historic charm.

Name: Zum Kaiser Franz im Rössl
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Here, you won't want to miss out on the Austrian specialities such as Viennese fried chicken, Tafelspitz (prime boiled beef) or Topfenknödel (curd dumplings)! Available as a large or small portion, the Wiener Schnitzel is a real highlight. Be sure to ask about the fish of the day, freshly caught from the adjacent Lake Zug. As well as the good food, diners can look forward to a cosy, stylish atmosphere and attentive service – not to mention a warm welcome from the manager.

Name: Café de Peney
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This lively and popular restaurant located on an arm of the Rhone calls to mind a vintage picture postcard: charmingly done out, with various antique objects and a wisteria-covered terrace. Fine ingredients are prepared to produce flavour and finesse. Specialities include, for example, pig's cheeks confit with Gamaret or the runny hot chocolate biscuit.

Name: Stüva
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Lots of old wood and lovely stone floors give Stüva a cosy, rustic feel. The kitchens produce Graubünden cuisine with international touches. Dishes include capuns (pork-stuffed chard leaves) and Veltlin pizzoccheri pasta, braised calves' cheeks and lamb steaks.

Name: Alpenblick - Bistro
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A pleasant alternative to Gourmetstübli, Bistro also offers excellent food including a number of seasonal regional dishes such as poached fillet of whitefish Interlaken style with a herb and cream sauce and cheese fondues. Beef fondue buffet on Tuesday evenings.

Name: Dal Mulin
Address: Plazza dal Mulin 4, Saint Moritz, 7500, Switzerland
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This modern, rustic yet stylish restaurant in the heart of St Moritz has a friendly feel. The charming and attentive front-of-house team serves cuisine that has the same informal style as the setting but is far from simple, with a focus on carefully prepared, elegant and subtle dishes. The wine selection is outstanding – they even have their own wine shop!

Name: Gommerstuba
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Diners are assured of a pleasantly informal atmosphere and great food at this little inn run by Yvonne and Lars Dederscheck on the outskirts of Niederernen. The latter clearly enjoys putting a modern spin on classic cuisine – for example, a fine, intense sweet mustard ice cream is added to the creamy classic beef tartare. Valais wines are recommended as an accompaniment. The welcoming interior has a contemporary feel – as well as an attractive stone-clad counter, there are pleasing decorative touches including some lovely paintings that are also available to purchase. Last but not least, there is an inviting terrace with a lovely view.

Name: Asia
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: At this restaurant, an Oriental-style decor in dark colours provides the setting for Japanese cuisine, including the usual classic favourites. The menu features traditional and fusion sushi, sashimi, delicious Thai curries, dim sum and many other Asian specialities, plus there’s an interesting set menu (at lunchtime) which changes daily.

Name: ZOLLHUUS
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This friendly place is perfect for meat lovers. They specialise in steaks, some of which are matured in the restaurant's own dry-ageing cabinet. Vegetarian and vegan alternatives are also available. The first Saturday evening of every month is devoted to Wagyu beef dishes, and it's BBQ night every Thursday (Jun-Aug). There's a fabulous rooftop terrace with views of the Aare and the region. For overnight stays, the adjoining Hotel Kettenbrücke has elegant guestrooms with a minimalist design.

Name: Café du Levant
Address: Rue du Vieux Four 53, Aire-la-Ville, 1288, Switzerland
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In a quiet little village in an attractive rural setting, you will find this friendly, down-to-earth restaurant. The property backs onto fields and the fresh air is a real tonic. They serve seasonal and richly flavoured regional French cuisine, which you can accompany with your choice from a good selection of wines from the Geneva region. Lovely terrace.

Name: Josef
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This trendy, urban restaurant and bar is in the middle of a residential area in Kreis 5 (fifth district). The atmosphere is lively and buzzy, and in light of their interesting concept it comes as no surprise that the place is well frequented: they serve tasty modern European cuisine with dishes in starter-size portions - and at a fair price. Good wine list and cocktail selection.

Name: Postigliun
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Far above the valley lies the Sgier family restaurant, where Sandro (the son) and Guido (the father) serve up their tasty cooking. You should definitely try "Guido's capuns"! They also make game dishes with meat from animals they have hunted themselves. If you plan to accompany your meal with wine from their appealing selection, you can stay overnight in one of their guestrooms.

Name: Gül
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: This restaurant tucked away in an inner courtyard has a laid-back atmosphere and is pleasantly lively thanks to a vibrant soundtrack of Turkish music. And so the scene is set for the food, a modern take on traditional Turkish dishes – made in the open kitchen and, in keeping with the way in this part of the world, served in smaller portions or larger dishes for sharing.

Name: Agorà
Address: Via Muro degli Ottevi 10, Brissago, 6614, Switzerland
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A historic restaurant in the town centre serving exquisite cuisine with a focus on carefully selected top-quality ingredients. The ambience here is pleasantly informal, plus there’s a charming inner courtyard for summer dining. Don’t miss the stuffed quail – one of the chef’s specialities!

Name: Indian Rasoi
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This restaurant not far from the Place du Rondeau is based on the interesting concept of serving authentic, hybrid Indian cuisine that is not tied to any single region. The droves of customers suggest this is a wining formula! The atmosphere is modern, the service friendly and attentive. In summer, the terrace is most pleasant.

Name: STÜVA in der Krone - Säumerei am Inn
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: These different Arvenstuben – one of which is the over 300-year-old Stüvetta – are a good alternative to LA CHAVALLERA. Here, all the cosiness of the Engadine region benefits from a modern touch. The tasty cuisine homes in on the essentials; they use mainly regional and seasonal ingredients. In fine weather, food is also served on the terrace.

Name: Natürlich
Address: Rue de la Coulouvrenière 38, Geneva, 1204, Switzerland
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Just a few metres from the River Rhône and the BFM theatre, this restaurant has a trendy, relaxed, bistro-style atmosphere. It serves modern, seasonal cuisine based on fine regional ingredients, accompanied by a good wine list featuring organic and classic options. And for an even more convivial meal, dishes are designed to be shared!

Name: Wiesner Mysterion – Werkstatt Kost
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Those under the spell of the "Wizard of Entlebuch" in Bramboden know they will be getting something special. Like Wiesner – Zauber, Werkstatt – Kost is also located in the Weitsicht hotel. The location is simply magnificent; the terrace is idyllic, boasting one of the loveliest views in the whole region. Drawn to the produce yielded by the mountains, Stefan Wiesner pulls off his culinary philosophy of incorporating nature into his dishes – sustainable and definitely not run of the mill! His four-course set menu makes the most of what the local forest, meadows and gardens have to offer. The wonderfully crusty sourdough bread from the Wegelin wood-fired oven, served beforehand with aromatic, almost black charcoal butter, is the perfect start. Equally unique is the original, cosy interior with a workshop atmosphere. The food counter is also a cookery school.

Name: Alpenblick - Bistro
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The bistro may be cheaper than this establishment's upscale restaurant (Stuba), but a meal here is still really tasty and fresh. Whether you come for lunch or dinner, the terrific, no-frills market-inspired cooking won't break the bank. They are keen to use produce from the region, in dishes such as "Hüttler's hamburger" or house speciality "Dad's steak tartare". Another of their classics is the spicy Thai red curry, with just the right amount of heat! In keeping with the Alpenblick style, the atmosphere is nice and relaxed, and the service is charming and attentive. There are also some good wines – the wine list is the same as at the fine dining restaurant.

Name: Panorama - Bistro
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This attractive alternative to the Cayenne offers excellent cuisine at a very reasonable price. Although the dishes are simpler in style, they are prepared with equal sophistication using quality regional produce, always with a certain modern twist. Attentive service, plus the same wine list as in the Cayenne. Wonderful views!

Name: Centrale
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Particularly renowned and popular with locals, this restaurant has a delightful family ambience. It offers delicious regional cuisine that can be enjoyed outdoors on the lovely terrace in fine weather.

Name: Edo
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: You can be in the Swiss mountains and still enjoy authentic Japanese cuisine, including dishes such as Japanese fondue, grilled chicken with Teriyaki sauce, and delicious gyozas and sushi (takeaway dishes are also available). Here, legendary specialities from Japan are prepared in front of you with high-quality ingredients and meticulous care. Terrace with views of the surrounding peaks.

Name: Sonne
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: At the Häfliger family's lovely 100-year-old restaurant, diners can look forward to fresh, flavoursome food and attentive service provided by experienced staff. Classic Swiss cuisine is served in the form of a seasonal or surprise set menu. Alternatively, you can order à la carte. This place even has its own excellent spring water! Pleasant terrace to the rear of the building. Tip: Delicious cheese is sold in the cheesery next door.

Name: Braui
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Housed in the cultural centre that shares its name, braui serves good traditional cuisine in a pleasant, brasserie atmosphere. The menu is made up of seasonal dishes and includes classics such as beef tartare or veal cordon bleu. Smaller choice available at lunchtime. Tip: The public car park, Braui-Parkhaus, is handy.

Name: Casa Casutt - Ustria
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A long-standing establishment, in which Linus and Therese Arpagaus cook up excellent cuisine using fresh produce. The menu takes its cue from the region and includes local specialties such as capuns (Swiss chard rolls) and pizokel (buckwheat spätzle). Fans of veal liver, sweetbreads or tripe are also in for a treat. The space, including the traditional dining room, is charming, and the large contingent of locals makes for a lively atmosphere. The garden terrace is wonderful, and Sala is another alternative.

Name: Seebistro Belvédère
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The location right by the lake is superb! The modern bistro is just in front of the fine dining restaurant – the same kitchen team works at both. There is a seasonal set menu with Mediterranean influences and made with regional produce, plus a choice of classics.

Name: Gasthaus Schupfen
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: With a history dating back to 1455, this lovely half-timbered house is really something special. In an inviting atmosphere, food is served in three charming rooms and on the idyllic terrace overlooking the Rhine. The menu features classics, including Kalbsgeschnetzeltes Zürcher Art (veal ragout), and seasonal dishes such as Kundelfinger trout with boiled potatoes and spinach. If you are looking for a good location for a wedding or event, the premises can also be rented out.

Name: Adler
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The name of the game here is "Gasthaus at its best" – this applies to the cosy dining rooms, the warm, attentive service, and chef Daniel Jann's cuisine. Whether you opt for Murmeltierpfeffer (marmot stew), Gitzi-Bratwurst (a goat meat and beef sausage) or asparagus dishes, meticulous craftsmanship and flavour are guaranteed. The focus lies squarely on the region. Eating here is fun! Stylish guestrooms are available for overnight stays.

Name: Kaiserstock
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Great view,Terrace
Description: The Kaiserstock is no longer a well-kept secret – and the narrow, steep approach road is worth every effort. The chef clearly has a passion for cooking, creating delicious dishes such as homemade ravioli and Brischtner pears as a dessert. The ingredients are all locally sourced, while the rustic guestrooms are absolutely charming. Please note: cash payments only!

Name: Gasthaus Zur Fernsicht - Swiss Alpine
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A pleasant alternative to the gourmet restaurant, Gasthaus zur Fernsicht is friendly and modern with a great view of the lake through its glass frontage. “Swiss Alpine Food” takes pride of place here, with a focus on selected seasonal produce sourced from local farmers and producers. Reduced lunch menu, plus relaxed yet professional service.

Name: Restaurant du Quai
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This inviting restaurant on the shore of Lake Geneva serves unfussy and tasty seasonal cuisine. Chef Jérôme Manifacier is a real pro. His motto is "take your time"; ours is to place our trust in him. Superb terrace shaded by the plane trees and with a splendid view of the lake and the Jura mountains.

Name: Bacchus Bistro & Genussmanufaktur
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: You will feel right at home at this restaurant, thanks to the tasteful, upscale decor, friendly service and – last but not least – good-quality, fresh dishes cooked up by Werner Tobler. There are two set menus: "Du Terroir", comprising three to four courses, and four- to six-course "La Table chez Bacchus". Tip: Genussmanufaktur sells an appealing range of cheeses, spices, cakes, wines etc.

Name: Zum Alten Stephan
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant in the middle of the historical old town is not only steeped in history, it is also a place to enjoy really good food. On the menu you will find "Stephan's Classics" as well as dishes that are somewhat more modern, but by no means contrived. The charming front-of-house team is managed by the proprietress. Delightful terrace in front of the building.

Name: 16 ART-BAR-RESTAURANT
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Diners will feel right at home in this charming and inviting restaurant. Set in a former bell foundry, the atmosphere is welcoming and delightfully down to earth. The blend of rustic and modern styles is interesting, and the art on the walls is sure to draw the eye. You can look forward to very friendly and attentive service, as well as pared-down and exceedingly flavourful dishes prepared by owner Nik Buchs. Popular choices here include true classics such as entrecôte or veal cutlet. The extensive wine list also includes organic and biodynamic wines.

Name: Bistro by Regina Montium
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Whether you hike up or take the mountain railway (ideal from Vitznau), it's well worth stopping off here. The location is idyllic – at 1 550m above sea level, the terrace is wonderful – and the "natural cuisine" is another big attraction! This includes smaller plates and regular dishes such as Rigi beef ragout or burger with Alpine cheese, many of which are made with produce from the immediate vicinity or grown in their own garden. Individual ingredients are explained in a friendly and competent manner. Why not try a gentian root tonic with Rigi juniper gin before dinner? Both the Bistro, for lunch, and fine dining restaurant, Regina Montium, for dinner, are located in Kräuterhotel Edelweiss, where you can stay overnight after your meal.

Name: Blaue Ente
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Historic industrial architecture outside and a trendy and lively atmosphere (and some fine old machinery) within. The service is attentive and easy-going, while the menu includes dishes such as rack of lamb with garden cress risotto and Zurich egg on leaf spinach with potato foam and truffle. Make sure you try the flatbread specialities made from naturally fermented spelt sourdough.

Name: Chappeli
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In this friendly, down-to-earth restaurant overlooking the village, the Hausmann/Köhli team propose a really fun dining experience! Your charming hostess takes care of the restaurant floor while the chef-patron showcases cuisine that is distinctly regional in terms of flavour and aroma. Excellent wine recommendations. Be sure to bag a table on the delightfully verdant garden terrace!

Name: PINOT
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The location may seem a little unusual but the food is really good! Set in the side wing of the modern Klinik Gut private hospital, PINOT boasts a fashionable, minimalist-style interior, an open kitchen and a great view. The chef, Roland Schmid, has made a name for himself in the region over the years. “Gourmet evening” with a set menu on Thursdays.

Name: La Fleur de Sel
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Regional cuisine and a bistro style atmosphere in the Fleur de Sel.

Name: Restaurant Schlüssel - Schlüsselstube
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Schlüsselstube is a bistro where they also serve outstanding food – and it represents really great value for money. Classics such as braised veal cheeks are delicious, and the desserts are extremely hard to resist! When it comes to wine, this cosy place also hits all the right notes. The service provided by waitresses in traditional dress could not be more charming!

Name: Wirtshus zum Wyberg
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The restaurant on the first floor is a little more elegant and comfortable than the bar. The large menu ranges from a delicious veal schnitzel in morel sauce to the classic saddle of venison grand veneur, not to mention a popular lobster menu which includes home-made ravioli.

Name: Des Bains
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Despite the many works of art on the walls here (all of which are for sale), this is indeed a restaurant and not an art gallery! Food-lovers will delight in the delicious traditional cuisine on offer, accompanied by a selection of local wines. The name of the restaurant is a reference to the old thermal baths of Roman Aventicum.

Name: Rathauskeller Bistro
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The friendly service and relaxed atmosphere here are popular with locals and tourists alike. Diners can choose from the selection of classics such as cordon bleu, Lammhacktätschli (lamb patties) and beef roulades, and there is also a seasonal menu. The tables on the gorgeous terrace in front of the building in the cobbled pedestrian zone are coveted. Tip: Just a stone's throw away, the lakeside is perfect for a stroll.

Name: Blume
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: With a penchant for risotto dishes, the chef at this pleasant Gasthof cooks with heart and skill, sourcing regional produce of excellent quality. Rustic downstairs lounge and a more elegant upstairs room. Situated in a beautiful quiet rural location, yet still close to Zurich.

Name: Bistrot Dumas
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This buzzy, often packed bistro, located in the Champel district, sports a striking decorative style with a patchwork ceiling of coloured glass and eye-catching columns. The traditional culinary repertory features deftly curated French classics, rich in flavour and aroma and entirely made in house. The slick service is both efficient and dutiful.

Name: Landgasthof Ochsen
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The food is terrific in this inn dating back to 1288 – the skilful chef clearly pours a lot of love into his cooking. As well as regional dishes and classics, Asian and Mediterranean influences also make their way onto the menu. A meal in their Gaststube is a somewhat simpler affair. There is a lovely terrace overlooking the pond, plus a charming smoking lounge. Pleasant and handy guestrooms.

Name: Bären
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: As chef, Martin Thommen represents the 14th generation of the family to work in this historical inn. Good traditional fare is served in cosy dining rooms and on the terrace under shady plantain trees. Attractive events room on the upper floor.

Name: Auberge de la Croix d'Or - Bistro
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Claudia and Olivier Hiernard have combined bistro and restaurant at their charming inn. The delicious bistro fare on the blackboard is now complemented by a market-inspired "Menu du Marché", meaning flavoursome dishes are now served in both parts of the establishment. Just don't forget to leave room for dessert! On Friday and Saturday evenings, only a small selection is available.

Name: Höhwald
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Reopening November 2023.In this wonderful restaurant with its stunning view, Heribert and Silvia Dietrich serve up excellent regional cuisine in an atmosphere that could hardly be more welcoming. Try the maluns, a Graubünden potato speciality cooked over an open fire, or the tasty braised venison cheeks. The patio heaters make it possible to sit outside on the terrace even on cooler days.

Name: Moosegg
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Up here, at an altitude of around 1 000m, there is much to get excited about: the phenomenal view of the Emmental and the Alps – either from the modern, elegant restaurant with its large window front or the magnificent terrace – is complemented by good food with a regional and seasonal focus. For a cheaper but equally indulgent alternative, head to Beiz. The terrific wine selection boasts around 800 different options. Chic guestrooms are available in the adjoining boutique hotel.

Name: Chez Philippe
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Philippe Chevrier from the Domaine de Châteauvieux is the brains behind this huge restaurant inspired by New York-style steakhouses. Relaxed atmosphere, meats sourced from the renowned Boucherie du Molard, fish caught by small-scale fishermen, dishes cooked over a wood fire, a truly authentic cheesecake and an expansive wine list. A real favourite!

Name: Château de Pleujouse
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Perched on a rocky spur, this 10C fortress overlooks the surrounding countryside. A duo of chefs delights diners with organic and regional ingredients; bread, gratins and rice pudding are baked in the bread oven – a truly artisanal approach, which, by drawing on produce from the terroir, takes us back to the feasts of yesteryear! A very warm welcome.

Name: Bistrot du Lion d'Or
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In the restaurant of this hotel dating from 1750, the team offers - in a friendly and relaxed atmosphere - delicious French cuisine with seasonal products, such as artichoke, smoked whitefish from the nearby lakes and buckwheat, or pan-fried sweetbreads, morels and asparagus. The well-curated wine list is also worthy of your attention. In fine weather, the pleasant terrace to the rear of the building is a peaceful little haven for diners.

Name: L'Agape
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A lovely, tastefully refurbished bistro featuring old tiled floors, wooden banquette seating, mirrors on the walls, a large chandelier fashioned out of old copper pans and a small service counter. This place ticks all the boxes when it comes to welcoming and serving diners. As for the food, chef Clément Thellier has put together a short, savvy menu that makes your mouth water with its well-crafted and beautifully presented dishes. A dining experience at a reasonable price – not to be sniffed at!

Name: Ivy 23
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A lively restaurant and bar in the historical centre of Carouge. Whitewashed brick walls and 1930s-style decoration, such as lamps and old posters evocative of the prohibition era in the US, make for a distinctive atmosphere, underscored by a soundtrack of jazz/swing sounds. They serve modern and seasonal food with a French twist. Pleasant little terrace in the courtyard to the rear.

Name: Stadthaus
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In the restaurant of the grand Hotel Stadthaus, you can either dine in the casual Stadtcafé or the elegant La Pendule; the same flavoursome cuisine is served in both areas. There are classics such as cordon bleu, vegetarian dishes and a bistro set menu – an ambitious gourmet set menu is also served on Thu-Sat evenings. The range of wines available by the glass and bottles is also impressive.

Name: sunny bar by claudia canessa
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant in the traditional Hotel Kulm is a hit. This is mainly down to the authentic Peruvian cuisine, which is made with really good, fresh ingredients and tastes great. The interior is also lovely, with its decor comprising numerous photographs contributing to the atmosphere, as does the lively, attentive and professional service.

Name: Auberge Communale
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This rather inconspicuous Auberge is located in a small set village slightly above Vevey. Run by the Konrad family, it not only offers guest rooms for overnight stays, but also serves really good food! Whether eating in the modern, understated restaurant or on the pretty terrace, you can choose from the delicious "Bistro" dishes or the "Gastro" menu. It is always tasty and prices remain very competitive.

Name: Bären
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: At this rather grand establishment with two dining spaces, Gaststube and GnussStube, the wide-ranging menu includes simpler dishes and more sophisticated fare, plus vegetarian options. You can dine à la carte or opt for a set menu – the fine-dining set menu ("MundArt"), has to be ordered in advance. At lunchtime, a reduced à la carte selection and daily specials are available. Ingredients are sourced as locally as possible. There is a decent wine list with a focus on Swiss labels. The waitstaff are friendly, attentive and well trained.

Name: Zum Wilde Maa
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In the Matthäus quarter in Kleinbasel, this smart building on a corner has housed a restaurant since 1910. The owners, who have already made a name for themselves in the city with their previous restaurant, Bonvivant, serve tasteful, unpretentious cuisine based on good ingredients. Fair prices, very friendly service and good wine recommendations.

Name: SALZANO
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Just outside the town you will find the gorgeous chalet hotel which houses this warm and welcoming rustic-style restaurant. Diners especially appreciate the delicious Swiss cuisine served here – the Chateaubriand is a real treat! At midday, there is a lunch offer in addition to the classic menu. Should you be interested in an ambitious set menu, the "close-to-nature gourmet menu" can be ordered in advance. The excellent ingredients are sourced locally wherever possible.

Name: Ô Bois Sauvage
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated at an elevation of approximately 1 500m above sea level, this restaurant is just 250m away from Hérémence's high-speed lift station. The breathtaking mountain vistas are undoubtedly one of the restaurant's standout features, best enjoyed on the fantastic terrace. Alternatively, you can savour the view from indoors, where the atmosphere is modern and relaxed. Incidentally, the numerous decorative works of art are available for purchase. This restaurant's commitment to sustainability and its strong attachment to the region are evident in the selection of produce, such as fillet of Swiss grass-fed ox or cheese. The short wine list features labels from the region.

Name: Lokal
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This pleasantly laid-back and casual establishment occupies a corner plot by the canal-like Suze River at the border between Neustadt-Süd and Neustadt-Nord. Guided by the motto "gemütlich - ehrlich - herzlich" (cosy - honest - cordial), Lokal is a cross between a restaurant and a bar with a relaxed atmosphere; in fine weather, the gorgeous terrace beckons. The cuisine is modern and international, with the focus squarely laid on regional and seasonal ingredients. In addition to the à la carte selection, there is a carte blanche surprise menu comprising four or five courses. Decent wine list, friendly and professional service. You are also welcome to just drop in for a glass of wine, a beer or a cocktail.

Name: Njørd café
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Njørd Café is a spin-off of Njørden Restaurant, in a more casual culinary vein. It serves fresh and seasonal Scandinavian and Swiss cuisine in a modern, Nordic atmosphere. Breakfast and brunch are also served at the weekend. There is a charming terrace planted with herbs and flowers to the rear of the building. Hotel Hemma has a number of pleasant guestrooms.

Name: Bazaar
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: At this restaurant in the chic Alpine CERVO Mountain Resort – which commands a great panoramic view – you are whisked away to an exotic and predominantly vegetarian world of flavours, ranging from Arabic to Chinese specialities, from Lebanese flatbread (manakish) and pistachio baklava to dim sum and much more. In keeping with its name, this place has a lively and friendly atmosphere, to which original and highly disparate decorative details also contribute.

Name: Le Lab by Adel & Niko
Address: Route de la Crottaz 5, Corseaux, 1802, Switzerland
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The house is located directly behind the boundary between Vevey and Corseaux. The ground floor houses a cookery school, while the basement houses the restaurant itself. The ambience is modern, with warm colours (the burgundy-red wall catches the eye), discreet decoration for the wine and a long counter. The charming owner, who runs the restaurant with her husband, adds to the ambience. Interesting dishes come out of the kitchen: uncomplicated, tasty and served in an almost one-size-fits-all format, at a reasonable price. Delicious, for example, "Wild prawns, green curry, Thai vegetables, coconut milk". The small terrace is also very pleasant.

Name: Grey Gardens
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list
Description: Everyone is drawn to restaurateur Jen Agg's hip, boisterous venue, which manages both style and substance with confident charm. An excellent wine list is paired with a small, mercurial menu that punches above its weight class, where ostensibly simple, unassuming dishes turn out to be heavy hitters. Raw items like oysters and crudos are commendably fresh, and the house-made pastas are real showstoppers. Take as an example hearty spaghetti twirled with a mackerel-based twist on XO sauce, lifted with fermented chili puree and crunchy potato crumbs: beguilingly complex, indulgent and umami-packed. The menu might only offer a duo of desserts, but they’re just as inspired as the rest—in other words, not to be missed.

Name: The Ace
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Brunch,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Set your alarm. This is cooking worth waking up for. Indeed, brunch usually isn’t a kitchen’s brightest moment, but that is far from true at The Ace, a slim vintage diner that first opened in the 1950s. Husband-and-wife team Rafael Badell and Maggie Stackpole are the latest to hold the keys to this historic haunt, and it’s during the day when the cooking really sings. What’s that smell? It’s probably expert wedges of house-made sourdough sizzling away on the griddle. Start with the duck confit and wild mushroom toast crowned with softly poached eggs. Whatever you do, save room for, what is likely, the city’s best French toast. A triumphant square of brioche arrives topped with caramelized pears, vanilla bean whipped ricotta and toasted pistachios.

Name: BB's
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Brunch,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace
Description: Start your morning or fire up your evening at this groovy Filipino diner bursting with color and coolness. Sea foam green tile, pink booths and turquoise stools set the stage for a hangout that doesn’t take itself too seriously. Brunch is a treat, featuring Adobo fried chicken paired with pineapple habanero hot sauce. The wonderfully sour braised pork loin soup will ward off the longest nights and the coldest winters. Dinner is a different speed. The cocktail bar comes alive, and the kitchen trades in Japanese milkbread French Toast for classic pancit with chili oil, chicken liver mousse and calamansi pie with orange blossom meringue. With a come-as-you-are vibe, this charming restaurant is a welcome winner in Parkdale.

Name: Sunnys Chinese
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: In the belly of Kensington Market, down a hallway that nearly looks like a dead-end, you will find the door to this high-energy hotspot. There’s no turning back, as the packed-out room is constantly buzzing with groups huddled around Chinese homestyle dishes pulled from Sichuan to Guangdong. Spicy, fiery, crispy, smoky – the high-wattage cooking is a total delight, as the kitchen pulls no punches at every possible junction. Tripe and beef shank coated in chili oil is a good start before launching into the charred silver needle noodles. Best of all might be the grilled chicken thigh coated in cumin, chili and pepper. To finish, the crispy Hong Kong French Toast with black sesame jam and oolong condensed milk short-circuits all manner of restraint.

Name: SumiLicious Smoked Meat & Deli
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted
Description: In a non-descript Scarborough shopping center, Sumith Fernando’s smoked meat is something of a rite of passage. Fernando spent nearly two decades learning his craft at Schwartz's in Montreal before settling on his own recipe. His halal brisket is marinated in a secret spice blend for days, smoked for hours until tender and finally finished in a steamer. He opened in 2018 and has been behind the counter ever since, building sandwiches out of thinly sliced, peppery brisket piled high on soft, spongy rye smeared with yellow mustard. Against the advice of any physician, complete your order at this no-frills deli with poutine—fries topped with Quebec cheese curds and submerged in gravy. Ask for extra napkins, you'll need them.

Name: Bar Raval
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Are we in San Sebastian or Toronto? Open day and night since 2015, Grant van Gameren’s ode to Spain continues to be just the kind of place to get lost in and lose track of time. The cozy room is a vision, a stunning cocoon of curved, South African mahogany that wraps around every surface. The menu is equally small but offers a striking roster of conservas and pinxtos. Briny boquerones laid over stracciatella are a must, as are the plucky shrimp a la planxa coated in a riot of smoked paprika, cumin and garlic. Indeed, guests will graze and graze until they’ve run out of things to order. There’s plenty to drink here, too, with a host of talented bartenders ready to mix and pour sherries, highballs and smart cocktails.

Name: White Lily Diner
Address: 678 Queen St. E, Toronto, M4M 1G8, Canada
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Brunch,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Old school diners are rare creatures these days, but ones that smoke their own bacon, make their own biscuits and donuts, bottle their own hot sauce and grow their own vegetables? Even rarer. A culinary unicorn, this bright yellow nook sets the standard not just for diners but for any restaurant that aspires to serve both people and planet. While also partnering with local farms, husband-and-wife team Ben Denham and Ashley Lloyd live on their 10-acre farm in Uxbridge, which supplies a handful of restaurants and a CSA. Breakfast is the main draw, but guests will be happy at any hour of the day. Verdant green salads, fantastic sandwiches on homemade bread, and a stunningly light hash brown make for a grand meal that gets all the details just right.

Name: Fonda Balam
Address: 802 Dundas St. W, Toronto, M6J, Canada
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Is that the best lengua taco you’ve ever had? Is there a better birria in the city? You might find yourself asking a lot of questions at this casual fonda where it’s impossible not to over-order. What started out as a summer birria pop-up by celebrity chef Matty Matheson and former Quetzal chefs Kate Chomyshyn and Julio Guajardo quickly evolved into this brick-and-mortar where tortillas are made in-house. The menu has expanded sensibly with aguachile de camaron, spicy seafood cocktail and sweets like chocolate cake with coconut flan. This is food you crave on a regular basis served in an easy-going setting that doesn’t care how you’re dressed. Low-flung counter seats, sunshine-yellow napkins and cacti in every corner add to the charm.

Name: Tiflisi
Address: 1970 Queen St. E, Toronto, M4L 1H8, Canada
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: East of downtown Toronto in Beaches, the Pkhakadze family delivers some of the city’s best and brightest Georgian cooking. Portions are built to share so bring a friend or two. The cold leek pkhali salad bound in a light walnut sauce is a vibrantly green beginning and especially essential before the Acharuli khachapuri arrives. A celebration of carbs and dairy, this stretch of fluffy bread cradles a pool of melted cheese topped with butter and an egg yolk. There’s more on the way: Large lamb khinkali with warm broth and long skewers of juicy kebabs topped with fried potatoes. Without question, this is hearty food, seasoned beautifully, prepared with care and radiating with all the comforts of home, wherever that may be.

Name: Favorites Thai
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This vibrant Thai hot spot hides in plain sight along Ossington Avenue. A quick walk through a tiny coffee shop to the very back leads to the actual dining room, anchored by a small kitchen fitted with binchotan charcoal grills. Sunlight bathes the airy, narrow dining room. All the while, guests dig into electric, vibrant Thai cooking that makes the most out of fresh herbs and fiery chilis. You could fill up just on appetizers, like sticky rice spring rolls, fried chicken wings and beef tenderloin tartare enlivened with fish sauce and fried shallots. A particularly clever fried calamari salad demonstrates the creative talents of this kitchen. From green curries with fish to red curries with duck, the curated menu offers wide appeal for groups.

Name: Campechano
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: If you’re here for anything but tacos, you’ve come to the wrong place. Time flies at this cozy hotspot that sources heirloom corn from Mexico and presses and griddles tortillas every day. The menu is short and sweet, but still, how does one pick between the smoky barbacoa with jalapeño salsa and the flaky, beer-battered haddock with red cabbage? Sautéed mushrooms with double-smoked bacon and chili oil are a sleeper favorite too. The sounds and smells of the kitchen fill the boxy room that’s little more than white kitchen tile and worn wood. Everything arrives fast and hot, and then, in a blink, it’s all over and you’re back outside, plotting your inevitable return. A second location on College Street offers a similar menu in a more spacious setting.

Name: R&D
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: In a match made on primetime, Chef Alvin Leung was one of the judges who declared Eric Chong the winner of "MasterChef Canada’s" first season, before taking on the younger chef as his protégé. Smack dab in the middle of Chinatown, this hip, unconventional eatery is the product of their partnership, serving up just the sort of freewheeling fusion cuisine that made Chong a TV hit. The assortment of decidedly untraditional dim sum serves as a prime example, drawing upon a grab bag of international flavors, including French, Chinese and Korean, as in flaky sou filled with foie gras parfait, or bao filled with kimchi and galbi. Mains are similarly genre-defying, like a signature butter-poached lobster with scallion oil, dashi and vermicelli.

Name: Chica's Chicken
Address: 2853 Dundas St. W, Toronto, M6P 1Y6, Canada
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This humble corner in the Junction is a faithful tribute to "hot chicken," a fiery, eye-watering style popularized in the American South. Chickens are dry-brined for two days and seasoned with a dark, brooding mix of spices. Diners in a hurry can grab a boneless sandwich and be on their way, but true fans know that excellence takes time and are content to wait the full half hour as bone-in birds are fried to order. Medium heat is an approachable entry into this genre, but daredevils can swing for spicier tiers turbocharged with ghost peppers. An order of deep-fried pickles won’t win you any points with your doctor, but they’re a solid starter while you wait in the bare dining room that booms with rap music.

Name: Enoteca Sociale
Address: 1288 Dundas St. W, Toronto, M6J 1X7, Canada
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace
Description: A home away from home, this venerable Roman favorite recently celebrated its 10-year anniversary with a quick renovation that has paid off handsomely. The restaurant is as inviting as they come, radiating comfort and anchored by a marble bar that welcomes solo diners like long- lost friends. From bread to charcuterie, practically everything is made in-house here, down to the fantastic pastas that make up the very heart of this menu. There isn’t a table in sight that hasn’t ordered either the signature cacio e pepe or the bucatini all’Amatriciana. Comforting starters like golden-fried arancini stuffed with mozzarella di bufula or clever riffs like caprese sformato reflect the many talents of this capable kitchen, which also offers a tasting menu.

Name: Fat Pasha
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Is there a better patio in the city? Under a canopy of trees, communal tables and an easy breeze make for a surefire summer destination. But even from the inside, it will be easy to fall for this irresistible cooking that roams the Middle East. Sharing is paramount here, though on your own you could make a meal out of the salatim platter, which samples excellent dips like creamy hummus and smoky muhammara, fantastic falafel and grilled pita. Chicken shawarma is a house favorite, but don’t sleep on the grilled lamb kofta, which arrives in a winning pool of green toum and a refreshing mint salad. Indeed, this is food that you can crave and eat regularly. During the day, stop by the next-door sister, Schmaltz Appetizing, for a classic bagel and lox."Middle Eastern, Cozy"

Name: Cherry Street Bar-B-Que
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: With views of the downtown skyline and construction sites on all sides, this popular Port Lands joint feels far from the rest of the city. In a way, it is. Pitmaster Lawrence La Pianta brings the barbecue traditions of the American South to Hogtown in this 1920s brick building that was once home to a bank. After years of competing and judging with the Kansas City Barbeque Society circuit, he knows his way around a broad range of tastes ranging from Texas-style brisket to St. Louis-style ribs. Lightly charred wings and snappy, finely spiced sausage links are sleeper hits. Everything is smoked on the patio inside of a redesigned shipping container and saucing is kept to a minimum. Stopping by on a weekend? Know that meats are prone to sell out.

Name: Indian Street Food Company
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: Found in Leaside along a packed row of shops on Bayview Avenue, this neighborhood stalwart delivers a tight menu of street food favorites and regional curries from various corners of India. The dining room is wrapped in reclaimed wood panels and colorful murals, and cushy tables with white cloth invite further lingering. Over-ordering is easy, but friendly servers are quick to offer guidance. Deep-fried cauliflower finished in a sweet chili glaze is a kitchen specialty, but savory chaats, arriving lashed in refreshing chutneys, are worth an order. Order the thalis to see the breadth of this kitchen’s talent in one large, oversized platter featuring delicately spiced lamb curry, rich dhal makhani and a superb south Indian vegetable curry.

Name: Puerto Bravo
Address: 1425 Gerrard St. E, Toronto, M4L 1Z7, Canada
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Puerto Bravo is a quaint little spot on a busy street. The menu is also compact, leaning heavily on seafood while spotlighting regional cooking from Tampico on the Gulf of Mexico. Their itty bitty kitchen is the little engine that could, doling out bold flavors and phenomenal bites made with quality ingredients and executed with care. Salsa macha is made in-house. One dish worth ordering is the wera tostada, a riot of colors and textures. The crispy corn tostada is layered with mashed avocado and thin slices of octopus and shrimp tossed in a spicy macha mayo for a vibrant meal. Finish with something sweet, perhaps the classic carlota. Made with soft Marie biscuits layered with lime, condensed milk and cream cheese, it's a refreshing finale.

Name: Wynona
Address: 819 Gerrard St. E, Toronto, M4M 1Y8, Canada
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Wynona is a lively and friendly neighborhood bistro. The open kitchen is the heartbeat of the place—snag a seat at one of the tables to watch the chefs at work. The young team is relaxed but efficient, and all guests are well looked after, with staff members happily recommending dishes or wines.Seasonality drives their selections, and the menu changes weekly. Clear Italian influences are evident across the menu. Case in point? Thin slices of capocollo ham, topped with pickled banana peppers and drizzled with sweet local honey is certainly a Med-minded opener, and a delicious one at that. You'll never go wrong with homemade pasta, perhaps lumache with sausage crumble, sugar snap peas and a dollop of creamy cheese.

Name: Alma
Address: 1194 Bloor St. W, Toronto, M6H 1N2, Canada
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Chef Anna Chen dazzles in Bloordale Village from this minimally adorned shoebox of a restaurant. Scallion bread with stracciatella cheese and eggplant dip. Parmesan tapioca fritters. Is this Chinese or fusion? Red lanterns dangling from the ceiling and a ceramic lucky cat waving from the corner hint at the menu's intentions but the chef needn’t be bothered with labels.The menu is at once comforting and imaginative. Start with pan-fried radish cakes dotted with an assertive garlic-chive paste. A wide bowl of addictively chewy noodles with pork wontons is pure comfort. An unlisted rhubarb trifle with coconut makes for a lovingly sweet send-off. All the while, servers roam about pouring natural wines with abandon.

Name: La Bartola
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Chef/owner Ivan Castro developed a passion for cooking at the heels of his mother and grandmother, and he shares the vibrant spirit and bold flavor of his native Mexico City at La Bartola. Bright colors and vivid artwork echo the upbeat mood here, but this isn't your typical taqueria. Instead, traditional and authentic Mexican dishes offer a surprise—they're completely meat-free. Black sesame tostadas with salsa macha negra and sikil pak are a perfect opener. Tacos made from purple corn are eye-catching, while braised hibiscus is a delicious substitute for the typical meat. Quesadillas are filled with a mix of softened roasted potatoes, refried beans, vegetarian cheese and crisped onions. Wash it all down with a mezcal, Mexican beer or tequila.

Name: Gostilna na Gradu
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant serving top-quality local cuisine is housed in the inner courtyard of Ljubljana castle. Perched on a hill overlooking the city, the castle can be accessed either via a delightful funicular or a pleasant walk uphill.

Name: Gostilna Rajh
Address: Soboška ulica 32, Bakovci, Murska Sobota, 9000, Slovenia
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The fourth generation now at the helm at this restaurant has not lost the family’s love for local culinary traditions, updating these only when absolutely necessary and continuing to offer many of the original dishes created by their ancestors.
