Be sure to sample the enticing cheese trolley – an unconventional selection of international cheeses that the chef presents with great enthusiasm. A Bib Gourmand restaurant with a cosmopolitan twist!

Name: DiVino
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This former school has been transformed into a warm, urban restaurant, including a graffiti portrait of Don Corleone! You can see the chefs working their magic in the open kitchen, where they create French and Mediterranean dishes full of creativity and nuanced flavours. Make sure you ask for advice when making your choice in the beautiful wine library.

Name: Héron
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: From the farmer, to the gardener, to the fisherman, Héron's suppliers are all local. The season and the Dutch soil will determine what appears on the menu. Sustainability is key at this lively establishment, so dishes might feature previously unheard-of cuts of meat, a variety of preserves and foraged ingredients, and your dessert could contain fish garum. The chef will surprise you with his novel ways of putting local produce centre stage.

Name: Hoog Holten
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Your experience at Hoog Holten begins with the drive there: the charm of the surrounding Salland countryside is captivating in itself. The terrace of this romantic establishment, housed in an old hunting lodge, happens to be one of the most beautiful in the country! Brasserie Birds keeps things traditional – go to the restaurant for more varied, contemporary cuisine. The set menu changes daily, but always seeks inspiration abroad for its sometimes truly innovative dishes.

Name: Raedthuys
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Just about everything is homemade in this restaurant, which has its own bakery, own patisserie and even its own smokehouse! Choose from the wide selection of generous dishes created by chef Marion, who focuses on genuine traditional flavours with no unnecessary frills. Combine your classic meal with one of the numerous beers on offer here, many of which are on tap.

Name: Scheepskameel
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Scheepskameel is a lively, relaxed establishment, providing honest, straightforward food. Everything here starts with top-quality ingredients, prepared without fuss and beautifully seasoned. The wine list is comprised entirely of German wines and accompanies the food perfectly.

Name: Bistro Nijeholt
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Whether you are looking for classic, modern or international cuisine, the chef of this trendy bistro switches between different preparation methods to make his menu top notch, and he succeeds with gusto. The atmosphere is informal, allowing diners to enjoy exuberantly delicious dishes.

Name: A-Fusion
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A-Fusion immediately captivates diners with its vibrant atmosphere. On the menu is an appealingly exotic blend of Chinese, Japanese, Thai and Korean flavours. On entering, you will see sushi being made to order, and as you head further in you will notice the barbecue and the dim sum and wok kitchen. Thanks to the reasonably priced à la carte menu and small portions, you can try everything. The depth of flavour of the minced pork dumplings, the spice and umami of the XO sauce, the ultra-fresh salmon topping the nigiri... This is one of Amsterdam's best Asian restaurants!

Name: LEV Foodbar
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The relaxed atmosphere at LEV perfectly matches the concept behind this food bar: sharing dishes and enjoying good food together. The dishes (in snack-sized portions) are not overcomplicated; a couple of ingredients suffice to create amazing taste sensations. Steak tartare, pork tenderloin, cauliflower tempura, truffle risotto... At LEV, the table quickly fills with irresistible delicacies, often prepared using produce from the Achterhoek region. The perfect accompaniment to one of the many beers!

Name: Serre
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Like Okura's other restaurants, quality is the focus of this elegant restaurant, with its magnificent canal-side terrace. Excellent ingredients go into the international cuisine served here. The chef selects techniques from diverse cuisines, unifying them in straightforwardly delicious dishes.

Name: Uit de Kunst
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Hikers and cyclists who test themselves to their limits on the Vijlenberg are rewarded by this modern restaurant situated right at the top. The superb view from the terrace is a feast for the eyes, while the traditional dishes served here are a treat for the taste buds. Simple yet refined and delicious cuisine.

Name: Basaal
Address: Dunne Bierkade 3, The Hague, 2512 BC, Netherlands
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A cosy neighbourhood restaurant, Scandinavian and vintage vibes included, nice terrace on the water: what a nice place Basaal is! The full à la carte offer and the attractive wine list complete the picture. The modern market cuisine is based on intense sauces, generous flavours and creative, tantalising ideas. A deliciously unconstrained feast of flavour!

Name: De Aubergerie
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: People used to come to De Aubergerie for sweets, and in a sense they still do. This is now a pleasant restaurant, and the ‘sweets’ these days are modern, flawlessly turned-out dishes. The chef has an eye for quality and produces flavour with originality and skill.

Name: HAVN
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Two views, one of the historical harbour and the other of the open kitchen, grab your attention as soon as you enter this restaurant with a buzzing atmosphere. The same playful energy is even more apparent in the creations of chef Robin Blaauw. He is, for instance, as happy to dabble in the rich flavours of South American cuisine as he is to dive into the Asian culinary world. Drawing inspiration from his travels, he works with the finest Dutch produce to conjure up his dishes. Thanks to his eye for detail, this young chef has already made an impressive career for himself.

Name: De Schans by Mike & Wes
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: When they took over De Schans, Mike and Wes, respectively sommelier and chef, added a trendier, more relaxed vibe, whilst retaining the establishment’s commitment to fine food and wine. The chef crafts dishes in tune with the zeitgeist using cutting-edge culinary techniques to create a subtle blend of textures and unexpected flavours. The set menu is definitely worth sampling!

Name: Bergpaviljoen
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Choose your fish from the counter, treat yourself to one of the classics such as steak tartare or just opt for some tasty bar food accompanied by a good glass of wine. In this light-filled pavilion, with its Art Deco design features and spacious terrace by the beehives, you are spoilt for choice. But rest assured that, thanks to the quality of the produce that the chef has to work with, you simply cannot go wrong here.

Name: Fa. Pekelhaaring
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Welcome to the urban canteen of a number of Amsterdam’s local residents – a relaxed eatery without unnecessary sophistication, but one which is both authentic and welcoming. The cuisine is influenced (but not exclusively) by Italy and the chef enjoys adding his own variations and personal touches (such as crunchy textures and local influences) to his cooking. The varied à la carte is impressive indeed!

Name: Lazuur
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This charming neighbourhood restaurant proposes a refined fusion of French and Portuguese cuisine. The appealing set menu offers a choice of dishes including, for example, kale, bouchot mussels and molho de coentro. The chef cooks his ingredients to perfection and adds a dash of Mediterranean flair, as demonstrated in his soft-cooked pulpo, creamy riso venere and espuma of paprika. Be sure to check out the impressive port collection, which contains plenty of surprises.

Name: Bij Erik
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Wood, metal and leather create an intimate feel, although a table on the terrace is also a good choice: the view of the lock and windmill is magnificent. Erik Tas will have diners' mouths watering with fresh combinations in which stocks and sauces lead to wonderful harmonies.

Name: Marie
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Marie possesses that charm typical of the South of France. The brasserie decor exudes luxury, but the terrace overlooking the boats and bridges is where everyone wants a table. This tranquil oasis in the heart of the city is enhanced by the Mediterranean finesse of the cuisine. The lamb fillet and cheeks with a perfectly balanced hollandaise sauce, the salt-baked sea bass, the generous beef tartare: these are down-to-earth dishes that pack a punch, and they are simply irresistible. This is what Bib Gourmand is all about!

Name: Café Caron
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This cosy bistro is run by Alain Caron (a well-known TV personality and chef) and his family. The ambience here is typically French, as is the menu which features traditional, generous bistro-style dishes which are a work of art in their own right. Trying out the à la carte here is a real joy.

Name: Le Nord
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This authentic farmhouse dating from 1885 combines rural charm and modern design – the ideal setting in which to experience Grégory Nicole's cuisine. The finesse with which this French chef pays tribute to his homeland is a testament to his expertise. More modern inspirations add a dash of excitement without overcomplicating things. He surprises diners with, for instance, his own take on Poire Williams, or a beautiful cod fillet infused with zesty notes. Be sure to try the tuna pizza, a tribute to master chef Joop Braakhekke. A great Bib Gourmand restaurant that is also a sure bet at lunchtime!

Name: Rijsel
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The interior of this lively establishment resembles a classroom, and indeed this building was once a home economics school. Today you can see the 'master' at work preparing his lesson in French gastronomy thanks to the open kitchen. He has a sound knowledge of his ingredients and incorporates a nod to Flemish cuisine into his no-nonsense dishes. Whether you order the intensely flavoured typical Southern French fish soup or côte de bœuf served with a house-made béarnaise sauce and fried potatoes: at Rijsel, every dish is a feast!

Name: Alma Bodega
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The more down-to-earth little brother of MICHELIN-starred Alma has its own personality. Chic marble and stylish design give this laid-back restaurant flair. You can drop in any time of day to indulge in a fresh take on familiar flavours. The menu features a variety of dishes that will tempt your taste buds, including gyoza, köfte, pâté en croûte, perfectly done entrecôte with a delicious veal jus, rum baba and more. The skilfully prepared and generously flavoured dishes never fail to impress. Curated by Malou Hagenaars, the wine list always includes some exciting finds. Be sure to make your reservation in good time to avoid disappointment!

Name: Bistro TWO
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: How about a drink at the Dux hotel’s rooftop bar with its view of the town, lunch on the waterfront terrace or dinner in the chic, lively bistro? TWO is one of Roermond’s must-visit venues, offering a fascinating choice between typical bistro dishes such as duck liver terrine and more modern options such as meat loaf cooked in cocoa. Distinctive, updated cuisine which is quite simply delicious!

Name: Witlof
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: With the view of the River Waal, the jovial hostess and the chef who you see cooking as you make your way to use the facilities, at the Witlof, you will immediately feel at home. Jurgen Eikholt lovingly prepares classic cuisine with his trademark sophisticated, often oriental touches. Each dish on the menu can be ordered as a large or small portion.

Name: Brasserij Kok Verhoeven
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Take the left-hand door to a fashionable, cosmopolitan restaurant offering delicious fish and shellfish. Or, the right-hand door to the more relaxed brasserie with an extensive menu (again largely fish), which will win guests over with its quality and powerful flavours.

Name: Bistrobar Berlin
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This vibrant bistro-bar shares its avant-garde spirit with Berlin. Choose a spot in which to enjoy the restaurant’s home-grown creativity: the music is louder downstairs, while upstairs you’ll find more comfort. The cooking is modern and daring and the menu is international and eclectic – don’t miss the Kreuzberg dumplings with frankfurter sausage!

Name: Rotonde
FacilitiesAndServices: Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: They pick up their vegetables in a van which runs on biogas obtained by composting their waste. The aim is to utilise every part of their produce, which is grown with respect for nature and the seasons. Only biodynamic and natural wines are on offer. Sustainability is at the heart of the ethos of Rotonde, which is constantly seeking to improve itself. This vision translates into creative, intriguing taste sensations which are sophisticated and full of surprises. A spot by the open kitchen is a must if you want to watch the chefs tame the flames of their wood-fired barbecue!

Name: La Vie
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The 'living room' of the Hotel Valuas is a cosy luxury brasserie that is open all day long. Generous breakfasts, pastries or afternoon snacks, an enticing à la carte menu and a three-course set menu... there's something for everyone. The chef takes his inspiration from classic French cuisine and selects high-quality (often local) ingredients – and it's outstanding value for money. A seat on the terrace, overlooking the River Meuse, is a must!

Name: Bistro Aragosta
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The Aragosta has the warm, intimate feel of a bistro, where your welcoming host will introduce you to cuisine that is mainly French in feel with the occasional Italian influence, ranging from seafood risotto to duck terrine. Overall, the cooking here is classical, highly subtle and very tasty!

Name: Arles
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Arles brings Provence to Amsterdam. The prints on the walls of this bustling little bistro hark back to the hometown of the chef, who also shares his love of jazz music here (get a table in the dining room at the front if you prefer a quieter space). His culinary style is neo-bistro – a fresh take on the familiar flavours of French cuisine. Think the earthy flavour of beef cheeks cooked in red wine with buttery carrots or a new take on rice pudding. The set menu changes monthly and offers unbeatable value for money!

Name: Bistrot Regent
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Why travel all the way to France when you can dine at this timeless bistro, where the best of what the country has to offer is showcased in both the excellent wine list and traditional dishes? Think aromatic fish soup with rouille and croutons, or butter-soft duck leg confit with a zesty caper sauce, followed by crisp tarte Tatin for dessert. You can tell that Robbert and Heleen put their heart and soul into running Bistrot Regent.

Name: Restaurant ñ
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The yellow façade of this relaxed restaurant gives it a southern feel, which is further enhanced by the aromas of typical, authentic Spanish and Mediterranean dishes that greet you as you step through the door. The delicious options on the menu include fresh seafood, spicy chilli peppers, and dishes served with fresh, sophisticated sauces, as well as an excellent selection of cheese and charcuterie.

Name: 't Nieuwe Diekhuus
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This old thatch-roofed farm on the banks of the Yssel provides a charming setting (including a terrace with a stunning view of the river) in which you’ll feel immediately at ease. To this splendid backdrop, enjoy international delicacies (often with an Asian influence) prepared with top-quality ingredients and well-crafted garnishes that provide the perfect accompaniment. Generous cuisine that is well thought out yet gentle on the pocket!

Name: Bistrôt Chapeau
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Experience the charm of its colourful bistro decor, the peace and quiet of the terrace and a soothing ambience in this restaurant straight out of quintessential Burgundy! Here, Nicky Quarz revives often forgotten French classics without any unnecessary frivolity yet teeming with authentic flavours. Through his sauces, intensity etc, enjoy a welcome return to the very roots of French cuisine.

Name: Huson
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Huson is a trendy establishment where a lively industriousness always prevails. Here guests' mouths will water at the marvellous pairing of creativity with international ingredients in small dishes which are as subtle as they are exuberant. The chef is a dab hand at beautifully balancing fullness of flavour with freshness, as his signature dishes show.

Name: De Watermolen
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The watermill dating back to 1391 is the main attraction of this rustic restaurant, although of course the warmth of the place and lively terrace are also a draw. The chef sometimes opts for more modern techniques, but mainly serves honest, traditional dishes. Vegetarians always have good options here, including the set menu.

Name: Élevé
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A superlative view from the top of the WTC Hotel over Leeuwarden is underscored by a hip, casually welcoming ambience. The restaurant is both affordable and yet exclusive. Chef Kalkman’s cooking is modern, subtle and free of unnecessary frills. You can expect premium local produce, jazzed up with the occasional modern twist and generous flavours.

Name: Bistro LOF
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The experienced chef at this modern yet rustic restaurant in an old farmhouse in Broekhuizen park takes inspiration from Dutch ingredients, including produce from the restaurant’s own kitchen garden. His dishes are simple yet full of intense modern flavours, which are rich, carefully thought out and painstakingly prepared. Even the simple tomato with prawns dish will surprise you!

Name: Waers
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Waers is the incarnation of anti-conformity, which sums up Dennis Vermeulen to a T! In his restaurant showcasing a strong sense of Scandinavian purity, he brings out the very best of market-fresh ingredients and the seasons. There’s no fuss here, just original, well-balanced dishes with a contemporary feel that are well worth discovering and offer excellent value for money.

Name: Gym & Gin
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The name Gym & Gin is a reference to the balance we all have to find between pleasure and healthy living. After a workout in the gym upstairs, unwind in this lounge-like establishment with its vintage colour scheme and designer furniture. The cocktail/gin list as well as Kevin Valkhoff's set menu and à la carte options are all as impressive as each other. Inspired by exotic subtleties, he brings flavours to life with original flashes of inspiration, such as adding red pepper to cucumber and mango in order to give salmon some extra pep. If you fancy an afternoon aperitif and a light bite, the good news is that Gym & Gin is always open.

Name: Kwiezien
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Sit back and enjoy the tempting range of dishes which this cosy restaurant has put together. Karin and Remco work exclusively with fresh ingredients and are constantly in search of inspiring combinations. The rich palette of flavours they create is sometimes daring but they always pull it off.

Name: Oriole
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: Oriole is a haven of calm in the bustling city centre. The upscale bistro decor is alluring – the bar is terrific – though a spot on the verdant terrace is really the place to be. This is quite the hidden gem! The contemporary take on Mediterranean flavours, with a particular emphasis on vegetables, suits the setting perfectly. The "Oriole Express" set menu, with different options for each course, showcases the cuisine and produce of a given country every month. Whether you're tucking into grilled pimientos de Padrón, pâté en croûte or frango estufado with chicken, this Mediterranean-style feast is authentic, exquisite and inspired.

Name: Poortman
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Having been around for more than a century, Poortman has evolved from a café-style eatery into a proper restaurant where authentic memories add to the friendly atmosphere. Dutch classics such as veal tongue with pointed cabbage and hazenpeper (hare stew) with red cabbage are prepared with just as much skill as international specialities including ceviche or the celeriac-based dish. The dishes on the menu are certainly hearty but in no way lacking in finesse – the game jus, for example, is testament to this. At Poortman, flavour reigns supreme!

Name: Gaar
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Chef Joachim Müller delights his guests with a worldly and diverse menu which includes dishes such as steak from Limburg beef, scampi in a Thai sauce and Moroccan couscous. A trendy, accessible and lively restaurant with real appeal, plus a menu where traditional dishes go hand in hand with more exotic options. An interesting wine list completes the picture.

Name: Springbrunnen SKLENAR
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: After almost 30 years in Mallorca, Czech-born Martin Sklenar and his wife Lucie swapped the Balearic island for the vineyards of Oberkirch. Here, they propose an interesting blend of regional (Baden), Mallorcan and Bohemian-inspired cuisine. This is served in a cosy interior with a slightly rustic feel, or out on the wonderful terrace known as the Weinberggarten. The ingredient-led dishes can be accompanied by your choice of wine from a predominantly regional selection.

Name: November Brasserie
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This Japanese brasserie in a busy neighbourhood proposes two concepts under one roof: at lunchtime (Sat-Sun) there is just a short menu; in the evening you can choose from a decent range of Japanese dishes, sushi and sashimi. The competent waitstaff have a refreshingly natural manner of serving. The bright interior, done out in a modern-minimalist style – complete with a small sushi counter – is aesthetically pleasing. They also serve breakfast at the weekend.

Name: CARUSO Pastabar
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Neapolitan-born Anna and Marcello Caruso, working with Emanuele Barbaro, have come up with a cool concept: a tasty, relaxed and lively dining experience, played out in a chic atmosphere. Service comes courtesy of a relaxed, attentive team under the tutelage of the charming proprietress. They serve a reasonably priced three-course set menu, which you can put together yourself – there's delicious homemade pasta for the main course!

Name: falke23
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This delightful spot is a well-kept, typically rustic-style Bavarian inn. In a lively, atmospheric and pleasantly informal setting, diners sit at large wooden tables and are waited on by a laid-back front-of-house team. The menu is divided into a modern and creative set menu and specialities including well-known classics such as veal cream goulash or cheese spaetzle – with lots of variety, there is something for everyone. The regular events and themed evenings are also worth noting.

Name: Rebblick
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Housed in Korb's Remstalhalle, this restaurant has retained a certain 1970s feel, while incorporating chic modern design features and an attractive glass façade. Jochen Gromann serves up flavoursome seasonal cuisine drawing on regional and international influences (including Swabian Zwiebelrostbraten). Managed by Nadine (his wife), the front-of-house team are friendly and well drilled and provide astute wine recommendations. Delightful terrace – with a view of the vineyards, depending on where you sit.

Name: Weinstube zum Engel
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: With his Weinstube (or "wine tavern"), Christian Beck, son of the owner of the hotel and restaurant Heiligenstein, also located in Neuweier, has brought a new layer of culinary enrichment to the village. The cuisine here comprises regional, seasonal and Mediterranean dishes. Vegetarian dishes and small bites are also available. Friendly service in a cosy interior that blends tradition and modernity. The terrace is also lovely.

Name: Winzerstube - Vinum
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A friendly and modern restaurant in the tastefully done out hotel of the same name. In summer, it is a treat to sit on the Mediterranean-style terrace. The kitchen serves tasty Baden dishes prepared with precise craftsmanship and based on choice ingredients. When it comes to the wine, too, the restaurant has a clear penchant for the region. There is also the Weinstube – a traditional rustic-style wine bar.

Name: Jäger & Lustig
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: With its cosy atmosphere and great food, this is a truly charming place. "Heimatküche" is how they themselves term their fresh and flavoursome cuisine. The emphasis is on classic German dishes and game – goose is the seasonal speciality of the house. Tip: Order the "whole goose for four people". Don't miss out on the beer garden in summer.

Name: Bistro Margarete
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In addition to Sein, Thorsten Bender now runs this second restaurant. The place has a stylish and lively atmosphere and, outside, the terrace in the courtyard verges on the romantic in summer. The food is tasty and regional, with a menu that includes classic and modern dishes. There is also a fairly priced wine list. The service is pleasantly friendly and casual. Tip: try the appealing lunch menu.

Name: WurzelWerk
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Two houses, built in 1875 as an agricultural estate, now house a guesthouse (with café service at weekends) and a restaurant, where owner Benjamin Bendzko promises and delivers fresh market-based cuisine. Excellent – and almost exclusively regional – ingredients go into the tasty and pleasingly straightforward dishes. Rural charm and pretty decor make for a beautifully cosy backdrop. In summer, the garden terrace is a real hit.

Name: Cube by Mika
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Somewhat tucked away, this is a trendy and lively maisonette-style restaurant occupying two levels. The atmosphere is laid-back and casual and, on the lower floor, you can also sit at bar tables. This place specialises in delicious izakaya cuisine – predominantly Asian dishes and finger food for sharing. On certain days, they also propose an ambitious tasting menu.

Name: Wirtshaus zur Sonne
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This restaurant has been in the same family for over 300 years. Diners can sit inside in the wonderful, wood-panelled dining room or outside on the pretty garden terrace to enjoy the flavoursome fare. This includes tafelspitz (boiled topside of beef) galantine with radish carpaccio or pan-fried skrei cod with tomatoes and herbs.

Name: Feilmeiers Landleben
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Cash only,Terrace
Description: This cosy and modern restaurant knows how to makes diners feel welcome. For Johann (who goes by Hans) Feilmeier, his "country life" cooking reflects both a love of his native region and a sense of duty. He cooks regionally and seasonally inspired food. Choose from one of the different set menus or order à la carte. Extremely charming and cordial service - matching wine advice included. Tip: the home-made jams!

Name: Zum Goldenen Anker
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Not only does this 18C hotel offer a comfortable stay (opt for one of the newer guestrooms), it is also a popular modern take on a rural restaurant. Diners are waited on by a friendly front-of-house team in an attractive modern setting with a rustic touch. The food is flavoursome, fresh and seasonal. The main courses are also available in smaller portions. In summer, make a beeline for the gorgeous terrace to the rear of the building.

Name: Gasthaus Wolters - Zur Börse
Address: In der Langen Straße 22, Wurster Nordseeküste, 27639, Germany
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Formerly a livestock exchange, this appealing inn is steeped in tradition. Behind the typical brick and half-timbered façade, tables are laid out in a pleasingly rural interior where diners enjoy a quality take on regional home-style cooking made using excellent produce. Friendly service completes the picture. Be sure to reserve your table – the Gasthaus Wolters tends to get booked up.

Name: Wirtschaft von Johann Gerner
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The journey out here to the countryside is well worth it, because Detlef Gerner and his wife Tanja live and breathe hospitality par excellence in their cosy restaurant. The hand-written menu features flavoursome dishes based on seasonal and predominantly regional produce – incidentally, they bake their own bread. In summer, you can sit on the terrace out front. Overnight accommodation in the pretty "Häusla" (for two to seven people).

Name: Alter Esel
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The cordial couple at the helm take pleasure in offering seasonal cuisine with regional and Mediterranean influences. Your meal can be served inside the cosy, lovingly decorated restaurant or at one of a handful of outdoor tables with views over the historic houses of this charming little town.

Name: Lamm
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The impeccable façade is inviting for a start. Cross the threshold and an exceedingly friendly welcome awaits you. Take a seat in the charming dining area, where you will eat extremely well! The chef's cooking is classic, pared back and made with select seasonal ingredients. There is a choice of à la carte dishes and a set menu, which is also available in a vegetarian version.

Name: Michels Stern
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The Michel family have always run their restaurant with great dedication, and now the fourth generation is at the helm. Two brothers make this an experience to remember: Wolfgang draws on good produce to cook tasty dishes ranging from traditional home-style fare to refined cuisine. Stefan will be delighted to recommend the right Franconian wine to go with your food. Plus well-kept guestrooms.

Name: Zur Krone
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: The Isele family has been cultivating the art of hospitality in this traditional building since 1854. The interior boasts a pleasant atmosphere in which to enjoy classic German cuisine that is seasonal, carefully prepared and based on a range of regional ingredients. The home-made terrines and desserts are definitely worth trying – the diet will have to wait! The wine list also has a very regional slant. In addition, there are comfortable, tastefully decorated guestrooms in which you will be tempted to stay for more than one night!

Name: Schäck's Adler
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Christoph and Sandra Schäck have brought to life this picture-perfect hotel. The atmosphere in the wood-panelled dining rooms is really cosy, the service is very friendly, the cuisine is ambitious and tasty – the emphasis is on regional ingredients and seasonal produce. There is also the appealing Strumbel Bar and a number of extremely well-kept rooms.

Name: Greifen-Post
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant has three cosy dining areas that exude historical charm. The food served here is flavoursome and seasonal, made using local produce where possible. Diners can opt for the set menu or order the individual courses à la carte. There is also a selection of more rustic classics. The guestrooms are done out in an appealing range of styles: Renaissance, Romantic, Biedermeier or country house.

Name: Ostiner Stub'n
Address: Schlierseer Straße 60, Gmund am Tegernsee, 83703, Germany
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This typical regional inn sets great store by its regional ingredients. The menu is in constant rotation and devised in line with the seasons. There is also a set menu complete with wine pairings, which is popular with diners, and the service is attentive. In summer, the lovely terrace overlooking the garden is very popular.

Name: Gasthaus Weißenbeck
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: You will find plenty of satisfied customers here, and no wonder! The mother and daughter Weissenbeck team cook up a storm using regional and seasonal produce – and the prices are fair. The lovely inn also makes for a cosy setting, and in summer the delightful garden terrace is most inviting.

Name: Schwarzkopf
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Run by Stefan Pumm and his charming wife Anja, this restaurant serves fresh, tasty cuisine including chateaubriand steak with Béarnaise sauce (for two), a popular house speciality. Elegant wood-panelled dining room, inviting terrace, plus good accommodation also available (ask for one of the refurbished rooms).

Name: Landgasthof Adler
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Cash only,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This centuries-old inn has long been known in the region for serving good food. Since February 2022, chef Michael Vogel has been perpetuating this tradition: he worked at the Adler years before and took over the reins after a stint working under top chef Andreas Caminada. The style of the decor is charming with its mix of tradition and modernity. Tip: The shop (Lädle) selling regional produce. Pretty guestrooms.

Name: Schimmel's
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Cash only,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant's striking red façade draws the eye. The smart interior is modern and stylish, and the atmosphere is welcoming – the wooden tables are a nice touch. In the open kitchen, regional dishes are prepared, occasionally incorporating influences from around the globe. Diners can choose between the two set menus or order à la carte. The soups, for example, are delicious, but so is the fresh fish! The proprietress ensures cordial and attentive service. They also offer pretty guestrooms and holiday flats.

Name: Dorf-Chronik
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This fine winegrower's house dating from 1747 stands in the centre of the town. Sandstone and half-timbering create a cosy atmosphere, while decorative pictures add a touch of modern flair. Charming courtyard terrace. Diners can expect delicious regional and seasonal cuisine, as well as friendly service from Marion Schwaab and her team. Head to the vinotheque to sample wines from the property.

Name: Dorfstuben
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The Clock Room and the Förster Jakob Room are lovingly decorated, 19C country rooms, which could hardly be more charming and cosy. Tasty regional food is served, the prices are fair, and the service is friendly.

Name: Fleur de Sel
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Fleur de Sel offers fresh, classically inspired cuisine in a friendly, Mediterranean atmosphere. Try the sea bass with walnut risotto, glazed root vegetables and parsley pesto or the Iberico pork cheeks with braised red Paprika and rosemary jus.

Name: Gasthaus Assenmacher
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: It's clear that Christian and Christa Storch put their heart and soul into running this place. The chef-patron wins over diners with his modern take on classic cuisine. Eschewing any gimmickry, he lays the focus squarely on quality produce and flavour. The lady of the house manages the friendly and attentive waitstaff. Pleasant little terrace to the rear of the building. Decent accommodation options at the hotel.

Name: Gasthof Blumenthal
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: A family business in its fifth generation and a Franconian inn just as we like them! The restaurant boasts a cosy interior and a glorious terrace. Enjoy the charming informal service in a relaxed atmosphere. Choose from a range of fuss-free and tasty regional dishes, including traditional favourites, all made with good ingredients.

Name: Funky Fisch
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Are you in the mood for fish of the uncomplicated and Asian-inspired variety? Then head to the trendy and lively Funky Fisch by The Duc Ngo. The centrepiece is the large fish counter, where you choose the fish you want to eat, which is then prepared in the open kitchen. A wide range of Asian food, from Chinese to Vietnamese, is served, with influences from all over the world.

Name: Speisemeisterei Burgthalschenke
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The Großhammer family has been renowned for its good cooking for years! Diners can choose between the set menu or classic dishes. The cuisine follows the seasons, with ingredients being sourced in the local area. Laid out over three levels, the restaurant also has a lovely terrace. On a practical note: large car park.

Name: Lazarus Stube im Oberschwäbischen Hof
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Good, fresh ingredients go into making this really tasty seasonal regional cuisine, including classics such as Zwiebelrostbraten (fried beef and onions in gravy) or homemade Maultaschen (German ravioli). For more ambitious cooking, look to the "gourmet menu" of the second restaurant, Esszimmer. Modern and functional guestrooms available at Oberschwäbischer Hof.

Name: Kaufmann's
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: In this lovingly renovated former castle brewery, nowadays the name of the game is good, fresh cuisine. In an attractive setting of exposed old brickwork, vaulted ceilings and sleek, modern style, the restaurant serves flavoursome dishes with a regional dimension as well as international influences. For example, Rhön trout is served all year round, along with seasonal dishes such as braised haunch of venison.

Name: Schatzhauser
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Another iteration of the Finkbeiner family's Traube Tonbach suite of restaurants. The interior is minimalist and modern, airy and light, with a terrace boasting a great view of the valley. They serve a pleasant mix of international cuisine and regional classics, plus steaks cooked on the Lavastein grill. The service courtesy of well-trained staff is very friendly. Incidentally, the place is named after the good forest spirit from a Black Forest fairy tale.

Name: Berggasthof Schlüssel
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This mountain inn dating back over a hundred years is located at an altitude of 700m in the district of Pfaffenberg. Your dedicated hosts propose regional dishes that are in tune with the seasons and peppered with modern touches, to be savoured in cosy dining rooms with plenty of rustic charm. If you fancy a bottle of wine with your meal, why not stay over in the well-kept guestrooms?

Name: Kaisers Eck
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit cards not accepted,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus
Description: Situated by Ahlbeck's main church, this cosy restaurant with its pleasantly down-to-earth atmosphere is run by a husband-and-wife team – she manages the waitstaff in her friendly and relaxed manner while he does the cooking. The cuisine is predominantly regional, and the "Lieblingsmenü" is a hit. However, there are plenty of other options that whet the appetite – the decision won't be easy.

Name: Gasthaus Polster
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In this establishment steeped in tradition – it's been a family business since 1839 – the gourmet restaurant and Polster-Stube have been merged and now offer many Franconian regional dishes on the menu, alongside classical cuisine. Vegetarians are also catered for. There are lovely, comfortable guestrooms.

Name: Lindenhof
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Like their hotel, with its cosy individually designed guestrooms, the Hankhs' restaurant is also very popular. This is down to the excellent seasonal cuisine, which has regional and Mediterranean influences. You can order à la carte or opt for a set menu (vegetarian version available). Friendly and competent waitstaff. The small terraces in front of and to the rear of the building are delightful.

Name: Landhaus Lebert
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Cash only,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In a small town about 10km from Rothenburg ob der Tauber, this cosy restaurant serves really flavoursome cuisine made from good-quality regional produce – importance is attached to sustainability. In summer, there is a lovely beer garden. Well-kept guestrooms for overnight stays, and a barn for private events. Tip: In the old shepherd's caravan, you can buy products made on site, such as lemon liqueur, spice mixtures, jellies and jams.

Name: Berggasthaus Niedersachsen
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This historic property on the Gehrdener Berg ridge offers some excellent food that is an interesting mix of traditional fare and sophisticated classic dishes. These range from Hannover tongue ragout to turbot with shellfish béarnaise. Attractive terrace. Hot food is served non-stop from 3pm on weekdays and at weekends.

Name: Münstermanns Kontor
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: What started as a shop selling eggs and butter later became a delicatessen and today this spot is a popular bistro with a pleasingly lively urban atmosphere and an open kitchen. The tasty dishes include German classics such as currywurst and Wiener schnitzel, but also international dishes. The food is accompanied by decent wines by the glass, and the service is friendly. Open from noon to 8pm, last orders 6.30pm. NB: They don't take reservations at lunchtime – so come early, as the place gets very busy.

Name: Weinrestaurant Turmschänke
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: In this restaurant in the Nicolaiturm, the lovely historical details, such as paintings and original furniture dating from 1912, foster a rustic yet elegant feel. Enjoy seasonal dishes – served as a set menu or à la carte. Grilled dishes are also available. There are around 140 items on the wine list, which includes helpful hints. Special wine evenings are also organised here.

Name: Zum Vaas
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: It is always a delight to visit a friendly and welcoming restaurant with a lively atmosphere. This one can look back on over 150 years of tradition and boasts a spruce, upscale interior. The service is cordial and attentive, and the food is delicious and made using high-quality ingredients from carefully selected producers. In addition to the menu of the day, which also features Mediterranean touches, there are the Vaas classics, such as roast Swabian-Hall pork. The impressive wine list comprises a remarkable range of vintage wines from various producers – predominantly from Germany and France, but also from Austria and other Old World countries. Comfortable guestrooms are available in the hotel of the same name.

Name: Nußbaumerin
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Here in her cosy restaurant Johanna Nußbaumer recreates a little bit of Austria in the heart of Berlin. Specialities include breaded fried chicken, Wiener Schnitzel, sirloin steak, and a range of Austrian stews and sweet dishes. The excellent wines also hail from her home country.

Name: Weinhaus Anker
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A restaurant that is steeped in tradition and run with great commitment. The lovely interior exudes a historical charm in which to enjoy French and regional dishes, and the service is friendly – hostess Elisabeth Deppisch is also a sommelière. In the winter, on Thu-Sat evenings, a short Franconian menu is served in the rustic vaulted Schöpple. You can also stay overnight in well-kept guestrooms.

Name: Gambero Rosso da Domenico
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Domenico has been on his mission to showcase Italian cuisine in Franconia for well over 20 years, and has run this restaurant at the small marina with his wife, Teresa, since 2012. Here, they live and breathe hospitality, serving two set menus with dishes that can also be ordered à la carte. Astute wine recommendations come courtesy of the chef-patron himself. Gorgeous terrace overlooking the Main River.

Name: Tischlerei
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: An absolutely delightful spot! The location at the historical harbour is terrific, with sailing ships as far as the eye can see! The terrace is of course especially inviting in summer. The atmosphere is very relaxed, with diners sitting at long tables to enjoy delicious, freshly prepared dishes made with top-notch ingredients and brimming with bold flavours. A shining example is the fish soup, and the braised specialities such as the ossobuco are not to be missed, either. At lunchtime, boat builders and traders come for the reasonably priced daily special. Tip for motorists: Use the Marina Yachtzentrum car park.

Name: Margaretenhof
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace
Description: This former farmhouse boasts a truly idyllic location. Inside, there are lovingly decorated rooms; outside, a wonderful garden terrace. Then there are your dedicated hosts and the excellent cuisine that ranges from regional to Asian, including sushi. Late Oct-Mar: "Wine & Dine" set menu on Friday evenings by reservation only. Try the afternoon tea (Sun and public holidays, 2-4.30pm).

Name: Bistro Fatal
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: It would be a shame to miss Alexandre and Sarah Bourgeuil’s pleasantly unpretentious bistro for it offers some truly excellent food at genuinely reasonable prices. Try the open Noir-de-Bigorre pork ravioli with kohlrabi and ginger salad or the excellent codfish!

Name: Rössle
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This family-run restaurant serves fresh, flavoursome cuisine made with choice ingredients. Alongside the intriguing "Chef's Menu", there are specials written up on the board, plus a menu of classic dishes – they all go down a treat. To round off your experience, attentive waitstaff, a friendly atmosphere and a delightful terrace. The attractive guestrooms combine warm wood and sleek design.

Name: Adler
Address: Obere Dorfstraße 4, Wangen im Allgäu, 88239, Germany
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: Ambitious, fresh and unfussy are the terms that best describe the mixture of regional and international cuisine offered by Uwe Zöller at this slightly out-of-town restaurant. Front of house, friendly Anne-Kathrin Zöller serves a range of dishes including scallops with Thai curry, and duo of lamb on a bed of wild garlic pesto with Barolo jus.

Name: DELI
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Here, in an appealingly down-to-earth and relaxed atmosphere, you can enjoy interesting international cuisine that is based on the seasons and drawn from select ingredients. The terrace on Niagaraplatz, a square with a waterfall feature, is also charming… The traditional hooded beach chairs are great for really chilling out. Good to know: They serve hot food all day.

Name: Bistro
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: It's no wonder the lovely Bistro in this attractive old building draws the crowds: here the straightforward dishes are packed with flavour! The owner is in charge of the service, running the show with professionalism and genuine warmth. The small terrace with a view of the church and Marktplatz is also very attractive.

Name: Joseph Naus Stub'n
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This comfortable rustic-style restaurant (named after the first climber to reach the top of the Zugspitze) is not just an attractive place where you are looked after by very friendly staff; the food is also really good and fairly priced. For overnight stays the Hotel Zugspitze has well-kept guestrooms done out in a country-house style.

Name: Fährhaus
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: Practically right behind the dike and just a few minutes' walk from the ferry port, this restaurant serves distinctly local cuisine made with produce sourced from local fishers and farmers. Completely unpretentious and free from unnecessary frills, owner Gerold Janssen's dishes are brimming with freshness and flavour, as in the Helgoland crab cocktail or the crispy baked plaice fillets. Good to know: Well-kept guestrooms are available for overnight stays or holidays.

Name: Brasserie Colette Tim Raue
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A big name on the Berlin fine dining scene, Tim Raue has created a pleasantly down-to-earth brasserie of the sort you would normally expect to find in Paris. This place has a modern feel but exudes a slight touch of nostalgia too. The food here is excellent, and fans of classic cuisine will certainly find what they are looking for on the appealing menu. In the evening, you can also opt for the "Tim Raue Menü" or the seasonal set menu that changes every month. Lunch tip: "La table dressée".

Name: Fachwerk
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Semi Hassine and Patrizia Weidemann-Hassine run this restaurant in the old town, where exposed timber beams lend the space a charming rustic feel. The lovely terrace commands a view of the old half-timbered façades all around. On the menu: Westphalian cuisine with Asian and subtle Eastern influences. Hot food is served from 4pm; on Saturdays from noon, all day.

Name: Rotes Ross
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: If you are a fan of fresh and seasonal regional cuisine, the Bogner family's restaurant will be right up your street. This place is cosy and the service comes courtesy of friendly and well-drilled waitstaff managed by the lady of the house. As for the wine, the focus is also on the region. In summer, the leafy courtyard terrace is in great demand. You can also spend the night in one of the well-kept, comfortable guestrooms.

Name: Poststuben
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: It is hardly surprising that this restaurant is so popular. It has friendly service and seasonal regional food that is full of flavour. Menu options include braised beef cheeks with porcini mushrooms and plums, as well as a range of more traditional dishes.

Name: Löwen
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This is a charming traditional restaurant with a gorgeous terrace. Representing the fourth generation, Roman Pfaff has breathed new life into this family business. The high-quality ingredients used here come almost exclusively from the (Lake Constance) region – their origin is indicated on the menu. However, international flavours also come into play and, in addition to one or two classics, the chefs conjure up imaginative modern dishes such as pan-fried Lippertsreute salmon trout fillet with a paprika and tarragon topping, baba ganoush and oriental potato wedges. This often means a full house, so it is best to make a reservation!

Name: Landhaus Hadrys
Address: An der Halberstädter Chaussee 1, Magdeburg, 39116, Germany
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Since 2003, Sebastian Hadrys has been synonymous with sophisticated cuisine! The food is seasonal and has an international edge. There is a set menu that you can put together yourself by choosing three to seven courses. The prices are very reasonable and the wine list is also very good. As for the setting, the pleasantly bright, modern space has a casual feel, plus a large terrace. Experienced staff provide friendly service. Tip: Cookery courses are also organised here.

Name: Schwögler
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The decor here is sleek and unfussy, with an attractively designed wine bar that fits in nicely. The menu is divided into three sections: "classic", "innovative" and "seasonal" – in each case, you can opt for a set menu or order à la carte. And those who want to avoid meat or fish altogether will be happy to see that there is also a vegetarian set menu. Lovely terrace.

Name: Bar Mural
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This hip bar is loud, lively and trendy – and therein lies its charm! The short menu features various cold cut platters, as well as a selection of tasty and carefully thought-out dishes, which are also served as a set menu – a vegetarian version is also available. A few options can also be ordered to share. For advice on what to drink, just ask the laid-back, well-drilled service team. The wine list is moderately priced and includes a decent selection of wines by the glass.

Name: Zum Falken
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: You can be sure of a warm welcome at Zum Falken with its old oak beams, lovely wooden floors and traditional rustic chairs and benches. Try the fresh Bratwurst sausage, which are served on Thursdays and Fridays, and the homemade fruit brandies. Function room in the old barn and wine tastings in the vaulted cellar.

Name: Moarwirt
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace
Description: Here at the Bio-Landhotel Moarwirt, the excellent food is made out of primarily organic ingredients – indeed, the place has Naturland and Slow Food certification. The modern Alpine-style dining rooms are very pretty; in summer the terrace is a real hit. You can also stay overnight comfortably. N.B. weekly closures vary out of season.

Name: Renoir
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: "Classic" is the watchword here – when it comes to the food, as well as the tasteful, down-to-earth interior design. You can count on the wine pairings recommended to go with the tasty dishes made from good produce, as the chef is also a trained sommelier. Be sure to visit the small gallery in the building.

Name: Landhaus Tanner
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The Tanner family wows its guests with a wonderfully warm and cosy atmosphere. This applies both to the chic and modern Alpine-style guestrooms and to the elegant restaurant, where you'll be served delicacies such as veal lights with bread dumplings, or roasted pike perch with Bavarian asparagus and a lovage-hollandaise sauce. Service runs continuously from 12. 30-9pm.

Name: Tölzer Schießstätte - Hager
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: Michaela and Andreas Hager have been serving their seasonal, traditional Bavarian cuisine for years at Tölzer Schießstätte. Dishes such as delicious spinach dumplings with chanterelle mushrooms and tasty roast pork with poached cabbage and dumplings feature on the menu. The atmosphere is lively and the service charming.

Name: Stocks Restaurant
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant is housed in a charming half-timbered building with a thatched roof. The comfortable interior is done out in dark tones that exude an air of chic elegance. Friendly waitstaff serve delicious fish dishes or sushi, and those who prefer meat will also find plenty of tempting options on the menu. There is an additional lunchtime special. Tip: Parking is available to the rear of the building.

Name: Weinhaus Zum Ritter
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: This converted 500-year-old farmhouse certainly has character. The many regulars come for the cosy atmosphere in the charming dining area (the old Swiss church window draws the eye), the cordial service and, of course, the fresh regional cuisine courtesy of chef-patron Thomas Hausin – his flavoursome dishes are clearly the work of a chef with experience at top-flight establishments! NB: different opening hours in summer.

Name: Landgasthof Rebstock
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In the heart of the wine village, the Keller family runs this cosy, rustic, centuries-old house, where the welcoming hosts offer fresh, seasonally inspired cuisine. They like to use ingredients from the region, but international influences can also be detected on the menu. The service is professional and very attentive. They also have guestrooms.

Name: Gasthaus Goldener Stern
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: This long-established restaurant in Rohrbach has been run by the Fuß family for three generations. The cosy, modern rooms are beautiful and the regional and seasonal cuisine is inspired by modern concepts. Attentive service provided by charming waitresses dressed in traditional costume. This is an exciting venue for a variety of events with a chic wine store in the basement. Smaller menu available in the attractive beer garden.

Name: Pades Restaurant
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Wolfgang Pade offers a constantly changing menu, which is based on the availability of produce and relies on regional producers. Please note that there are only two service times: 5.45pm and 8.15pm – so make your reservation in good time! The garden terrace behind the pretty patrician house is magnificent.

Name: Reck's
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Cuisine, art and accommodation are combined in this long-running family business. Three sisters run both the hotel – with some classic, some stylishly modern guestrooms – and the restaurant, which offers really good seasonally influenced cuisine. There are three cosy dining areas inside; outside, there are tables on the terrace in the shade of the plane trees, which affords views of the orchards! There is art displayed everywhere in the house.

Name: Lotters Wirtschaft - Tausendgüldenstube
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Not only does the Hotel Blauer Engel offer lovely guestrooms, it is also home to this restaurant. With 360 years of tradition to its name, it exudes historical charm. Warm wood panelling lends the space a cosy atmosphere, and the old tiled stove is a nice detail. Added to that is service with a personal touch and very good food – to be sampled either à la carte or in set menu form.

Name: Barra
FacilitiesAndServices: Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Be careful not to overlook the house with the inconspicuous front! A thoroughly and unabashedly trendy concept, from the minimalist urban look and relaxed, pleasantly neighbourly atmosphere to the nicely pared-down modern cuisine served in the form of small sharing dishes. High-quality ingredients with a preference for those sourced in the region. Tip: From the seats at the counter you have a very good view of what's happening at the cooker.

Name: Jägerwirt
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This is the archetypal Bavarian inn at its best: a cosy rustic-style interior, charming service and uncomplicated, tasty cuisine. Popular grilled veal and pork hock dishes, as well as goose and duck, are also available if ordered in advance. The rural location is also delightful.

Name: Königshafen
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The journey up to the north of the island is well worth it! Here, family tradition dates back to 1881, with the fifth generation currently looking after this spruce house with a white-brick façade, serving good regional and seasonal cuisine. Nice garden terrace behind the house. Closed Mon-Tue in winter.

Name: derWaldfrieden
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Rural inn.

Name: Gasthof zur Sonne
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Set directly across from the Swiss border, Gasthof zur Sonne serves fresh, flavoursome cuisine with regional and Mediterranean influences in a country-style setting. Try the emmer risotto with Trollinger and grilled Calabrese salami or the duet of skrei and wild salmon in lemon sauce. The restaurant also offers three simple but beautifully kept guestrooms.

Name: Heim's Restaurant
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In this approximately 300 year-old building, you can enjoy fresh seasonal cuisine in a tasteful setting. Each of the regional dishes can be paired with the perfect Moselle wine. Opt for the seats next to the windows with views over the vineyards and the Moselle. Kitchen opening hours: 12-9pm. Nice guestrooms in the Reiler Hof.

Name: Am Kring - Büschker's Stuben
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In the mood for traditional regional dishes like Münsterländer Zwiebelfleisch (beef and onions)? Enjoy your meal in the rustic-style dining room or cosy fireside lounge. In addition, the hotel Am Kring offers modern guestrooms. Attractive location in this village built around the church.

Name: Landgasthof Backers
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The success of the Backers family restaurant (the fifth generation is now at the helm) is down to the snug ambience and, of course, the fresh and seasonal regional cuisine: the local venison and Diepholz geese are popular dishes. The restaurant is a long-standing Slow Food Alliance member. Try the "Backers zum Kennenlernen" four-course regional set menu with drinks and overnight stay.

Name: Cervus
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Centrally located, just a stone's throw from the train station, this lovely inn has also proved to be a hit with locals. A simple and fuss-free setting in which to enjoy the decidedly fresh and tasty food prepared in the open kitchen. In addition to more ambitious fare, classics such as schnitzel or roast beef also go down well with diners. Simpler and shorter lunchtime menu. Charming inner courtyard.

Name: Gasthaus Hofmann
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: The food on offer at Gasthaus Hofmann is seasonal and regional, the produce fresh, and in some cases homegrown. It is just this combination that attracts the many regulars to the friendly, rustic atmosphere of this country inn. Try the roast pork with crackling, potato dumplings and kohlrabi or the Kleinlangheim chicken. Guests from further afield may like to spend the night in one of the comfortable guestrooms.

Name: Vetter.
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Located in a residential area, this popular restaurant proposes a pleasant interior in which to tuck into regional classics or Mediterranean dishes. Good, fresh ingredients are skilfully prepared in a refreshingly uncomplicated way. In summer, spaces on the pretty terrace are hotly contested.

Name: SonneStuben
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The regional and seasonal cuisine served here wins diners over with the flavours it exudes and technical prowess it evinces. The pretty, cosy dining area affords views of the old town's historical half-timbered façades; having your meal out on the terrace that overlooks Marktplatz is a pleasant option. They are also open for lunch. Tip: It is worthwhile taking a stroll through the town. You can spend the night at Die Sonne Frankenberg hotel.

Name: Gutsausschank im Baiken
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit cards not accepted,Great view,Terrace
Description: This restaurant is surely worth a visit for its location alone, set amid the vines and with a lovely view of the vineyards and Eltville. Book a table on the terrace if you can – part of it is offers protection from the rain. The food is regional and seasonal.

Name: Rührberger Hof
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This historical Rührberger Hof estate has been around since 1902. The fact that it was once used for farming is no longer apparent today. The pleasingly modern interior is an attractive setting in which to enjoy the excellent cuisine, which is based on classical foundations and takes its cue from the region and the seasons. At lunchtime, the reasonably priced set menu of the day is very popular. There are also well-kept contemporary-style guestrooms.

Name: Fürstenfelder
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This former monastery makes for a wonderful setting. In what was once the cattle shed, the impressive Bohemian vaulted ceiling has been incorporated into the modern interior design, with a centrally positioned open kitchen. Out in the courtyard of the Cistercian monastery, there is a lovely terrace, slightly separated from the beer garden. The menu is varied, featuring dishes with a modern twist and made with sustainably produced (organic) regional produce. Options include dishes from the Josper grill, as well as vegetarian and vegan alternatives. Lunchtime buffet.

Name: Die Pfarrwirtschaft
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This is not merely Thomas Merkle's second restaurant, but a hotspot in its own right. The tasty food is wonderfully unpretentious and based on very good ingredients. Tip: Try one of the Black Forest beef dishes. The culinary experience is enhanced by friendly and attentive service, a pleasingly informal vibe and a really modern style with a rustic touch. In summer, needless to say, guests find themselves drawn to the beautiful garden. In short, a place that fosters a feeling of wellbeing!

Name: Zöllner's Weinstube
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: Surrounded by splendid gardens, this 18C half-timbered sandstone building is as charming on the outside as it is on the inside. Sitting beneath a striking vaulted ceiling, diners can enjoy regional as well as Mediterranean-inspired cuisine made from first-rate produce. There is also an excellent selection of Franconian wines. In summer, the terrace is a must!

Name: Aschbacher Hof
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This pretty country hotel run by the Lechner family offers not only fabulous views of the region and tasteful, cosy rooms but also exceptionally good, fresh cooking.
