The regional and seasonal dishes include game as well as classics like Zwiebelrostbraten (fried beef and onions in gravy). Wonderful terrace.

Name: Landgasthaus Hirsch
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The Waldenmaier family (now in their fourth generation) cook excellent, seasonal, regional fare at their traditional country inn. The game is locally hunted, the bread comes from the little bakery next door, and even the schnapps is home distilled. There is also a pretty terrace on the first floor and a lovely rustic beer garden.

Name: Erbgericht Tautewalde
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Inside, the modern dining rooms are done out in a pretty, rural style; outside, there is a lovely courtyard with a view of the kitchen. The seasonal cuisine is regional and international, and they are keen to use local produce. You can choose between the "Landidyll" set menu and "A la carte menu". Overnight accommodation in the traditional Erbgericht.

Name: Zur Krone
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: Run with dedication and a real sense of tradition by nine successive generations of the same family for over 200 years, this cosy country-style restaurant offers good food and comfortable rooms. The tasty menu options include veal roulade in a creamy cheese sauce with vegetables and spätzle.

Name: Eiflers Zeiten
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The pleasant, rustic-style alternative to Bembergs Häuschen has a distinctly cosy feel. What takes your fancy? The roasted salmon fillet with creamy black salsify, or a classic such as Berlin-style calf liver? There are also changing dishes of the day, e. g. Sunday roast. The two chandeliers made out of bottles are eye-catching! The view through the windowed façade onto the pond is also lovely.

Name: von Euch
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Located in the city centre, Hotel von Euch not only offers modern guestrooms, it has now also made a name for itself as a destination for foodies! In the elegant restaurant – or on the gorgeous terrace in summer – owner and head chef Johannes Schute delights diners with delicious cuisine that won't break the bank. Consisting of Livar cloister pork with potato, apple, onion and a wonderful jus, the dish "Himmel & Erde" ("Heaven & Earth") is a perfect example of how to combine superior and more down-to-earth elements to create something that is both refined and intensely flavoursome.

Name: das asam
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: You dine in the Modlersäle, once the refectory, on the first floor of this former monastery building. It has beautiful high ceilings decorated with lovely mouldings and paintings – the historical setting is tastefully combined with an interior design of clean lines. The food is modern and seasonal, and the tasty Zwiebelrostbraten (fried beef and onions in gravy) is a classic. On warm summer days, the terrace in the cloister garden of the monastery courtyard is idyllic! You can stay overnight in well-kept, simply charming guestrooms.

Name: Wirtsstube im Hotel Burkhard
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In the second restaurant of the hotel Landgasthof Burkhard, the cuisine is somewhat simpler, which does not detract from the quality. Dishes range from cordon bleu to sea bream with lemon. The dining areas are cosy and prettily done out – you can choose to enjoy your meal in the Wirtsstube or the Esszimmer. The inner courtyard terrace, which is shared with the Kaminstube, is also very appealing.

Name: Staudenwirt
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This well-established restaurant with its small, well-kept hotel has been run by the same family for three generations. Each dining area has quite a different style, from rural to contemporary charm, plus there is a delightful terrace. The menu comprises a good array of regional-traditional, modern-seasonal and internationally influenced dishes. Vegetarians are well catered for, too. Plus it is all reasonably priced!

Name: Gasthaus Egertal
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The Rupprecht family have brought together two concepts in their attractive traditional guesthouse: the elegant restaurant and the bistro serve the same menu. It features freshly prepared dishes with regional and classical influences. Most of the fruit and vegetables are home grown. The terrace out front is lovely in summer.

Name: Aldingers
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: Susanne and Volker Aldinger skilfully combine the traditional and contemporary here. The really tasty food can be enjoyed à la carte or as a set menu. Diners can choose from a range of regional and international dishes – from their "offal week" specialities to nasi goreng. The atmosphere is cosy and neighbourly, and there is a pleasant little terrace. Tip: the wines from their own winery!

Name: Kleines Meer
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Laid out over two levels, this convivial restaurant has exposed roof timbering that lends a pleasant airy atmosphere. Lake Müritz is just in front of the building, making the terrace with its small lounge area a popular spot with guests. Made from good-quality ingredients, the cuisine here is regional and seasonal; there are also vegetarian options. The hotel of the same name has well-kept guestrooms.

Name: Salt & Silver Levante
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: With this friendly urban restaurant, Salt & Silver in the St Pauli neighbourhood also has a Levantine version in addition to its Latin American eatery. Here you dine mezze-style, following the example of the cuisine of the southeastern corner of the Mediterranean: Levant-inspired dishes, both big and small, come together to the table and are made for sharing.

Name: Geberts Weinstuben
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Freshness, flavour, aroma – this is how you might sum up Frank Gebert's cuisine. He also likes to use produce from the region to create his classic dishes. The restaurant, located in a side street not far from the Rhine, is furnished with a touch of elegance; outside, meanwhile, it is pleasant to sit in the courtyard on the vine-clad terrace.

Name: Landgasthof Schwanen
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A Landgasthof – country inn – in the best sense! The Fräulin family is committed to its patrons; the whole establishment is very well looked after, from the restaurant to the comfortable guest rooms. The tasty food is fuss-free and influenced by regional culinary tradition – in the evening, the menu is somewhat more extensive. As for the interior, the dining rooms are done out in a traditional-rural style with the occasional modern touch.

Name: Landgasthof zum Müller
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: At their established country inn, Ingrid and Markus Buchner serve fresh regional and seasonal cuisine with international and Mediterranean influences – responsible for this is chef Marcel von Winckelmann. The service is friendly and cordial, the rustic-style restaurant rooms are inviting, and the leafy terrace with its small open barn ("Salettl") is delightful. They have modern rural-style guestrooms, too.

Name: Hirsch
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Hirsch is an extremely well-kept and well-run family business, where you can stay overnight and, first and foremost, eat very well. The kitchen's repertoire ranges from breaded pork schnitzel to sole fillet with shrimp and Riesling sauce. Really friendly and charming service completes the picture of the ideal country inn.

Name: Zur Linde
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The Trautwein brothers run this 300 year-old former posting house with its charming mix of historical and modern decor with great dedication. The menu includes Swabian classics such as Gaisburger Marsch beef stew, maultaschen ravioli and veal tripe with braised oxtail, alongside seasonal offerings. The rustic vaulted cellar is available for events.

Name: Landhaus Zum Rössle
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Family tradition since 1780! Here the hospitality extended to diners is just as important as the tasty cuisine made from regional produce. Besides classic dishes, a surprise menu is also served. In summer the garden is a delight! There is a fantastic barn venue for parties. You can also stay overnight.

Name: Wirtshaus Mättle
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Dating from 1848, this inn has been given a tastefully modern makeover. High-quality, market-fresh produce is used to conjure up cuisine that looks to the Mediterranean as well as the local region for inspiration. In addition to à la carte dishes (the whole roasted trout, for instance, is a house speciality), a surprise menu is also on offer. Gorgeous terrace. Located in the basement, bar-cum-restaurant THEODOR is ideal for events.

Name: Gasthaus Schwanen
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: Now in its third generation, this charming family-run inn opposite the church serves very good food. A cosy atmosphere awaits you inside, while the idyllic garden terrace beckons outside. Here, they keep chickens, hunt game and make schnapps, and their own produce often features on the menu. Accommodation options: Gasthaus Schwanen, Villa Pfarrhus with its beautiful garden, and the Malermeisterhaus guesthouse.

Name: Adler
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The atmosphere in this historical inn is cosy and rustic. The cordial and welcoming service staff is led by the charming Styrian manager, who herself is a fantastic host! In the kitchen, a father-and-son team prepares flavoursome dishes using high-quality ingredients. The menu is divided into two sections: classic Swabian dishes such as Kutteln in Lemberger (a tripe speciality) or house-made maultaschen, and sophisticated dishes like Japanese ramen soup or Breton monkfish with cauliflower and almond puree. An old jukebox provides the background music. Tip: The restaurant produces its own range of schnapps.

Name: Lohmayr Stub'n
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Chef Sebastian Oberholzner puts his heart and soul into his cooking, meaning his delicious dishes are much in demand. He uses seasonal and regional ingredients, making sure to know his suppliers and the origin of the produce. There is also a good selection of wines. Diners enjoy charming service in the setting of a fine historical building.

Name: Krietsch
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This place used to be called Fuggerei – its name may have changed but it continues to be a great restaurant. At Krietsch, the cuisine is seasonal with a connection to the region, but it also draws on international influences. At lunchtime there are daily specials. Diners can sit inside, beneath the period vaulted ceiling, or out on the gorgeous terrace. Great location for a visit to the cathedral, which is just to the rear of the restaurant.

Name: Die Krone
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Chef Volker Lahn continues the family tradition in the kitchen at Die Krone. The cosy Baden setting of the dining rooms is matched by good local Baden cooking. The seasonal fare is available in the form of a set menu or à la carte.

Name: Goldener Adler
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Everything Rolf Hekeler and Christopher Oelkrug are doing here makes sense, and tastes great. The cooking is down-to-earth and based on high quality fresh produce. The many (regular) customers enjoy international dishes alongside tried and tested classics such as Wiener Schnitzel with potato and cucumber salad.

Name: Gutsküche
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: It is a real pleasure to see the terrific produce gracing the plates at Gutsküche, just outside Hamburg – this is sustainable gastronomy par excellence! The organic ingredients from their own estate, Hofgut Wulksfelde, are the absolute focal point of the cooking, and the menu features vegetarian dishes that can be supplemented with fish, poultry and meat "garnishes". GUT's caprese with hand-scooped buffalo mozzarella, rocket and tomato pesto, for example, is a marvellous seasonal dish – the wonderful aroma of fully ripe tomatoes remains in the memory! Tip: Snacks can be purchased at GutsDeli and delicatessen shop, as well as organic produce in the on-site farm shop. In summer: organic ice cream in the lovely GutsGarten.

Name: Kugelmühle
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Max Matreux has been at the helm of this minimalist-style restaurant in the side wing of a factory since 2001. He is a strong advocate for sustainability, as is apparent in his classic cuisine, which features seasonal and regional ingredients. A three- to five-course set menu is proposed, as well as an à la carte selection. Tip: Ask about the "Bib Gourmand" set menu. Friendly and well-trained waitstaff.

Name: Dorfstube
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: It's no wonder people that love to eat here! In addition to its fine dining restaurant, Hotel Hirsch has its Dorfstube, which is a great option for fans of Swabian cuisine. In the cosy old dining space, completely done out in wood, you can tuck into specialities such as tripe, maultaschen and Zwiebelrostbraten (roast beef with onions). These delicious dishes are all made using regional produce. Friendly service. We highly recommend staying overnight. The guestrooms are really lovely and inviting.

Name: Bauernstuben
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace
Description: It's cosy and original here, lots of rustic wood and a lovely decoration! Diners sit at beautifully laid tables and enjoy friendly service. The seasonal regional cuisine is really tasty: game terrine, beef roulade, steaks matured on the premises... offal also features on the menu. In addition to the good food, you also have the option of staying in one of the lovely hotel rooms at Ochsen-Post.

Name: Ramster
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The chef at Ramster uses locally sourced products to create succulent dishes such as braised leg of Heidschnucken lamb or wild hare. These taste particularly good eaten on the lovely terrace overlooking the garden. If you fancy spending the night, the rooms, some of which have balconies, are comfortable and contemporary in style.

Name: Der Engel
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Family-run since 1764, this place exudes an appealing sense of tradition, from the charming parlours laid out behind historical half-timbered walls, to the warm atmosphere and tasty regional cuisine. Choose from classic dishes, daily specials or set menus. You can also stay overnight in one of the lovely guestrooms.

Name: Weingut
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: How about dining in a chic and trendy modern restaurant after a stroll through the city? Choose one of the daily specials from the blackboard or simply opt for some tapas or a glass of wine – you can also buy bottles here. The service is very friendly and attentive. Decorative wine racks and high tables contribute to the pleasant wine bar atmosphere of the place.

Name: Weinstube
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: These former stables have been converted into a delightful restaurant, in which terracotta tiles, warm colours and an old brick ceiling lend a real country feel. The international cuisine on offer follows the seasons closely. Diners are well looked after by a friendly and professional front of house team. Charming and elegant guestrooms are available in the Hotel Am Brühl.

Name: August
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Long-standing tradition and really good food are what the Gehrke family stands for. The fresh, seasonal cuisine is imbued with international flair: roast leg of venison with a wild mushroom sauce; duck breast and cabbage with chorizo and raisins; hake filet on ribbon noodles and wok-fried vegetables. Wine cabinet with a great selection! Nice guestrooms at the Schmiedegasthaus Gehrke hotel.

Name: Landhotel zum Hirsch
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This traditional inn dating back over 300 years serves regional cuisine made with seasonal and predominantly locally sourced ingredients. The menu ranges from classics such as Hirschwirts Gaisburger Marsch (a traditional Swabian beef stew) and Swabian tripe ragout to Mediterranean-influenced dishes such as fried Atlantic sea bream fillet with a white wine sauce on bell peppers and courgettes with risotto. This elegant family-run establishment has comfortable guestrooms.

Name: Löwen-Wirtschaft
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The "Alpine lifestyle hotel" Löwen & Strauss proposes this really appealing eatery as an alternative to its fine dining restaurant. The rustic yet modern decor (complete with lovely little touches like old skis, cow bells etc) goes down just as well as the friendly service and the mouth-watering cuisine, which takes its cue from the region and the seasons. Top tip: Have a drink at Berggold, the adjacent bar.

Name: Kamin- und Bauernstube
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Among the dining options at the exclusive Hotel Dollenberg, you can choose to eat in the cosy, rustic-style Bauernstube, the elegant fireside Kaminstube or out on the wonderful spacious terrace – both the terrace and the Kaminstube offer beautiful views of the Black Forest. Whichever space you opt for, you can look forward to high-quality regional and international cuisine. The excellent wine list served in the fine dining restaurant is also available here! Tip: try the set menu ("Menü der Woche").

Name: Beesten
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Since 1906, over four generations, the Beesten family has put its heart and soul into running this traditional inn in the heart of Rheine. The owner himself is at the helm in the kitchen, preparing classic French and German cuisine peppered with seasonal influences. The interior is elegant and tasteful, while the service is charming. Take a seat on the terrace under the lovely old chestnut trees.

Name: Gasthof Alpenrose
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace
Description: This lovely, long-established restaurant is always busy and has a loyal following of regulars. Located close to the church, it has been run by the same family since 1868. Inside it has comfortable dining nooks, outside a secluded beer garden and terrace. The seasonal Bavarian cuisine often draws on ingredients sourced from the surrounding area. Charming guestrooms are also available.

Name: Sülbecker Krug
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: If you fancy prime beef cooked in an oven heated to 800°C, then this restaurant renowned for its meat is a good choice. The menu includes classics such as rib-eye, rump or flank steak served on a wooden board with superb sauces. They also have a wine bar. Various promotions are also offered throughout the year – don't hesitate to enquire!

Name: Elefanten
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In the heart of this charming town is this welcoming inn, which is run with great dedication by the Glässing family – now in its fourth generation at the helm. The classic, regional cuisine makes full use of what each season has to offer, often drawing on regional produce to conjure up flavoursome dishes. You might choose to pair your food with one of the locally produced wines on offer.

Name: Harmonie
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This charming building dating from 1823 has not shed its traditional character – lovely old wood panelling makes it really cosy! Here you will get to enjoy friendly service and regional, seasonal dishes, such as braised leg of venison. At the entrance you can sneak a peek into the kitchens.

Name: Zur Glocke
Address: Friedrich-von-Teck-Straße 12, Höchstädt an der Donau, 89420, Germany
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace
Description: The Stoiber family have put their heart and soul into running this trendy, modern restaurant. Their commitment is particularly evident in the excellent cuisine, which sticks close to the seasons and draws on quality ingredients. There are two set menus, one of them vegetarian, but you can also dine à la carte from the small menu of the day. The terrace in the front garden is ideal for warm summer days, and there are modern guestrooms ranging from "classic" to "design".

Name: Zum Kreuz
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted
Description: This inn has existed since 1683 and the Schwer family is the third generation to carry on the tradition. Here, just outside St Märgen at an altitude of approx. 1 030m, a father-and-son team cook up quality seasonal fare, including local game, and classics such as maultaschen and schnitzel. There is an à la carte menu, the "Tradition" set menu and the vegetable "Gemussmenü" (only by ordering in advance). Comfortable guestrooms and holiday apartments for overnight guests.

Name: Bistro
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Have you tried the second restaurant on the Detemple-Schäfer premises? If you're looking for a really nice alternative to the fine dining restaurant, there is also Bistro, which goes down a treat with its delicious regional cuisine and friendly, pleasantly uncomplicated atmosphere.

Name: Gaststube Zum Klosterbräu
Address: Kirchplatz 1, Neuburg an der Donau, 86633, Germany
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This is how you imagine a historical Bavarian restaurant: wooden beams on the ceiling, floorboards, tiled stove – rustic, inviting and wonderfully cosy (or "zünftig" as they say in these parts). There is also a wonderful terrace. The cuisine is classic, regional and seasonal – served à la carte or in three set menus, one of which is vegetarian. There is a good selection of wines to choose from. Tip: Visit the Baroque Münster Heilig Kreuz in Bergen.

Name: Lamm
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A modern ambience, a pleasantly informal atmosphere and the warmth of a traditional inn go hand in hand here. The menu whets your appetite with an interesting array of regional and international dishes. The set menus, which include a vegan one, are also excellent. A much sought-after place – for weekends you should book early!

Name: Sternenschanz
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A fun dining experience! The Linck family put their heart and soul into running this delightful restaurant. Diners can look forward to friendly service and the chance to eat really well without breaking the bank. The menu focuses on Swabian fare and home-style cooking, with dishes such as Flädlesuppe (pancake soup) and creamy veal goulash. No wonder there are so many regulars! In summer, the gorgeous garden terrace beckons.

Name: Das Jagdhaus
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Built in 1856, this charming timber house has three dining areas and is a really pleasant alternative to the other restaurants run by the Bolkart-Fetz family in Oberstdorf. Only ingredients sourced from within Germany – preferably from the region – go into the dishes on the traditional menu, including some excellent game options. Decent wine list. There is also a lovely beer garden shaded by chestnut trees.

Name: Gasthaus Scherz
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A native of Vorarlberg, Michael Scherz – no stranger to Cologne's gastronomy scene – focuses on Austrian cuisine, with classics such as Tafelspitz (boiled beef), Wiener schnitzel and Kaiserschmarrn (shredded pancake with raisins). Great Austrian wines. The service is speedy; the staff friendly and well-trained. Very nice terrace to the rear of the house. Good to know: the restaurant is easily accessible from the city centre by tram.

Name: Piccolo
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: You may not see the cathedral here in Porz-Langel, but you do pretty much have front row seats onto the Rhine! This restaurant serves classic cuisine with seasonal and Mediterranean influences, prepared using decent ingredients, most of which are sourced from the region. You can choose à la carte or put together your own three-course menu for a set price. The friendly staff also have plenty of good wine recommendations up their sleeve, drawing on the decent selection with a focus on Austria and Germany.

Name: Zum Caféwirt
Address: Hirschbachstraße 9, Kirchdorf an der Amper, 85414, Germany
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: A traditional inn with pretty painted walls and an unpretentious, friendly atmosphere. The menu focuses on regional, seasonal cuisine, with options including Cafewirt’s fried chicken, venison medallions under a nut crust with brown bread dumplings, and a Sunday roast pork. Reasonably priced daily menu.

Name: Zur Sonne
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: You should also try a meal at the Glück family’s friendly restaurant. Zur Sonne serves up tasty regional fare alongside a few more sophisticated dishes. Why not try the braised belly and loin of Swabian-Hall pork with creamed carrots and mustard?

Name: mundart Restaurant
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Swabian-born Markus Hebestreit’s restaurant has an attractive, modern, country-style decor and charming interior courtyard. It is located in a pretty, old village house in this little wine-growing town. The fresh and tasty food includes dishes such as braised ox cheeks and tuna fish carpaccio.

Name: Landhaus Hohenlohe
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The interior at Hohenlohe comes in two styles: cosy and rustic or casually elegant. Matthias Mack’s cuisine is also a mix, offering Mediterranean dishes such as saddle of lamb in a Provençal garlic crust with pimento cream and baked saffron risotto alongside classics such as pan-fried beef steak and onions. The service is friendly and the restaurant also offers a few well-kept guestrooms.

Name: Gasthof zum Kranz
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Built in 1769 and run by the same family for seven generations, the interior at Zum Kranz is modern and elegant in the minimalist style. The kitchens produce flavoursome, classic, international fare. If you come in the autumn, make sure you try the game!

Name: Hirsch Genusshandwerk
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This lovely village inn serves dishes with classical foundations and modern inspirations. The seasons call the shots, and there is a preference for quality produce sourced locally or even grown in the restaurant's own garden. The friendly and dedicated front-of-house team helps create the welcoming atmosphere. Delightful terrace.

Name: Westerndorfer Stube
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The cosy Stube of the Landgasthof Karner is a good alternative to the fine dining restaurant. The combination of rustic charm and discreet modern features makes for a harmonious whole. Here, the connection to the region is strong; from the schnitzel with roast potatoes, to the braised leg of lamb or trio of dumplings, great store is set by local and seasonal ingredients.

Name: Knippschild
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: With its homely farmhouse furniture this restaurant makes a great first impression. The great regional menu makes an already perfect dining experience even better!

Name: Klösterle Hof
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Chef Markus Klein and his wife put their heart and soul into running this restaurant. In a charming rustic setting, friendly waitstaff serve delicious regional and seasonal cuisine made using good-quality ingredients. Good to know: Hot meals are available from noon to 8pm. Guestrooms available in three different levels of comfort.

Name: Kandlbinder Küche
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: The yellow façade of the old coaching inn is hard to miss. Inside, discreet modern touches have been beautifully integrated into this stylish setting. The cuisine takes its cue from the seasons and draws on international influences. Here at Salon, chef Martin Kandlbinder serves up his "Kandlbinder" set menu as well as a surprise menu. For more down-to-earth fare, head to Einkehr, where the quality of the ingredients is taken just as seriously.

Name: schuberts
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This town-centre restaurant right by the Lauter River offers a pleasant backdrop with a casual brasserie atmosphere for tasty regional and seasonal cuisine with Mediterranean influences. The cosy wine bar, Entennest, is also popular - the menu is the same here. If you would like to stay overnight, they also have lovely individually furnished guestrooms.

Name: Bärenkrug
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Whether you are seated in the Friesenstube or the secluded courtyard garden with its old chestnut trees and abundant greenery, at the Sierks family's restaurant you can look forward to quality cuisine with a regional and seasonal focus in the form of daily specials, classics or set menus. Tip: Be sure to try the home-made chocolates. The hotel of the same name, also part of this long-standing family business, has attractive, comfortable guestrooms.

Name: Zum Lamm
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: This inn is everything you could wish for! Your cordial hosts, Ulrike and Manfred Kreger, put their heart and soul into running this popular restaurant. He is the chef and specialises in regional cuisine – one of his specialities is pike-perch from the Rhine, which is practically on the doorstep! Another equally delicious option is the herb-crusted rack of lamb with mint sauce, grilled watermelon and gnocchi. In summer, the tables in the garden to the rear of the building are in high demand. Smart guestrooms available for overnight stays.

Name: Gaststube
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Housed inside Krone is this pleasant and down-to-earth restaurant that is also run by the Wölfelschneider family. The Gaststube menu will appeal to those who appreciate traditional regional fare. As well as delicious food, guests can enjoy the friendly service, which contributes to the congenial atmosphere.

Name: Freihardt
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Eating here really is a pleasure! The cuisine is international and seasonal, the highlight being the Bavarian beef. A friendly atmosphere reigns in the restaurant and its conservatory, and the terrace on the busy street is a place "to see and be seen". Right next door is the restaurant's own butcher's shop, which has for many years employed so-called humane slaughtering methods.

Name: Landhotel Krone
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Here, tradition rubs shoulders with current trends in cosy little spaces that feature an attractive blend of old brickwork, wood, steel and glass. The regional and seasonal cuisine is scattered with international influences. Medieval vaulted cellar for events. This family-run business also offers attractive, individually designed guestrooms and wellness facilities.

Name: Gasthof Berghof - Ursprung
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Rustic wood matched with clean lines and fresh splashes of colour provide an ‘old meets new’ look at this restaurant. The decor is mirrored in Alexander Schütz’s excellent cooking, which comes both as an upmarket set menu or simply a hearty Bratwurst. The delicious food and reasonable prices make dining here a real pleasure.

Name: Schloss Niederweis
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In the converted granary of this 18C castle, classic seasonal cuisine is served. You will be looked after in a friendly manner in an attractive modern ambience – the high historical roof timbering is eye-catching. In addition to a charming garden, there is a lovely ballroom and a registry office. On a practical note: easy parking.

Name: Gehrlein's Hardtwald
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Somewhat tucked away, the Gehrlein family's restaurant boasts a warm and welcoming interior, as well as a lovely garden terrace. Meticulously crafted using the finest ingredients, the dishes served here are remarkably flavoursome. One shining example: Label Rouge guinea fowl, celeriac, carrot, miso, fritter. The friendly waitstaff pull out all the stops to ensure a perfect dining experience. The guesthouse opposite provides comfortable guestrooms.

Name: Brasserie Colette Tim Raue
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Tim Raue has his finger on the pulse with the concept behind this place: you could almost be in a French brasserie, what with the friendly and pleasantly informal atmosphere, and the really good, tasty food, such as bouillabaisse or gnocchi for vegetarians. High-quality produce goes without saying.

Name: Gasthaus
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Like the gourmet restaurant, Gasthaus also combines modernity and tradition, from the decor down to the menu. While things are a bit more casual here, the cooking is also really good – the quality of the sauces alone will convince you of that! You can put together your own menu – and even make it vegetarian. Friendly service.

Name: Schuberts Wein & Wirtschaft
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The dedicated young owners produce seasonally inspired regional food and an excellent value lunch menu that includes water and coffee. The setting – a wine bar first established in 1801 in a small street in the old town – completes the picture.

Name: Zur Mühle
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: In their well-established restaurant – it’s been in the same family since 1895 – Hermann and Kerstin Berger prepare internationally inspired cuisine such as sliced salmon in a rocket and pesto crust with teriyaki beans, mashed potato and sweet mustard. The interior is cosy with a modern note.

Name: Vier Jahreszeiten Restaurant Imhof
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: You will certainly eat well at Andreas Imhof's restaurant. The cuisine is regional and uses ingredients selected with seasonality in mind. Dishes made with Allgäu heifer, for example, are popular. The interior of this friendly place is bright, refined and modern; outside, the beer garden is presided over by an impressive lime tree.

Name: Anetseder
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Traditional German public house culture is alive and well here, and at the same time they tap into the zeitgeist. The lovely dining space has a high ceiling and a trendy, modern feel and the waitstaff are friendly. They serve fresh and tasty food, with seasonal ingredients, preferably from the region, taking pride of place.

Name: Die Alte Brauerei
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Your friendly hosts Eric and Isabelle Dauphin have imbued their charming restaurant with a touch of French flair, which extends to the menu. There is a good selection of seasonal dishes that can be ordered à la carte as well as a choice of reasonably priced set menus. The "bouillabaisse du chef" is certainly worth a try. Access to the restaurant and the individually designed guestrooms is via the interior courtyard.

Name: Sticky Fingers
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Located in the beautiful Old Town, this is a fashionable restaurant and bar. The decor and background music are very much on trend and lend this laid-back establishment something of a club atmosphere. The appealing international menu features flavoursome dishes including fish and chips, panzanella and paella – all served by very friendly waitstaff. As well as wines, there is an extensive selection of cocktails, another big draw of this place.

Name: Auers Schlosswirtschaft
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Cash only,Mastercard credit card,Terrace
Description: This pleasant restaurant has been run with dedication for over 30 years. The charming country-style dining rooms exude gemütlichkeit, the service is attentive and the kitchens produce seasonal, regional fare. The Bavarian sirloin with asparagus ratatouille and herb polenta is particularly appetizing. Attractive tree-shaded terrace.

Name: Schwanen
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Smart, modern decor, fresh and tasty food. Good ingredients are turned into regional and international dishes. Alternatively, there is Bistro K.B., where a traditional German/Swabian menu is served. For overnight stays, this long-standing family-run business offers practical guestrooms with contemporary decor.

Name: Sennhütte
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Family hospitality is the name of the game here! Since 1918, the Grether family have put their heart and soul into this place and not least into the good food, made mostly with regional produce. Dishes ranging from traditional to slightly more sophisticated are served in a space divided into smaller rooms or out on the lovely verdant terrace. Snacks and cakes are available throughout the day. They have their own distillery, smokehouse and Alpine dairy. Pretty, comfortable guestrooms.

Name: Café Rapp
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Originally a bakery and café, the family business is now also a restaurant, where quality, flavour and price are spot on. The emphasis is on regional and seasonal products – vegetables and meat are sourced from the village, herbs are grown in the kitchen garden. A must in the afternoon: the delicious fresh cakes! Pretty guestrooms.

Name: Graf Everstein
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The Multhoff family's restaurant draws in diners with the promise of skilfully prepared food and wonderful views over the Weser. The friendly and attentive staff serve up beautifully fresh cuisine that sets great store by both seasonal produce and selected ingredients.

Name: Feine Speiseschenke
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This friendly restaurant is located in a small village in a quiet side valley surrounded by woods and meadows. It offers seasonal cuisine bearing regional and international influences. They even raise Scottish Highland cattle here. You can choose from various set menus (including a vegetarian one) or go à la carte and opt for one of the classic dishes.

Name: Das Fetzwerk
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Das Fetzwerk feels modern and pleasantly uncomplicated - this applies as much to the trendy ambience as the food. Tasty, fresh dishes with a certain pizazz are served here. The service is friendly and attentive. The restaurant is located in the comfortable Das Freiberg hotel. Open from 1pm. Tip for sunny days: the terrace.

Name: RÖHMS DELI
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A pleasingly straightforward concept that goes down well with restaurant-goers. Cuisine drawing on regional and international influences is served in a friendly, modern atmosphere – the à la carte menu is complemented by daily specials on the board. For those with a sweet tooth, the counter displaying fine home-made pastries is a highlight! Attentive service. Pleasant terrace.

Name: Michaelis
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Tasty and fresh food is served in this refined restaurant in a restored building from the Wilhelminian period, which also houses the comfortable hotel of the same name. The menu is seasonal – there are various set menus (one of which is vegetarian) and a sophisticated à la carte selection. Friendly and attentive service. In summer, the terrace behind the house is very appealing.

Name: Am Osterfeuer
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: Hans-Jörg Dunker and his team have long been synonymous with quality and Westphalian cuisine with an international twist. The restaurant interior is attractive and cheerful, having been given a skilful modern makeover, but care has been taken to leave the traditional character of the building intact. One of the chef's specialities is the wonderful fish and shellfish soup with aioli, bread and parmesan. A gorgeous terrace for summer.

Name: Capricorn [ i ] Aries Brasserie
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: Located in a neighbourhood with a unique character, this appealing, laid-back restaurant has plenty of regulars. Welcoming and lively, it's everything a brasserie should be. The menu, too, is down-to-earth, including mouthwatering options – house-made venison ham, brasserie classics such as steak-frites and vegetarian dishes. Tip: Take a punt on the moderately priced surprise menu. Friendly and professional service. Pavement terrace.

Name: Allgäuer Stuben
Address: Lindauer Straße 75, Isny im Allgäu, 88316, Germany
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: The good food and welcoming atmosphere are the main draws of this restaurant run by the Rimmele family, whose dedication to their work is palpable – that is certainly the case for chef Susanne Rimmele. She cooks regional as well as Mediterranean dishes. The front-of-house team are charming and obliging. Tip: the delightful terrace. They also offer cookery classes, tackling eg pasta, asparagus, game. Pleasant overnight accommodation is available at Hotel Hohe Linde.

Name: Landgasthof Hirschen
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The dedication of chef Verena Martin and her team is palpable. In a charming setting diners enjoy cordial service and good food that is made primarily with produce from the region and draws inspiration from the seasons. The kitchen staff put their heart and soul into their work – the motto here is ä weng eppis Feins, or "a little something fine" in the local dialect. Tip: "Unser badisches Menü" or "Unser großes Menü" (for two or more people).

Name: Restaurant Corona im Hotel zur Post
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Terrace,Wheelchair access
Description: It's a real treat to eat here! In this classic restaurant, Sergio and Kerstin Corona work as a well-coordinated team, providing charming service and Mediterranean-inspired cuisine. In addition to the "Méditerranée" and "Corona" set menus, from which you can also choose à la carte, there is also a bargain to be had in the three-course lunch menu.

Name: Die Windmühle
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In this former corn mill, the Lemke family now run a restaurant that serves excellent food. There are two comfortable dining spaces – the Mühlenstube and the Kaminzimmer – plus a delightful terrace where you can tuck into delicious seasonal and regional dishes. The friendly and attentive front-of-house team take delight in talking diners through their selection of German wines.

Name: Landgasthof Löwen
Address: Kirchdorfer Straße 8, Kirchdorf an der Iller, 88457, Germany
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Alexander Ruhland represents the fourth generation of his family to run this traditional country inn, and his kitchen turns out top-notch dishes. He combines classic and modern influences, with the region and the seasons playing a major role. Modern and comfortable guestrooms are also available.

Name: HYGGE Brasserie & Bar
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This place is certainly hip! In Danish, hygge describes a feeling of cosiness and comfortable conviviality – just like the atmosphere conjured up in this pleasantly lively and stylish timber-framed restaurant with an open hearth at its centre. Delicious seasonal and regional dishes are served here, and many of the ingredients come from their own farm. Opt for the "HYGGE" set menu, the surprise menu, or order à la carte. There are appealing vegetarian options, too. The trendy bar-lounge is also popular.

Name: Westphalenhof
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The Westphal brothers (one of them is the chef, the other the sommelier) create seasonal, international cuisine ranging from fresh (home-grown) asparagus to loin of acorn-fed pork, roasted lettuce hearts and hazelnuts. The wine list offers a good selection of wines to accompany your meal. Stylish and elegant ambience.

Name: Poppenborg's Stübchen
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This is the more relaxed alternative to Poppenborg's more traditional eatery. Try the Atlantic sea wolf with mustard sauce or the Westphalian-style boiled top-side of veal. Pretty garden terrace.

Name: Zur Krone
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In the centre of the village you will find this charming restaurant with its comfortable dining rooms. Ralf Restel serves simple, flavoursome regional fare with international influences. Try the boiled rump of beef with herb sauce and pan-fried potatoes or the breast of corn-fed chicken with stir-fried vegetables and curry sauce. In summer the best tables are those outside on the quiet leafy terrace.

Name: Freihaus Brenner
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Diners often come here for the freshly caught trout and char, but don’t miss out on the roast saddle of suckling pig with sage jus and romanesco or crispy fattened duck with red cabbage, which are also on offer. To enjoy the wonderful view, opt for a window table or the terrace in summer.

Name: Kucher's Weinwirtschaft
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Kucher’s offers a mix of charmingly mismatched antique tables and chairs, pretty decor and an almost family atmosphere. The sour kidneys with sautéed potatoes have been on the menu here forever – a classic that has plenty of faithful fans. Most of the meat used in the seasonal regional fare comes from the Eifel area.

Name: Landgenuss
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Run by the Hämmerle family, this restaurant enjoys great popularity, so it is advisable to book well in advance! With a friendly country house feel, charming service and great food, this place is a nice alternative to Barrique. Made with plenty of local produce, the dishes served here are seasonal with occasional Mediterranean touches. The wide-ranging menu includes their "Original Wiener schnitzel" and sea bass with rosemary and thyme. In summer, make a beeline for the terrace.

Name: Zum Dückerstieg
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: An attractive, cosy restaurant with rural flair which serves seasonal and regional cuisine. Here, you can look forward to flavoursome dishes that pack a punch. The delicious options on offer include salmon, North Sea prawns, sea bass, suckling pig and game. Steeped in tradition, this family-run business – now in its fourth generation – also has attractive, comfortable guestrooms for overnight stays.

Name: Gasthaus Sternen Post
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This beautifully restored 1875 restaurant is a fine example of the dedication of its owner. Diners sit in comfortable rooms complete with tiled ovens to sample delicious dishes such as venison stew with spaetzle (a Swabian pasta speciality) and red cabbage or apple fritters with vanilla sauce. Overnight accommodation comes in the form of lovely country house-style rooms.

Name: Stumpenhof
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Great view,Terrace
Description: Diners are in such good hands here that they can't help but enjoy themselves! The waitstaff are exceptionally friendly, while the owner herself, who radiates good humour, is always ready to cater to her guests' needs. On the menu: plenty of the classics of Swabian cuisine, such as tripe soup or creamy veal goulash (which is best enjoyed with the home-made spätzle).

Name: Landgasthof Meier
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This typical country restaurant full of rustic charm has been cleverly extended with a modern style annexe. Take a look at the impressive kitchens where the team conjures up dishes of liver dumpling stew, pot-roast beef in a cream sauce and chocolate fondant. There are also some chic overnight rooms.

Name: Die Halde
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated at an altitude of 1 147m, this stylish restaurant successfully bridges the gap between history and modernity! The food is served in cosy traditional dining rooms, where guests are looked after by friendly, well-trained staff. Local produce is favoured, and the water comes from the house's mountain spring. There are also lovely guestrooms done out in a modern, regional style.

Name: Zur Linde
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Cash only,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A stalwart of the region’s gastro scene for decades now, Zur Linde serves flavoursome, traditional food made using excellent ingredients. Try the maultaschen salad, the pike dumplings with leaf spinach or the tasty veal cutlet with roast vegetables. The ultra-modern apartments in the annexe are ideal for long-stay guests.

Name: Landgasthof Zur Post
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Since 1870, this house has been in the same family, already in its sixth generation. They serve down-to-earth regional and seasonal cuisine made from good produce. The ambience is cosy and rustic; in summer the terrace commands a lovely view of the countryside. There are also a few guestrooms and a holiday apartment. Excursions possible in the Naturpark Vogelsberg.

Name: Brasserie Colette Tim Raue
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This is MICHELIN-starred chef Tim Raue's take on a French brasserie. Just like at the Colette brasseries in Berlin and Munich, the menu includes typical classics such as oysters, bouillabaisse and macarons, as well as more modern dishes and vegetarian or vegan options. The highlight here is the first-floor terrace overlooking the pedestrian area – but seating is limited, so you'd be well advised to make a reservation!

Name: LAMM
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A really cosy place, where you will also eat very well: seasonal Swabian-Baden cuisine, with an emphasis on regional produce; some of the meat comes from the restaurant's own highland cattle. There are good wines to accompany your meal, as well as a special whisky offer. In summer, try and bag a spot on the terrace. Pleasant guestrooms also available.

Name: Gasthof Brink
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus
Description: A place with charm! The traditional style that is cultivated here will evoke childhood memories for many diners. Family-run since 1880, the restaurant serves classic French cuisine that is down to earth and delicious. The pleasant setting has an elegant feel. The house-made pâtés and terrines are just as popular as the saddle of veal with Béarnaise sauce or the sole meunière.

Name: Diergardts Kühler Grund
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This excellent family business is now run by the fourth generation. Since taking over the reins, Philipp Diergardt has upped the ante – not least thanks to his first-class training –, at a restaurant which was already operating at a high level. He pours passion into his upscale bourgeois dishes, e.g. the pan-fried young piglet blood sausage. Then there is the tasteful country house ambience and attentive service.

Name: GERHARDS GENUSSGESELLSCHAFT
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Not far from the Deutsches Eck, a spit of land formed at the confluence of the Rhine and Moselle rivers, the historic Blumenhof lies behind ancient walls. Here too you will find the entrance to this modern, minimalist-style restaurant with its lovely vaulted ceiling. Sample the seasonal, regional cuisine inside or outside on the magnificent terrace. Try the braised beef cheeks with mashed potato.

Name: HENNE.Weinbar
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Set in the heart of the old town, Hendrik ("Henne") Olfen's appealing bistro-style restaurant has a pleasantly laid-back atmosphere – and it's really popular! Likewise, the excellent food, which represents great value for money, goes down just as well! There is a simple menu at lunchtime and, in the evening, a range of modern, seasonal tapas-style plates that are ideal for sharing. Decent wine list. Delightful little courtyard terrace.

Name: Zur Flottbeker Schmiede
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Hamburg offers a taste of Portugal in this old listed forge building, where a traditional German ambience (with authentic decor and an old open fireplace) combines with a more informal southern European feel. The menu focuses on Portuguese-Mediterranean cuisine, with a selection of delicious tapas.

Name: Flux - Biorestaurant Werratal
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Unaffected, natural, simple and honest, that's the motto here. The organic food menu includes, for example, duo of lamb with kohlrabi-spaghetti und lemon polenta. Vegetarian/vegan as well as gluten- and lactose-free options available. Idyllic garden. The Biohotel Werratal offers cosy guestrooms.

Name: Seehof
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Boasting a lovely lakeside location on the marina, this restaurant offers a popular terrace as well as its “Badische Weinstube” and panoramic “Alois” dining rooms. Flavourful and classic artisan dishes feature on the menu. Tip: the local classics ("Alemannische Klassiker"). Accommodation is also available – the “boathouse” and rooms with views are particularly recommended.

Name: philipps
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A really appealing restaurant in the Schanzenviertel neighbourhood. A few steps lead down to this lively, modern establishment on the lower ground floor, where friendly and dedicated waitstaff serve fresh international cuisine. Tip: Be sure to make a reservation – this place is small and extremely popular!

Name: Zum Rebstock
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A fun place to eat! In this historic half-timbered house (in the family since 1750) you can sit back in the delightful wood-panelled interior and enjoy charming service and really good Baden cuisine. Tip: sample the array of starters and desserts as little "temptations" (Versucherle). Great wine list. Buy some home-made cherry or plum brandy to take home with you. You can also stay overnight comfortably.

Name: Gutshof Andres
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The listed manor house has been owned by the family since 1839. Regional food served in the two dining rooms or on the pretty terrace. Two apartments.

Name: Landgasthof Mange
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: One of the best restaurants in the region! Not only do you eat really well here, the prices are also extremely fair. The cuisine is mainly regional and seasonal, with the emphasis laid squarely on select produce. Tip: try the schnapps, cakes or bread, all made by the family themselves.

Name: Gasthaus Widmann's Löwen
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This cosy establishment serves up classic regional fare and seasonal dishes made from high-quality, fresh ingredients. The Widmann family places great emphasis on their restaurant's connection to the region. Why not try "Widmann's spare ribs"? Alternatively, you could opt for a surprise menu comprising three or four courses? Don't miss the chance to enjoy the lovely beer garden in the summer – it really is a delightful spot! Cookery classes and various other events are also held here.

Name: Scheidels Restaurant zum Kranz
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Conscious of their long family history (the restaurant is now run by the seventh generation), the owners here are committed to maintaining their traditions yet the food remains resolutely down-to-earth. Charming historic ambience, plus warm and welcoming staff. Simple, tasty dishes take pride of place, inspired by regional and seasonal produce. A vegetarian menu is also available.

Name: ROSE
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The Tress family is all about organic produce, with a vegetarian and vegan take on regional cuisine taking centre stage. The complex, aromatic and carefully considered dishes win diners over with their depth of flavour – the pea and broad bean tartare, for instance, make a lasting impression. Meat can be ordered as a side dish – here, they follow the principle of nose-to-tail eating. All the wines are Demeter-certified. Should you wish to stay over, there is the guesthouse opposite.

Name: Kaltwassers Wohnzimmer
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: Wohnzimmer offers a cosy "living room" feel with some charming nostalgic touches inside and a designer atrium with view of the glazed kitchens in the interior courtyard. The modern regional cuisine uses fresh quality produce and includes dishes such as Wels catfish served with mashed potatoes and apples, kohlrabi and Ahle Worscht sausage.

Name: Talblick
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Brothers Claus and Rainer Weitbrecht are carrying on the tradition of their parents' business – the dedication of the whole family is palpable. As head chef, Claus Weitbrecht delights diners with both Swabian and international cuisine, including vegetarian dishes. The craftsmanship and harmonious flavours are excellent in equal measure. There is also a well-curated wine list. For a more upscale alternative, head to the hotel's Gourmetrestaurant. Comfortable guestrooms available.

Name: Alte Posthalterei
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Regional and seasonal cuisine is served in the delightful interior of this long-established, family-run restaurant. On the menu, classics such as trout meunière, Wiener schnitzel, and beef tenderloin goulash Stroganoff whet the appetite. For those who like to dine al fresco, a cosy beer garden nestles in the shade of the chestnut trees. There are beautiful, spacious guestrooms available for overnight stays.

Name: Gasthaus Ödenturm
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: As if straight out of a picture book, this beautiful inn stands on the edge of the forest. Diners can look forward to a friendly, family atmosphere and great food, which can also be enjoyed out on the delightful terrace. The dishes on the menu range from regional to Mediterranean. Whether you order steak, fish or local game, there is something for everyone. Modern yet cosy guestrooms for overnight stays.

Name: Landhaus Gräfenthal
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Peter Lauterbach represents the fourth generation to run this family restaurant in an idyllic location. The food is a contemporary take on regional, seasonal cuisine influenced by Mediterranean culinary tradition. Inside, pale wood, a tiled stove and pleasing decorative touches make for an inviting setting; outside there is a beautiful garden terrace. Friendly waitstaff.

Name: Melkhus
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The former cowshed of this beautifully renovated historical Immenhof estate houses this charming alternative to the Rodesand restaurant. The food is fresh, seasonal and made using regional ingredients. A reduced classics menu is served from 3-6pm, as is coffee and cake. The terrace boasts a view of the lake, Kellersee. Pick up some home-made jam, souvenirs etc at the farm shop.

Name: Anne-Sophie
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: We recommend getting a table in the light and airy winter garden: here you have beautiful views over the garden! The food is tasty and seasonal, with classics such as braised veal cheeks also proving popular. At lunchtime there is a reduced menu as well as inexpensive daily specials. The restaurant is located on the Schlossplatz, some 150m from the main hotel building.

Name: Im Kittchen
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card
Description: This little restaurant is located in the middle of the old town, in a narrow side street near the Eiermarkt. The dining area has a rustic feel and tightly packed table, which contributes to the charming atmosphere, as does the cordial proprietress, who is in charge of the service. The delicious options are written on the blackboard and also come in smaller portions as a surprise menu. The impressive wine list features around 230 labels.

Name: Weißes Roß
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: All the meat served by Hans-Jürgen Nägerl comes from the restaurant’s own butchery. This is a fact much appreciated by his guests, as are his ‘chalet snacks’ and ‘kitchen parties’. His delicious cuisine includes Tafelspitz (Viennese-style boiled beef) with herb sauce and roast potatoes.

Name: Weinbistro "George"
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This bistro is definitely worth a visit. The second dining option in the Weinhaus Uhle hotel is a wine shop and appealing restaurant that is open all day in one. Seated at bare wooden tables in an attractive space, you are served tasty dishes made from regional produce, such as "Der Pilzgarten" (The Mushroom Garden) – mushrooms from the Helvesiek mushroom garden in cream with bread dumplings. And of course, Müritz zander is also on the menu. Decent wine list. In summer, there are tables laid out front on the street.

Name: Treibgut
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: As a sophisticated alternative to Seestern, Treibgut adds to the gourmet credentials of the Lago hotel. Modern cuisine is served in a trendy and exceedingly stylish interior. There are also dishes for sharing, e.g. steak cuts, whole fish or snack platters. They offer a nice selection of goods from their own bakery, butcher's shop and ice cream factory.

Name: Weinstube Brand
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit cards not accepted,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace
Description: Here, diners can look forward to really good food which is both fresh and seasonal, as well as cordial service. Everything is pleasantly down-to-earth – just as you would expect in a wine tavern. The wine and game, like most of the produce, come from the region. Whether you opt for the classic rump steak, one of the daily specials or a vegetarian dish, be sure to leave room for the molten chocolate cake – just heavenly! Delightful courtyard terrace. In short: a fun dining experience!

Name: Heinzler
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Whether in the Jagdstube, in the Panorama Restaurant or on the great terrace (almost at the water's edge), here at the Heinzler brothers' you can look forward to good seasonal fare. For example: smoked fillet of Bodensee whitefish on a beetroot salad with horseradish mousse and potato pancake, or duo of veal in a peppercorn sauce with Brussels sprouts and fried potatoes.

Name: Zipang
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Notable sake list,Visa credit card
Description: The minimalist interior at Zipang has clean lines, muted colours and a smart silver sheen. This makes a perfect match for chef Toshiharu Minami’s mix of traditional and modern Japanese cooking styles. The restaurant is popular with Japanese diners – always a good sign.

Name: Krone
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Krone has been properly invested in: from the façade to the hotel rooms, everything is chic and high quality, the restaurant is modern and sleek. The food is very good, with select produce turned into aromatic dishes with plenty of flavour. At lunchtime, a smaller range of interesting options. If you are staying longer, Basel and Alsace are very close by.

Name: Mühlenhelle - Bistro
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This beautiful bistro with its pleasant bright, airy atmosphere is an attractive alternative to the gourmet restaurant – and the food is just as good, with tasty seasonal cuisine prepared from fresh ingredients in the open kitchen. Game dishes often feature on the menu.

Name: Almer Schlossmühle
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This carefully converted old mill next to the little Schloss Alme is a highly appealing restaurant that abounds with rustic charm. The delicious food features seasonal dishes from the regional repertoire as well as classic fare from the chef's native Austria. Head for the lovely terrace in fine weather. There are also guestrooms for an overnight stay.

Name: Freisinger Hof
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: It is easy to see why this charming inn dating from 1875 is always busy. It boasts a stylish interior, a lively atmosphere and delicious food. There are classics from Bavaria and Austria – the focus is on beef but there is also Backhendl (breaded fried chicken). If you're lucky, you'll be able to try the fabulous creamy veal goulash at lunchtime. Quick and helpful service. You can have a comfortable stay in one of the well-maintained guestrooms.

Name: Little John's
FacilitiesAndServices: Cash only,Terrace
Description: Housed in a spruce building dating from 1905, Tim Lellau's restaurant is appealingly laid-back with a Scandinavian feel. Here, attentive and well-drilled waitstaff serve high-quality, fresh cuisine. There is a choice of two set menus: "Weide & Wasser" (Pasture & Water) and the vegetarian "Wald & Wiese" (Forest & Meadow) – this can be made vegan by prior arrangement. Alternatively, you can also order à la carte. There is also a reasonably priced three-course set menu at lunchtime. From the entrance area, you can see into the kitchen, which is sure to whet your appetite! N.B. cash payments only.

Name: ElbUferei
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Just outside the centre, on the Elbe Cycle Route, a friendly restaurant with a gorgeous terrace, bar and open kitchen awaits. Here, on the ground floor of ARCOTEL HafenCity, the atmosphere is pleasantly laid back and the modern decor has a maritime feel. The menu features predominantly Mediterranean dishes (à la carte or in a set menu) along with light bites and steaks. On certain weekdays there are additional specials such as pasta or burgers.

Name: Schneider
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
