Description: This restaurant has been run by the same family ever since it first opened in 1884. Stefan Püngeler now represents the youngest generation at the helm, putting the emphasis on good seasonal produce. Mediterranean and French-classic inspired dishes are served, as well as a gourmet set menu. There are also a few classics on the menu. The wine list focuses on labels from the region. Accommodation is available in the small Sonnenhof hotel in the neighbouring village. For hikers, Dernbacher Haus on the edge of the forest is perfect for a pit stop.

Name: Lucky Leek
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: "Fine Natural Dining" is the concept here. This pleasant restaurant serves up entirely vegan cuisine in the form of a three- to five-course menu. From classics such as tofu with vegetables to vegan cheese, you can expect interesting and tasty dishes that are as popular with international guests as they are with Berliners. The service is charming. In summer, the best place to dine is on the terrace out front.

Name: Sommerau
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The trip to the Hegar family's restaurant just outside Bonndorf is definitely worth it! Nestled in a quiet valley, surrounded by woods and meadows – the setting could not be more idyllic. There's an inviting terrace, but you can also enjoy the view from inside. The cuisine is regional and seasonal, made using top-notch ingredients. In the hotel of the same name, there are cosy, modern rooms and a beautiful sauna house, plus a natural swimming pond.

Name: Seehaus
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This is a gorgeous spot at any time of the day. In the summer, the terrace overlooking the lake is perfect for a relaxed lunch or afternoon cake, and in the evening, you'll be just as happy to sit inside – there's something romantic about this charming restaurant done out in warm rustic wood. They also serve fantastic modern and international cuisine. Tip: try the homemade pannacotta for dessert!

Name: Weedenhof
Address: Mainzer Straße 6, Jugenheim in Rheinhessen, 55270, Germany
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This pretty restaurant with its wood and dry-stone interior offers a warm and welcoming setting in which to enjoy flavoursome regional dishes including veal chop in a leek crust. Don’t forget to leave a little space for the excellent desserts – the apricot dumplings with zabaglione are excellent! There are also a number of pleasant guestrooms.

Name: Landgasthaus Gidibauer-Hof
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: You eat well here, and furthermore the regional cuisine comes at very fair prices. The home-reared beef, for example, is sure to whet the appetite. The ambience is friendly, cosy and rustic. The converted cowshed is a great venue for parties. In the hotel of the same name, the guestrooms are furnished with natural wood furniture.

Name: Nil
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Diners are bound to enjoy their time here! This restaurant in the trendy Schanze district has a delightful ambience, the service is informal and friendly, and you can certainly expect to eat well. The delicious food follows the seasons and draws on international influences. Opt for the five-course set menu. Excellent and reasonably priced short wine list.

Name: Bergfriedel
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This has been a family-run business for years! The welcoming team serves delicious, fresh food that diners can enjoy as they take in the views over the Bühlertal. The wide-ranging menu includes traditional cuisine from Baden, vegetarian/vegan dishes and gourmet specialities. Add to that an extensive wine list. The chic restaurant extension is done out in a modern take on regional style. Pleasant overnight accommodation available.

Name: Behl's Restaurant
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: You really can taste the dedication of the Behl family in the excellent food on offer here as local produce is transformed into flavoursome dishes such as Blankenbach river trout with potatoes, orange carrots and saffron foam. Try for a table in the shady interior courtyard. The family also offers "spirit evenings" in its own distillery.

Name: WEINreich
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated right in the centre of a pretty little wine village, this is a wine bar with a difference. Purism and a modern spirit define the cuisine here which boasts influences from further afield than the local Palatine region. Dishes include Palatine pickled trout with sweet-sour pumpkin and rösti, and delicious curd-cheese dumplings for dessert. Charming, individual guestrooms also available.

Name: Long March Canteen
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Currently one of "the" places to eat, Long March offers a dimly lit interior, informal service and a kitchen open to the diners’ gaze. The menu features Cantonese fare in the form of a variety of dim sum and dumpling dishes. Wide selection of wines, spirits, cocktails and tall drinks.

Name: Schwarzberghof
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The food here is really good so not surprisingly this charming wood-panelled restaurant is very popular and booking is therefore recommended. The menu includes grilled turkey breast with tomatoes, peppers, courgettes, olives and rosemary potatoes, and fillet of zander with a Riesling cream sauce. Attractive garden terrace.

Name: esskunst
FacilitiesAndServices: Cash only,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The former hall of a bank is now a smart and sophisticated restaurant serving ambitious cuisine. Here, culinary tradition is tastefully combined with modern trends. On the menu, for example: char fillet, strudel dough, celery, turnips, kohlrabi. Tip: try the home-made pralines with your coffee. Charming, attentive and experienced service.

Name: Weinhaus Stern
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A popular address and deservedly so: an inviting, rustic-style interior, a pretty courtyard, friendly service and, last but not least, good seasonal cuisine. Chef Klaus Markert relies on honest craftsmanship and flavours, along with fine wines from the region. Be sure to try the house brandy production. Charming guestrooms are also available, and there are home-made fruit jams for breakfast.

Name: Weisses Rössl
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Standing in the heart of the beautiful old town is this house with a strikingly painted facade. The many regulars appreciate the pleasant, contemporary-rural ambience, charming service and fresh, tasty dishes, such as marinated salmon with wasabi and cucumber or braised venison with bread dumplings and vegetables. Small terrace in summer.

Name: Schorse im Leineschloss
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This pleasantly uncomplicated restaurant is the second in the cube-like extension of the Leineschloss, alongside Votum. The restaurant skilfully combines down-to-earth and modern, the cuisine has an international bent, but also regional influences. It's delightful to sit on the terrace by the Leinewehr or on the Platz der Göttinger Sieben. Coffee and cake in the afternoon.

Name: Froschgrundsee
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This appealing country house lies above a small lake, in the town's Schönstädt neighbourhood. Hannes Scammell shows his culinary mettle, cooking up fresh and tasty seasonal dishes. You can also dine outside. At lunchtime, the menu is somewhat reduced. Barbecue fans, take note: they also organise regular evening events dedicated to grilled meats.

Name: Altdeutsches Restaurant
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Florian Kellerbauer divides his menu into two sections "Unsere Heimat" and "Unsere Leidenschaft" (Our Homeland and Our Passion), in each the emphasis is on the quality of the ingredients. The service is friendly and charming. Thanks to its location in the historical centre, you can sit on the terrace in the heart of the action. The Deutsches Haus hotel, a patrician house from 1440, has comfortable guestrooms.

Name: Kuro Mori
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: "The Black Forest meets Asia" is the motto of this stylish restaurant run by Steffen Disch, who some will know from Gasthaus zum Raben in Horben. Kuro mori is Japanese for "black forest". Intriguing, rather unconventional modern dishes made from high-quality ingredients are conjured up in the open kitchen. At lunchtime, a small set menu is proposed, or you can choose from the evening à la carte selection. Attractive location in Freiburg's old town.

Name: Gasthaus Stromberg
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This old-established restaurant in the pedestrian zone offers minimalist-style and a friendly atmosphere as traditional meets modern. The food is seasonal and regional – try the pumpkin variations with Dorstener goat’s cheese or the beef roulade with speck and curly kale. Werkstatt, just 1. 5km away, is ideal for groups.

Name: Jouliard
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This French bistro has been set up in a well-maintained townhouse located a little outside the city centre. The kitchen proposes classic fare such as confit chicken with herbs and scalloped potatoes, as well as more modern dishes like fjord trout with potato foam, braised carrot and passion fruit. Lovely terrace out front.

Name: Villa Esche
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Built in 1903, the former coach house of Villa Esche (now the Henry van de Velde Museum) houses this bright, tastefully designed restaurant where diners can enjoy attentive service and top-notch seasonal cuisine. Opt for the four-course menu or order à la carte. At lunchtime, the options are slightly more limited but include moderately priced daily specials. Delightful terrace overlooking the grounds.

Name: Café GUPI
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Set up in what was the gardener's house on a historical country estate, this is the trendy restaurant-bar concept of the Düster and Schneider restaurateur and winemaking families. Their tasty modern dishes made with seasonal ingredients are served à la carte or as a set menu. In summer, the terrace shaded by the large trees of the lovely Läublin Park is highly inviting. The name of the restaurant is derived from the regional "GuPi" wines (Gutedel and Pinot Noir). Tip: Booking advisable.

Name: EssBar
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The outwardly unimposing restaurant run by Daniel Baur and Olga Jorich is situated only a few steps away from the Hofgarten public park. Pleasant atmosphere, plus flavoursome dishes prepared from good-quality ingredients and offering good value for money. Neither will you be disappointed by the wine list! Attractive protected terrace to the rear.

Name: Rait'ner Wirt
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This beautifully renovated and well-established 17C inn now houses attractive, comfortable guestrooms and exceedingly cosy dining rooms – and the glorious beer garden outside is a real draw in summer! The kitchen serves up regional fare, from liver dumpling soup to roast pork or fried chicken.

Name: Zum Storchen
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This establishment is run by the Trienen family in a beautifully renovated old townhouse. The food here is exceptional; the cuisine is seasonal and regional, drawing on modern and international influences. Tip: Try the daily specials as a set menu. There are two pleasant terraces: one out on the pavement, and one in the courtyard to the rear of the building, which is quieter. Comfortable modern guestrooms.

Name: Schwingshackl HEIMATKÜCHE
Address: An der Isarlust 1, Bad Tölz, 83646, Germany
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The second restaurant of Mr and Mrs Schwingshackl is also worth a visit. They use selected seasonal produce to cook dishes with a great deal of flavour, and diners get value for their money. The menu also includes dishes from the chef's homeland of South Tyrol. The terrace overlooking the Isar River is wonderful in summer!

Name: Gärtnerei
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This chic restaurant located almost directly on a strip of restaurants in Berlin-Mitte serves up modern, tasty and fresh food. On the menu you will find plenty of vegetarian dishes. The wines are predominantly Austrian – the owner is from Styria. The interior is refined and, in keeping with the horticulture-inspired name, plants and floral motifs decorate the walls.

Name: Oechsle
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Serving flavoursome dishes made from fresh, high-quality ingredients in a pleasant contemporary atmosphere, this restaurant on the corner is a real gem. Its short menu draws on both Mediterranean and classical influences. This place also doubles as a wine bar, so you can look forward to a well-curated wine list. Experienced and charming waitstaff provide great service with a personal touch. In summer, the tables out front, facing the street, are in high demand.

Name: Felsenbirne
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This modern, chic and comfortable restaurant is located right in the pretty old town, not far from the Elbe. Owner and chef Felix Mikulla uses seasonal ingredients – his dishes are fresh and delicious, as well as good value. In summer, diners can make the most of the terrace in the inner courtyard.

Name: Emilia
Address: 2  East Street, Ashburton, TQ13 7AA, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The northern Italian region of Emilia-Romagna provides the inspiration behind this classic osteria set within a former bank in the centre of town. The daily changing menu is chalked on the door of the old vault, which now houses the wines, and from the tiny kitchen comes forth flavoursome and generously priced dishes that you feel are doing you good. There’s a daily offal dish and the pasta is made in-house.

Name: Evernight
Address: Unit 1A, 3 Ravine Way Embassy Gardens, Wandsworth, London, SW11 7BH, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Notable sake list,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: You can tell that there's an experienced chef behind this trendy take on an izakaya: it’s a veritable hotspot. The sharing plates use British produce married with measured Japanese refinement. The chicken karaage is good and you’ll be reluctant to share any of your gyoza, but it’s the aged beef rib rice donabe for two that’s the real standout. Sit at the counter for the best experience.

Name: Queen of Cups
Address: 10-12 Northload Street, Glastonbury, BA6 9JJ, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This deliciously different restaurant sits within a rustic 17C inn in the heart of Glastonbury, and comes with numerous seating areas, including a cosy courtyard for sunny days. Menus showcase West Country produce and the resulting Middle Eastern and Mediterranean small plates burst with colour and flavour. Grab a friend, go for the chef’s selection entitled the ‘Queen’s Feast’ and accompany it with the ‘sharing ciders’.

Name: The Chequers
Address: 50 Rivers Street, Bath, BA1 2QA, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Whether it's Orkney scallops or Wiltshire pheasant, there’s always an appealingly muscular quality to the cooking at this popular pub set in a smart residential street amid elegant Georgian terraces. You can choose between elaborate dishes with international flavours and touches of originality or those of a more traditional bent. The homemade bread is always a must.

Name: Root Wells
Address: 12 Sadler Street, Wells, BA5 2SE, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The views of Wells Cathedral alone are enough to attract anyone here, but add in an appealing ‘veg-led’ menu of small plates, great prices and eager-to-please service, and you have a restaurant we’d all like to have on our doorstep. Ask for the fried cheese puffs while you decide what else to order; the kitchen lets the ingredients really shine and the desserts are particularly good.

Name: Yr Hen Printworks
Address: Carrier's Lane, Cardigan, SA43 1FA, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: It was a stone chapel before its printworks days for the local paper, but now the building has been lovingly restored and feels fresh and modern – this is a real gem. The menu is all about small plates and some of the meat comes from the family farm. They know how to grill, smoke and pickle; the triple-cooked chips are great; and the desserts really hit the spot. Their strapline is ‘Drink, Dine, Unwind’ and you can easily do all three without breaking the bank.

Name: The Galley
Address: 41 Fore Street, Topsham, EX3 0HU, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Set towards the older part of a delightful town, this cosy, rustic, reinvigorated bistro comes with a cheery atmosphere and prices that won’t frighten the horses. The menu is not overly long but is balanced and appealing, and the cooking is delivered with consummate care and not without some finesse. If it’s game season, don’t miss the venison. If you aren’t a local, this place will make you wish you were one.

Name: The Spärrows
Address: 16 Red Bank, Green Quarter, Manchester, M4 4HF, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Nestled under the railway arches in Manchester’s Green Quarter is a restaurant whose name is (almost) the English translation of the word ‘spätzle’ – which gives some clue as to the style of food on offer here. The dumplings and assorted pasta dishes are all made in-house and include excellent pierogi. The focus on Eastern Europe carries through to the wine list, which has a leaning towards Polish wines.

Name: Kushi-Ya
Address: 1A Cannon Court, Long Row, Nottingham, NG1 6JE, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This simple yet inviting first floor space features an open kitchen and counter dining. The cooking is Japanese but we’re not talking sushi; instead, as the name suggests, they specialise in kushiyaki: skewers of meat and vegetables, cooked over a charcoal grill. Sharing is encouraged and prices are easy on the pocket. Extend the evening with a visit to their bar, Yokocho, a few steps away in Hurts Yard.

Name: El Gato Negro
Address: 52 King Street, Manchester, M2 4LY, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The buzzy ‘Black Cat’ sits in a pedestrianised street. The ground floor houses a bar, the first floor plays host to an industrial-style dining room and the top floor is home to a private events space with a retractable roof. Appealing tapas dishes include meats from the Josper grill.

Name: Pulpo Negro
Address: 28 Broad Street, New Alresford, SO24 9AQ, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A characterful, laid-back restaurant in an old townhouse; its name translates as ‘Black Octopus’. The stylish interior features exposed brick, rough floorboards and an open kitchen. The chef-owner hails from Barcelona and his tasty, authentic tapas is accompanied by a good choice of Spanish wines.

Name: Ibérico World Tapas
Address: The Shire Hall, High Pavement, Nottingham, NG1 1HN, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: Hidden in the basement of the old city law courts and jail is this friendly, long-standing restaurant with a vaulted ceiling, colourful Moorish tiles and ornate fretwork. Mediterranean and Asian influenced dishes are listed under ‘snacks, charcuterie & cheese', 'tapas' and ‘desserts’, with 4 dishes per person being about the right amount. The ‘express’ menu represents great value.

Name: Hare & Hounds
Address: Maendy Road, Aberthin, CF71 7LG, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The chef’s passionate desire to make this 300 year old pub the most seasonal in Wales is laudable. Menus change twice daily and produce is from his 3 acre allotment and family farms – and he also hunts and forages. The cooking is unfussy yet dishes are absolutely bursting with flavour; if you get a chance, don’t miss the buttermilk pudding. A great value 'Saver' menu is available for lunch Thursday to Saturday and early evening on Wednesday and Thursday.

Name: COR
Address: 81 North Street, Bedminster, City of Bristol, BS3 1ES, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Its look is somewhere between a Mediterranean restaurant and a tapas bar, with some counter dining and shelves bursting with cookery books and wine but, more importantly, it’s imbued with an air of contagious positivity and is a perfect fit for this buzzy neighbourhood. Dishes like hake with mussels or Tropea onion with hazelnut beurre noisette really hit the spot – and the charcuterie and cheeses are also good.

Name: Waterman
Address: 5 Hill Street, Belfast, BT1 2NG, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Nothing beats the buzz of a big bistro and, judging by the numbers who flock here, the locals heartily agree. The modern, unfussy dishes are influenced by Europe, with Italy holding sway – this is the kind of food you could happily eat every day. Prices, too, are excellent, particularly considering its city centre location. The period building also houses a cookery school and event space.

Name: The Pelican
Address: 45 All Saints Road, North Kensington, London, W11 1HE, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Take a big old Victorian boozer and do it up, serve gutsy food with a British heart, and keep the menu flexible and the prices sensible – and you have a pub we’d all like to have at the end of our street. It’s hard to resist any menu that boasts such dishes as potted shrimp; faggots with peas and carrots; beef and Guinness pie; and their signature, mince on toast. It brings a patriotic tear to the eye.

Name: Plaza Khao Gaeng
Address: Arcade Food Hall, 103-105 New Oxford Street, Bloomsbury, London, WC1A 1DB, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: With an open kitchen and electric pop blaring, there's a buzzy, vintage vibe at this relaxed, homely spot in the Arcade Food Hall. Chef Luke Farrell grows many of the Southeast Asian ingredients in a tropical greenhouse in Dorset, which are then deftly used to create wonderfully authentic, punchy Southern Thai curries. Start with Miang Phuket (coconut and betel leaf wraps), then go for a curry – perhaps a hearty Massaman (beef shoulder) – or, if you're feeling adventurous, the fiery Klua King Muu (dry wok fried pork).

Name: Gunpowder Spitalfields
Address: 11 White's Row, Tower Hamlets, London, E1 7NF, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A loud, buzzy restaurant with just ten tightly packed tables, serving vibrant small plates from across the Indian regions. The name is a reference to the chef’s daily-made spice mix and his menu takes its influence from old family recipes. Standout dishes include deep-fried crab and crispy pork ribs.

Name: Cin Cin
Address: 60 Western Road, Brighton and Hove, BN3 1JD, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Cin Cin’s loyal band of customers come for its great value Italian food – a mix of homemade pastas and small plates, where fresh ingredients are simply cooked and natural flavours are allowed to shine. You can create a different experience every time you come by sitting in a different place: in front of the open kitchen, at the horseshoe counter, gazing out the window onto the street, or in the calmer rear room. There's also another branch in London.

Name: Bryn Williams at Porth Eirias
Address: The Promenade, Colwyn Bay, LL29 8HH, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: If you’re after a relaxed, friendly environment, this striking beachside brasserie with faux industrial styling, blue leather banquettes and stunning sea views is the place to come. The owner is proud of his Welsh roots and it shows on the menu. Cooking is pleasingly unfussy and local seafood is to the fore.

Name: Cornish Arms
Address: 15 West Street, Tavistock, PL19 8AN, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A mix of locals and tourists, drinkers and diners, makes for a great atmosphere at this traditional high street pub. The knowledgeable team are genuinely warm and welcoming, and the appealing dishes mix classic elements with some unusual modern twists. Boldly decorated bedrooms complete the picture.

Name: Broad Chare
Address: 25 Broad Chare, Newcastle Upon Tyne, NE1 3DQ, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Housed within a converted warehouse by the quay, Broad Chare is a ‘proper’ pub, with a cosy bar serving appetising bar snacks and over 50 beers, and a rustic first floor dining room offering a more substantial menu of hearty, punchily flavoured dishes. Fair prices and a friendly team add to its appeal.

Name: Kilberry Inn
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A remotely set former croft house whose striking red roof stands out against whitewashed walls; inside you’ll find wooden beams, open fires and a mix of bare and linen-laid tables. Classic dishes are crafted from carefully sourced local produce and meat and fish are smoked in-house. Bedrooms are modern.

Name: Galvin Green Man
Address: Main Road, Howe Street, CM3 1BG, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The Essex outpost of the Galvin’s empire is this big, busy pub, where there’s always something going on, from live music evenings to special events. The friendly team offer a warm welcome and the original 14C building provides all the rustic charm you’d expect, while a modern barn extension and a charming riverside garden complete the picture. The extensive menu offers an appealing mix of classic British and Mediterranean influenced dishes which are big on flavour, and the set lunch/early evening menu is a steal.

Name: Charlton Arms
Address: Ludford Bridge, Ludlow, SY8 1PJ, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A number of terraces offer lovely waterside views at this substantial pub on the banks of the River Teme. The cooking is a mixture of British and French classical recipes, with traditional and appealing options like fish & chips, fish soup and confit duck leg. These straightforward, well-priced dishes don’t disappoint and pack in plenty of flavour. Be sure to hang around for dessert, where a sticky toffee pudding is hard to resist. There are cosy bedrooms upstairs and the location is great for exploring nearby Ludlow.

Name: Haveli
Address: 3-5 Broadway, Darras Hall, Ponteland, NE20 9PW, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Haveli means ‘grand house’ and this neighbourhood restaurant is certainly very smart. Influences come from all over India; try one of the chef’s signature curries. Staff combine personality with professionalism.

Name: Beckford Bottle Shop
Address: 5-8 Saville Row, Bath, BA1 2QP, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: It’s now a wine shop and bistro but the building was formerly a tea merchant’s and a grocer’s, and many period features remain, including an old cast-iron range in the intimate basement lounge. The atmosphere is relaxed, the creative small plates offer great value for money and the wine selection is extensive.

Name: Blaise Inn
Address: 260 Henbury Road, City of Bristol, BS10 7QR, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in the suburbs, close to the famous folly of Blaise Castle, this simply decorated village inn serves good value, traditional British dishes cooked with a skilful, modern approach – make sure you save room for dessert! As well as quality ales and a well-chosen wine list, you'll find a pleasant rear courtyard in which to enjoy them. Personable service completes the picture.

Name: Provender
Address: West End House, High Street, Melrose, TD6 9RU, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Brunch,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This friendly, family-run restaurant is a perfect match for this lovely Borders town. The chef – a local – spent time in London before returning home, and his time with Pierre Koffmann shows through in well-executed, classically based dishes which deliver plenty of flavour and represent great value for money.

Name: Gunton Arms
Address: Gunton Park, Thorpe Market, NR11 8TZ, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This charming inn overlooks the 1,000 acre Gunton Estate deer park. Enjoy a tasty homemade snack over a game of pool or darts in the bar or make for a gnarled wood table by the fireplace in the flag-floored Elk Room. Dishes are fiercely seasonal; some – such as the Aberdeen Angus steaks – are cooked over the fire. Well-equipped bedrooms have a stylish country house feel.

Name: Sardine Factory
Address: Quay Road, West Looe, Looe, PL13 2BX, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A converted sardine factory on the quayside plays host to this laid-back first floor restaurant which affords views across the harbour to East Looe. The extensive menu champions Cornish seafood, including mussels from Fowey and fish from Looe itself – much of it cooked on the bone.

Name: Brasserie Zédel
Address: 20 Sherwood Street, Soho, London, W1F 7ED, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A grand French brasserie, which is all about inclusivity and accessibility, in a bustling subterranean space restored to its original art deco glory. Expect a roll-call of classic French dishes and some very competitive prices.

Name: The Inn at Welland
Address: Hook Bank, Welland, WR13 6LN, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Take in delightful views of the Malvern Hills from the charming terrace of this country inn or, cosy up inside, in the understated New England style dining room. Well-presented modern dishes show plenty of flair and deliver punchy flavours, and there’s a wide choice of wines by the glass.

Name: St. JOHN Bread and Wine
Address: 94-96 Commercial Street, Tower Hamlets, London, E1 6LZ, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: There is an appealingly stripped-back quality to both the food and the décor at this well-priced St. JOHN spin-off. The highly seasonal menu offers dishes that are perfect for sharing, and the cooking is as British, uncomplicated and hugely satisfying as you would expect – accompanied by suitably spartan surroundings. The brand’s nose-to-tail ethos is on show too, with options like roasted bone marrow and crispy pig’s cheek. Don’t leave without trying the baked to order madeleines.

Name: The Anchor
Address: High Street, Ripley, GU23 6AE, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Despite its name, this pub is nowhere near the water. At 400 years old, it retains an appealingly rustic feel but it also has a modern edge and a friendly, laid-back vibe. Cooking is full of flavour, with enticing snacks on offer alongside good value modern dishes of local ingredients.

Name: Fox & Hounds
Address: 2 High Street, Hunsdon, SG12 8NH, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Brunch,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A welcoming high street pub with contemporary styling. The chef’s ethos is to let good quality ingredients speak for themselves. Alongside homemade pasta dishes you’ll find meats cooked on the Josper grill and plenty of local game. Flavours are pronounced, combinations are classical and portions are hearty.

Name: Hoppers
Address: 49 Frith Street, Soho, London, W1D 4SG, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: Street food inspired by Tamil Nadu and Sri Lanka features at this fun little spot from the Sethi family, who also own Trishna and Gymkhana. The 'hoppers' – bowl-shaped pancakes made from fermented rice and coconut – are ideal with a creamy kari. The ‘short eats’ and the prices are great too.

Name: Root
Address: Unit 9, Cargo 1, Gaol Ferry Steps, Wapping Wharf, City of Bristol, BS1 6WP, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This busy, welcoming little restaurant occupies five first floor shipping containers on the old wharf. Produce from small local suppliers is used in simple yet flavour-packed small plates formed around vegetables. They have a modern, sometimes intriguing style and inventive touches.

Name: Three Oaks
Address: Austenwood Lane, Gerrards Cross, SL9 8NL, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: An appealing, well-run pub in a rural location, comprising several different areas: dine in the brighter room overlooking the terrace and pretty garden. Cooking is tasty, satisfying and seasonal, and they offer particularly good value set lunch and dinner menus. The bright young staff are eager to please.

Name: Six Bells
Address: Main Street, Witham on The Hill, PE10 0JH, United Kingdom
Location: Witham on The Hill, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: You’ll receive a warm welcome from the charming team at this bright, characterful village pub. It’s decorated in a personal style with framed maps and menus, and its shelves groan under the weight of cookery books. Dishes are skilfully crafted and chock-full of flavour; choose from sophisticated dishes on the main menu, tempting free-range rotisserie chicken or pizzas cooked in the wood-burning oven. Stylishly appointed bedrooms complete the package; Hayloft is the best.

Name: Mark Jordan at the Beach
Address: La Plage, La Route de la Haule, Beaumont, JE3 7YD, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Modern brasserie with a small lounge and bar; a paved terrace with bay views; and a dining room with heavy wood tables, modern seashore paintings and animal ornaments. Menus showcase island produce and fish from local waters. Cooking is refined but hearty, mixing tasty brasserie and restaurant style dishes.

Name: Skosh
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: This bright restaurant is located close to the 12C Micklegate Bar; sit at the counter to watch the action. ‘Skosh’ comes from the Japanese word meaning ‘small amount’; a reference to the small plates for which the restaurant is known. Many dishes have Asian influences; choose around 6 or 7 between two.

Name: The Square at Porthleven
Address: 7 Fore Street, Porthleven, TR13 9HQ, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In summer, bag a table on the terrace of this small harbourside bistro; in winter, cosy up and watch the waves crash on the harbour wall. Coffee and cakes give way to snacks and sharing platters, then to modern classics which fly the flag for Cornish produce. They have a deli and ice cream shop next door.

Name: Bao
Address: 53 Lexington Street, Soho, London, W1F 9AS, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: There are some things in life worth queueing for – and that includes the delicious buns here at this simple Taiwanese operation. It is a sweet and unpretentious place, helped along by service from a friendly young team. The classic bao and the confit pork bao are standouts, along with ‘small eats’ like fried chicken with hot sauce. They operate a number of other restaurants across London, including in King's Cross and Shoreditch.

Name: Dastaan
Address: 447 Kingston Road, Ewell, KT19 0DB, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Dastaan means ‘story’ and this simple neighbourhood restaurant is the story of two friends, Sanjay and Nand. Northern India leads the great value menu; portions are generous, spicing is superb and there are many layers of flavour. Sauces are memorable, sides add to the experience and the homemade kulfi is a must.

Name: Hope & Anchor
Address: Sluice Road, South Ferriby, DN18 6JQ, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Great view,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Wheelchair access
Description: Don’t be put off by its location next to the cement works, as this rustic, nautically themed pub with Humber views is definitely worth the visit. Carefully prepared British dishes display touches of originality and are full of flavour, with top quality ingredients leading the way and fruit and veg from their own smallholding. Meats are aged in a glass-fronted drying cabinet and cooked in the Josper oven; some are designed for sharing and they even offer Wagyu. Bedrooms are modern and some have estuary views.

Name: Twelve
Address: Marsh Mill, Fleetwood Road North, Thornton, FY5 4JZ, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Dine surrounded by exposed bricks, reclaimed wood and graffiti art at this passionately run cocktail bar and restaurant set beside one of Europe’s tallest working windmills. Hearty, wholesome cooking has a refined edge; the à la carte menu is the most innovative.

Name: BOX-E
Address: Unit 10, Cargo 1, Wapping Wharf, City of Bristol, BS1 6WP, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Wapping Wharf is home to Cargo, a retail yard made of converted shipping containers, and on the first floor is intimate BOX-E, a compact restaurant clad in chipboard and plywood. Cooking comes from the heart and dishes are rustic, assured and flavour-packed. The panna cotta is a must!

Name: Andria
Address: 5 Lower Street, Dartmouth, TQ6 9AJ, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: Born in Paris, raised on Italian home cooking and trained in the UK, head chef Luca offers an original selection of modern European small plates at this delightful modern bistro. Ingredients from Brixham and Torbay take centre stage; the crab and the Brussels sprouts are must-tries.

Name: Marmo
Address: 31 Baldwin Street, City of Bristol, BS1 1RG, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The former Guardian Assurance Building sits in the heart of this bustling city and is a charming spot with plenty of character thanks to its high ceiling, parquet floor and panelled walls. The rustic look is a perfect fit for this on-trend osteria-cum-wine-bar, where Cosmo Sterck prepares a concise menu of flavour-packed Italian dishes in the open kitchen. His smiley wife Lily, meanwhile, takes care of the organic and biodynamic wines.

Name: Sculthorpe Mill
Address: Lynn Road, Sculthorpe, NR21 9QG, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This striking former mill dates back to 1757. It has been lovingly restored by sisters Siobhan and Caitriona Peyton, who have created a chic dining pub with contemporary bedrooms and a riverside terrace. The experienced chef offers well-judged, flavoursome cooking, with plenty of vegetarian options.

Name: manteca
Address: 49-51 Curtain Road, Shoreditch, London, EC2A 3PT, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: After pop-ups in Mayfair and Soho, this bright, buzzy Italian restaurant has a permanent home. Here they follow a maximum sustainability, minimum waste ethos, from seeking out local suppliers to using a nose-to-tail approach; with everything made in-house. The appealing menus are designed to encourage sharing.

Name: The Royal
Address: 1 St Johns Road, St Leonards on Sea, TN37 6HP, United Kingdom
Location: St Leonards on Sea, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This friendly town centre dining pub is set within a boldly painted Victorian building and has a lovely vintage feel; if you want a table in the bar area, be sure to arrive early, as it’s first-come, first-served. The appealing menu focuses on top quality seasonal produce and unfussy dishes have a British heart and some Mediterranean influences.

Name: Duncombe Arms
Address: Main Road, Ellastone, DE6 2GZ, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Owners Johnny and Laura Greenall were sad to see the hub of their local village shut its doors, so in 2012 they bought it, smartened it up and reopened it as a stylish dining pub – and it’s been a hit ever since. It’s an attractive place with a delightful terrace and a neighbouring red-brick barn which houses luxurious bedrooms that look out over the fields. You'll find a few pub classics, but the majority of the menu comprises appealing seasonal dishes which are full of flavour and keenly priced.

Name: Kricket
Address: 12 Denman Street, Soho, London, W1D 7HH, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This trendy restaurant started life as a pop-up in a 20-seater shipping container and now has branches in Soho, White City and Brixton. There's not many Indian restaurants like this, that come with a counter, an open kitchen and such a great buzz. The selection of well-priced contemporary dishes are perfect for sharing and made with home-grown ingredients; the Keralan fried chicken is a must.

Name: Sha-Roe Bistro
Address: Main Street, Clonegall, Y21 KH61, Ireland
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A welcoming 17C former coaching inn set in a picturesque village; it’s a simple place with a relaxed, intimate feel and candlelit tables in the evenings. Menus offer carefully presented, unfussy dishes with clear flavours and a classical base. Sourcing of local and farmers’ market ingredients is paramount.

Name: Aldridge Lodge
Address: Aldridge Lodge, Duncannon, Y34 W650, Ireland
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This attractive house is set in a great rural location and run by cheery owners. The constantly evolving menu offers tasty homemade bread and veg from the kitchen garden. The focus is on good value fish and shellfish (the owner’s father is a local fisherman), with some Asian and fusion influences. Homely bedrooms come with hot water bottles and home-baked cookies.

Name: Pichet
Address: 14-15 Trinity Street, Dublin City, D02 T998, Ireland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: You can’t miss the red signs and striped canopies of this buzzy brasserie – and its checkerboard flooring makes it equally striking inside. Enjoy snacks at the bar or classic French dishes in the main room; the parmesan agnolotti is a must-try. A good selection of wines are available by the glass or pichet.

Name: Prashad
Address: 137 Whitehall Road, Drighlington, BD11 1AT, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Set over two floors of a former pub, this colourfully decorated, family-run restaurant offers interesting, original Indian vegetarian cooking inspired by the owners Gujarati heritage. Dishes are substantial in both size and flavour and spicing is well-judged; the dosas are popular.

Name: Rick Stein's Café
Address: 10 Middle Street, Padstow, PL28 8AP, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Don’t let the tiny shop front fool you – behind is a deceptively large café decorated with bright Cornish artwork. The concise menu offers unfussy, flavoursome dishes informed by Rick Stein’s global travels, so expect to see dishes from Europe but also from places as far afield as Vietnam, Malaysia and India. The bedrooms are simply furnished but comfy.

Name: Flint House
Address: 13 Hanningtons Lane, Brighton and Hove, BN1 1GS, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Brighton’s pedestrian district plays host to this fashionable brasserie hidden inside a red-brick house. Enjoy a drink on the terrace of the first-floor cocktail bar, then head down to the buzzy main room dominated by an open kitchen and stainless-steel counter. Appealing modern small plates have a European accent and burst with freshness and flavour. Many of the good value wines are also offered by the glass.

Name: Imad's Syrian Kitchen
Address: 2.14-2.16 Kingly Court, Carnaby Street, Soho, London, W1B 5PW, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A move to a slightly larger premises on the top floor of Kingly Court has not dimmed the ethos of this sweet restaurant. Affable chef-owner Imad was a restaurateur in Damascus before fleeing and settling in London, and his desire to provide and nourish is evident during your visit. The appealing, great value menu focuses on satisfying Middle Eastern flavours. Expect generous sharing dishes and plenty of lamb – and don’t miss the falafel.

Name: pahli hill
Address: 70-81 Mortimer Street, Regent’s Park and Marylebone, London, W1W 7SJ, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This extremely colourful, comfortable restaurant in the heart of Fitzrovia is modelled on the communal living ‘building societies’ of Bombay, and comes with striking posters, a relaxed ambience and an intimate basement bar. The menu is divided into ‘small’ and ‘big’ plates and sharing is encouraged. Dishes are confidently executed, easy to eat and full of fresh, regionally inspired flavours.

Name: Brutto
Address: 35-37 Greenhill Rents, Clerkenwell, London, EC1M 6BN, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: You can’t help but have a great night out at talented restaurateur Russell Norman’s wonderfully relaxed trattoria. It comes with gingham tablecloths, a great signature negroni and a menu of flavoursome, keenly priced Tuscan favourites, from dough ball ‘cuddles’ to beef shin and peppercorn stew.

Name: Legare
Address: Cardamom Building, 31G Shad Thames, Southwark, London, SE1 2YR, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: An unpretentious Italian restaurant in one of the converted Shad Thames warehouses; the unfussy service suits the style of the place. The seasonally influenced menu uses British produce, with the in-house pasta a particular highlight; dishes are relatively simple but flavours are bold and prices, appealing.

Name: Saint Francis Provisions
Address: Short Quay, Kinsale, P17 T880, Ireland
FacilitiesAndServices: Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: An endearing, laid-back restaurant with just 13 seats inside, and a heated terrace out front. The concise, daily changing menu offers a range of Mediterranean-inspired small plates created from the best local ingredients. Dishes are delivered from the open kitchen as and when they are ready, and offer punchy flavours and an appealing simplicity. An all natural wine list completes the picture.

Name: EDŌ
Address: 3 Capital House, Unit 2, Upper Queen Street, Belfast, BT1 6FB, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: ‘I eat’ is a smart, modish brasserie in the heart of the city, with rustic-meets-faux-industrial styling and seats at the long kitchen counter for those who want to get in on the action. The international menu allows for sharing – 3 or 4 dishes each is the perfect amount – and many ingredients are cooked over apple or pear wood in the Bertha oven. The room has a contented buzz, service is warm and welcoming, and the owner can always be seen keeping a watchful eye over proceedings..

Name: Goldie
Address: 128 Oliver Plunkett Street, Cork, T12 X5P8, Ireland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A lively, on-trend seafood bistro with an open kitchen and a stripped-back feel; the tight-knit team offer friendly service and the feel is relaxed and informal. The daily menu offers well-priced, modern dishes which use a ‘gill-to-fin’ approach, making use of the whole catch from the smaller day boats.

Name: Richmond
Address: 43 Richmond Street South, Dublin City, D02 X499, Ireland
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The owner and his team bend over backwards to make sure you have a great time at this welcomingly worn, rustic shop conversion just outside the city centre. Skilfully prepared, traditionally based dishes are robust yet refined and allow each core seasonal ingredient to shine.

Name: Noto
Address: 47a Thistle Street, Edinburgh, EH2 1DY, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Following the success of Aizle, as well as time spent in New York, Stuart Ralston opened this small plates diner in the heart of Edinburgh – and it’s been a hit ever since. Well-conceived dishes display influences which span the globe, with a particular focus on Asia. Save room for the luscious Michel Cluizel chocolate and miso dessert.

Name: Uno Mas
Address: 6 Aungier Street, Dublin City, D02 WN47, Ireland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The best seats in the house are at the counter in this buzzing, good value restaurant run by enthusiastic, personable staff. Start with some Spanish-inspired nibbles from the ‘para picar’ section before choosing one of the well-executed, unfussy main dishes which come with many layers of flavour and texture. A dedicated sherry list and a vermouth-based cocktail selection offer appealing additions to your visit.

Name: Ox and Finch
Address: 920 Sauchiehall Street, Glasgow City, G3 7TF, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Run like a well-oiled machine, this is a hugely likeable bistro with a rustic edge thanks to its tile-backed open kitchen and wines displayed in a huge metal cage. The Mediterranean dishes are big enough for sharing and showcase skilful use of simple ingredients, with the flavours really shining through. The appeal of the cooking is enhanced by its fantastic value for money, with delicious dishes like tubetti with brown butter, peas and guanciale an absolute steal.

Name: Volpe Nera
Address: 22 Newtown Park, Blackrock, A94 D780, Ireland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Nestled away in a small parade, the ‘Black Fox’ takes its name from its position midway between the suburbs of Blackrock and Foxrock. Split over two floors, the upstairs has a slightly plusher feel, while the atmosphere is livelier downstairs, in part thanks to the open kitchen. The menu evolves with the seasons, mixing Mediterranean influences like rabbit cavatelli with Asian elements like cep dumplings, across modern, flavoursome dishes. Service comes from a friendly and knowledgeable team, while a carefully curated wine list completes the experience.

Name: The Scran & Scallie
Address: 1 Comely Bank Road, Stockbridge, Edinburgh, EH4 1DT, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Comfort food abounds at this relaxed operation from the Tom Kitchin stable, which positions itself as a real neighbourhood pub, but one that also happens to serve great tasting food. As this is one of the busiest eateries in Edinburgh, you need to make sure to book if you’re to indulge in the hearty joys of steak pie, Cullen skink or fish & chips. Leave room for dessert too – if there's a bavarois on the menu, go for it.

Name: Kai
Address: 22 Sea Road, Galway, H91 DX47, Ireland
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The long-standing, sustainably minded Kai is really two places in one. At lunch, they take walk-ins only and serve one course followed by homemade cakes and pastries. Things ramp up a gear at dinner, with a 3 course à la carte heavily guided by the seasons and the local area. Dishes are often understated in appearance, but plentiful in flavour and skill. Finely judged seasoning runs throughout and keep an eye out for the specials – like a super conference pear tarte Tatin. Excellent wine pairing suggestions will enhance your visit.

Name: Kateh
Address: 5 Warwick Place, Bayswater and Maida Vale, London, W9 2PX, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: It’s wise to book ahead if you want to join the Little Venice locals who have long known what a jewel they have in the form of this buzzy, busy Persian restaurant; be sure ask for the ground floor rather than downstairs. Sharing plates, fresh salads, satisfying stews and expertly chargrilled meats served with lovely fluffy saffron rice, are all on offer – you’ll leave feeling satisfied and sated, and your wallet won’t take a battering either.

Name: Thyme
Address: Custume Place, Strand Street, Athlone, Ireland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The chef-owner here is one who’s constantly reinvesting in his beloved restaurant and is always on the search for great new local suppliers – whether that’s fresh vegetables or free-range pork – and the pride he has in his establishment is palpable. The two menus showcase the locality well, with dishes that are satisfying and flavoursome. Do try the cheeses, which are accompanied by homemade crackers made using grains from the brewery next door.

Name: Wine & Brine
Address: 59 Main Street, Moira, BT67 0LQ, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This fine Georgian house on the main street comes with a comfortable dining room, brightened by the addition of an extension. From the open kitchen, the experienced chef-owner and his team use good quality Northern Irish ingredients to prepare dishes that are big on flavour and wholly satisfying. The menu changes regularly – and game season is always a highlight.

Name: Courthouse
Address: 1 Monaghan Street, Carrickmacross, A81 X066, Ireland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: Relaxed, rustic restaurant featuring wooden floors, exposed ceiling rafters and bare brick; ask for table 20, by the window. Great value menus offer carefully prepared, flavourful dishes which are a lesson in self-restraint – their simplicity being a key part of their appeal. Friendly, efficient service.

Name: Palomar
Address: 34 Rupert Street, Soho, London, W1D 6DN, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A hip slice of modern-day Jerusalem in the heart of theatreland, with a zinc kitchen counter running back to an intimate wood-panelled dining room. Like the atmosphere, the contemporary Middle Eastern cooking is fresh and vibrant.

Name: Sargasso
Address: Unit 13, Harbour Arm, Stone Pier, Margate, CT9 1AP, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The seaside outpost of London restaurant Brawn, Sargasso sits beside the harbour wall and comes with some great views. The ethos and the menu are similar: an almost daily-changing selection of 12-15 well-priced, wide-ranging seasonal dishes. Fish from the small local boats is a highlight.

Name: Trullo
Address: 300-302 St Paul's Road, Canonbury, London, N1 2LH, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A stalwart of the local dining scene, this split-level restaurant is a hit with the locals and has a true neighbourhood feel. An open kitchen contributes to the light, buzzy atmosphere and the casually dressed service team are a perfect fit for the style of the place. The daily changing menu of rustic Italian dishes makes great use of the charcoal grill and the delicious pasta is hand-rolled before each service.

Name: Primeur
Address: 116 Petherton Road, Canonbury, London, N5 2RT, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A relaxed neighbourhood restaurant whose concertina doors fold back to reveal a quirky interior with counter seating around the edges and a huge communal table. Plates are small and designed for sharing; understated but packed with flavour – simplicity is key, allowing the ingredients to really shine.

Name: Farang
Address: 72 Highbury Park, Highbury, London, N5 2XE, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: It’s easy to understand why Farang is so popular; it’s an immensely likeable restaurant serving generous and heartwarming recipes from all regions of Thailand – and even with overly eager ordering, you finish up with a bill that isn’t too overwhelming. The ‘Feasting’ menus – which includes a vegetarian version – are great for groups, and you’ll find it hard to resist buying some of their produce in the little store area on the way out too.

Name: Plaquemine Lock
Address: 139 Graham Street, Islington, London, N1 8LB, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A unique and very colourful pub named after a small city in Louisiana and with a menu centred around Creole and Cajun traditions. Dishes like gumbo with okra, blackened chicken, and crawfish with corn and potatoes are carefully cooked and packed with flavour. Big Easy style cocktails add to the fun.

Name: Everett's
Address: 22 High Street, Waterford, X91 Y983, Ireland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This proudly run, welcoming bistro is set in the heart of the city and dates from the 15C; sit on the ground floor with its barrel-fronted bar or in the intimate vaulted brick cellar. Modern menus showcase the best of the Irish larder and generously-sized dishes are assured, refined and full of flavour.

Name: Chart House
Address: The Mall, Dingle, V92 T2R9, Ireland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This characterful former boathouse sits in a pleasant quayside spot. The charming open-plan interior features exposed stone and stained glass, and the room has a cosy, intimate feel. Seasonal local ingredients feature in rustic, flavoursome dishes and service is friendly and efficient.

Name: Cush
Address: by the Pier, Ballycotton, P25 FY94, Ireland
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Family owned and run, Cush is a cosy, traditional pub with a smart, modern restaurant, comfy bedrooms and views out over the rooftops to the fishing boats in the harbour. Local produce features in hearty dishes, with seafood naturally to the fore, and guests are well looked after by the friendly team. A set menu is available in the pub area, with an à la carte and tasting menu on offer in the restaurant.

Name: Bonnie Badger
Address: Main Street, Gullane, EH31 2AB, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Tom and Michaela Kitchin have created their version of a pub in an old coaching inn dating from 1836. The bar serves pub classics, the dining room offers dishes with a 'nature to plate' philosophy and, in the garden, dishes are cooked on a Big Green Egg. Super comfy bedrooms showcase Scottish designers.

Name: Éan
Address: Druid Lane, Galway, H91 WD26, Ireland
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: By day, this eatery by the Druid Theatre is a busy artisan bakery-cum-café, serving pastries, sandwiches, salads and soups. At night it transforms into a busy and warmly run wine bar-cum-restaurant offering natural, biodynamic and organic wines, alongside a short but appealing menu of creative, seasonal dishes designed for sharing. The squid toast with miso mayo has become everyone’s favourite dish.

Name: Paradise
Address: 61 Rupert Street, Soho, London, W1D 7PW, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Vibrant sharing plates fuse Sri Lankan family recipes with British, Portuguese, Malay, South Indian and Dutch influences. Meats come from some of the finest farms in the UK, whilst vegetables and spices come from Sri Lanka. The on-trend industrial setting features counter seating and booths.

Name: Hereford Road
Address: 3 Hereford Road, Bayswater and Maida Vale, London, W2 4AB, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A converted Victorian butcher’s shop; now a relaxed and friendly neighbourhood restaurant. It specialises in tasty British dishes without frills, made using first-rate seasonal ingredients; offal is a highlight. Booths for six people are the prized seats.

Name: Berenjak
Address: 27 Romilly Street, Soho, London, W1D 5AL, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Based on the hole-in-the-wall 'kabab' houses of Tehran, with exposed brick and painted plasterwork; the best place to sit is at the open kitchen counter opposite the tandoor and the mangal barbecue. Cooking is fresh and tasty; try the coal-cooked aubergine and the goat shoulder kabab.

Name: Kudu
Address: 119 Queen's Road, Southwark, London, SE15 2EZ, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Brunch,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Kudu is run by a young husband and wife team, who attract an equally fun and youthful local clientele. Patrick’s South African roots are evident in dishes like the must-try scallop potjie and the ‘braai’ lamb neck – and the brioche-style bread with bacon butter is memorable. Sit up at the bar to see the care which the kitchen puts into the original dishes. Amy and her service team are delightful, and laughter fills the buzzy room.

Name: Table Forty One
Address: 41 Main Street, Gorey, Y25 E1X7, Ireland
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Having worked in various hotels and restaurants around the world, Gorey native Andrew Duncan has returned home to open this cosy, welcoming restaurant. The concise seasonal menu offers classic, technically adept dishes with a great balance of texture and flavour. The wine list is short yet well-priced.

Name: Spitalfields
Address: 25 The Coombe, Dublin City, D08 YV07, Ireland
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Set in a historic area of this city is this fittingly traditional-looking Irish pub, where the charming staff offer a warm and friendly welcome. It’s deservedly busy – drinkers are welcome but most are here for the food. Enticing dishes are fresh, flavoursome and great value, with the likes of oxtail and bone marrow Parker House rolls.

Name: Noble
Address: 27a Church Road, Holywood, BT18 9BU, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Hidden away in the centre of town is this compact little restaurant where the service is warm and genuine and the room has a happy buzz. Good value dishes showcase carefully prepared local ingredients in unfussy combinations, where bold flavours exceed expectations. Be sure to check out the daily specials on the blackboard; for dessert, don’t miss the chocolate délice.

Name: Stag & Hounds
Address: 4 Main Street, Burrough on the Hill, LE14 2JQ, United Kingdom
Location: Burrough on the Hill, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This traditional 16C village pub sits at the heart of the local community; find yourself a cosy corner and settle in amongst the locals and their dogs. The concise, weekly changing menu has plenty of appeal and offers fresh, recognisable dishes that show an experienced hand is in the kitchen. The lunch menu is great value – and you may well find that your fruit and veg has been grown by the green-fingered villagers themselves.

Name: Bancone
Address: 39 William IV Street, Strand and Covent Garden, London, WC2N 4DD, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: It’s all about freshly made pasta and great value at this lively Covent Garden Italian. Start off with antipasti like burrata, prosciutto or grilled artichokes, before moving on to the main event; there’s a range of pastas available, but the best of all might still be the signature ‘silk handkerchiefs’ with walnut butter and confit egg yolk. Sit up at the open kitchen to watch the chefs working their magic – ‘bancone’ is Italian for ‘counter’ after all.

Name: Upstairs (at Trinity)
Address: 4 The Polygon, Lambeth, London, SW4 0JG, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The open-plan kitchen is the focus of this more relaxed room upstairs from Trinity. It’s all about sharing the visually appealing, flavoursome and reasonably priced plates, which bring a hint of the Mediterranean with them.

Name: Provender
Address: 17 High Street, Redbridge, London, E11 2AA, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: ‘A little piece of France in Wanstead’ is the tagline at this busy and welcoming neighbourhood bistro – and they certainly deliver it. The extensive menu is a roll-call of classic French dishes from escargots and soupe à l’oignon to coq au vin and steak frites. They prove to be well-cooked too, providing satisfying flavours at fair prices. A startlingly good value prix fixe is available throughout the day Tuesday to Thursday and for lunch only on Friday and Saturday.

Name: Kiln
Address: 58 Brewer Street, Soho, London, W1F 9TL, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card
Description: There’s an obvious passion to the whole team at this lively little restaurant that offers fiery, authentic Thai dishes. Clay pots, woks and grills all feature on a well-priced menu that takes its influences from Laos, Myanmar and Yunnan. Dishes showcase the skill of the chefs to pack in plenty of spice without losing the natural flavours of the ingredients. The ground floor counter – a great spot to watch the chefs at work – is available for walk-ins only; groups of up to six can book seats in the basement.

Name: Popolo
Address: 26 Rivington Street, Shoreditch, London, EC2A 3DU, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Skimmed concrete floors and exposed brick walls give this restaurant a utilitarian feel; sit at the counter and chat to the chefs as they work. Italian, Spanish and North African influences feature on the menu of small plates. Pasta is a highlight and classic, simply cooked dishes allow the ingredients to shine.

Name: Deanes at Queens
Address: 1 College Gardens, Belfast, BT9 6BQ, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This bustling modern brasserie offers great value, day and night. Those after coffee and cake or a cocktail should make for the bar, while the terrace is a great spot on a sunny day.
