Indeed, an annual beer festival, an awe-inspiring beer menu and knockout beer associations demonstrate the star role of brewed beverages here. Chef Sainte pairs this ethos with no-nonsense food that shines the spotlight on nostalgic Flemish recipes, albeit with subtle modern touches. Rare beef is served with fresh green peas, asparagus and a gutsy gravy: rugged, generous cooking that hits the spot every time and which never fails to bring a smile to the face of satisfied diners.

Name: Bistrot L'îlot
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A Parisian vibe mixed with industrial and minimalist details sets the welcoming scene. The bistro’s theme revolves around a selection of pure, varied and delicious dishes to be shared. “What you see is what you get” is their motto! The Euro 45 menu is great value-for-money.

Name: Ni Shifu
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The full scope of Sichuan cuisine is unveiled in this relatively unassuming restaurant, whose 10-page something menu seems endless! The talented chef plays with Chinese herbs, hot spices and a myriad of textures. The epitome of generous, Ni Shufu revolves around discovery and pleasure, without killer prices!

Name: Elea Ouzeri
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Aromatic courgette fritters, fried squid dusted with lemon peel and oregano, melt-in-the-mouth moussaka as gutsy as it generous: this friendly restaurant rolls out the red carpet of traditional Greek cuisine, unveiling flavours that will leave your tastebuds aching for more. ‘Sharing is caring’ is their motto and the extensive Mezze menu is emblematic of their generous approach to Mediterranean style dining.

Name: L'Echappée Belle
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The quintessence of a Bib Gourmand, this eatery is embodied by Grégory and Camille’s warm friendly welcome. The couple has created strong ties with local producers, such as Ferme d’Artagnan and Ferme Fourchette, who have become part of the family. The chef crafts their excellent ingredients generously and creatively, underscoring the distinctive flavour of Belgian endive with braised beef cheeks, crunchy celeriac and marinated onion. Authentic Liège recipes and a fine view of the cottage garden from the terrace.

Name: dis-moi où ?
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Tell me where? Well, here! If you are looking for food that combines tradition and generosity, this upbeat eatery is the place for you (don’t forget to book). Chef Nicolas Michiels not only knows how to concoct good sauces and grill meat to perfection, he is also a dab hand at whipping up more elaborate recipes of great delicacy. He might mix a subtle quenelle of scallops and langoustine with a seafood jus, creating an exquisitely delicate balance. Choosing from the extensive menu may pose something of a conundrum. Why not try one of the excellent whiskeys suggested by the chef at the end of your meal?

Name: l'Apropos
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: After a facelift, L’Apropos now sports a warm, bright interior with colourful artwork. Chef Fournier shares his love of world, Mediterranean, Asian and North - African food, which he skilfully mixes and prepares, demonstrating a flawless sense of balance.

Name: L'Entre D'Eux
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Caroline Druine combines delicacy and generosity in dishes that demonstrate her commitment to local, organic ingredients. For example, she pairs wild boar from the next-door forest with “grandma’s” red cabbage and a gutsy dark brown cocoa sauce that is so good you will be licking your fingers after mopping it up with bread! The casual vibe is further amplified by Alexandre’s natural, friendly service. A small patio in the garden planted with pear trees is ideal for alfresco summer dining.

Name: Michel
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Time seems to have stood still at Michel’s. From the classical interior to the traditional, no - frills food, everything is authentic. Walloon produce and young cockerel take pride of place on the table. A treat for your taste buds.

Name: Instroom
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit cards not accepted,Maestro,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus
Description: Instroom is both a restaurant and a vocational apprenticeship project designed to help people from underprivileged backgrounds find employment. In an industrial loft vibe, the staff from all over the world mixes their culinary memories with local customs. Chef Seppe Nobels, a vegetable champion, adds his culinary know-how and training to accompany this whirlwind food tour through Afghanistan, Nigeria, Venezuela, etc… An exciting foodie adventure!

Name: De Farmasie
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A good meal is just what the doctor ordered! So, book a table quickly in this fashionable establishment, quirkily adorned with a 17C pharmacy cabinet. The chef, a keen “farm to table” adept who is equally at home with rib steak and Thai curry, demonstrates an innate flair for flavours and tastes. The owner adores sharing his love of fine (Italian) wine with diners.

Name: Des Ardennes
Address: rue de la Hate 1, Corbion, 6838, Belgium
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The Maqua family’s charming hotel has been welcoming guests in the Ardennes since 1900 and several generations continue to work in the family establishment. The peaceful rooms overlook the rolling countryside, while in the restaurant, the accent is on satisfying French favourites, albeit in keeping with today’s tastebuds. The cooking is spot on and flavoursome. Splendid wine cellar.

Name: Le Moulin
Address: rue de la Lesse 61, Daverdisse, 6929, Belgium
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: While on your getaway in the Ardennes be sure to knock on the door of this old mill. The welcome is warm, the setting cosy and the prices reasonable. The menu boasts up - to - the - minute flavours and an excellent lunch special. On the garden terrace you can hear the soothing sound of the river.

Name: Fico
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Nadia Bruno pays tribute to Sicily and her mamma, Grazziella, at Fico. The friendly vibe and colourful vintage interior provide the perfect foil to sun-drenched cooking. Street food, classics such as vitello tonnato and orecchiette al ragu salsiccia… Everything is consummately crafted, flawlessly fresh and emblematic of Italian flair!

Name: Appel Thaï
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Appel Thaï, which is a firm favourite with fans of Asian fare, makes the most of its lush green oasis in Anderlecht. Choose between the peaceful terrace or the buzzier, casual vibe indoors. Fresh, spicy, intense flavours crafted by a veteran chef. Home-made nems served with a tingling sauce, rich massaman curry or a Pad Thai all cooked to textbook perfection: high-flying Thai cuisine in an unstuffy, relaxed setting. Wide variety of choice and dependable first-rate quality.

Name: Erasmo
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Venetian chef Matteo Vianello chalked up experience in the kitchens of Alain Ducasse and Jean-François Piège before becoming chef at Mensae and at Sellae. Now closer to the sea, in Finistère, he has dedicated his small contemporary bistro to the island of Sant'Erasmo (home of the famous purple artichoke). He has certainly not lost his touch, revisiting the classics in mouth-watering dishes that draw convincingly on the Breton and Italian repertoires – for instance, onion soup and tiramisu.

Name: Ose
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: After stints in top establishments from New York to Paris, two veteran chefs now swap places every fortnight, taking turns in the open kitchen and the dining room. 100% bistronomic cooking from scratch using local, fresh, seasonal ingredients is the backbone of this bistro in the Abbesses neighbourhood. The menu, chalked up on a slate daily, is bang-on confident with a strong French bias and showcases deceptively simple recipes. ‘Ose’ means to dare – so what are you waiting for?

Name: Kwon
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted
Description: Cinema, TV series and… food! Korean culture has become omnipresent in France – much to our delight. This restaurant's trendy decor has a minimalist, industrial feel, a menu of Korean classics such as barbecue and bibimbap, and above all a keen sense of detail. The care taken over the accompaniments is particularly clear to see, whether you opt for the emblematic kimchi, crunchy beans with a smoky flavour, caramelised lotus flower or cucumber with chilli. This is generous and fresh fare and good value for money!

Name: L'Ourse
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This tiny bistro is decorated with paintings and knick-knacks, as well as a bear costume from the Paris Opera House. At lunchtime, chef Céline Mingam (formerly at Le Galoubet in Arles) cooks exclusively (delicious) market-inspired daily specials that are chalked up on the board. In the evening, the à la carte menu is expanded and just as tasty: roasted aubergine, feta, spiced yoghurt, fresh herbs; guinea fowl supreme, roasted grenaille potatoes, braised fennel, meat jus with tarragon... The bill is very reasonable.

Name: Solelh
Address: 30 avenue des Compagnons de la Libération, L'Isle-sur-la-Sorgue, 84800, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The owners of the star establishment, le Vivier, were happily inspired when they decided to open this welcoming bistro (open kitchen, trendy designer furnishings, double terrace) wedged between an antique dealer and an art gallery, near the station and a stone’s throw from the Carré des Arts du Luberon. The chef rustles up modern versions of traditional bistro recipes, dishes to share, ribs of beef and monkfish tail on a Japanese barbecue. The small selection of regional (but not only) wines adds the finishing touch to an excellent, sun-drenched meal…

Name: L'Orangerie
Address: 9 rue de la Prépoise, Pornic, 44210, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Trained by some of the best (Alain Dutournier, Jean-Michel Lorrain, Alain Ducasse), chef Julien Lainé creates pleasant cuisine that surfs between tradition (leek vinaigrette; veal vol-au-vent; rice pudding) and modernity (skate wing and citrus fruit shortbread garnished with sea urchin mousse; scallops decorated with a clementine coulis and burnt lemon confit). In a tourist town like Pornic, the presence of this place with its two colourful little dining areas and an open kitchen is most welcome.

Name: Le Colvert
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This delightful house surrounded by greenery was for many years a grocery - cum - bakery; now it is the meeting place of fine food lovers! The chef whips up market - fresh recipes in tune with the seasons – maillard duck, guinea fowl stuffed with goat’s cheese and mushrooms; fine selection of vintages to drink with your meal.

Name: Osma
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: "Osmazôme is a term popularised by the gastronome Brillat-Savarin to define the principle of the sapidity of game in broths," explains Valentin Barbera. Having worked at Le Lièvre Gourmand in Orléans and Christian Têtedoie in Lyon, this young chef nevertheless elected to set up his trendy "table de copains" – a place for friends to eat together – in an out-of-the-way village in the bocage landscape of the Perche region. The tables, lit by a cascade of pretty designer wall lights, are made from salvaged railway carriage floors. The on-point dishes are made using only local ingredients, or as good as: lentils, pumpkin, wood sorrel; egg, potatoes, pike eggs; turnip, eel. All of the wines are natural.

Name: Acte 2
Address: 3 rue de la Petite-Calade, Avignon, 84000, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In the city of the famous arts festival, theatre is even part of the restaurant experience. Act I: a young couple of professionals set up shop in the historical centre. Act II: dishes that exude good, fresh local and seasonal ingredients. Act III: excellent value for money. The scene is set! Tuck into the free-range egg cooked at 64°C and served on a tarte fine with fresh peas; cod steak, cooked to melt in the mouth and served with a selection of fresh vegetables, a herb condiment and lime emulsion. The dessert named "La vie en rose" is a deliciously heady treat.

Name: Alebrije
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: After training at the Paul Bocuse Institute and a number of noteworthy spells in top establishments, such as Troisgros, youthful Carla Kirsch, who hails from Veracruz in Mexico, has settled in the Croix-Rousse district. The signature here is clearly Mexican from the décor, which features old rafters with splashes of colour, to the food, which Carla joyfully crafts using top-notch seasonal ingredients (sweet corn in the starter and chili peppers in the dessert). The menu changes monthly and the beverages include a few Mexican wines as well as tequilas and mezcals.

Name: Le Bel'Art
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Sandrine and Vincent Cardoso (formerly of the Forge at Milhac d’Auberoche) can now be found in a modern edifice done up in a minimalist vibe. A feast of tender loving care has, however, been lavished on the food and nothing leaves the kitchen that hasn’t been puzzled over and preened to perfection. First-rate local produce (milk-fed veal, walnuts, blueberries), splendid vegetable side dishes (celeriac and potatoes with stuffed poultry), jus and sauces (verbena-flavoured butterscotch milk): every bite unveils the chef’s virtuoso technique and flair. The lunchtime menu is a bargain.

Name: La Table de Nernier
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace
Description: In a medieval village on the banks of Lake Geneva, between Yvoire and Messery, you are invited to cross the threshold of this charming inn. Inside, rustic (terracotta tiles, beams) and contemporary features (pendant lights, designer chairs) are a match made in heaven. The chef's cuisine is seasonal, simple and tasty, by virtue of impeccable technical skill, as in the excellent porcini in parsley or the roasted zander with a meurette sauce. Menu updated on a monthly basis. Smiling and attentive service courtesy of the maître d' (the chef's partner). Pleasant terrace on a charming little square.

Name: La Table de Mee
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This Korean restaurant pays tribute to the country's specialities in a stripped-back interior dominated by wood and with a counter where diners can sit and watch the chef working at his large plancha. Punchy flavours and sauces are the order of the day, courtesy of the obligatory kimchi, Korean fried chicken and delicious ssams (wraps). The mackerel fillets simmered in a soya, chilli and white radish broth is a standout dish. Insightful tips from an experienced sommelier (ex-Gaya and Pilgrim) will help you choose from the selection of wines and craft beers.

Name: Rouge
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Behind the port, in the antique dealer neighbourhood, a disciple of Yves Camdeborde is at the helm of this friendly wine bar. The chef prepares lovely Mediterranean sharing plates, concocted with ultra-fresh produce. It is delicious and hearty, and the wallet doesn't take too heavy a hit. A hundred or so lively wines feature on the list, also at reasonable prices. Open all day from noon (no reservations taken).

Name: Double Dragon
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: In this friendly "Asian canteen", sisters Katia and Tatiana Levha offer simple dishes of mixed inspiration (China, Philippines, Thailand etc) in an upgraded "street food" vein. This is cooking that is full of character, with pronounced flavours, and often deliciously spicy. A fun experience and tasty fare.

Name: Hostellerie du Prieuré
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This 18C sandstone former convent chants a pure-bred Gallic culinary litany based on regional produce (rack of lamb from the Moselle meadows, fillet of Lorraine beef) and seafood (brill, line-caught whiting, scallops). The portions are generous and the desserts by Maeva (the owners’ daughter) are divinely decadent, illustrated by her Grand Marnier-flavoured strawberry soup. Charming welcome.

Name: Le Café des Arts
Address: 2 rue de la Poste, Beaulieu-sous-la-Roche, 85190, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Make a beeline for this peaceful town and meet Virginie and Antoine Préteux, a young yet experienced couple. Antoine conjures up flavoursome recipes, sprinkled with modern twists to suit today’s palates. His recipes are inspired by market availability and the seasons in a bid to celebrate regional, often organic produce. Spruce, colourful interior.

Name: Vidal
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: In this restaurant opened in 1984, the Vidal family (father, son and daughter-in-law in the kitchen, Mrs Vidal front of house) serve a delicious repertoire that is an intelligent take on tradition: tasty dishes that highlight a series of small local producers (noire du Velay lamb, fin gras du Mézenc beef, market gardeners...). Aurélien's pâté en croûte is a fine technical feat and deserves a special mention.

Name: PY Restaurant
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In this dinky brasserie in a classy neighbourhood, Pierre (in the kitchen) and Yuko (front of house) are a champion team. Take a seat in a trendy décor to sample hearty, well-crafted dishes that set the tastebuds tingling: Basque black pudding à la plancha, fried squid and creamy mushy peas – without forgetting the knockout desserts, such as creamy grapefruit, olive oil biscuits and mango sorbet. The evening menu features a wider range of top-notch ingredients (lobster, beef fillet, sweetbread).

Name: L'Épine
Address: 19 place de la République, Azay-le-Rideau, 37190, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Blackthorn (épine or prunelier in French) is a thorny bush or tree commonly found in the hedgerows of France, whose purple-blue berries (sloes) are often turned into liqueur (or sloe gin). Chef Sébastien used to go picking wild fruit with his grandfather when he was little, hence the restaurant’s name. This former school dating from 1866 is a haven of good taste: exposed ceiling beams, large windows leading onto a terrace shaded by trees, designer lighting and works of art. The chef signs a bistronomic, seasonal menu which celebrates local produce and artisans, at affordable prices.

Name: Veronatuti
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Start with a salad of fennel and orange of Sicilian inspiration, followed by a main course from Emilia-Romagna (stracotto of braised beef in red wine, carrots and onions) and a dessert of Lombardy and Piedmont inspiration (homemade ice cream served with a crumble of sbrisolona made with roasted corn (farina bòna) and a thin layer of chocolate). The owners of this authentic trattoria embark their diners on a whirlwind culinary tour of Italy. Everything is fresh and homemade - even the coffee comes from a local roaster. Delicious food without killer prices.

Name: Racines
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace
Description: The roots of this bistro go back to the family history of the proprietors, a young couple: on one side of the family, a butcher's shop specialising in choice meats (especially milk-fed veal from the Limousin) and on the other, chickens and orchards. The chef, former second in command at L'Esquisse, knows all about good produce, as his dishes show: slow-cooked egg, crozets pasta, brezain cheese; onglet de veau (veal steak), polenta, grilled leek, garlic condiment.

Name: Auberge du Pont de la Zorn
Address: 2 rue de la République, Weyersheim, 67720, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Marquetry art from Atelier Spindler, antiques, lightened beams and untreated wood tables: the dining area displays its Alsace heritage with pride! On the menu: tasty regional specialities, such as bœuf gros sel (boiled beef), and flammkuchen in the evening. Bucolic terrace on the bank of the River Zorn. Then there is the impeccable welcome and service – this place deserves its success.

Name: Bistrot la Coulemelle
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In the middle of the village, this is the delightful "bistro annexe" of Régis and Jacques Marcon's fine dining restaurant. The traditional pâté en croûte "Richelieu", skate wing terrine, roasted cauliflower and mushrooms, cheeses from Ardèche and Auvergne. What more can we say? This is hearty fare and devilishly good. The open kitchens lend the place an inviting feel.

Name: L'Alicanta
Address: Route de Meyrueis, Le Rozier, 48150, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: L'Alicanta has been on the scene for a while, perched on the banks of the River Jonte, in the exceptional setting of the Gorges du Tarn. The chef puts in a solid performance, his cooking is replete with distinct flavours and his dishes are brilliantly assembled. Everything here is home-made and the menu changes with every season. Absolutely delicious!

Name: Le Saint-Georges
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In his restaurant, just a roll of the dice from the casino, Paul Courtaux doesn’t gamble with our appetites. He crafts vibrant, flavoursome cuisine, which cleverly shines the spotlight on regional produce, illustrated by frothy cold fish soup with an aïoli of cuttlefish and mussels, or a slice of Ségala veal simmered in lemon, basil, aubergines, tomatoes and parmesan… The splendid regional wine list deserves special mention, as does the charismatic welcome.

Name: La Chaumière
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Put your skis away! You won't be able to resist this lovely thatched cottage at the entrance to the resort with an interior where wood predominates. On the menu find a fine selection of Catalan dishes, delicious tapas and good regional wines. The proprietor likes the finer things in life (choice meats, locally grown vegetables) and has even set up a ham cellar!

Name: La Table de Léo
Address: 13 rue de l'Abbaye (Le Bourg), Saint-Avit-Sénieur, 24440, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This stone - built house in the heart of the village has a pretty terrace overlooking the church square. Inside, you will discover a great little restaurant with a chef who dares to branch out from the usual regional fare. He pays special attention to his ingredients and how best to present and cook them.

Name: La Belle Étoile
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: At this residence overlooking the Dordogne, wonderful surprises await you. The delicious food showcases the best of local produce and is an absolute delight. There are pretty guestrooms, should you wish to extend your stay in this pretty village.

Name: Les Canailles Ménilmontant
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: In the heart of Ménilmuche, just beyond the boulevard, two partners have set up shop behind this colourful façade, formerly the site of the Bistrot Blanc Bec. The two cohorts have opted for a tried and tested formula: quintessential, traditional nosh, full of flavour and generosity. Competent, efficient service.

Name: L'Alchimie
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Picture an infectiously buzzy neighbourhood hangout, underscored by the vibrant colour scheme of a refurbished bistro. A concise menu, succulent dishes, prices that make sense and the talent of a master chef: such is the secret of this establishment’s success, which is often fully booked. Velvety butternut, chestnut and bacon soup; tandoori-flavoured roast turkey with black rice and vegetables: high-flying culinary technique by a gourmet alchemist.

Name: The Presbytere
Address: 16 rue de la Sienne, Heugueville-sur-Sienne, 50200, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In a picturesque nook of Normandy, English chef Edward Delling-Williams (formerly of the Grand Bain in Paris) fell in love with this presbytery that he has turned into a venue that is somewhere between an English pub and a Normandy bistro. Untreated wood tables, hunting trophies, a huge stone fireplace and bare rafters set the scene for hungry diners to dig into dishes ranging from mussels with aïoli and confit of duck served with a knock-out cucumber and mint salad to melt-in-the-mouth courgette cake. A staunch advocate of local produce, Ed has no lack of projects up his sleeve, including the creation of a small farm.

Name: Le Temps d'Aime
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In the modern neighbourhood of Port Ariane, this family restaurant (father and son work in tandem) is certainly a good bet. Whether you opt to eat on the terrace or inside the contemporary restaurant, the cuisine is all about fresh seasonal ingredients, most from short food supply chains, and cooked market fresh for optimal flavour. The bill is very reasonable.

Name: Le Bouchon Bourguignon
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Within the contemporary setting of this annexe of Yohann Chapuis' fine dining restaurant, treat yourself to generous and meticulous Burgundian-inspired cuisine. The regional classics are present and correct: "Maison Greuze" pâté en croûte, eggs meurette (in a red wine sauce), fresh frog's legs in a parsley sauce, Bresse chicken with morels and vin jaune, Charolais beef. For dessert, the floating island with pink pralines or the Mâcon wafers will round off your meal perfectly.

Name: AHPĒ
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In a neighbourhood at a remove from the centre, this colourful, bustling bistro with caramel-toned walls and cheerfully mismatched furniture celebrates each season (the name is made up of the first letters of the four seasons) in a light-hearted atmosphere. Chef Idir Fseil is a fan of fermentation, but also of open-fire and a la plancha cooking, and he prepares a good market cuisine: white tuna, cucumber water and orange in brine; pork belly with green chilli, raw cream and beetroot; beef tartare, fermented black radish, bottarga and grenaille potatoes. Booking is essential.

Name: Au Clair de la Vigne
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace
Description: Run by an enthusiastic wine buff, this gourmet bistro also benefits from the culinary talent of a former chef of Christophe Bacquié. The food is authentic, generous and delicious. The regularly renewed slate menu stars a traditional bistro line-up, albeit with an updated Mediterranean tang: mint-flavoured courgette gazpacho and courgette flowers stuffed with Brousse cow’s cheese; roast Mediterranean dentex (fish) and risotto-style celeriac; pistachio-flavoured financier with strawberry soup… Located in a semi-pedestrian street just behind the waterfront, it is thankfully and peacefully off the beaten tourist track.

Name: L'Oustalet Maïanen
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace
Description: This discreet and pleasant restaurant is located opposite the former home of Frédéric Mistral. Enjoy the tasty Provençal cuisine under the Virginia creeper arbour.

Name: Orizhon
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In their restaurant next to the port of Audierne, this pair certainly open up new culinary horizons. The chef is from Brazil, the floor manager hails from Finistère and together they serve up delicious, aromatic cuisine that will make you happy you came. The chef, of course, draws on the local pantry – most notably fish and seafood, to which she judiciously adds modern and exotic touches. Buckwheat pancakes taco style, pork confit, lovage; tuna tart, tomato chutney with spices; grilled octopus, beetroot, fresh goat's cheese, red wine vinaigrette. Pleasantly colourful and contemporary interior decor; terrace with a view of the port.

Name: Cucina Mutualité
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The colourful modern bistro decor and extremely cordial staff make for an appealing atmosphere. As for the food, the wonderful seasonal Italian menu is a pageant of authentic, flavourful and truly generous dishes: you won't be disappointed by the melt-in-the-mouth braised ox cheek paccheri... al dente, obviously! You may even be allowed a second helping.

Name: Une Table à Deux
Address: 10 rue de la Pleau, Toulouse, 31000, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: After learning the ropes in Toulouse, Morgane and Nicolas made a beeline for Korea and Malaysia to research new flavours. Back in their hometown, they have chosen the Carmes district to regale diners with playful recipes that blend Mediterranean and tropical flavours, resulting in impressively curated and beautifully balanced dishes. Fantastic value for money lunchtime menu.

Name: L'Esprit Bistrot
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A remote village in the north of Isère, a small, non-descript bistro: you can't help but wonder what they'll be feeding you here. The answer is excellent food prepared by an enthusiastic chef with undeniable talent, who has worked in Michelin-starred restaurants (including with Gilles Goujon and Michel Kayser). The long list of local producers with whom he works makes your mouth water! For starters, fresh foie gras with walnut wine, pear compote and toasted brioche, or venison and veal pâté en croûte with vegetable pickles; for the main course, roast quasi of veal with salsify in an espuma, roasted and cut into crisps, drizzled with veal jus. Lunch during the week is excellent value for money.

Name: Auberge Le Nézil
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: With its white façade with small windows and thatched roof, this cottage is the epitome of a Brière inn! The chef concocts his meticulous cuisine, adding the odd bold twist here and there that he always pulls off with great skill, as can be seen in his grilled scallops, lentils, Granny Smith and smoked bacon; Vendée duckling, olive purée with black garlic, parsnip croquettes, passion fruit vinaigrette... Original dishes, good produce (eels and frogs), along with a real sense of generosity make this a highly recommendable place! Fireplace, beams and floor tiles. One for the inveterate gourmets.

Name: La Ferme de la Haute Crémonville
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: To see verdant Normandy again, to admire the horses of the neighbouring stud farm, to dream of the pastoral life: this authentic half-timbered farmhouse is so pretty that it makes the most intractable city-dweller want to retire to the countryside. In these parts you will come across calves, cows, pigs and… traditional delicacies: cep ravioli with chanterelle cream, crunchy vanilla millefeuille; not forgetting the steaks cooked over a wood fire. You have barely put down your knife and fork before you are planning to return to these lovely dishes and bucolic setting.

Name: Le Grand Saint-Benoît
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The restaurant is in a regional house with a terrace on a pedestrian square in the village, where the poet Max Jacob is buried. Good classic cuisine with inventive touches.

Name: Le Tiroir
Address: 20 Grande Rue de Vaise, Lyon, 69009, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This establishment in the working-class district of Vaise, appointed in a characteristic trendy bistro vibe, is irresistibly endearing! The work of a youthful team, the food slaloms between iced tomato soup served with a mousse of white balsamic vinegar and a more patriotic Gallic line-up (tartare of beef, foie gras) – the menus and carte are regularly renewed. Excellent value for money and pleasure, including in the evenings.

Name: Comptoir Breizh Café
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Breizh Café is the result of a stroke of genius: the idea of mixing Breton traditions with the Japanese flair for presentation. Inviting modern decor with a counter facing the open kitchen, as in Japan. Local ingredients (100% organic buckwheat, oysters from Cancale, butter from Bordier) and a few contemporary touches, such as buckwheat pancakes rolled up like maki. Good choice of ciders.

Name: Auberge des Deux Magots
Address: 1 place du Bouffay, La Roche-Bernard, 56130, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: All the charm of an old Breton house in a pretty little town full of character. The refined and creative cuisine showcases seasonal regional produce. At lunchtime, there's a mouth-watering market-inspired set menu that represents remarkable value for money. The line-caught pollack served with buckwheat risotto with squid ink is on point! Even better, the chef bakes the bread himself.

Name: Le Central
Address: 20 cours de la République, Roanne, 42300, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The Troisgros family's other gourmet establishment. Michel and Marie-Pierre dreamed up this bistro-cum-grocery in a 1920s hotel. The warm, vintage decor is inspired by the grocery stores of yesteryear. You can sample a concise menu, possibly picking into à la carte suggestions, whose influences vary (traditional, Indian, Asian, etc). The place is always busy: a well-deserved success.

Name: Le Carré de l'Ange
Address: chemin du Parc (Palais des Évêques), Saint-Lizier, 09190, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Paul Fontvieille presides over the kitchens here with the same enthusiasm and infectious good mood as ever. This passionate chef composes delicious and savvy dishes ranging from the creative, such as artisanal soba noodles made with buckwheat from Ariège in a fresh herb broth, to the more traditional, eg comforting veal axoa. Bag a table on the terrace, which boasts a breathtaking view over the verdant valley… you'll be in seventh heaven!

Name: La Ferme de Cupelin
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Not content with clocking up an impressive CV (Senderens, Flocons de Sel, Murtoli), chef Romain Desgranges is first and foremost a Saint Gervais man, and that makes all the difference. He celebrates the ingredients of his region in meticulous dishes, with game in season (deer, pheasant), old-style terrines and delicious home-made bread. A delight.

Name: Au Lion d'Or - Chez Théo
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A pleasant and elegant inn, run by the same family since 1928. The chef brilliantly weaves flavours of today into the wealth of local specialities, without excluding the specialities of other parts of France! The selection of wines by the glass is short but well put together. Make the most of the beautiful terrace in summer.

Name: Le Saint Joseph
Address: 100 boulevard de la République, La Garenne-Colombes, 92250, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This local bistro serves wholesome, updated, tasty fare, in the shape of a menu devised by chef Bordier, whose illustrious career speaks for itself. Diners dig into good food in a friendly relaxed venue, washed down with a selection from the concise wine list, which showcases wine - producing women.

Name: Au Relais des Ménétriers
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The time is long gone when ménétriers or itinerant fiddlers went from inn to inn but hospitality is still the rule at this Relais, as is good food! The chef concocts true traditional French cuisine and buys his vegetables from local farmers. You can't argue with the results, which are generous and tasty.

Name: Le Kitchen
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In the student district of the Louis Lumière and Jean Moulin Universities, this Kitchen is thriving. The interior, a delightful blend of Art deco and Scandinavian (as is the owner), holds only eight small square tables. The pastry display case (to eat in or take away), the work of the owner’s pastry chef companion, sets our tastebuds drooling and the kitchen is open for breakfast and teatime, as well as lunch (but is closed in the evenings). Organic local produce, vegetables mainly, take pride of place on the table.

Name: Sauf Imprévu
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Félix Gagnaire, a pastry chef by training and son of multi-starred Pierre Gagnaire, whose international renown needs no introduction, deserves our respect for this restaurant (open mainly at lunchtime) in the Brotteaux district. Flavoursome food with a firm focus on pedigree French traditions: watercress soup, poached egg and bacon; warm porkpie; mango and passion fruit cheesecake. The regulars joyfully dig in to wholesome, hearty dishes oozing with regional flavours and heritage. Everything is fresh and entirely made from scratch. A safe bet every time.

Name: Le Rabelais
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Housed in the pretty 17C vaulted room of an old wheat mill, this restaurant would have gone down well with Rabelais's insatiable Gargantua! Enjoy the tasty seasonal dishes that are meticulously prepared (the menu changes several times a week). This place is located in the immediate vicinity of Saint-Chamas's Poudrerie – the black powder mill founded in 1690. History, literature, good food: what more could you ask for?

Name: Chez Yvonne - S'Burjerstuewel
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A buzzy vibe and closely packed tables set the scene in this winstub, whose menu is the epitome of Alsace tradition (cockerel in Riesling, garnished sauerkraut, braised knuckle), albeit with a few more creative dishes, such as their delicate Alsace makis. Don’t miss the chance to sample one of the house specialties: melt-in-the-mouth pork cheeks slowly braised and simmered in a velvety pinot noir sauce – to die for!

Name: La Grange des Halles
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Rungis is more than just the famous food market known to every chef, it is also an old town and home to a this somewhat idiosyncratic bistro. The venue provides the setting for the chef, whose CV mentions Le Taillevent and La Grande Cascade, to concoct market-fresh (what did you expect?) cuisine that combines visual appeal with crisp flavours. Very pleasant shaded terrace to the rear.

Name: Les Petits Princes
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: This inviting street corner restaurant is not far from the tram line. The kitchen is visible through a glazed window. The menu features up-to-the-minute, appetising and never dull dishes such as tartare of meagre fish and citrus fruit, melon soup with fresh ginger and Espelette spices. Delicious terrace/courtyard to the rear at lunchtime.

Name: M Restaurant
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A cocktail of vitamins! Julien Gautier’s cheerful establishment adds a whiff of exuberance to Lyon’s well-heeled, tree-lined Avenue Foch. The smart interior sports a muted blue and flashy orange colour scheme, felt grey designer armchairs, linen tablecloths, a bar and a wine cellar encircled by a conservatory… The similarly charismatic service is as smooth as a silky béarnaise sauce. In the kitchen, the veteran and talented chef, formerly of Léon of Lyon, rustles up an appetising, market-sourced menu, combining flawless technique and know-how in a bid to pamper our tastebuds with delicate flavours tailored to modern appetites. The honey-flavoured madeleines served with a fromage blanc sorbet are awesome!

Name: Le Zeste Gourmand
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A minimalist interior in the zeitgeist (slate grey tiles, white and yellow walls and bare light bulbs) and food to match: finely crafted, flavoursome dishes based on premium produce at prices that make sense.

Name: La Clé des Champs
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This establishment is run by a professional young couple who go to great lengths to keep their guests happy. The fruit of their labours: modern and well-executed cuisine that puts ingredients from the local terroir in the spotlight, as in their tender and tasty haddock sausage accompanied by Picardy mushrooms, or their stuffed farm-reared guinea fowl, apple and onion, chicory jus.

Name: Saku Restaurant
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Saku is the nickname of the chef of this establishment tucked away behind a nondescript façade. He and his wife, both of whom are Japanese, prepare jubilant Gallic cuisine in keeping with today’s tastebuds, with the occasional Japanese tang. The produce is fresh, always in season, at common-sense prices, and the service is friendly and professional.

Name: Bistrot Lucien
Address: La Rôtisserie du Chambertin, 6 rue du Chambertin, Gevrey-Chambertin, 21220, France
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Bare stone walls, bench seating and a superb wooden counter set the scene in this bistro, which is housed in its parent hotel. Expertly crafted burgundy recipes take pride of place on the nostalgic menu: home-cured ham, poached egg in wine, Bresse poultry, profiteroles... Fantastic wine list!

Name: L'Amandier
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Avocado and shrimp tartare with a dash of sherry; shoulder of lamb confit, rosemary and tomato juice; vanilla rice pudding… The endearing couple’s delicious recipes are rich in Provençal accents. A good meal every time at reasonable prices!

Name: Grain de Sel
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In this pleasant restaurant, the chef concocts original, meticulous and tasty dishes, such as golden hake, different textures of salsify and Japanese mushrooms. The menu is regularly renewed, and in summer you can make the most of the pleasant terrace.

Name: Histoire Ancienne
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: This bistro channels an authentic vintage spirit, with its banquette seating, mirrors and Art Deco-style posters. Patrick Comte is at the helm, still cooking up his tasty take on traditional seasonal dishes: snail persillade, corn royale, jus à la bourguignonne; tender veal chop, tarragon mustard cream… Generous cooking is the name of the game!

Name: Au Plaisir Ambré
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Visa credit card
Description: Inside Vauban's fortifications, this converted butcher's places a premium on fine ingredients. Freshness is the watchword of the skilful chef, who knows how to coax out the best flavours. Examples would be the slow-confit farmhouse pork belly, wasabi jus and parsnip purée, and the dark chocolate tart with coconut sorbet. Sheer pleasure.

Name: La Table de Michel Dussau
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Just outside the town centre and near the rugby stadium, chef Michel Dussau whips up tasty recipes in a fashionable brasserie setting. He professes a weakness for local and seasonal ingredients, even better when organic. The establishment’s other appeals include a glazed wine cellar, a meat maturing cabinet.

Name: L'Épicurien
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Luck has nothing to do with the current reputation of this downtown venue, facing Jean Jaurès Fountain, as the darling of the town’s discerning epicureans. The stripped-back interior sports a distinctly Scandinavian feel, which given the chef’s Swedish origins is hardly a surprise. On the culinary front, he deploys his undisputed talent, adding a new twist to French classics and conjuring up enticing recipes in tune with the era: generous portions, well crafted and oozing with flavour. The intelligent wine list and crack table staff, as professional as they are friendly, add the final flourish.

Name: Caillebotte
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Chef Franck Baranger crafts fresh, thoroughly modern dishes, the secret of which only he holds: lightly seared squid, redcurrants, courgette and gremolata; line-caught fish, marinated cucumber, polenta, béarnaise sauce and fig pickles… A casual, friendly vibe provides the perfect foil to distinctive, appetising and colourful food.

Name: Chez Michel
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: Masahiro Kawai, the Japanese chef of Chez Michel, plays a joyful, flavoursome traditional score, in which nothing is forbidden, from iconic Brittany stew (kig ha farz) to Paris-Brest pastry, without forgetting roast foie gras. He celebrates regional produce, starting with Brittany, lavishing care and generosity on each dish.

Name: La Méditerranée
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: The frescoes evoke the Mediterranean in this restaurant opposite the Théâtre de l'Odéon. The maritime inspired cuisine, in which particular attention is paid to the best ingredients, is influenced by the accents of the south. In summer dine beneath the azure blue awning.

Name: Ô en Couleur
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: At Le Commerce, the chef concocts well - thought - out dishes that are prepared using the finest ingredients. The results appeal to the taste buds without breaking the bank. Pretty dining area with contemporary decor. Comfortable and colourful guestrooms are available should you wish to prolong your stay.

Name: Akashon
Address: L'Héliopic, 50 place de l'Aiguille-du-Midi, Chamonix-Mont-Blanc, 74400, France
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The restaurant welcomes you in an industrial - style interior, using materials that reference the region's industrial heritage. At dinner, the cook beautifully turns out his exacting creations. Good memories of the monkfish, artichokes and gnocchi.

Name: Le Bistro des Glycines
Address: 4 avenue de Laugerie, Les Eyzies-de-Tayac-Sireuil, 24620, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: One of the undeniable plus points of this hotel is its excellent bistro with a nicely decorated conservatory extension (untreated wooden tables, Shaker-style chairs). At lunchtime, diners tuck into good-value dishes in tune with the zeitgeist, eg semi-cooked tuna loin, sautéed vegetables with ginger, or cabbage from the garden stuffed with confit de canard. This creative and tempting menu is proving to be a well-deserved success!

Name: La Gazette
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Inside this small half - timbered building, the trendy decor harmoniously blends refinement with the charm of timeworn beams. As for the seasonal cuisine, it showcases the finest ingredients. A memorable experience!

Name: Restaurant du Dauphin
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This pretty 16C house at the foot of the Porte St Julien proposes homemade cuisine for the modern palate with a smattering of exotic touches. The tuna ceviche with coconut milk and ginger is a good example. The interior has grey and raspberry tones. Fine selection of wines by the glass.

Name: Mensae
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Visa credit card
Description: Cuisine of the moment, full of freshness and with spot-on flavours. Among the classics, on the menu all year round, the frogs' legs, garlic and parsley or the mousse au chocolat praliné are good enough to spark a riot. The decor has the good taste to make itself discreet. The small sidewalk terrace is welcome in summer and the lunch menu is a boon.

Name: Ô Saveurs
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Chances are it won't be the charm of the location near the train station that draws you here, but the restaurant has more than enough of its own merits. Where shall we begin? Scallops from St Brieuc Bay in a Quessoy saffron sauce and seaweed-flavoured conchiglioni or duckling breast roasted in honey and sage with a pear poached in blueberries and shiitakes, and a delicious encounter between cherries and pear with a white chocolate topping to finish…

Name: L'Hibiscus
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In a bustling pedestrian street, the façade is discreet. Venture inside for fresh ingredients, original recipes and modern cuisine, courtesy of Céline Lefebvre, a chef with a proven track record. No à la carte, but a short set menu changing regularly abreast of the seasons and availability. Reasonable prices.

Name: La Table d'Hôtes
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit cards not accepted,Wheelchair access
Description: Not far from the seaside resort, this family restaurant is the stomping ground of a couple who have experience working in some fine establishments. Yoann Lavalley has bought the stove which he used during his apprenticeship and uses it to create seasonal cuisine that is both flavourful and indulgent. The sommelier, his wife, has curated a nice wine list that represents excellent value for money. Fish of the day, local meat, Normandy cheeses… A pleasant place.

Name: L'Auberge des Montagnes
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This farmstead in the heart of a remote picturesque village (ideal for walks in the country) is the HQ of a chef who competently and carefully crafts traditional recipes. Save room for the cheese board and Salers cheese, produced just a few yards away.

Name: Restaurant du Musée
Address: 2 rue de la Rochette, Fréland, 68240, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In this former mill on the Ure, next to the museum of the Welche country, Alain Schmitt’s cooking finds varied inspiration, close to home in “terroir” dishes (fleischschnaka of local trout) and further afield (line-caught grouper in a yosenabe style dashi broth).

Name: Les Arômes
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In this 1930s house basking in the aromas of Provence, unflappable hostess Françoise Besset and her husband Yannick officiate. His innkeeper's soul has not changed and he continues to regale guests with fresh and inventive regional cuisine. Enjoy in one of the charming little dining spaces or, in fine weather, on the terrace on the veranda overlooking the garden planted with olive trees. An exemplary place.

Name: Vigne en Foule
Address: 80 place de la Libération, Gaillac, 81600, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A pleasant wine-themed bar-restaurant serving bold bistro fare with a new twist, together with a few meat dishes to share (suckling pig, veal chop, etc.). Modern plating and gourmet flavours, such as the raviole of beef. Diners make a beeline for the delightful alfresco space come springtime. The wine cellar boasts a head-spinning selection of almost 300 different wines!

Name: Le Viscos
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: "In the kitchens, Alexis (representing the seventh generation) treats diners to dishes that are an ode to the land, enhanced with more modern touches. It's precise, fine and always prepared with sensitivity towards the ingredients; the desserts, in particular, are very good. "

Name: Maison Joanto
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Wheelchair access
Description: Joanto means "Little John" in Basque, but there is nothing diminutive about this place! Its fine traditional architecture and convivial ambience are more than worthy of applause, as is the generous cooking of its head chef, who has worked in some top establishments. This is meticulous and indulgent cuisine, with an explosion of Basque Country flavours: pâté en croûte, milk-fed Pyrenean lamb, Armagnac baba. Fantastic value for money.

Name: Le 6 à Table
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In a peaceful village, this small square whiling away the days in the shade of the church makes a picture - perfect scene. The chef uses seasonal ingredients as much as possible, mostly also local (figs, cheese, vegetables), and demonstrates care and finesse in the preparation of his dishes. To savour in the modern interior reminiscent of an atelier, or on the terrace.

Name: La Chaumière de Pomper
Address: Le Moulin de Pomper, 14 hameau de Kerhervé, Baden, 56870, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Wheelchair access
Description: Well - known in the region, this pancake house rustles up crêpes made from 90% organic buckwheat flour and 10% wheat flour, resulting in a mixture so light and airy the crêpes are even crispier than the norm. In fact, it even has a name in Breton kraz! If you can’t make your choice, we suggest sticking to the classics! Impressive list of ciders.

Name: Le Bistro Chapouton
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The second offshoot of Le Clair de la Plume, the nearby parent establishment, occupies a stunning 18C edifice set in flower-decked gardens. Fresh, seasonal produce are the stars of the bistro menu: crunchy white asparagus with a hollandaise sauce, slow-roasted shoulder of lamb and gratin dauphinois and, to finish, home-made pastries. The huge, covered terrace commands a matchless view of Grignan Castle.

Name: Cook'in
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This restaurant is where France (the chef) meets Thailand (front of house). The result is fusion cuisine (pan-fried scallops, lentil salad with ginger, red curry shellfish bisque) with a few “unmissables” (“tom yum talay” soup, or wok-fried Dublin Bay prawns with panang curry…). Reasonable prices.

Name: Le Nid
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: An establishment run by charming people: Emilie takes care of the customer's every need, while the chef rustles up seasonal cuisine, full of freshness and flavour, making the most of short food supply chains and local producers. A gourmet hideaway that fills up every day and offers excellent value and maximum dining pleasure.

Name: Oma
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The minimalist decor (waxed concrete floors, Scandinavian furniture and designer pendant lights) suggests the food is the main focus here. The menu varies according to season and inspiration: smashed avocado, gravlax salmon and orange vinaigrette; roast veal fillet, potato and artichoke fricassee; raspberry compote, crumble, mint and lemon sorbet. Very reasonably priced menu-carte.

Name: Coteaux et Fourchettes
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This cleverly named restaurant (a pun on côteaux meaning hills and couteaux meaning knives) is housed in an old wine cellar. The region is well represented both by the delicious cuisine and by the excellent choice of local wines. Pleasant, contemporary decor and a terrace overlooking the vineyards.

Name: Le Rendez-vous des Gourmets
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Since he opened this splendid country restaurant, Didier Doreau has turned it into a genuine gourmet stronghold. Terrine of pike à la Chambord, pâté of game served warm drizzled in jus, traditional calf’s head, Grand Marnier-flavoured baked citrus fruits… You can expect a pageant of traditional Gallic staples, made with fresh, crisp produce, crafted into dishes that exalt and respect the intrinsic flavour of each ingredient. The chef is renowned for his way with game in season (hare, venison, wild boar, etc.), which further adds to the well-deserved success of what has become a culinary benchmark in the region.

Name: Le Gantxo
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Welcome to the Basque country! Le Gantxo – named after a pass in pelota – gives directly onto the trinquet, the ground where the famous local sport is played. In the kitchen, Isabelle and Laurent Miremont revisit Basque cuisine in a very personal way, composing dishes that are up to the minute, often copious, always tasty. A firm favourite!

Name: L'Instant...
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Take an instant to savour a gourmet interlude not far from Toulouse! Diners eat cheek to jowl at immaculate white tables. In the kitchen the chef creates contemporary cuisine with a few Southern French and Asian touches. Don't miss the "L'instant gourmet" set menu!

Name: Les Canailles Pigalle
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This pleasant restaurant was opened by a pair from Brittany who can boast impressive culinary backgrounds. Here, the name of the game is bistronomy and seasonal recipes. Specialities include beef tongue carpaccio with ravigote sauce, and rum baba with whipped vanilla cream – a real treat! Tip: if the restaurant is full, go to Le Comptoir Canaille, just a few doors down, where they serve more contemporary cuisine.

Name: L'Antre Amis
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The chef-patron at L'Antre Amis brings passion to his cooking. Using seasonal ingredients, he composes a short up-to-the-minute menu (Landes asparagus, Graubünden meat and devilled egg; cod loin fillet and creamy risotto with early peas), as well as tapas-style dishes for sharing. To be accompanied by your pick from some 200 wines. Pleasant contemporary setting and terrace on a quiet street.

Name: Impérial Choisy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A genuine Chinese restaurant frequented by many local Chinese people who use it as their lunchtime canteen. Hardly surprising given the delicious Cantonese specials on offer!

Name: Le Montcenis
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Both the decor (vaulted cellar, exposed stone and beams) and the food are full of character. Laurent Dufour draws on fine produce to create generous and authentic dishes, such as guinea fowl breast with spinach leaves and carrots, and green cabbage cannelloni with smoked bacon. The menu changes regularly and, in winter, features truffles, of which the chef is a big fan! A cordial welcome.

Name: La Guinguette du 1er Mets
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A stone’s throw from the town hall, this postage - stamp restaurant is in the hands of an enthusiastic young couple. The chef devises fresh, modern menus that keep pace with the seasons, such as maki - smoked fera fish in a tarragon, mustard and egg yolk sauce. Gracious, smiling service.

Name: Au Colombier
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: By the River Saône, a fine 18C building that feels like a cross between a hip guinguette and a country house. The food is resolutely contemporary: carpaccio of gilt - head bream with lemongrass, saddle of rabbit stuffed with wild basil... without neglecting the classics, such as the wonderful pan - fried frogs' legs. Good taste and character.

Name: Le Bistronôme
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In an exquisite location on the banks of the River Cuisance, Lisa and Jérôme have made their establishment a firm fixture of the culinary scene of Arbois. The chef’s seasonal recipes, emblematic of his technique and flair, are a festival of mouth-watering delicacies from his signature dish, Planches trout stuffed with morel and pleurote mushrooms, vin jaune sauce to farm-reared Jura pork chop, creamy polenta and a jus of beer infused in pink berries or squab in Kampot red pepper. Their “au fil du jour” daily special is a steal and the service is refreshingly unstarched and friendly: remember to book!

Name: La Chaumière
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This family-run place, a 19C coaching inn, has been in the hands of chef-patron Philippe Arnault since 1992. He is ably assisted by his wife, daughter and, in the kitchen, his son-in-law, Sébastien Provendier (who has previously worked for the Meilleur family and Passedat). Tuck into delights such as trout gravlax with beetroot, buckwheat pancake and horseradish cream, in a pleasant dining room with large bay windows giving onto the inner courtyard. There is a shaded terrace to be enjoyed in fine weather and six guestrooms done out in a modern style inspired by the Sologne region.

Name: Les Coloquintes
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant installed in a former silk - throwing factory is run by a young couple – he in the kitchen, she front of house. They propose contemporary cuisine, aiming to keep supply channels short and respecting local produce, trout, chestnuts, fruits etc. In summer, get a table in the shade of the lime trees.

Name: L'Aubépine
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: L’Aubépine is flourishing in the hands of a youthful researcher, now on a quest for flavour. Chef Manuel is a staunch advocate of locally sourced produce, whose ingredients he seeks to exalt, respecting both their texture and nutritional value. Everything is made in house and the menu changes weekly depending on the market.

Name: L'Espérance - Stéphane Carbone
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Treat yourself to a bucolic gourmet getaway a stone's throw from Caen, in Stéphane Carbone's terracotta-coloured establishment. The chef, well known to locals, serves traditional dishes with a modern twist, for example knuckle end of lamb, bulgur risotto with turmeric and turnip roasted with sweet tonka pepper. Each table commands a lovely view of the canal.

Name: L'Ô à la Bouche
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: At the head of this pleasant restaurant is a foodie couple who travelled to faraway lands and seas before dropping anchor in Cahors. Jean - François concocts gourmet dishes such as: salmon marinated in fennel or wild seabass, pan - fried chard and Lautrec pink garlic cromesquis. Enough to make your mouth water!

Name: Auberge La Grange aux Loups
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This village inn, dripping in style, has been revamped in a modern vibe by an enthusiastic couple. The menu focuses on carefully crafted, mouth-watering dishes (pastilla of pork, wild garlic and broad bean pickles; roast king prawns, Camargue rice, chorizo and fennel; citrus fruit-flavoured rice pudding and orange sorbet). Service with a smile and a lovely patio for alfresco dining in fine weather.

Name: So
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: After notching up experience in some fine establishments, Japanese chef So Takahashi works alone in the kitchen, and his partner, Rie, is front of house. He uses ingredients that are bought directly at the neighbouring market to concoct French cuisine interspersed with Japanese inspiration. The result is finely executed, light and flavoursome. So good!

Name: Le Denti
Address: 25 bis avenue de Loverchy, Annecy, 74000, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This dinky restaurant off the busy tourist track is the haunt of a couple with a passion for ‘denti’ (a Mediterranean fish). Both are talented, versatile cooks and together they craft flavoursome market cuisine with a weakness for fish and a reverence for the seasons. With only a handful of tables, bookings are snapped up fast, so book ahead!

Name: Le Grapiot
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Established in a famous wine-growing village, this welcoming restaurant is the stronghold of a fervent defender of flavour and fine produce. His cooking is ideally paired to the local wines, which is all the better as his list of Jura wines is one of the best in the area. Good value-for-money.

Name: Aux Trois Pastoureaux
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Although Jean-François Lucchese started out as a pastry chef, he likes to define himself as a "craftsman of taste", taking care over cooking, seasoning and marriages of ingredients. Here in this old building in the centre of Châteaudun, go back in time courtesy of the "Medieval Menu", which is all about tradition! Delicious bread made in-house.

Name: Aux Bons Enfants
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: This family business, opened in 1935, only recently had a telephone line installed, but still accepts cash only! The fourth generation continues to craft authentic Provençal ingredients into heart-warming, hunger obliterating dishes. All the produce, fruit, veg and fish from small boats, comes direct from Forville Market just down the road. We tucked into petits farcis (stuffed vegetables), Niçois-style braised beef cheeks, homemade gnocchi and the house dessert: rum baba with vanilla cream – to die for!

Name: Air Accueil
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Near the Vitry - en - Artois airfield, this vast inn used to be an officers' mess. Today it is much more than a simple canteen! The food is delicious, and all the experience of chef Franck Gilabert shines through. There are numerous nods to local specialities, and the flavours really take off!

Name: Bistrot du Pollet
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Let us make no bones about it: in this bistro, it is the sea that decides, and the dishes depend directly on the local catch. Enjoy squid, foie gras du pêcheur, sole du bistro or scallops with lentils. Quality and freshness are the order of the day, and what generosity in the preparations!

Name: Fine Gueule
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In Nice's old town, opposite the town hall, this restaurant's newly refurbished interior is organised around an open kitchen and a counter where customers can sit to eat. But the real pleasure is to be found in the food, with traditional dishes chalked up on the board each day, including for starters the home-made pissaladière, devilled eggs or calamari a la plancha.

Name: Bistrot des Anges
Address: Rue de l'Ouest, Le Cannet, 06110, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This brasserie run by the team from Villa Archange has a modern decor, friendly atmosphere and set menus inspired by sunny climes! Tuck into artichokes stuffed with egg mayonnaise, Florentine cream and basil or veal kidney with mushrooms. For dessert, Thai grapefruit cheesecake from a sweets trolley filled with treats prepared by talented pastry chef Maxime Simonot. You'll be in seventh heaven!

Name: Auberge Pyrénées Cévennes
Address: 106 rue de la Folie-Méricourt, Paris, 75011, France
