FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Chef Pierre Négrevergne is really flourishing in this house that is over 100 years old. He delights diners with his tasty "grandmother's" cooking, which highlights French gastronomic heritage (home-made terrine, blanquette de veau à l'ancienne and grilled rice, millefeuille), served in generous portions. It is still a treat to eat here.

Name: Aux Plumes
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A young Japanese chef with a great track record creates inspired, generous cuisine using the best ingredients in the neighbourhood. Cream of sweet potato soup, cocoa emulsion; lychee and coconut milk blancmange and exotic fruit minestrone – the original dishes are carefully prepared, change on a weekly basis and are delicious every time. At lunchtime, a trilogy of starters at an unbeatable price.

Name: Le Casse Noix
Address: 56 rue de la Fédération, Paris, 75015, France
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Old signs, clocks and vintage furniture: the scene is set. As for the food, authenticity is the order of the day: delicious down - to - earth canaille cuisine, good wines and an amusing collection of nutcrackers picked up here and there by the owner's mum. Tasty.

Name: Jouvence
Address: 172 bis rue du Faubourg-Saint-Antoine, Paris, 75012, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: Located not far from the rue de Cîteaux, this apothecary-style shop from the 1900s is not merely aesthetically pleasing. It proposes modern cuisine, replete with quality ingredients, such as scallop ceviche or a fine Angus entrecôte. The chef has a sure and generous touch, and the service is attentive.

Name: Le Tire Bouchon
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Pay little attention to the unremarkable façade of this restaurant, as the main focus is on the pretty dining room with its exposed beams and open fire. Refined traditional cuisine that follows the seasons is served. Friendly service with a smile.

Name: Spoon
Address: 25 place de la Bourse, Paris, 75002, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Brunch,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: On the mezzanine floor of the Palais Brongniart, diners are drawn here by the promise of aromatic spices – tamarind, ginger, coriander, saffron. The chef's dishes are inspired by the Maghreb, India, the Middle East: Doha chickpeas with lemon caviar; amberjack, curry leaves and coconut milk; Fez pastilla with dried fruit, cinnamon and star anise.

Name: Julien
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Local folklore is celebrated by waiters in traditional costume and a characteristic wooden Vosges decor. In a lively, yet sophisticated atmosphere, you will be treated to tasty, copious regional preparations: sauerkraut, veal kidneys, sweetbread and bouchées à la reine. The food is as heart-warming as the rooms, the grounds and the hotel’s magnificent spa facilities.

Name: Iida-Ya
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Confit of pork breast in ginger, sushis, makis or tempura recipes… This smart, zen - inspired restaurant gives you an unhampered view of the Japanese chef delicately preparing delicious dishes that draw their roots from French and Japanese traditions. Fine selection of saké (rice wines).

Name: La Grillade Gourmande
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant's specialities include boned squab with foie gras in puff pastry or traditional textbook calf sweetbread, all of which are the handiwork of a friendly chef of Lyon origins. The interior is the epitome of friendly and buzzy and the garden is bliss, come summertime!

Name: Auberge Le Centre Poitou
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The same family has been honing their talent for hospitality and running this inn, formerly a post house, since 1870. The food is flavoursome and skilfully prepared using produce selected by the new chef, son, Mathias.

Name: DZ'envies
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: You can trust the chef’s culinary hankering or ‘envies’! In a hip canteen vibe next-door to the market, David Zuddas gives free rein to his love of cooking and premium produce. The menu features a line-up of traditional Burgundian classics (poultry breast in spices, roast carrots and bulgur wheat). The lunchtime menu is a bargain, while in the evening you can choose from 3, 4 or 5 courses.

Name: Les Épices Curiens
Address: 3b place de la Gare, Écouviez, 55600, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: When strolling around the area you could easily cross over into Belgium without realising it. But the former train station of this border village, since converted into a lovely restaurant, will encourage you to stay in France. Sample the inspired cuisine and nicely prepared dishes, all paired with good local wines. Lots of taste!

Name: Minami
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This tiny Japanese restaurant is crammed with regulars. The minimalist interior provides the perfect foil to well-crafted Japanese fare with the occasional foray into a traditional Gallic repertory. A few examples: sushi of foie gras, caramelised eel or jasmine-perfumed crème brûlée. A few tables are laid on the patio in fine weather.

Name: Épices et Tout
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This small restaurant with an unobtrusive façade will wake up your taste buds. Beautifully prepared dishes, fresh produce, and judiciously deployed spices. For example, organic creamy slow-cooked egg with mushrooms, guinea fowl with seasonal vegetables and sweet and sour sauce or citrus macaron. An appetising menu to relish on the small terrace in summer.

Name: En Cuisine
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Since undergoing a complete refurbishment following a fire, the interior of this refined restaurant displays a degree of Scandinavian flair. The dishes are all about finesse and mouth-watering flavours: eg the soft and tender skate wing accompanied by delicious home-made gnocchi flavoured with lemon and flat parsley, enhanced by a delicious sweet and sour sauce. Everything is well executed – compliments to the chef!

Name: 52 Faubourg St-Denis
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Fans of neo - bistros are going to love this place with bare concrete and exposed stone, a concise, tempting menu, good wines and craft beers. Nothing is left to chance, down to the coffee, which is selected and roasted by the owner. Bear in mind the place doesn't take bookings and doesn't have a phone.

Name: Le Radis Beurre
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Chef Jérôme Bonnet found the perfect location for his restaurant on Boulevard Garibaldi in Paris. He prepares tasty, well-crafted cuisine that bears the hallmark of his early years in southern France. The pork loin with braised endives, Mimolette Vieille cheese and a pearlescent jus is just one dish that will certainly grab your full attention.

Name: Mandoobar
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Good authentic Korean restaurants are not two a penny in Paris, but this little restaurant, where the chef works behind his counter, is one of them: diners look on while Kim Kwang-Loc, as nimble-fingered as he is precise, creates the famous mandu (Korean dumplings) and tuna and beef tartares that make up the bulk of his minimalist menu. Passionate about Korean herbs, he seasons each of his delicate and tasty dishes with addictive flavours, perhaps in a quest to recreate his earliest culinary memories in Korea…

Name: Le Petit Paris
Address: 18 rue de la République, Daglan, 24250, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In the heart of a picturesque Périgord village, this welcoming establishment is fronted by a large terrace overlooking the village square. Meals are served in two tastefully rustic dining rooms. The chef, a local lad, takes pride in showcasing regional produce. Carpaccio of foie gras and a port-based vichyssoise; melt-in-the-mouth beef chuck in a Pécharmant wine sauce and traditional Grand Marnier soufflé to finish.

Name: Le Gibolin
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: After stints at la Chassagnette and Maison Rabanel, to mention but a few, Arnaud Jourdan has masterfully taken over the helm of this well-known bistro. He continues to focus on market-fresh cuisine in a bid to combine flavour with simplicity and generosity, illustrated by crunchy pig’s trotters and ears or ricotta-spinach boulettes, mushrooms and pecorino romano cheese. A buzzy, laid-back vibe and a fine selection of natural and biodynamic wines at prices that make sense. We wager you will enjoy it as much as the many regulars.

Name: La Dariole
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In the heart of the old town and not far from the cathedral, this 15C half-timbered house showcases an easy alliance of old stonework and cosy touches. The chef, who even trained here when he was learning his trade, hits the mark with delicious cuisine that is in tune with the times. The seasonal menu changes regularly and features appealingly tasty dishes such as pork chop with potatoes and a caper jus.

Name: Clamato
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Inspired by the oyster bars of the East Coast of the United States, this outpost of Septime owes its name to a cocktail that is very popular in Quebec, a Bloody Mary of sorts with the addition of clam juice – needless to say, you can try one here! The place has all the makings of a bistronomy hit, with its trendy decor and short menu that puts fish and seafood and vegetables centre stage, and draws on international influences. The ingredients are chosen with great care and prepared as simply as possible, then presented in plates for sharing. Please note that reservations are not possible: first come, first served!

Name: Richer
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This place appeals as much for its arty "canteen" vibe as it does for its dishes, which showcase a fresh and tasty take on market-inspired cuisine, as in the long-braised beef chuck served on a fine broccoli purée. Bear in mind, though, that the only way to reserve is to show up at the restaurant.

Name: Chez John
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Welcome to Chez John: the lair of a talented English chef who is adding a new spin on regional produce. Take a seat indoors or on the secluded patio and dig into colourful dishes in tune with the seasons. After stints in top establishments, the chef is a past-master of technique and his delicate recipes mixed with unbeatable value for money have attracted a crowd of regulars. An antidote to Brexit!

Name: Au Coin des Halles
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit cards not accepted,Terrace
Description: A javelin throw from Langeais château, make a halt in this pretty tufa stone house. The period wainscoting and parquet floors are offset by contemporary furnishings, which add a bright, cheerful note. Chef Pascal Bouvier crafts inventive recipes, inspired by regional produce, illustrated by veal, baby carrots, sweet potatoes, tamarind and arabica jus or white asparagus, braised pork belly (kakuni) and roasted pomelos. The combinations are sometimes surprising but always spot-on for fine meals with the added bonus of charming service. The lovely terrace in summertime is the final cherry on the cake.

Name: Le Bistrot
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: On the menu of this bistro near the theatre and the cathedral, you will find hearty Gallic seasonal recipes, starring fine ingredients that shout their name. The Savoie-born chef worked for a long time in Ducasse establishments. In fine weather, meals are served on a shaded terrace, which further increases the pleasure.

Name: Le Saint-Eutrope
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: A New Zealander, previously sous-chef here, and his partner are replacing the British chef who was at the helm for many years. The decor has been freshened up a little, and the single set lunch menu has been replaced by a short two-choice menu. The new bosses have been wise enough to maintain the winning formula: a vintage vibe, friendly atmosphere, low prices and a wine list with a passion for natural wines. The unadorned plating belies the technical refinement of the cuisine. No fancy presentations here, just trendy, family-style cooking (yes, it's possible!).

Name: Auberge des Chenets
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: You quickly forget the road just outside, as you snuggle up near the fireplace of this pleasant inn! The menu stars gutsy, feelgood dishes of Burgundian inspiration that are consummately crafted and oozing with flavour: egg parfait and meurette snails, farm-reared beef cooked in pinot noir wine, wafer-thin apple tart…

Name: Zen
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This enticing restaurant combines a refreshing contemporary interior design and authentic Japanese cooking. The menu is well - rounded and faithful to the classic sushi, grilled dishes and tempura, with house specialities of gyoza and chirashi. Ideal for a quick lunch or a relaxing ‘zen’ dinner.

Name: Jeux 2 Goûts
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Having settled in his native region after several years spent in high - end Parisian establishments, Christophe Marchais is bringing a dose of culinary flair to Châteauroux. He prepares tasty and creative dishes, inspired by a building steeped in history. The best restaurant in the city.

Name: Côté Saisons
Address: 10 avenue de la Côte-Vermeille, Laroque-des-Albères, 66740, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Let's set the scene: a 19C building surrounded by greenery, with large bay windows, a flower-decked garden and a pretty terrace to cater to all seasons. On the menu are tasty, well-crafted dishes, eg warm calf's head with Charroux mustard, Cerdagne pig confit with honey-ginger, tender chuck of beef and pan-fried foie gras. In addition, the service is all smiles.

Name: Auberge de Combes
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This quintessential inn – typical of the area – stands on the heights of the Orb Valley. The terroir expresses itself in no uncertain terms: the food and the landscape share a subtle yet rugged edge. Semi-cooked foie gras over grapevine embers, wood pigeon roasted in a wine sauce, sweet chestnut and pear tart… Meals are served within hundred-year-old stone walls or on the patio which commands a sweeping view over the valley. To be washed down with a glass of Faugères, of course!

Name: Au Bon Accueil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This restaurant, run by a young couple, is true to its name when it promises a warm welcome. In a bright, contemporary interior, the chef works with premium seasonal ingredients, most of which sourced locally, dexterously crafting creative recipes, such as roast langoustine with a shellfish emulsion or ballotines of free-range poultry stuffed with creamy parsley.

Name: L'Ourdissoir
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card
Description: Slightly outside the city centre, this modest establishment sports a warm interior that provides the perfect foil for spot-on, modern food that generously keeps pace with the seasons. Elegant presentation and an original culinary score, with unexpected combinations.

Name: B2K6
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This pleasant bistro was born out of a meeting of minds between two culinary enthusiasts. Jerome Bru, former sous - chef to Anne - Sophie Pic, and Romain Billard, sommelier, also a graduate of some famous establishments. Enjoy the lovely cooking, which is in harmony with the seasons and uses local ingredients, accompanied by just the right wines. A great team.

Name: L'Auberge du Laminak
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In this charming inn on the edge of the forest, the Basque country – where the chef is from – meets fine produce from the Ardennes. The result is tasty and skilfully made dishes, such as the slow-cooked egg with piperade and Basque ham.

Name: La Part des Anges
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Market-fresh cooking with a devout respect for the seasons and just the right dose of generous creativity is the name of the game here. Local small-scale producers take pride of place and you can expect an abundance of flavours.

Name: Le Boudes La Vigne
Address: Place de la Mairie, Boudes, 63340, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Built on old fortifications, this pleasant restaurant lies at the heart of a wine-growing village that produces Boudes, one of the five wines of Auvergne's vineyards. Christian Coutarel, a jovial chef, works away in the kitchen preparing generous and flavoursome traditional cuisine, without ruling out more modern dishes.

Name: La Gabale
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: With this brasserie, Cyril Attrazic has created the ideal offshoot of his gourmet establishment. The modern decor, adorned with panoramic photos of Aubrac landscapes, provides the perfect foil to sample full-flavoured, well-crafted dishes, whether indoors or on the shaded alfresco area out front. A few dishes you may sample include poultry and foie gras pâté en croûte with vegetable pickles; sautéed fillet of hake, red Camargue rice and pistou of herbs; strawberries, elderflower lactic sorbet and miniature waffles.

Name: La Toupine
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Follow the locals as they flock towards this bistro, whose inviting terrace is shaded by vines in summertime, and its stylish interior, appointed in a smart yet soothing vibe with stainless steel, stone and exotic wood. However, it is the market-fresh food, above all, that draws the regulars. Crépinette of pig’s trotters, pickles of pleurote mushrooms and a port wine sauce, followed by a fillet of Limousin veal with sautéed mushrooms and a barigoule of vegetables with a heavenly wafer-thin apple tart to finish.

Name: Le Pantruche
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Pantruche is slang for Paris... an apt name for this bistro with its chic retro decor, which happily cultivates a 1940s - 1950s atmosphere. As for the food, the chef and his small team put together lovely seasonal dishes in keeping with current culinary trends.

Name: Bistrotters
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A lovely place in the southern reaches of the 14th arrondissement near Métro Plaisance. The Spanish chef carefully selects his ingredients, with a preference for small-scale producers in the Paris region, and instils them with various influences (Asian, Mediterranean etc). Laid-back service.

Name: Abri Soba
FacilitiesAndServices: Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: You may have heard of soba, Japanese pasta made with buckwheat, the reputation of which is currently snowballing around the planet. The chef of this restaurant has made soba his house speciality and serves it lunch and evening in an amazing variety of preparations: hot, cold, in stock or with finely sliced duck. Simply flavoursome – get out your chopsticks!

Name: Pho Tai
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: In a quiet street in the Asian quarter, this small Vietnamese restaurant stands out from the crowd. All credit to the chef, Mr Te, who arrived in France in 1968 and is a magnificent ambassador for Vietnamese cuisine. Dumplings, crispy chicken with fresh ginger, bo bun and phô soups: everything is full of flavour.

Name: L'Athome
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In his new restaurant complete with wine shop, chef Lionel draws on his strong culinary background as well as good local produce – organic market garden vegetables, small-scale fishing – to create delicious set menus offering excellent value for money at lunchtime and an appetising tapas menu in the evening. Edwige provides friendly and efficient service.

Name: Hostellerie d'Héloïse
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Wholesome regional dishes – Burgundy snails, Charolais beef and a reduction of red wine from Mâcon, together with tempting traditional recipes (roast turbot, mashed cauliflower and veal gravy), have built the reputation of this hostelry, which also proposes more modern dishes and a splendid choice of wines by the glass. Lovely bright conservatory overlooking the River Grosne. Rooms for overnight stays.

Name: Auberge de la Baraque
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: "In the interior, as cosy and hushed as they come (fireplace, mouldings and chandeliers) of this coaching inn (1800), diners can enjoy quality contemporary cuisine; it is tasty and nicely presented. Pleasant service, reasonable prices and good wine list. "

Name: La Table Bâgésienne
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Behind the façade of this former coaching inn lies a contemporary interior, complete with a glazed wine cellar, and hearty Bresse cuisine to make your mouth water… Pommes Anna with frogs' legs sautéed with a garlic butter cream, Bresse poultry with cream and vin jaune, or the traditional nougat glacé. Pleasant, quiet terrace to the rear.

Name: L'Araignée Gourmande
Address: 8 rue de la Paix, Laragne-Montéglin, 05300, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Settle at your table in this bright, modern interior and experience the talent of Thierry Chouin. This Breton chef may have a particular penchant for fish - based fare, but that doesn't mean he snubs lamb and potatoes. He fetes the ingredients with nicely turned - out dishes, each a lovely homage to tradition.

Name: Au Petit Relais
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant proposes exceptionally tasty dishes featuring lobster, fine fish, Bresse specialities and choice wines. The dining room is smart, and the service is friendly.

Name: Les Flots
Address: 52 boulevard de la Mer, Châtelaillon-Plage, 17340, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This picturesque 19C blue and white house stands on the boulevard that skirts the immense beach. Take a seat in a contemporary dining room overlooking the sea and dig into beautifully presented super-fresh fish and shellfish platters, the establishment’s pride and joy. Guaranteed to find favour with seafood lovers!

Name: Bistrot RG
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: MICHELIN-starred chef Nicolas Gautier (from Nature, just next door) and his brother Mathieu pay tribute to the cooking of their father Roger Gautier (RG) with a short menu featuring tasty unpretentious dishes and a bill that won't break the bank: "Antoine" pâté en croute or the chef's grilled veal sausage billed as "15-20cm of happiness". This convivial place keeps it in the family.

Name: Art'zain
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Artzain means shepherd in Basque – a tribute to the owner’s father. In the heart of the village, this old barn has been entirely restored and now sports a rustic designer style (the furniture is by Basque craftsman Alki). The food is seasonal and mainly local. Excellent address.

Name: Winstub du Chambard
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The chef, Olivier Nasti, revisits all that Alsace's terroir has to offer: baeckeoffe and choucroute, onion tart and presskopf... Without forgetting the trout from the vallée d’Orbey, with white wine sauce, and an iced kougelhopf to die for. Tasty and generous, an ode to good food! Daily specials on the chalkboard too.

Name: La Taverne Alsacienne
Address: 99 rue de la République, Ingersheim, 68040, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Run by the Guggenbuhl family since 1964, this salmon-pink-fronted tavern has earned its reputation. Even those who know nothing about Alsace cuisine are smitten by the enticing regional dishes, washed down by fine wines from near and far! The fillet of zander, sautéed sauerkraut and Riesling sauce we sampled lingers with us still.

Name: La Botte d'Asperges
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: With its name that conjures up springtime (it means "bunch of asparagus"), this restaurant cooks up a tasty menu. Running the show, a couple from the trade and a chef with a strong track record. The comfortable interior is done out in a contemporary bistro style. An altogether pleasant eatery.

Name: Auberge du XIIème Siècle
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In a village that Balzac particularly loved, this Auberge is something of an institution. The thirty-something chef, Kévin Gardien, now runs the inn, flanked by his partner Stéphanie Marques, who is in charge of the service. Regional produce takes pride of place in the modern, appetising dishes, all of which at reasonable prices. A quintessential French country inn!

Name: L'Alcôve
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Just behind the cathedral, this restaurant has been treated to a makeover and a new name, whilst retaining its culinary hallmark: expertly crafted, market-fresh recipes as full of flavour as they are flawlessly prepared. Examples include spider crab, crunchy veg and vinegar sorbet; whole grain risotto with asparagus, confit artichokes and an emulsion of wild garlic. Enduringly popular, all the more so because of the eater-friendly prices.

Name: Le Pressoir de Bacchus
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Such is the renown of Sylvie Grucker and her son that this pretty restaurant on the wine route is greatly in demand. Sylvie combines traditional recipes with an inventive streak in a bid to showcase regional fare: bacon-flavoured choucroute soup or duck shepherd’s pie, mushrooms and 12-spice sauce, side by side perennial favourites like granddad’s snails, ravioles of carp in a creamy, smoked sauce or Sylvie’s meringue and ice cream extravaganza! Local winegrowers and producers from the village (thirty or so) take pride of place on the enticing wine list.

Name: L'Émotion
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Two chefs, Michaël Ruat and Mickaël Méjean, childhood mates from Puy-en-Velay, have teamed up in this eatery. The interior sports a preference for natural materials and designer details (handsome glazed wine cellar). The food forges a culinary path between regional Haute Loire ingredients (green lentils, premium Mézenc beef) and a more contemporary score (tartare of red tuna, citrus fruits, fennel sorbet and crunchy pesto).

Name: L'Évidence
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: After honing his skills in top houses, Julien Burdin is enjoying his well-deserved success: knockout plating, premium ingredients and crisp, legible flavours, illustrated by ham and parsley terrine, mustard-flavoured whipped cream and onion pickles. The à la carte range highlights superior produce, like blue lobster, vegetable risotto and a seafood, tomato and wine sauce. Polished service.

Name: Arkadia
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A magnificent surprise awaits you along the Ardèche gorges: chef Marvin, born in Brittany, regales diners with uninhibited cuisine using locally sourced produce (vegetables and cheese in particular). The dishes are legible, appetising and the menu is renewed every month; the infectious gaiety of Philippine in the dining room is quite irresistible.

Name: La Merenda
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit cards not accepted
Description: A delightfully old - fashioned establishment, oozing with vintage charm. Dominique Le Stanc, formerly two - star chef of the Negresco, rustles up succulent regional dishes (stuffed sardines, tripe à la niçoise, chard pie, etc. ). No telephone – Dominique prefers guests drop in to book!

Name: La Table d'Inomoto
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Having formerly worked at the Pavillon des Boulevards, Seiji Inomoto now runs this very beguiling bistro. You can expect beautifully prepared fusion cuisine drawing on France and Japan, in which "modest" ingredients are elevated by perfect cooking and an astute sense of seasoning. The cooking is good, often original, and you won't believe the value for money. Don't delay!

Name: Le Relais des Salines
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This waterside bistro showcases seafood flavours and super-fresh produce. The menu sails between timeless classics (oysters, confit of octopus, lentils, mustard-flavoured sabayon and the chef’s lemon pie) and more spur-of-the-moment recipes. Inside, this former oyster shed upholds its heritage, while the terrace overlooking the marshes is blissful.

Name: Le Coq d'Or
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: ‘The Golden Cockerel’ is aptly named: the interior is full of the birds – brought back by customers from their travels! As for the food, expect an array of fine, well - crafted dishes that offer a creative take on local specialities.

Name: Bistrot Saveurs
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: British chef Simon Scott knocked around in London and Provence, before setting up shop in Tarn. A vibrant red façade leads into the snug trendy interior. This eclectic chef and master craftsman works exclusively with first-class ingredients (preferably local) in a bid to serve crisp, legible food oozing with flavour and aroma: cannelloni of king prawns wrapped in local courgettes, asparagus, truffle-flavoured mimosa eggs and squid ink ice cream; plancha seared slab of veal, foamy mashed carrot and nigella blossom, carrots in cream of cumin and carrot tops… Searingly good food throbbing with flavour!

Name: La Vieille Forge
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Beyond the rustic façade of this charming 16C house, some lovely surprises lie in store: chef Laurine Gutleben's dishes give pride of place to fresh produce and free rein to creativity, for instance the scallops with light hollandaise, braised leeks and gomasio popcorn. Well-chosen wine list, particularly from Alsace but not only.

Name: U Licettu
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Could this pink-rendered villa, decked in flowers and overlooking the gulf, have found the secret of authentic Corsican food? Whatever the case, you can be certain that you will sample wholehearted, full-bodied dishes made with first-class ingredients in keeping with time-honoured culinary traditions: nothing goes to waste from pig’s trotters to tails, the meat is slowly spit-roasted on the open fire or the lady of the house hovering nearby to check you finish your plate. Beverages included in the menu. Highly recommended.

Name: Le Jour du Poisson
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Run by a youthful team, this friendly little bistro at the tip of the island is often fully booked. The menu, as short as it is tempting, is everything it's cracked up to be: fish, from local fish auctions, features in many guises, short supply chains and natural wines are favoured, the bread is made in-house with flour sourced from Oléron. Agnolotti of langoustines, lemon butter and herbs is the signature dish.

Name: La Maison de Celou
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Clinging to the ramparts of the historic village, this lovely house embodies the art de vivre of Provence. The chef crafts spot-on dishes, steeped in originality, illustrated by scallops on toast with spinach and confit of tomatoes. The decadent desserts are fiendishly tempting, even addictive. Superlative sweeping view over Mont Ventoux and the Luberon range from the terrace.

Name: Le Balcon
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Chef Jean-Philippe Gauthier is upholding the traditions of this former coaching inn, which has been in the family since 1951. House specialties include: terrine of quail with plums and armagnac and a knockout trolley of matured cheeses. Meals are served in an interior that blends character and authenticity. Charming welcome and service. Rooms for overnight stays.

Name: Relais de l'Abbaye
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This modern Relais, looking out onto the surrounding meadows, is anchored in local culinary traditions. The chef is passionate about fine ingredients and showcases regional producers (Charlieu andouille, Charolais meat, cheese etc) in generous and nicely prepared dishes.

Name: Le Bistrot de Berne
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Chef Aurélie Liautaud turns out hearty, sun-drenched recipes starring first-rate ingredients, in particular from her own organic garden. Crunchy local asparagus, young hake roasted in anchovies, confit of pork ribs: straightforward, unfussy food that hits the spot every time, washed down with estate wines at prices that make sense.

Name: Le Flaveur
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This restaurant is tucked away in a side street set back from the marina and the walled city. Harmony reigns in the kitchen, where a duo of chefs composes dishes made with ultra-fresh ingredients. Locally sourced produce takes pride of place on the menu: buckwheat, the daily catch of small local boats, Brittany-reared pork, Bruyère Blanche poultry, farm-range eggs, without forgetting the excellent homemade bread.

Name: L'Écureuil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: By settling in Auvergne, the chef wanted to return to his roots. He has opened this friendly Squirrel devoted to good food. On the menu: appetising, market-fresh cuisine. Simpler lunchtime menu. The interior is the epitome of country chic.

Name: L'Agape
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Julien Gleize set up his restaurant on this pleasant square in the heart of the Cité des Papes in June 2014. The chef looks totally fulfilled as he works away in the kitchens, composing hearty, cleverly devised dishes, in which seasonal products are nicely showcased.

Name: Avenio
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: In the heart of Avignon, this modern restaurant run by a young couple with stints in high-end establishments is enjoying a well-deserved roll. Carefully sourced ingredients, a warm welcome and recipes in tune with the zeitgeist. Free-range poached egg, spinach and mushrooms, herb-crusted baked cod, sautéed leeks, shellfish and saffron butter and a pavlova of citrus and passion fruit to finish. Careful: tables are snapped up fast!

Name: L'Angle Saint-Laurent
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This smart and appealing setting with exposed stone, painted beams and soft lighting is to be found at the corner of rue St Laurent and rue des Bouchers. Ingredients from the region take pride of place on the menu (Bayeux pork, Normandy oysters... ), and feature heavily in the delicious, original and beautifully made dishes.

Name: Les Quatre Saisons
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The cooking of Didier Guibert, whose restaurant is located in a quiet little street in the city centre, is sincere and nicely done. He only works with fresh produce – and in particular meat supplied by his two brothers, butchers by trade. A well-run place.

Name: Italie là-bas
Address: 23 rue de la Bancasse, Avignon, 84000, France
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This enthusiastic Italian couple is living proof that Italians do it better. While he pampers guests front of house, she rustles up delicious Italian dishes, some highly creative, to propose tasting menus that include a vegetarian option. Venison bresaola; vitello tonnato with coffee, yuzu and hazelnuts; riso al salto with saffron, wild mushrooms and taleggio… food rife with authentic, wholesome flavours. Buon appetito!

Name: La Rapière
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This restaurant in a 15C building, tucked into a picturesque little street, has earned itself a good reputation. It serves fresh fish, fine local specialities or a sunnier culinary register.

Name: Les Maisons Du'O - Le Bistro Panoramique
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Locally grown tomatoes and fruit, Ventoux spelt and pork: the chef hits the spot every time with modern recipes rich in Provençal accents, such as line-caught black hake, local beans with pistou and Barronnies chorizo. Excellent value for money menu and knock-out view of the Ouvèze from the spacious contemporary dining room.

Name: La Table de Laurent
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Laurent Prat uses quality produce (langoustine, monkfish etc) to create a range of classic and more modern dishes that are always seamlessly put together and have international influences: pan-fried gnocchi with spinach; seared prawns in a Mexican marinade; grilled grouper, aubergine roll with beetroot hummus. Afternoon tea with house-made pastries, served in an inviting wood-panelled interior.

Name: Cartouches
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: In the picturesque and lively neighbourhood of Saint-Aubin, this tiny bistro is always busy! Chef Nicolas Brousse and his wife take great pleasure in serving up tasty, carefully prepared dishes. And in keeping with this spirit of conviviality, why not share a fine steak (butcher's choice – for two people)? This goes down very well with a natural wine from the extensive selection. The set menu changes every week.

Name: Le Saint Marc
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The scenic village of Aups, south of the Verdon Gorges, invites you to make a bistronomic halt. Chef Alexandre Dimitch and his small team play a local, bistronomic score, rich in generous flavours, with truffles in summertime and bouillabaisse and bourride by the fireside in winter. Wine lovers may like to know that the next-door wine cellar becomes a wine bar in the evenings.

Name: Le P'tit Goustan
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The chef at Le P'tit Goustan takes pride in sourcing his ingredients locally, whether fish or meat, fruit or vegetables, before putting together a feast of tuna tartare, tarragon pesto, cucumber with fresh goat's cheese, manioc chips, cucumber sorbet and gazpacho; roast pollack with turmeric and saffron, panisse, mussels two ways; strawberry tartare... The best of Brittany inspires him to create original, masterful dishes, to be enjoyed in one of the two cosy, contemporary dining spaces. The terrace of this charming establishment has a view of the small port.

Name: Au Raisin d'Or
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This hearty, inviting inn offers tasty Alsatian dishes featuring local produce. The regulars appreciate the daily specials and the chef’s classics (calf’s head, liver quenelles, boiled beef, etc). Friendly service.

Name: Le Beauvoir
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Annie and Mickaël Landaud are at the helm of an elegant family establishment which is quite a favourite with the locals. The bluish tones and plant-inspired artwork pay homage to the nearby marshlands… The chef conjures up modern, appetising dishes, adding a playful new spin to a traditional Gallic score. Alfresco dining in the rear courtyard.

Name: Café Brochier
Address: 4 place de la Fontaine, Saint-Julien-en-Vercors, 26420, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This handsome building is an institution in this Vercors village. Dating from 1867 and recently taken over by a youthful enthusiastic couple, it is home to a historical cafe adorned with frescoes dating back to 1912. Locally sourced ingredients play the lead roles on the menu, which changes regularly. Respect for the seasons goes hand in hand with respect for the produce, culinary skill and flavour. Three unpretentious rooms upstairs.

Name: L'Affranchi
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In one of the oldest streets in the city, nestled beneath the arcades, this creative restaurant promises diners "uninhibited gastronomy". True to their word, the team at the helm whisks up fresh, high-quality cuisine, only using ingredients sourced via short supply chains. Relaxed service in an inviting atmosphere characterised by exposed stone, oak parquet and street art.

Name: L'Atelier L'Art des Mets
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The chef proposes up - to - the - minute, distinctive cuisine, whose mainstay is wild herbs, which he learned to know through a local herb picker. Lamb’s quarters, wild lemon balm, purslane, mugwort... The culinary score is poetic and rich in flavour, illustrated by the slow - cooked, farm - reared, maize - fed chicken in lamb’s quarters with slow - cooked artichokes. Fine art at the service of taste!

Name: Peck & Co
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Brunch,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The chef and his partner have turned their former gourmet establishment into a friendlier and trendier venue thanks to a modern makeover and an open-plan kitchen. Talented chef Romain hasn't lost his touch and his market-fresh menu is a masterclass of fragrant, flavoursome and deftly crafted recipes, such as Iberico pluma pork, cream of cranberry beans, chards and a creamy chorizo sauce.

Name: Ahizpak Le Restaurant des Sœurs
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This bolthole is run by an irresistible trio of ahizpak (‘sisters’ in Basque). They pool their skills and talents to conjure up meals with a focus on premium, seasonal Basque produce. Delicate, succulent and generous are the watchwords of this welcoming establishment. Sunday Brunch.

Name: L'Aillet
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The chef may profess a simple, local approach to cooking, but his food finds its place among its trendy bistro peers on account of its definitively contemporary look. A starter of cauliflower, herring, tarragon and peanuts boasts a pared-back presentation and well-balanced flavours. The chef is also a past master in the art of tradition and roasting joints, a skill set we can only applaud! A welcome addition to the Arcachon Bay culinary scene.

Name: Gribiche
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: We fell head over heels with this endearing bistro! Traditional dishes, jazzed up for modern tastebuds and served generously, are enticingly chalked up on slate menus: porkpie, calf’s head gribiche sauce, lamb shank and desserts to die for with lashings of salted butter and cream. Fine choice of reasonably priced tipples.

Name: Les Quatre Saisons
Address: 3 route du Frenz, Le Frenz, 68820, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: Roland and Christelle are in the kitchens and Frédéric is in charge of selecting the wines. A winning team of father, daughter and son - in - law run this cosy chalet, and they don't put a foot wrong with their delicious seasonal cooking!

Name: L'Air de Famille
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: L'Air de Famille makes for an appealing place to eat with its period decor (vintage advertising posters, original counter) and unpretentious atmosphere. Tradition and the seasons dictate the menu here, with particular attention paid to flavour combinations and sauces. Calf's head with ravigote sauce and other classics regularly feature… and they boast a well-stocked wine list!

Name: Auberge des Aryelets
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: "You have to gain a little altitude to reach this hilltop village in the Pyrenees. On the central square, a driven young couple took over this place, honouring tradition and the region's produce: suckling pig cooked at a low temperature and rich jus; confit lamb, black garlic jus. "

Name: Auberge de la Poutre
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In the hub of a pretty village in the Jura lakes area, this family-run inn dating from 1740 plays on its rustic charm. Chef François Moureaux works with fine ingredients to create delicate and tasty contemporary cuisine, but doesn't neglect to revisit local specialities. As for the decor, the establishment is named after one notable feature: its 17m-long ceiling beam that comes from a 3m3 fir log!

Name: Auberge du Pont
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The cuisine is meticulous, tasty and flavoursome, with sauces to die for… Enjoy crispy shoulder of lamb with red onion and Taggiasca olives, or opt for more surprising original dishes such as gravlax beef glazed with rice vinegar. When the weather is fine, make the most of the shady terrace overlooking the Allier River. At lunchtime, they serve a single set menu – the menu du marché – and amenu-carte in the evening. Not to be missed!

Name: Le Bac à Traille
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The Japanese-born star chef of La Cachette has made his dream come true in this bistro, whose name pays homage to a former ferry that used to cross the Rhône. The market-fresh cuisine is impeccably crafted, always punchy and heroically flavoursome. A Franco-Japanese-inspired menu to share plus a selection of regional vintages. Unbeatable value for money.

Name: L'Auberge
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Not far from Hazebrouck, this Auberge was once a tannery then a tavern true to the traditions of France's northern regions. Now it is a restaurant with a friendly atmosphere showcasing seasonal produce and Flemish roots in reinterpretations of classic local fare (welsh, carbonade). Chef Antonin, who is also a wine enthusiast, pulls off surprising combinations such as snails, haddock and spinach, too!

Name: L'Embellie
Address: 245 route de Pont-sur-Grosne (Le Bourg), Sainte-Cécile, 71250, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A former stable whose rustic cachet is enhanced by beams, a fireplace and exposed brick walls. In the kitchen, the chef often draws inspiration from his travels, but always returns to certain classics, such as duck foie gras terrine or sautéed veal sweetbreads. The porchetta-style stuffed Burgundy rabbit and cromesquis made an impression. Have a home-made ice cream on the pleasant summer terrace, which only adds to the charm of this place.

Name: Le Bistro Urbain
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: At the helm of this bistro, which has just moved to a glamorous and more spacious location in the heart of Montpellier, is Cédric Sangenito, a chef with a seamless CV. His cooking is modern and a touch inventive, highlighting good fresh produce, especially vegetables; the menu is updated every week – although the rum baba, the emblematic dish of the house, is a mainstay, in various different guises. Furthermore, the bill won't break the bank and you receive a friendly welcome: full marks.

Name: Le Cottage
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The restaurant at Le Cottage is the latest venture of Philippe Girardon, a chef whose passion and experience are beyond dispute. He creates bistro - style fare using lovely fresh ingredients. Savour these in the large dining area or outside on the terrace in the shade of the plane trees.

Name: La Closerie des Roses
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Surrounded by rose bushes, this restaurant, which has stood on the banks of the Loire since 1938, affords a lovely view of the river and the abbey church – St-Florent-le-Vieil. In a lovely contemporary space, the chef serves up appealing traditional cuisine drawing on regional fare (pike-perch, pike, eel, young free-range pigeon, calf sweetbreads) accompanied by classic sauces (beurre blanc, shellfish jus, wine sauce).

Name: Ishikawa
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In a busy pedestrian street in the city centre, chef Yugo Ishikawa has set up shop in this elongated, minimalist-style restaurant. He throws himself body and soul into his painstakingly crafted dishes from the traditional Japanese cuisine he so loves. On the daily specials board: tonkatsu shoulder of pork in breadcrumbs, tuna tataki with ponzu oroshi, tsukemono pickled vegetables. Simpler delicious options at lunchtime. You almost feel like you are in an izakaya in Tokyo. A hit.

Name: Racines
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A stone’s throw from the marina of Étaples and only 5km from Le Touquet, this new restaurant is focused on succulent wholesome fare made with carefully sourced local produce. The recipes of chef Pierre Chavatte hit the spot every time. The interior sports a contemporary vibe with semi-open kitchens and hanging light fixtures surrounded by roots, a passing nod to the restaurant’s name. Highly recommended!

Name: Racine
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: "The name refers to not just one racine (""root""), but several: the chef's Burgundian roots, a great source of pride for him; the origins of the ingredients he uses (90% of which are produced within a 100km radius). His tasty and well - balanced dishes do the rest. Small delicatessen and wine bar on Thursdays and Fridays. "

Name: Le Chardonnay
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Hugues Maisonneuve is at the helm of this swish bistro. In the kitchen, a young chef rustles up a concise, seasonal à la carte menu and a particularly enticing market-fresh menu. Everything here looks as good as it tastes. Trendy vintage décor, soft lighting and a pleasant patio.

Name: Bistrot DuPont
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: By the River Seine, this affably French bistro conjures up vintage recipes served by a cheerful team: slab of foie gras, coq au vin, fillet of beef in cognac, and the house specialty, andouillette. A bustling, friendly vibe depicts this gregarious eatery with atmosphere by the bucket load.

Name: Bistrot de Port-Lesney
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Just a few metres from the River Loue, this bistro with red shutters has a terrace that gives onto the village square. The chef's generous traditional cuisine is a real ode to the terroir: smoked trout and preserved leek; Petit Mercey snails; poultry supreme and a vin jaune cream – served on tables with checked tablecloths in an interior packed with salvaged knick-knacks.

Name: La Table d'Antoine
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This eatery is located in a pedestrian street just next-door to the Parc des Sources. Its chef, an inveterate traveller, rustles up creative, cleverly balanced cuisine and is equally at home with a shoulder of lamb cooked in embers as with roast seabass and a fishy jus of oysters and citrus fruit. The contemporary décor mixes Volvic stone and Salers leather!

Name: La Vierge
Address: 58 rue de la Réunion, Paris, 75020, France
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: You will adore this vintage interior with antique tables, wooden chairs, old tiles and an open kitchen. As for the food, the chef sends out fresh, effective and flavoursome fare – from the first to the last bite. The lunchtime menu is a steal.

Name: Le Médiéval
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In a cobbled street in the heart of a picturesque historic village, Pierre Creuzet, former second chef of Jacques Lameloise, navigates between a pure-bred French line-up and more modern creations: rillettes of smoked salmon in lime; roast pork, mashed potatoes and sweet-sour sauce; panacotta with strawberry. His wife, Loren, a sommelière, advises diners as to wine-food pairings.

Name: Gare aux Goûts
Address: 26 bis rue Louis Blanqui, Lorient, 56100, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Chef Vincent Seviller has come up trumps in this establishment near the railway station. He invites diners on a bistronomic journey in a tasteful, modern setting. An experienced and talented craftsman, each dish is artfully presented, flavoursome and balanced. The lunchtime menu is chalked up on a slate, but more elaborate in the evening.

Name: Auberge Saint Fiacre
Address: 5 rue de la Fontaine, Veuil, 36600, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The couple at the head of this pleasant inn in a small village near Valençay can be relied upon to whip up amazing food; everything is homemade and the chef favours regional ingredients to concoct his delicate, toothsome recipes. Served in a charming rustic interior or alfresco on the flower-decked terrace in fine weather. The establishment’s success and excellent value for money mean that bookings are essential.

Name: Saveurs de l'Abbaye
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A stone’s throw from the Abbaye aux Dames, now a concert venue, this stripped - back restaurant serves fresh, light, spontaneous food with a distinct preference for fine regional produce from the market, to which chef Vincent Coiquaud, basket in hand, goes daily. Plain, pleasant rooms for overnight stays.

Name: Restaurant Dimofski
Address: 2 quartier de la Gare, Wœlfling-lès-Sarreguemines, 57200, France
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Committed and determined, Julien Dimofski’s enthusiasm can be tasted in his delicious, carefully crafted dishes (just-cooked langoustines with yuzu butter, or roasted pigeon with a parsley jus), in keeping with modern tastes. Airy, rustic interior some 12km/7mi from Sarreguemines.

Name: Côté Sud
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This young couple with an impressive track record concocts simple cuisine, drawing on regional inspiration to deliver well-crafted dishes. You are sure to enjoy your visit to this stone house with a garden and pleasant terrace. Tuck into the slow-cooked egg with artichokes and black olives or saddle of rabbit stuffed with wood ear mushrooms, crushed potatoes and a red pepper coulis. The wine list focuses on organic and biodynamic wines. Charming service.

Name: Bellavista
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: It is always a pleasure to return to this eatery at the foot of the ramparts of a fortified citadel, no less! The menu positively smacks of the terroir, which is not surprising as the chef uses local produce delivered by the farmers in person. Slow-roasted Catalan lamb in fresh herbs with seasonal veggies, without forgetting cheese from the Pyrenees... Cosy rooms for overnight stays.

Name: Le Bistro d'en Face
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Chef-patron Hugo Brégeon and his wife Aurore, who is in charge of the restaurant floor, have set up shop in a small location, with a terrace that commands an uninterrupted panoramic view of the old town and the Dordogne River with its gabarres (traditional riverboats). The tasty, well-crafted food does the view justice: dynamic neo-bistro cuisine that brilliantly revisits some of the French classics – it is unbeatable value, and there is a nice choice of wines by the glass.

Name: Le Manoir de Kerbot
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This 16C manor house (once an orphanage) has been converted into a haven for food lovers. Guests are treated to fairly traditional cuisine – warm oysters, semi-cooked foie gras, catch of the day, pulled pork in a spice crust served with an aromatic reduction: tasty, well-crafted recipes all the way! The service is very attentive, and the terrace overlooking a lake is delightful, as are the lovely guestrooms.

Name: Mets et Vins
Address: 11 rue de la République, Bourg-en-Bresse, 01000, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This is the kingdom of Stéphane Prévalet, a champion of local produce and home-made fare who enjoys pushing traditional culinary boundaries. Examples include chicory and blue cheese upside-down pie or Dombes duckling with Bugey blackcurrant. A minimalist interior decorated with birch trunks sets the scene in this trendy establishment.

Name: Le 1825 - La Table bistronomique
Address: Château de la Brûlaire - 404 La Brûlaire, Gesté, 49600, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Tucked away in the countryside, this bistro is housed in a small 19C château. It is presided over by an experienced chef, who regales guests at lunchtime (only) with a remarkable repertoire in which the techniques learned in top establishments do justice to impeccable produce – the food is simple, fresh and fragrant. In the huge dining room that occupies the former orangery, original materials are combined with modern furnishings.

Name: Au Petit Vatel
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A genuine institution, “The” place to eat in Alençon is in the hands of seasoned chef Julien Perrodin and his wife, Barbara, in the dining room. They propose contemporary seasonal cuisine founded on top-notch regional produce (the chef is a local lad), without forgetting a wickedly tempting dessert trolley. The menu will make your mouth water, before your tastebuds sample the flavoursome fare, often with an exotic spike and as generous as the region. Prices that make sense.

Name: La Réserve du Presbytère
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Opposite the Romanesque church of a wine-growing village is this eatery serving bistronomy dishes. Diners savour traditional flavours in a decor comprising bistro tables and industrial chairs set up against a backdrop of exposed stone walls. The delicious desserts deserve a special mention: amandine tartlet with figs, raspberry confit and sorbet. Pleasant terrace to the rear.

Name: L'Équilibre
Address: 10 place de la Libération, Balma, 31130, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: "Run by a couple of 30 - somethings, who believe in hearty, wholesome food, this restaurant fully deserves its resounding success. The chef concocts inspired and balanced recipes using top - quality, market - fresh produce: flawlessly poached egg with cream of leeks and ginger; haddock and carrot pickles. Outstanding value for money. "

Name: Briket' Bistrot
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The Ibarboure family hotel also has this pleasant bistro, which is independent of the gourmet restaurant. The chef creates meticulous, delicate and flavoursome food in a refined setting. Basque ingredients dominate the menu, as you might expect, but not to the exclusion of exotic dishes. The team is young and friendly, the prices remain reasonable. A real treat.

Name: La Table de Pablo
Address: 1713 route de Rustrel, Hameau Les Petits-Cléments, Villars, 84400, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Delicate and decidedly creative cuisine based on good regional ingredients: this restaurant surrounded by vines and cherry trees is a real find. Try the surprise menu, inspired by the offerings of the markets and small-scale local producers. The chef-patron takes care of everything himself, both in the dining room and the kitchen. Special mention for the peaceful terrace, where you can hear the cicadas' call.

Name: Cécile
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Wheelchair access
Description: In the lively, bustling Carmes neighbourhood, a close-knit young team welcomes you to this modern bistro with a wood-decked veranda, large open kitchen and contemporary decor. The short menu is inspired by a real mix of cultures: exotic touches are incorporated into dishes such as Thai duck tartare and farm-reared pork loin with mango and pomegranate.

Name: L'Olivier
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Chef Olivier Lamard, former second-in-command to Michelin-starred Julien Binz, now has his own restaurant. He proposes modern cuisine that draws on the terroir of Alsace: soft cheese mousse, potato salad and home-smoked trout, pork from Goettelmann’s farm, and for dessert, pear with sesame. Nicely prepared dishes made from fine ingredients, some of which come from the chef's grandfather's garden. A charming place.

Name: Hyacinthe & Robert
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Chef Damien Le Quillec named his restaurant after his two grandfathers. In this unusual setting – previously a garage, cleverly converted into a contemporary loft – he channels his talent into crafting ambitious dishes that appeal to the modern palate. Meanwhile, he has opened a convivial little bistro next door – Numéro 100, where he serves bistronomy fare in a home-from-home atmosphere.

Name: Le Bistrot de Villedieu
Address: 21 place de la Libération, Villedieu, 84110, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Laurent Azoulay has embarked on a new culinary adventure in this village in northern Vaucluse since June 2020. The veteran owner chef, currently of the star EKrin at Méribel, whisks up provençal fare in a locally sourced bistro register. The flavoursome, flawlessly executed repertory is rich in character and some of the dishes are cooked in the wood-burning oven of the open kitchen. Meals are served in a contemporary bistro setting, or, in fine weather, on the shaded terrace on the village square.

Name: Le Saisonnier
Address: 56 rue de la Verrerie, Roye, 70200, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Anyone able to pull off a combination of gravlax salmon and smoked duck breast cream deserves our full attention! This is a chef with an impressive track record who, together with his wife, has brought to life this old farmhouse on the main road through the village. Expect well-crafted and carefully presented dishes, with combinations of flavours that may surprise (the salmon is a case in point). A cuisine that revisits certain classics but also encompasses dishes that are firmly rooted in the region, it draws on seasonal ingredients such as morels, emulsion of Vieux Comté cheese and vin jaune. Dine in the modern interior or on the pleasant terrace to the rear.

Name: Le Margote
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In his restaurant facing the Bassin du Roi, chef Gauthier Teissere, assisted by his wife Marguerite in the dining room, plays a modern, unabashedly modern score, jazzed up with occasional Asian note. The stylish, snug interior is the perfect foil for dishes that reverently respect the seasons. Each plate is a masterpiece, illustrated by a tartare of red tuna, avocado, chimichurri sauce or risotto of haddock with croutons in lemon butter.

Name: Le Patio by Lou Caléou
Address: 23 place de la Libération, Sommières, 30250, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Having worked together in some renowned establishments, chef Guillaume Dercourt and pastry chef Amandine Sabot decided to open this restaurant in Sommières with a stonework interior and a charming patio for summer. What's not to love? The cooking is resolutely modern in its form and draws playfully on the traditional French repertoire: tielle sétoise ravioli, slow-confit shoulder of veal, blanquette garnish or, for dessert, the delicious Paris-Brest. A real treat.

Name: Les Plaisirs
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This friendly family-run inn is tucked away in a village high in the hinterland of Nice. The young owner-chef, descended from a long line of restaurant owners, throws his heart and soul into preparing Provençal recipes using impeccably selected regional produce. Authentic flavours, fuss-free plating, enticing recipes and eater-friendly prices! What more do we need to say?

Name: La Petite Grange
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In this picturesque Cantal village, home to a castle, the traveller is always delighted to take a seat in this tastefully renovated traditional barn (wood, stone and shale). Beneath a stunning raftered ceiling, gaze out at the Doire Valley through the large windows. In the kitchen, chef Olivier Cloteau expertly crafts seasonal dishes that pay homage to the Cantal region and its producers, without forgetting a few nods to his Charentes roots (mouclade (mussels in saffron) as an appetizer). 100% wholesome, hearty nosh.

Name: Brasserie d'Asten
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: On Binic port, this contemporary brasserie has large bay windows overlooking the sea. The chef with a glittering track record (Le Coquillage – Maison de Bricourt in Cancale, La Pyramide Patrick Henriroux in Vienne and K2 in Courchevel) likes to cook up his enticing brand of "bistronomy" cuisine, incorporated into set menus that represent good value for money.

Name: Bergamote
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The unusual façade of this bistronomic bijou can be found in the heart of a district in the throes of renovation. A youthful chef carefully crafts seasonal fare, depicted by crisp flavours in a simple, natural setting. The lunchtime prices are deliciously eater friendly – more ambitious in the evening.

Name: Hostellerie Saint-Clément
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This small family-run restaurant is the epitome of friendly and the father and son team crafts a traditional, gourmet score, underscored by beautiful plating: breast of free-range guinea fowl and morel mushroom sauce; cassolette of Brittany monkfish… We recommend the homemade quail terrine.

Name: La Récré
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
