Description: This restaurant is housed in a former village school for boys. You will notice evidence of its previous incarnation in the decor with blackboards and geographical maps hanging on the walls. On the menu, the dishes are creative and make good use of locally sourced ingredients. It is enough to make us sign up for evening classes!

Name: Le Biniou
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The chef draws his inspiration from deepest Brittany, illustrated by dishes such as crumbly buckwheat in butter and shallots, but is also open to other influences, as the fillet of whiting, lemon balm and watercress coulis demonstrate. Deftly crafted food, cheerful service, a digestible bill and a location just a few knots from the beach. The quintessence of Brittany.

Name: L'IØDE
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A butcher's son born on the Île d'Oléron, chef Benjamin Girard has chosen to focus on fish and seafood. In this narrow modern dining space done out in white and blue hues, the delicious dishes with creative touches keep on coming: mackerel half-cooked with a blowtorch, grilled watermelon and tomato water; halibut with a langoustine foam and blackberries; black forest gateau-style "explosive cherry" dessert. Eater-friendly prices and an enticing wine list with plenty of organic options.

Name: L'Arbre Vert
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The tree mentioned in the name of this restaurant could well be a genealogical one, so closely is its history bound up with that of the Koenig family. Now run by the fifth generation of this family, the restaurant serves specialities from Alsace, which are accompanied by good regional wines.

Name: Cabane
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Chef Jean-François Bury, who boasts stints at the George V and the Shangri-La, is masterfully regaling Nanterre with modern, bistronomic nosh. Well-crafted recipes, generous helpings and wholesome flavours, such as confit of finely sliced veal belly in oregano, smoked apple puree, sucrine lettuce, or the exquisitely crafted and fiendishly tempting lemon and raspberry showpiece.

Name: L'Estacade
Address: 4 quai du Lénigo, Le Croisic, 44490, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This pleasant eatery on the quayside, opposite the fish market, is managed by two young people with experience in some elite establishments. They propose hearty and meticulously made food that makes good use of regional produce (fish, shellfish and seaweed, of course, but also meat). The lady of the house is a radiant hostess. Smiling staff and attentive service.

Name: La Croix Blanche
Address: 2 avenue de la Loire, Veuves, 41150, France
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: At this former coaching inn, you can enjoy the modern cuisine of chef Jean-François Beauduin, who learned his trade in Michelin-starred restaurants. His tempting menu abounds with wonderfully indulgent treats, which does not preclude finesse – the warm duck and foie gras pâté, shredded Brussels sprouts and langoustine sauce is a case in point. Seasonal and local ingredients are de rigueur. Note the selection of more traditional dishes, such as beuchelle tourangelle (creamed kidneys and sweetbreads). Charming service courtesy of the chef's wife, in a delightfully rustic setting. The pleasant terrace in the shade of mulberry trees is a real highlight.

Name: L'Ermitage
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This beautifully restored old barn has retained its rustic character and remains at one with its surroundings. The terrace is a lovely spot to sit and enjoy the traditional food, and in winter there is the fireplace.

Name: Les Loges du Jardin d'Aymeric
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The quintessential country establishment, where they are still passionate about what they do. Mad about great ingredients, the chef uses vegetables from his kitchen garden and citrus fruits from the surrounding area, and makes his own bread made with ancient flours. Unpretentious family service, reasonable prices: an enjoyable experience.

Name: La Tête au Loup
Address: Lieu-dit la Tête-au-Loup, Le Pin-au-Haras, 61310, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Stéphane and Agnès Mabille greet guests warmly in their spruce, traditional inn, appointed in a rustic vein. The seasoned chef concocts homemade terrines and assorted Normandy delicacies. In fine weather, make a beeline for the garden and terrace, which overlook the horses grazing in the next-door world-famous Haras du Pin stud farm. Unstarched, friendly vibe.

Name: Le Bistrot 270
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The Domaine du Colombier’s sibling restaurant offers well-structured, bistro fare, inspired by tip-top quality ingredients. French staples take pride of place in the wholesome, savoury recipes: semi-cooked duck foie gras; haunch of tender veal; shepherd’s pie. In fine weather, the terrace near the pool and the pool-house bar overlooking the meadows and the fortified town are heavenly.

Name: O2C
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A former helicopter pilot who now devotes himself body and soul to cooking, Christophe Bellegaud is at the controls of this restaurant, which sports a tasteful cream and chocolate colour scheme. He uses local ingredients to create 100% homemade up-to-the-minute market cuisine that is always spot on. Chantal, the second “c” of this o2c, gracefully caters to diner’s needs.

Name: L'Envers du Décor
Address: 23 rue de la Bienfaisance, Les Herbiers, 85500, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This old bakery has been transformed into a smart, contemporary restaurant that sports a minimalist soothing vibe. Chef Aurélien Jousseaume earned his stripes in Michelin-starred kitchens with the likes of Etchebest, Guy Savoy and Guy Martin. To-ing and fro-ing between his open kitchen and the restaurant floor, the chef, who is clearly having a ball, takes the orders and presents the dishes himself. His delicious seasonal cuisine demonstrates a laser-sharp understanding of sauces and jus, which we warrant will linger long in your memories (creamy jus of trout eggs on hake or a full-bodied gravy of veal and bacon on roast veal).

Name: Le Sous-sol
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This elegant basement plays an appetising gourmet score, orchestrated by youthful Thibaud Schouten! Slow-baked egg yolk, roast leeks, humus and cockles or loin of pork, roast green asparagus, Colonnata bacon and gravy: tip-top, market fresh, invariably regional ingredients, crafted into recipes that hit the spot every time.

Name: Bistrot d'Antoine
Address: 27 rue de la Préfecture, Nice, 06300, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The lilting accent of the South of France can be detected in this bistro, where a really convivial atmosphere reigns. Things hot up in the kitchen, with dishes such as old-fashioned pork casserole or knife-cut beef tartare – only the best makes the cut here. Crowded? Well, yes: Antoine has a huge (and well-deserved) success on his hands.

Name: Le Bistrot d'Antoine
Address: 3 rue de la Courtine, Strasbourg, 67000, France
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Near Place St-Étienne and the rue des Frères, this super bistro has cracked the formula for success: tasty produce, preferably local and seasonal, generous dishes from the traditional repertoire (including kâseknepfle and schniederspaetle), a friendly atmosphere, a natural and biodynamic wine list... and good value for money.

Name: Le Clos Saint Martin - La Métairie
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Wheelchair access
Description: Mélanie Zervos and her partner Mickaël Cappella welcome you to their restaurant in this small village between Mirepoix and Pamiers. The chef shines a spotlight on the local terroir: salad of pork trotters and herring "like a stuffed onion" on a potato emulsion, for a surf/turf dish that packs a punch; medallion of veal cooked until still pink in the centre, basil and vegetables from nearby market gardens; a deconstructed millefeuille that delivers on all its promises in terms of textures… Culinary bliss!

Name: Côté Bastide
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: At a slight distance from the town centre, this is the headquarters of Laurence and Cédric. She is the chef and produces tasty cuisine in step with the seasons. While he is a trained sommelier and chooses the best wines (notably Bordeaux) to accompany the dishes concocted by his partner. A duo that works wonders!

Name: Le Bon Temps
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: By the side of the legendary Nationale 7 road, this small eatery may not look like much but is a reminder not to judge a book by its cover! In the kitchens, it is a couple who cook up delicious and hearty market-fresh cuisine, in alignment with local producers. Potato blini with oyster mushrooms; grilled pluma pork with Madeira sauce, potato gratin… Fresh produce (especially the vegetables), the joy of a good job well done and unbeatable prices.

Name: La Fourchette à Droite
Address: 2 rue de la Pie-qui-Boit, Saint-Malo, 35400, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Welcome to Caroline and Étienne Corson's place. She is in charge front of house and, incidentally, being left-handed, is the reason the fork in the restaurant's name is on the right! The dishes run through what Brittany does best, showcasing lovely seasonal ingredients: monkfish gravlax with seaweed; hand-dived scallops and a medley of pumpkin; melt-in-the-mouth apple with an almond crunch and cider caramel, for example. Booking is recommended, as places are limited at this inviting little place.

Name: Jeanette
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Local wines vinified naturally, organic fruit and vegetables from the valleys around Grenoble, flavoured oils made on the premises, recycling and other eco-friendly initiatives: our two Jeannettes serve original and authentic cuisine in their friendly bistro (which offers great value for money, especially at lunchtime).

Name: La Petite Ourse
Address: 48 boulevard de la Liberté, Rennes, 35000, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Back in the city where they first met, Charlotte and Germain have set up a restaurant that expresses their warm and friendly disposition! It enjoyed instant success, and with good reason: ingredients selected with care (local and organic market produce and poultry; the same goes for the traditional bread), dishes that are full of flavour and good ideas. Simple and effective cuisine at highly competitive prices.

Name: Baca'v
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Good wholesome food and a casual, down-to-earth vibe depict Émile Cotte’s approach. After a traditional textbook approach to cooking, he now favours a more instinctive, spontaneous style, adding a personal twist to updated bistro classics, such as oeuf parfait, country bacon and cream of parmesan. The regularly changing slate menu is deliciously affordable and there is also a 5-course surprise menu.

Name: Bird
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In the heart of this charming borough, on a pedestrian square near the town hall, a pocket-sized restaurant run by a young chef with an impressive cv. Market-inspired menu with the likes of fresh pasta with mussels, calamari and langoustines, or poultry quenelles with freekeh... Scandinavian style dining room, terrace overlooking a fountain. Delicious prices.

Name: Auberge de La Mère Duval
Address: Impasse de la Linerie, Auzouville-sur-Saâne, 76730, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Alexandre and Mélanie Baranzelli are thriving in a new venue oozing with country charm: picture a stream spanned by two bridges and a watermill! The chef, after honing his skills in top establishments, demonstrates his fondness for traditional recipes from his native Normandy, to which he is increasingly adding his own distinctive culinary hallmark.

Name: La Pomme d'Or
Address: 1 rue de la Panneterie, Sancerre, 18300, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A slice of The Golden Apple (La Pomme d'Or) is always delicious. A young couple from Brittany has taken over this restaurant, a former coaching inn with a slightly revamped dining area. The modern cuisine draws on the Sancerre terroir and Breton roots: vegetables from the garden, tomato water broth; pork tenderloin fillet, seasonal vegetables. You can see straight away that the chef is a pro (cf. the presentation of the dishes) who never forgets the sine qua non: how it tastes! The chocolate gianduja praline with a gavotte biscuit crisp is a wonderful dessert. The wine list, unsurprisingly, gives the floor to Sancerre wines, and that is fine by us!

Name: Les 7
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This tiny place (no more than 25 covers) is the haunt of an enterprising young couple. The dishes are carefully presented, the flavours and textures are perfectly paired. Let's not forget to mention the absolutely delightful service.

Name: Café de la Fontaine
Address: 4 avenue du Général-de-Gaulle, La Turbie, 06320, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A convivial atmosphere, good choice of unpretentious, enjoyable wines, as well as tasty and generous market sourced cuisine of Provencal inspiration. All chalked up on the slate. A memorable culinary experience guaranteed!

Name: L'Auberge du Pas de Vent
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: L'Auberge du Pas de Vent… a splendid name, like something dreamed up by Tolkien. This authentic inn in the Landes serves bold and lively cuisine that remains aloof from fads and gimmicks. The menu fetes the terroir: farm-reared Chalosse beef, free-range fattened duck, veal from calves fed on their mother's milk, pure ewe's milk cheese from a village shepherd and home-made sourdough bread (without additives). Here, tradition is not a dirty word. Butternut soup and dried lomo sausage, cuttlefish broth with star anise, steamed leek and diced chorizo: the hearty dishes hark back to grandmother's home cooking. It's an enjoyable mealtime, while in the next room, people play a game of ninepins… Warm welcome, attentive, professional and efficient service. We couldn't ask for anything more.

Name: La Maison de Kerdiès
Address: 5 route de Perherel, à Saint-Samson, Plougasnou, 29630, France
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This restaurant at the tip of Trégor province was originally a signal station then a holiday camp before being converted into a restaurant. From inside, you can enjoy a panoramic view over the Bay of Morlaix. But your attention will soon be drawn back to the food, which encompasses both regional dishes (catch of the day with a Roscoff onion sauce) and more traditional fare (chicken supreme with morel mushrooms and garlic-fried potatoes).

Name: Chez les Anges
Address: 54 boulevard de la Tour-Maubourg, Paris, 75007, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: This chic brasserie, which was refurbished and revamped a few years ago, proposes an extensive set menu and an à la carte menu packed with premium ingredients (sole meunière, Galicia rib of beef). For solo meals, there is nothing like the central counter, where seafood is displayed on crushed ice. Tasty and masterful cooking, and a fine wine and whisky list… What a treat!

Name: La Chatellenie
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Emilie and Thomas Fournier have thrown all their enthusiasm and talent into this charming inn, hidden deep in the Vienne region. Regional produce takes the limelight in dishes as if art-directed and at deliciously eater-friendly prices. An example: grilled calf’s head that melts in the mouth with top-to-tail carrots. Well worth the detour.

Name: Atelier Salone
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Atelier Salone, the bistronomy sibling of Villa Salone, is pampered by Alexandre Lechêne, a chef with a stellar CV (Aux Lyonnais, Louis XV in Monaco) and a former Michelin-starred chef in Saint Véran (Hautes Alpes département). On the day of our visit, the menu included wild boar stew, squash gnocchi, quince confit and pear in a red wine, fillet of sea bream, raw and sautéed courgettes, and roast supreme of guinea fowl with green beans and figs. The original style of this early-20C building is underscored by contemporary details.

Name: Téjérina - Hôtel de la Place
Address: 51 place de la Mairie, Polliat, 01310, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The epitome of a family-run inn, where hearty portions of tasty cuisine du terroir are served with a smile in a freshly refurbished dining area. Calf's head, chicken in creamy sauce, chicken liver soufflé and frogs' legs are all on the menu. Well-kept guestrooms for overnight stays.

Name: Le Garriane
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: "Garriane" is the contraction of Garry and Ariane, and originality is the name of the game here! In the kitchens, Garry, an Australian, concocts seasonal, ingredient focused cuisine that is open to influences from around the world. At lunch and dinner, there is a single set menu. The restaurant is very small so it is best to book ahead.

Name: La Gare
Address: 4 rue des Ormelets, à Beaussais-sur-Mer, Ploubalay, 22650, France
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The chef reinterprets regional traditions by adding a fresh new twist to flavoursome surf - turf cuisine. As you explore the seaside resorts of the Emerald Coast, treat yourself to this countrified, gourmet Station!

Name: La Table du Pouyaud
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In the upper reaches of Périgueux, chef Gilles Gourvat (a local lad) has set up shop in a tastefully restored farmhouse. His modern recipes pay tribute to Périgord traditions, in which local produce (truffles in season) is cast in the star role. Examples: whole duck breast roasted with cèpes; scrambled eggs and truffles; semi-cooked duck foie gras smoked in hay. Heavenly.

Name: 20 Eiffel
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: In a quiet street a stone’s throw from the Eiffel Tower, this restaurant offers a understated interior full of light. On the menu, you can choose from a range of updated dishes, prepared by two chefs, all of which place the focus on flavour and taste. For example, a delicious fillet of wild Pollock with squash.

Name: Manger & Dormir sur la Plage
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: It sounds like the title of a song from the 1980s. This young and relaxed restaurant facing the sea offers marine-inspired cuisine, with a mouthwatering choice of shellfish, fish, and of course oysters: the establishment belongs to the Gillardeau family, the famous oyster farmers. The large terrace offers a lovely view, with the Île d'Oléron on the horizon. As for accommodation, "Dormir sur la Plage" has four large very well-appointed junior suites.

Name: Auberge de Port Vallières
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace
Description: The welcoming establishment of Marie-Hélène and Bruno Leroux offers sustenance to discerning foodies in a chic contemporary setting. Flavoursome cuisine, rich in regional delicacies, awaits you in this stylish, inviting restaurant, whose chef cannot resist prime ingredients: truffle-flavoured homemade white pudding, poultry sauce; seven-hour roasted shoulder of French lamb in thyme… Slick service. The wine cellar is a treasure trove of regional tipples! Good food comes first in this auberge where you are always welcomed with a smile.

Name: Les Petits Parisiens
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Chef Clément Gélard, after honing his skills in top establishments, is crafting modern bistro fare, adding an inspired touch to time-honoured family favourites such as stuffed cabbage. Food lovers won’t be able to resist the chocolate mousse with olive oil and fleur de sel or his absolute must: vanilla flavoured rice pudding with dried fruit and butterscotch – to die for!

Name: Chez Davia
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This likeable establishment, run by the same family since 1953, was founded by grandma Davia and taken over in 1985 by mum, Alda, now retired. Since 2016, Pierre Altobelli, whose impressive CV features star establishments in France and Asia, concocts tempting recipes rich in the aromas of Nice. Every detail is perfect, and the ingredients are meticulously sourced. Served in a welcoming vintage bistro décor steeped in authenticity. Heavenly!

Name: Le Bouche à Oreille
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This top-notch establishment is laid out behind a tasteful glazed façade. The chef adheres to tradition when crafting his bold, generous and flavourful cuisine but puts his own stamp on dishes with the odd touch of originality – think prawn tartare, prawn gyoza with coriander and lemongrass, bisque and cashew nuts. His friendly and efficient wife takes care of things front of house, dispensing insightful wine tips along the way.

Name: L'Altévic
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In a contemporary glass and metal setting, Jean-Christophe Perrin serves up-to-date dishes, inspired by the market : poultry and morel mushroom pâté en croute ; stone bass with white beans from Paimpol ; mont-blanc pavlova-style…

Name: C'la Vie
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: From a long line of bakers, chef Richard Durand has made C'la Vie a real mecca for food lovers. The food is good and life is good! The daily menu features terrific ingredients (most of them local), the flavours are distinctive, and the focus is firmly on dining pleasure. Enjoy your meal in the pared-back dining area inside, or on the terrace in the shade of a hundred-year-old plane tree. A fine selection of wines that celebrates the Rhône Valley and Languedoc, and rightfully so.

Name: Le Comptoir de La Butte
Address: 12 rue de la Mer, Plouider, 29260, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This extension of the gourmet flagship is also rich in culinary appeal. The modern layout sports an open kitchen and a shop to set your taste buds tingling… and they aren't disappointed when it comes to the generous traditional dishes with their roots in Finistère cuisine, nicely organised into a set menu.

Name: Brigade du Tigre
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Wheelchair access
Description: Both have trained with William Ledeuil, both are passionate about Asia, having traversed the continent, and now the duo who run the kitchen at Eels have joined forces to celebrate the joyful diversity of Asian cuisine in a bistro-style duplex. The result: small fragrant nuggets to nibble on your own or to share, concocted from quality products...

Name: Au Bon Accueil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: In a quiet street in the shadow of the Eiffel Tower, you can enjoy appetising market-fresh cuisine that mirrors the seasons and comes at a very reasonable price: smoked heart fillet of salmon served with lemon cream; roasted chicken supreme, oyster mushrooms and grenaille potatoes; pavlova with exotic fruits – all accompanied by well-chosen wines. A reliably good option, which is always booked out!

Name: La Maison de Marie
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This elegant pink granite house blends in beautifully with the surrounding coastal scenery. The chef shines the spotlight on the region’s star ingredients such as scallops from Cotes d'Armor and oysters from Lanmodez. His constantly changing menu, to the delight of the many regulars, adapts to market availability. Traditional culinary score.

Name: Ti-Coz
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This picture postcard stone inn offers both country appeal and a modern elegant interior, reminiscent of an English club. The chef is a fan of flavoursome, traditional cuisine that shines the spotlight on the best of Brittany’s ingredients. A former sommelier, he pairs his recipes with a fantastic 500-strong wine bin.

Name: Kalamansi
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Returning from Alsace, chef Frédéric Michel and his wife Manuella opened this delightful restaurant in his home town. He cooks up fresh and bold dishes, precisely cooked and with well-defined flavours, relying as much as possible on short supply chains (local fish and market gardening, Normandy beef).

Name: La Table
Address: 1 traverse de Jas, Les Ribas, Tourtour, 83690, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This charming small restaurant has a contemporary decor of paintings and designer chairs on the first floor of a stone - built house. Tasty cuisine showcasing seasonal market produce with an emphasis on vegetables.

Name: Le Malu
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A military barracks under Napoleon III, the site has since been converted into a restaurant, where chef Ludovic Brethenoux brings in the big guns. Originally from Périgord, he trained, most notably, at La Villa Madie in Cassis. His affinity with the Vendômois area is evident in his precise and refined contemporary cuisine. A real treat.

Name: La Table du Fleuve
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The brainchild of Thierry and Julien Verrat, this Charentes restaurant is distinctly bistronomic in style. The menu keeps pace with the seasons. For example, semi-preserved duck foie gras and truffles; tartare of trout with herbs and its caviar or raspberries with pineau des Charentes topping and steamed meringue. On fine days, meals are served on the terrace. An aristocratic yet welcoming setting devoted to good food.

Name: Spica
Address: 48 rue de la Préfecture, Dijon, 21000, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The former Café de la Préfecture is run by a young Japanese chef who worked (most notably) at La Maison des Cariatides. Think upcycled furniture, jazz music, unique menu with meticulously prepared market-fresh cuisine, and Burgundy wines at bargain prices. The pâté en croûte made in the traditional way made an impression, as did the rib eye steak with a red wine sauce and cardamom espuma: it's bold and it works!

Name: Fidelis
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: At their location facing the ramparts, this professional couple are making a big splash with delicious and elegantly executed traditional cuisine: a fresh pea soup that is unctuous and bursting with flavour; an excellent poultry roast in its skin… crispy and melt-in-the-mouth, it is served with a delicious carrot purée with just a hint of ginger.

Name: Cozna
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: After a stint in several prestigious establishments in France and the US, Sandra and Léo have settled in a car-free street in historic Annecy. Tradition is their motto (“cozna” means cooking in the Savoie dialect), a credo with which their diners wholeheartedly agree. The food is delicious food and served with a smile. A genuine good deal.

Name: Restaurant Anne & Matthieu Omont - Hôtel de France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This establishment, located on the main street of the village, proposes a culinary interlude. A young chef has taken over the reins of a restaurant that is well known to its following of regulars. He turns out masterful, determinedly creative cuisine, to be enjoyed in an immaculate modern setting. Comfortable rooms, ideal for an overnight stay.

Name: La Loge Bertin
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Behind the stylish mint green façade, an enthusiastic team is ready to take you on a gourmet adventure. The chef uses only the freshest ingredients to create extremely tasty, beautifully presented market-inspired cuisine. The contemporary bistro-style interior was recently refurbished.

Name: La Safranière
Address: 52 rue du Lavoir, hameau de Chabrits, Mende, 48000, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A gourmet restaurant situated on the site of an old saffron farm in the Gévaudan foothills. Enjoy seasonal cuisine in a fresh, colourful dining room. Cheese and wine from the region take pride of place on the menu.

Name: L'Alezan
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: As soon as you enter these former stables, entirely revamped in a modern style, you will feel right at home! A young couple is at the helm: in the kitchen, the chef proposes a carefully prepared and delicious range of dishes inspired by the seasons, while his wife can be relied on to pamper diners during their meal. A blue-chip value.

Name: Le Clos Saint Roch
Address: 87 avenue de la Vallée-des-Baux, Maussane-les-Alpilles, 13520, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A restaurant that appeals to everyone! An enthusiastic craftsman, the chef rustles up sun-drenched recipes oozing with Provençal flavours. The food is visually gratifying and hunger satiating. In summer, we recommend the patio flanked by oleander bushes. Dutiful service all year long and excellent value for money.

Name: Voyages des Sens
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: After learning the ropes in the company of legendary chefs, Nicolas Morelle has opened his own establishment in this pretty village. He works hand in hand with small local producers, devising intelligent, subtle dishes that hit the spot every time, such as trout, horseradish emulsion and organic seasonal veggies. A cheerful casual vibe sets the scene and curious connoisseurs can keep an eye on the kitchen and the chef through a window to the rear.

Name: L'Atelier Locavore
Address: 2 avenue de la Libération, Le Coteau, 42120, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: On the banks of the Loire, this establishment is now in the hands of a local lad. He aims to serve market-fresh dishes throbbing in flavour with a bargain-priced lunchtime menu and a more elaborate monthly menu. The majority of his ingredients come from within a radius of 200km, albeit with the occasional saltwater fish: his Brittany monkfish spiked with langoustine is truly mind-blowing!

Name: Les Dilettants
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Formerly a salesman for a leading pétanque brand, Thomas Filiaggi changed direction at the age of 30 to satisfy his love of cooking. He proposes an individual cuisine, largely based on fresh vegetables and aromatic herbs from his garden. A gem!

Name: Le Bastion
Address: 50 boulevard de la Promenade, Lagrasse, 11220, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Take a seat in one of two pretty rustic dining spaces to sample "avant-garde country fare", inspired by Auguste Escoffier but with a modern twist. Great produce from the region is used – tomatoes from the Estarac Gardens, vinegar by Cyril Codigna, fish fresh from the market at Port la Nouvelle… Concise tapas menu and spacious terrace.

Name: Mova
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: From a line-up of carefully selected seasonal ingredients (vegetables and fish), François Merle conjures up appetising, modern recipes, illustrated by a fresh, light starter of rillettes of seabream, celery pickles, coriander sorbet and fish eggs, whose distinctive flavours are exquisitely harmonious. Single set menu at lunchtime, tasting menu in the evening.

Name: L'Épicerie
Address: Chemin des Usages, La Borne, 18250, France
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Is the restaurant a grocer’s or is it the other way round? Whatever, this establishment is delightful, which is all that matters! Seasonal menu by Mathieu (in charge of savoury dishes) and Clémentine (desserts), all of which with 100% local produce. This unpretentious restaurant has been adopted locally, which is always a good sign. Beware, 20 seats only, so book before you come!

Name: La Croix d'Or
Address: 6 rue de la Herse, Le Pin-la-Garenne, 61400, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A country inn with an authentic family atmosphere. After working in some of the finest restaurants, the chef returned to his roots and transformed his grandparents house into a traditional inn serving fine cuisine.

Name: L'Océanide
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Roasted scallops, tart carrot juice, filet of plaice roasted with thyme butter, shellfish jus... L'Océanid certainly maintains close ties to the sea. Chef David Garrec chooses his produce at the famous neighbouring Marché de Talensac, and the freshness of the fish, cooked to perfection, is unmistakeable! Authentic 1950s vintage setting, with an old-world charm.

Name: L'AO - L'Aigle d'Or
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A young generation has brought a zest of modernity by way of more contemporary plating techniques and recipes (octopus with miso broth, or braised breast of pork with bbq-style jus and chimichurri…) all the while continuing to celebrate regional traditions (brawn, frogs’ legs, game etc). Practical rooms for overnight stays.

Name: Le Pré Saint Jean
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The frontage decked in Corten (steel with a rusty appearance) is part of a beautiful stone façade, on the town’s ring road. In the kitchen, the chef produce inspired and tasty gourmet cuisine. A success!

Name: La Chênaie
Address: Rue du Lejat - lieu-dit La Berlanderie, Croutelle, 86240, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The focus here is on good old-fashioned nosh, served generously and unfussily. Traditional French family favourites with the occasional more contemporary note, served in stylish dining rooms and, in particular, in the conservatory overlooking the grounds, planted with century-old oak trees. Dishes you might taste include meat stew with foie gras, quails stuffed with foie gras, upside-down apple pie and saffron ice cream. Prices that make sense and friendly service.

Name: Le 62
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Top marks for this restaurant that masterfully titillates our tastebuds thanks to the perfectly judged seasonings and harmonious flavours of the gifted young Vietnamese-born chef, who trained at Chamalières and the Belle Meunière in Royat. Polished bistronomic cuisine rich in French overtones, illustrated by farm-reared pork chop, sauce Grand Veneur, risotto and spring vegetables. The desserts are equally high-flying, depicted by yellow peach and an unctuous vanilla custard and whipped cream. Excellent value for money and a small courtyard patio add the final flourish to this irresistible establishment.

Name: Auberge de l'Abbaye
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A few steps from the romantic ruins of Hambye Abbey, this classical hotel - restaurant is now in the hands of a young couple. The chef in fact learned the trade here, before moving on to other fine establishments; now he serves flavoursome traditional cuisine, free of unnecessary frills. A litany of gourmet pleasures in store.

Name: Cheval d'Or
Address: 21 rue de la Villette, Paris, 75019, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Notable sake list,Visa credit card
Description: It is with great anticipation that you stop in front of this bright red façade high up in Belleville (in the east of Paris), having secured a table for one of the two evening services by booking well in advance. In this restaurant under the leadership of an authentic Japanese chef, ensconced with his team behind a long counter, you will get to enjoy fragrant dishes inspired by Japanese cuisine: Japanese binchotan charcoal grill, home-made soy ramen and onigri. Laid-back service from a friendly and dynamic team.

Name: Ô Moulin
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A young couple has transformed this charming Périgord mill into a peaceful country-style restaurant, open year-round. The chef produces fresh, tasty cuisine that is in tune with the times. Lovely shady terrace and attentive service. The first set menu is very reasonably priced. A pleasant place.

Name: Auberge Metzger
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Precise cooking, quality ingredients, well - presented accompaniments: Yves Metzger prepares regional cuisine that is quite simply delicious – and a bargain. Another reason to stay the night at this welcoming place in the Bruche valley. Spacious and comfortable guestrooms.

Name: Le Cygne
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This picturesque half-timbered Alsace edifice has successfully kept pace with the times and its veteran chef conjures up modern, bistro dishes. Examples include a mouth-wateringly juicy pink duck breast with golden rendered crispy skin served with a delicately orange-perfumed and slightly spicy gravy jus. Choice between two menus in a pared-down refreshingly minimalist interior.

Name: Auberge La Gaillotière
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Rows of vines hug the walls and patio of this converted wine storehouse, which now sports a fresh rustic vibe. The food juggles intelligently and appetisingly between classical roots and modern influences. The menu changes once a fortnight in a bid to keep pace with the seasons. Fine local wines (Muscadet, Val de Loire, Vendée Fief) at prices that make sense take centre stage. Service with a smile.

Name: L'Assiette au Jardin
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The setting comprises a small bistro-style dining area with shelves filled with delicatessen products, and a pretty extension. Sit back and tuck into tasty food, where tradition is nicely combined with influences from far and wide. The menu, which changes every two weeks, highlights local or regional produce. A charming place.

Name: Bistrot 1954
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Overlooking the grandiose scenery of Pointe Saint-Mathieu, this bistro makes your mouth water: a terrace in the fresh sea air, contemporary decor combining untreated wood and rattan furniture, and dishes from the chef, who lovingly showcases Brittany's fresh produce in his dishes: from shellfish and fish to buckwheat and seaweed.

Name: Kisin
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: When a Bib Gourmand chef from Tokyo arrives in Paris, the first thing he does is open a restaurant, tantalising and bewitching our senses. Diners will sample Japanese produce and genuine udon, made in front of the diner. Natural, additive - free ingredients, most of which are imported direct from the Land of the Rising Sun. Healthy, wholesome and succulent.

Name: Bistrot Louise
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The small terrace facing the church resembles a traditional walnut drier… Welcome to this walnut-growing village where Yann Tanneau (formerly of MadaM in Grenoble and who trained at Ducasse) has set up shop. A fan of fine produce, he whisks up gutsy cuisine in menus that change weekly. Guaranteed to please, excellent value for money at lunchtime and refreshingly informal ambience.

Name: Les Trois Bourgeons
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This contemporary bistro, with its understated decoration, has blossomed in an old cellar of famous Chablis producer Domaine Laroche. An Asian team, who trained in some of the top French houses, invites its customers to partake in a fine dining experience inspired by regional recipes, revisited with taste and imagination. Unbeatable value for money.

Name: Fleur de Sel
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In the heart of a picturesque village in the Cher valley, close to the Château de Chenonceau, a contemporary and friendly bistro treats its guests to fresh seasonal cuisine crafted by a talented chef. Mickaël Renard honed his skills in some top establishments, from the Hostellerie de Levernois (in the days of Jean Crottet) and the Côte d'Or in Saulieu (alongside Bernard Loiseau) to the Auberge des Templiers. Today: "perfect" slow-cooked egg with herring and leeks; hake fillet from Brittany with cumin cream, new potatoes and mushrooms in a herby oil. Two menus-carte that change every two months, and a lunchtime menu du jour on weekdays – all at very reasonable prices!

Name: Simple et Meilleur
Address: Place Notre-Dame, quartier de Caseblanche, Saint-Martin-de-Belleville, 73440, France
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Baked trout, Reblochon fondue, cold cuts and cheeses from the region, blueberry tart, or rabbit sautéed with mustard, tarragon and creamy polenta. Savoie produce takes pride of place at this attractive, cosy restaurant set up by René and Maxime Meilleur, who earned three Michelin stars at La Bouitte. The menu is an ode to the terroir, replete with dishes to be sampled in a rustic-style Savoyard bistro interior decked out in pale wood and with large bay windows looking out onto the mountains. In winter, you can ski right up to the door. Tapas served on the ground floor.

Name: Le Laurier Fleuri
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This former coaching inn may not enjoy the most appealing of settings, but once seated at your table you will have no trouble understanding the success of this restaurant run by a pair of industry professionals. With plenty of experience in prestigious establishments, the chef concocts a pleasingly refined and fragrant cuisine composed of bistronomy-style dishes delivered at reasonable prices.

Name: L'Artichaut
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Opened in 2013 by a chef whose passion proves to be contagious, this place is a temple of seasonal cooking. Dishes are prepared using market ingredients and included in a menu that is regularly renewed. Fresh ingredients, homemade preparations, regional wines: a restaurant that can't fail to win you over.

Name: Villa Mirasol - Bistrot 1912
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Villa Mirasol has entrusted the fate of its restaurant to Philippe Lagraula, a chef from Landes, who earned his stripes under Troisgros and Bras. His strong points are well known: presentation, originality, harmonious flavours, qualities that are illustrated by uncomplicated modern cuisine, such as black pudding with yellow pepper, runny egg and "cosa crocante".

Name: A Mandria di Pigna
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This former sheepfold, a family business for 15 years, is perfectly in tune with its authentic, welcoming village. Corsican produce takes pride of place from the veg and herbs fresh from the garden to the grilled or spit roast suckling pork and tender lamb (wood fired cooking is the house specialty). Savour textbook perfect, generous fare on the refreshing shaded terrace.

Name: La Ferme de Victorine
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: An authentic farmhouse with a pretty rustic - style restaurant, from which you can even see the cows in the cowshed in winter. The chef is passionate about Savoyard produce, and always on the lookout for the best cheeses and cold cooked meats. An eminently pleasant restaurant and very tasty dishes!

Name: Agastache
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This brand-new bistro is the brainchild of two gifted young partners who honed their skills in Lyon. The unfussy, up-to-date interior sets the scene for instinctive, updated and well-crafted dishes. Fine seasonal produce and a distinct fondness for vegetables result in food that combines formal elegance with flavoursome coherence. Now add lashings of generosity and a friendly atmosphere and you will find yourself in one of the best newcomers on the left bank.

Name: Les Grands Arbres - Verte Vallée
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This smart, contemporary interior is the stronghold of chef Thony Billon, who stylishly adds a new spin to regional ingredients. His flawless modern score is paired with a fine list of Alsace wines. It makes the heart sing!

Name: Le Cèpe
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: It all starts with fine produce from the local land, mountain porcini or fish from the neighbouring lakes, which the chef comes out and proudly present to diners. He then turns it into delightful, fresh dishes, all the tastier for the unbeatable prices. A place that is quite simply comfortable in its own skin.

Name: Pica Pica
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Fabien Lefebvre, formerly Michelin-starred at Octopus, as well as being crowned "Meilleur Ouvrier de France" 2004, is the chef behind this delicious and friendly brasserie. He serves up uninhibited Mediterranean cuisine, cleverly blended with other influences. The menu features a selection of tapas (hummus with cumin and pita bread; croquetas de jamón), picas such as lamb kebab with za'atar and sumac, or grilled octopus. More elaborate dishes include semi-salted cod, watercress and gnocchi, lemon and caviar emulsion. And then there are the tasty desserts. A down-to-earth concept, with sharing in mind. The lunch menu is a steal. A resounding success.

Name: Café A
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The beating heart of Maison Aribert, Café A never sleeps – it is open throughout the week from breakfast to dinner. Remaining true to his "village café" theme, which reinterprets recipes handed down from mothers and grandmothers, the chef proposes fine bistronomy cuisine at affordable prices. The simple food is made from carefully selected ingredients. Memorable dishes include a simply addictive pain perdu made with brioche served with ice cream and caramel sauce. A safe bet every time. Brunch on Sundays.

Name: Lai'Tcha
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In this annex of Yam'tcha, located at the foot of Église St-Eustache, you can enjoy simple but straight-to-the-point Chinese cuisine that is fragrant and made with fine ingredients. The short menu offers various dim sums, but also fresh home-made noodles, Imperial sautéed beef and an excellent salad of Galician beef, lamb's lettuce and oyster mushrooms.

Name: La Beaugravière
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: It feels as if time has come to a standstill at this family-run inn – and that is meant in the best possible way! Now in his 70s, chef Guy Jullien cooks up a delightful culinary offering that is sure to win over confirmed traditionalists: foie gras flan and cream of truffle soup, fattened Bresse chicken with truffles, roast rack of lamb with thyme, vanilla-raspberry ice cream vacherin… not to mention the simply irresistible truffle set menus. This is food in a classical vein that is as tasty as it is hearty, to be savoured peacefully in the shade of the trees in fine weather. The wines also hit the spot: the impressive cellar contains many treasures from the region. A real gem!

Name: L'Éden
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: There are two styles at L'Éden: classic or a winter garden atmosphere with views onto the kitchens. The chef lovingly simmers his traditional dishes, which are spot on and hearty.

Name: Le Moulin Fouret
Address: 2 route du Moulin-Fouret, à Saint-Aubin-le-Vertueux, Bernay, 27300, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In an Instagram-perfect picture of the French countryside outside Bernay, we fell head over heels with this imposing country house smothered in Virginia Creeper and its waterside terrace shaded by birch trees, without forgetting the historic mill, whose cogwheels are still intact. This idyllic venue is even more so by the fireside in wintertime, providing the perfect foil to chef Cédric Auger’s culinary ethos: first-rate fresh ingredients, consummate craftsmanship and cooking and polished table arts. The regularly changing seasonal menus pay tribute to the chef’s homeland, Normandy. Cosy guestrooms to make the most of this rural paradise.

Name: Les Arpents
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A stone’s throw from the castle, the burgundy-coloured façade of this contemporary bistro cannot fail but catch the eye. The tasteful interior sports walls covered in cream-coloured wainscoting and modern furniture. Two pals, who met at Tours Catering School, rustle up a flawless culinary score, delving freely into abundant first-rate local produce from asparagus and strawberries in season to Roi rose pork and goat’s cheese. Dishes may include crisp fillet of carp, Jerusalem artichokes and mushrooms, paired with a silky béarnaise sauce or lemon pie dusted with dried black lemon, a wickedly tempting detail that makes this dessert mouth-wateringly irresistible…

Name: Olive & Artichaut
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Originally from Nice, the chef moved back to the region with his Breton wife after several stints abroad. He showcases local ingredients in knockout recipes, inspired by the sea and the mountains: pissaladière-style wafer-thin tart with roast black pudding, braised chuck veal with creamy chickpeas and a chocolate and hazelnut praline pie to finish.

Name: Le Bistrot de Guillaume
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Right in the centre of Moulins, the small dining area is light and intimate, already setting the tone, and we don't need to be asked twice to be shown to our table. But the best is yet to come: in his little kitchen, the chef-owner composes dishes that are delicate and intelligent to the joy of our tastebuds, such as his textbook perfect Provençal aioli.

Name: La Fleur de Sel
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: In the heart of the historic district, it is a pleasure to taste Vincent Guyon’s inspired craftsmanship. The menu might feature monkfish, fried artichokes barigoule, dried tomatoes, emulsion of artichokes, stock and Brittany curry or another house signature dish: beef tartare with oysters served with mizuna, caviar vinaigrette and grilled rice. Deftly crafted and consummately cooked.

Name: La Capitelle
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: La Capitelle has plenty going for it. It offers a short menu that changes every two or three days and comprises of dishes made with quality ingredients (local, as far as possible). The traditional recipes are given a contemporary spin and are perfectly cooked. There is also an attractive vaulted dining area presided over by an imposing fireplace.

Name: Le Cerisier
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The menu at this small restaurant with a modern interior makes your mouth water in anticipation of the hearty, unpretentious dishes and the house speciality, pâté en croûte, made with different ingredients as the seasons change. In the kitchen, a couple is at work, preparing delicious cuisine that highlights local produce such as Ardèche trout. The desserts are particularly meticulous – poached pear with mulled wine, vanilla and speculoos trifle, pear sorbet. The terrific wine list (600 labels) includes a judicious choice of wines by the glass.

Name: La Cour de Rémi
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: After pursuing a career abroad, the chef has returned to his roots, to the family's former hunting lodge, to devote himself to cooking – his earliest passion. In this convivial place, he has perfectly mastered generous traditional cuisine, from cooking to seasoning. We love the terrine with home-made sourdough bread and gherkins from the estate in vinegar. The plus: overnight accommodation in a cabin on stilts!

Name: In-Fine
Address: 2 Rue de l'Hôtel de Ville, Frontignan, 34110, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Chef Grégory Doucey devotes himself hook, line and sinker to his restaurant in the town centre of Frontignan. Grégory is committed to sourcing his produce regionally (particularly the local catch) and can frequently be seen zigzagging between the open kitchen and his clients, with whom he shares fascinating insights about each dish. His flavourful cooking is a savvy balance between country fare and modernity, with taste as the overriding watchword.

Name: Au Bon Accueil
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: You will first be won over by the vintage charm of this 1960’s house, before you meet the talented team of the brother (in the kitchen) and his sister (in the dining room), who are both fast gaining in confidence. The food is on-point, the wine cellar savvy and the terrace very pleasant in season.

Name: L'Auberge du Pont des Pierres
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This restaurant on the road to Monts Jura is invariably busy! Chef Romain Blanc, who hails from the region, has no shortage of talent or ideas when it comes to cooking seasonal local produce: fish from Lake Geneva or nearby fish farms, pork and poultry from the surrounding area, local market gardeners and a herb garden. He also demonstrates a flair for preparing jus and a mastery of cooking processes, and makes a lot from scratch (including ice cream and bread). Bargain prices and service with a smile from Chloé, who will guide you through the nice selection of wines from independent winegrowers.

Name: Le Jardin Les Crayères
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The little sister of the Château les Crayères, housed in an outbuilding in the park, is a smart, very contemporary and elegant brasserie with its own veranda and terrace just opposite the herb garden. Flavoursome seasonal cooking.

Name: L'Arôme
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Visa credit card
Description: This small restaurant in a characteristic and colourful Marseille street looks like a classroom, with its old maps of France, blackboards, classroom chairs and menus presented in an exercise book. It serves flavoursome, carefully prepared Mediterranean dishes, such as cromesquis of veal. Laid-back atmosphere and a welcome as warm as the Marseille sun.

Name: La Falène Bleue
Address: Place de la Mairie, Lannepax, 32190, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Despite their youth, they have both clocked up several years of experience. Fabien and Hélène have combined their first names to create the Falène Bleue. Everything is simple and tasteful, from the food (sourced entirely from local producers) to the interior, dotted with pictures and objects picked up here and there.

Name: La Ferme du Poulet
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This picturesque 17C stone - built edifice has been magnificently transformed into a restaurant. The haunt of discerning foodies (the chef won a 2016 culinary award for his pork pies), the interior has been updated and the menu reflects a distinct regional slant.

Name: Paris Méditerranée
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The name pays homage to Brassens, who was born in Sète but also the chef, originally from Paris, and his wife, a native of Sète. The chef reinvents local recipes, in line with his mood and the catch of the day. The nearby tapas bar, Le Barbu, run by the same owner, is highly recommended.

Name: Le Tilleul de Sully
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This country inn stands in the shade of the old lime tree. The vegetable patch is full of courgette flowers, carrots, round cabbages and redcurrants, and the chef uses them to excellent effect in his dishes. Enjoy this tasty local cooking in front of the fireplace or outside, overlooking the fruit trees.

Name: Le Brélévenez
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This pretty stone house in Brélévenez (a neighbourhood in Lannion) is run by Monsieur and Madame Le Marrec. Business is going strong, and this is not by chance: the well thought-out and tasty food is in tune with the land and the seasons. One last thing, the space is modern, refined and a pleasant place to be.

Name: Auberge de l'Île
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Chef Pierre Koniecko has set up shop in this plush venue on Vienne Island, where he regales his guests with hearty, flavoursome creations, such as hake in bacon and croutons and braised, buttered cabbage. Delicately presented, premium ingredients served in a contemporary interior or, in summertime, on the exquisite riverside deck patio – heavenly on hot sunny days!

Name: SaQuaNa
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Is Alexandre Bourdas in the process of redefining the codes of gastronomy? He has made his SaQuaNa a social hub, open from morning to night, the idea being to make good food accessible to as many people as possible. The menu is varied, with influences from near and far, and always features signature dishes such as monkfish in coconut broth and combawa oil, or his emblematic pascade. A confident and inspiring culinary offering.

Name: Sodade
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Sodade is a song by Cesária Évora and a nod to the Portuguese origins of the late owner, Serge Vieira. In a large designer dining room or on the terrace overlooking the stream, you will sample dishes that are the epitome of tasty and simple. Pleasant guestrooms to stay longer.

Name: Le Confidentiel
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Among all the restaurants (which include some real juggernauts! ) surrounding the lake, this place proves that good things come in small packages. In a tiny, light - filled dining room you can enjoy dish after formidable dish, the bold flavours going hand in hand with the friendly and relaxed atmosphere. Now that you're in on the secret, you know what to do.

Name: La Chaize Gourmande
Address: 2 place du Marché, La Chaize-Giraud, 85220, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In this friendly, contemporary eatery, Cédric Merlaud, who aims for “enlightened international” seasonal cuisine, adds a sprinkling of originality to predominantly regional ingredients. Dishes can include the catch of the day from local Vendée ports and vegetables from small-scale market gardeners. Carefully executed, aromatic and mouth-wateringly tempting. Deliciously eater-friendly prices.

Name: Le Jean Moulin
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Guests are invited to take a seat in one side or another of a long dining room, divided by a glazed wine cellar, in a designer décor of industrial loft inspiration. The perfect foil to taste Grégoire Baratier’s cuisine in the zeitgeist. The menu changes very regularly, but here are two examples to give you an idea of the market-fresh cooking: thick ravioles of snails and fondant leeks, emulsion of garlic and parsley, scattered with wild herbs; confit of braised veal, mousseline of chervil root, caramelised winter vegetables and a gutsy gravy. Crisp, well-crafted and rich in tributes to Lyon’s culinary heritage.

Name: Perle des Vosges
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In this family-run hotel-restaurant, the first thing you notice is the wonderfully traditional interior (chandeliers and silverware). The dishes range from the classic (marengo chicken supreme) to the regional (veal kidneys with mustard seeds, marrow quenelles and spaetzle), to the occasional more contemporary offering (lobster tempura). The cheese platter from the valley is a real highlight.

Name: Manoir de la Pommeraie
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Not far from Vire is this 18C building that may look rustic at first glance, but turns out to be fine... Running the kitchens is a pair of chefs (also a couple): Masako, a Japanese pastry chef, and Julien, like her, trained in several renowned establishments. A good place, for both savoury and sweets!

Name: Winstub À Côté
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: An extension of Auberge St Laurent, this winstub gives diners a taste of Alsace – tarte flambée with marinated Scottish salmon, "granny's" home-made spaetzle – in a contemporary decor (designer furniture and light fittings, copper-topped counter). Unbeatable value for money and excellent service are the key to the success of this establishment: it's often fully booked!

Name: La Table d'Élise
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Conveniently opposite the fishing harbour, this seafood restaurant, an offshoot of the gastronomic La Marine, shines the spotlight on exquisitely fresh fish and seafood. The high-flying technique and hallmark of chef Alexandre Couillon can be tasted here in a bistro version at prices that won’t break the bank. Love at first bite!

Name: La Rochette
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This contemporary restaurant is a real find. A father and son team prepares tasty and refined dishes, such as chicken breast from Alsace with a pumpkin-seed crust and airy dumplings… Attentive service, a good selection of wines and guestrooms to prolong the stay complete the picture.

Name: Les Mets d'Adélaïde
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Are you sure you don't want to go back to school? Les Mets d'Adelaïde may well make you change your mind! The restaurant has taken up abode in the old village school, whose playground doubles as a summer patio. Rather than a nostalgic interior, however, expect a minimalist décor and a masterclass in contemporary cuisine. The service deserves a gold star!

Name: Sellae
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: On the coattails of Mensae ("table" in Latin) in the 19th arrondissement, Sellae ("chair") is another restaurant in the Thibault Sombardier stable. The chef cooks up modern seasonal cuisine, with a penchant for the South of France and above all for indulgence! In this bistro-style interior, the produce is prepared with real know-how: snail ravioli with grass butter, crispy speck, sweet garlic broth; roast veal, casarecce with mushrooms, vin jaune emulsion...

Name: Le Beaujolais
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: With such a name, this Beaujolais could not do otherwise than pay tribute to a region famous for its fine food and wines! The friendly couple that runs this house has hit the nail on the head with hearty wholesome fare. Examples include traditional andouillette, whole grain mustard sauce and sautéed potatoes.

Name: Le Rousseau
Address: 16 bis cours Saint-André, Le Pont-de-Claix, 38800, France
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In low-key, tasteful and contemporary premises, the new Le Rousseau is now more spacious and boasts a quiet alfresco area to the rear. Chef Élie Michel-Villaz, who remains forever faithful to his defining mantra, simplicity, rolls out a fresh, carefully crafted repertory, paired with lovingly selected wines (several hundred references – many natural or biodynamic), served in a casual atmosphere. A short supply chain business that is going strong. Simpler menu at lunchtime.

Name: Sépia
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This little place close to the beach is worth a visit. It is run by a pair of industry pros – the maître d' and her chef husband, who has worked in some fine restaurants. Whether in the dining space with its maritime decor, or on the lovely timber-decked terrace, enjoy food that is 100% home-made (including the ice cream and bread buns) and doesn't mess around. This is cheerful and sincere cuisine, cf. the bun with Cantal shavings and mantis shrimp cream.

Name: Nougier
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: For three generations, this delightful inn has been cultivating the art of hospitality and good food. The chef concocts meticulous dishes that toe the line between tradition and modernity and pay tribute to the seasons. So take a seat and order safe in the knowledge you will eat well!

Name: L'Ardoise
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit cards not accepted,Terrace,Wheelchair access
Description: Although we are on the left bank of the Maine, in an appealing contemporary brasserie interior, the dishes exude all the warmth of the Mediterranean – a selection of antipasti to share, or polish off yourself (e.g. hummus and panisses), followed by appetising mains (pasta with shellfish) and, last but not least, the desserts (tiramisu, pistachio and orange blossom dessert). There are also some more traditional French classics (such as home-made terrine, pâté en croûte and profiteroles). And the bill is very reasonable.

Name: Balsamique
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The youthful chef has more than one trick up his sleeve and his cuisine, poised between regional and modern, throbs with flavour. Examples include Tatin-style black pudding with cider apples. Daring recipes enhanced by impeccable produce (fish from Boulogne-sur-Mer, for example). Slick service. The peaceful little terrace is a real draw, especially on summer evenings!

Name: Quai 17
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Do not hesitate to try out this establishment set up within a charming hotel in a great location by the canal. Come inside and pull up a chair at your table in the plush dining room laid out beneath the glittering chandelier, and tuck into modern cuisine invested with plenty of Mediterranean flair, in which fish from Sète's market is king. For example, the pulled skate terrine, Sète-style bourride or roast monkfish, bottarga and artichokes. The magic of Sète on your plate.

Name: Lou Pinatou
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: He’s from the hills of Puy and she’s from Marseille. He likes forthright flavours and premium produce and she’s more of a pastry buff. Their gourmet culinary repertory is two-fold: in the old stone inn is a bistro that upholds traditions, while in a brand-new structure, you will taste gastronomic fare with a fine view of the valley to boot.

Name: La Table d'Auzeville
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
