FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The most informal and fun of Catalan chef, Oscar Bosch’s restaurants, Nit transforms the chef’s Mediterranean cuisine into a selection of exciting and original tapas dishes, all prepared with carefully chosen ingredients. This contemporary-style destination, next door to Bosch’s other eatery (Tanit), is full of character, with an enclosed terrace and a large bar. The liveliest tables are in the back, facing the kitchen, which turns out Spanish cuisine best enjoyed in the company of friends. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Brasserie Victória
Address: Avenida Presidente Juscelino Kubitschek 545, São Paulo, 04543-011, Brazil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: It is estimated that around ten million inhabitants of Lebanese descent live in Brazil. Esfihas (a type of Arab pizza) and quibes (meat croquettes) are as popular here as Brazilian staples such as pão de queijo (cheese bread) and coxinhas (chicken croquettes) and are sold at almost every Brazilian street stall. The Brasserie Victória, run by the same family for over 40 years, is nowadays considered the symbol of Lebanese presence in São Paulo, serving authentic, family-style cooking that represents the varied cuisine of their homeland. Make sure you try a little of everything. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: TonTon
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Located in a quiet residential street, this cosy, bistro-style restaurant is testament to the fact that travelling the world is always an enriching experience. Proof comes in the form of owner-chef Gustavo Rozzino's delicious international dishes, which take their influence from Brazilian, Italian, French and English recipes; this unusual culinary combination representing the various countries in which he trained as a chef. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Manioca
Address: Avenida Brigadeiro Faria Lima 2232, São Paulo, 01451-000, Brazil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: It’s spacious, bright and eclectic, yet despite its size, Manioca is somewhat hidden, as its sits inside a huge shopping centre behind the modern Livraria Cultura bookshop and customers to have walk between the bookshelves to reach it. Top-quality products, reasonable prices and a high level of technical skill are the hallmarks of this restaurant, which serves modern cuisine with Brazilian and international influences. Allow plenty of time as it gets very busy. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Charco
Address: Rua Peixoto Gomide 1492, São Paulo, 01409-002, Brazil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Despite its compact size, this restaurant in the Jardins district not far from Parque Trianon, is very welcoming with its small terrace and rustic-contemporary interior. Chef Tuca Mezzomo, a young gaucho from the Río Grande do Sul region, focuses on grill-based cuisine that showcases products and ingredients from different parts of Brazil. Guests are able to discover the large variety of flavours that this country has to offer through his dishes. As an added bonus, Charco even cures its own meats. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Le Bife
Address: Rua Pedroso Alvarenga 1088, São Paulo, 04531-004, Brazil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: With French celebrity chef Erick Jacquin as its consultant, Le Bife’s success is down to the simplicity of its menu: four quality meat dishes (filet mignon, entrecôte, steak tartare and hamburger) with salad, three sauces and a choice of sides included in the price. The executive menu, served midweek lunch, is based around the same formula but with just a single meat option (the cut of the day) and a delicious dessert – hot chocolate gateau with vanilla ice cream. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Miam Miam
Address: Rua General Góis Monteiro 34, Rio de Janeiro, 22290-080, Brazil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A restaurant with retro furniture, colourful decor and exposed brickwork, which harks back to the past; it is, in fact, the former mansion of chef Roberta Ciasca’s grandmother. They serve comfort food and traditional Brazilian classics, which showcase contemporary cooking techniques and a demonstrate a flair for presentation. A simpler, very reasonably priced menu is available at lunchtime, accompanied by a salad buffet. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Cepa
Address: Rua Antônio Camardo 895, São Paulo, 03309-060, Brazil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: If you like the idea of a seasonally inspired dining experience, escape São Paulo’s hectic business district and head for this unassuming restaurant—located in a residential district close to the São Luiz hospital. Here, chef Lucas Dante—who runs Cepa with his sommelier wife—focuses on creativity, ensuring that his cooking is always fun and based on products sourced daily from the market. The tasting menu is available in the evening and is a worthy option. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Mocotó
Address: Avenida Nossa Senhora do Loreto 1100, São Paulo, 02219-001, Brazil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Like its founder Zé Almeida, who came here from inland Pernambuco in the 1960s, you’ll need to embark on something of a pilgrimage to get to this famous and secluded eatery specialising in cuisine from the north-east. Originally famous for its mocotó dish, the kitchen, now run by Zé’s son Rodrigo Oliveira, conjures up many other delicacies from the north-eastern hinterland, including unforgettable torresminhos (pork rinds), prepared according to a secret recipe, that are crunchy, succulent and some of the best we’ve ever tasted! (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Più
Address: Rua Ferreira de Araújo 314, São Paulo, 05428-000, Brazil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant, in the western part of São Paulo, comes as a pleasant surprise. It's set within a simple yet charming house, in which chef Marcelo Laskani, co-owner along with maître d’ Mauricio Cavalcante, offers Italian-inspired cuisine built around a few solid principles: strong technique, meticulous presentation, and reasonable prices thanks to the judicious use of less luxurious ingredients. It's full almost every day, so advanced booking is highly recommended. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Corrutela
Address: Rua Medeiros de Albuquerque 256, São Paulo, 05436-060, Brazil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A restaurant that showcases the gastronomy of the future, in which sustainability is a central theme and an attractive "leitmotiv". The focus of the chef is on healthy, contemporary cuisine based around seasonal and organic ingredients, including fish and seafood, that help the planet. As an example, Corrutela does not use products wrapped in plastic, it makes its own flour and compost, and creates its own energy from solar panels. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Maria e o Boi
Address: Rua Maria Quitéria 111, Rio de Janeiro, 22410-040, Brazil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: This is a pleasant and informal restaurant that specialises in meat and is located in the charming Ipanema district. Here, you can enjoy Brazilian and international cooking with an Italian flair, which is always attractively priced and accompanied by copious sides. It is renowned for its grilled items (no fewer than seven different cuts of meat) and several signatures, including the ten hour-roasted beef rib (costela minga) as well as the surprisingly delicious duck heart with garlic bread and Grana Padano. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Ama.zo
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Ama. zo makes for a memorable dining experience that is both interesting and affordable. Here, in the delightful setting of a landscaped terrace—with large jabuticaba trees and an almost imperceptible cover to protect the dining space from the elements—savour reinterpreted Peruvian cuisine that is crafted from local products. Dishes feature strong flavours and pleasant textures with subtle nods to the Amazon and enticing Latin influences. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Tordesilhas
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: This established restaurant has a good reputation and has just celebrated its 25th anniversary. It's famous as a trailblazer for tasting menus of Brazilian cuisine, which are served Tuesday to Saturday evenings. There are lots of petiscos for sharing, as well as more creative dishes such as the three Amazonian sorbets served on jambu pearls, and the traditional feijoada, which is only available Saturday lunchtimes. Look out for the impressive collection of artisanal peppers! (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Balaio IMS
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Occupying the same modern building as the Instituto Moreira Salles, this restaurant is an excellent place in which to discover and enjoy chef Rodrigo Oliveira’s simple, fresh and attractive cuisine in the centre of São Paulo. In this modest setting, enjoy a combination of the successful dishes first created in the Mocotó restaurant, the latter, in particular, bringing a more traditional family-style influence to the dishes served here. Some tables are shared. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Kith 2º Andar
Address: Rua Bianchi Bertoldi 166, São Paulo, 05422-070, Brazil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This restaurant continues to make a big impression in Pinheiros, an office district where more informal eateries tend to be the norm. Its bright interior, which combines contemporary design with industrial touches, acts as a backdrop for the Brazilian cuisine with occasional international twists. Authentic, fresh dishes and refined techniques are the cornerstone here, with a focus on barbecue-grilled meats—a nod to chef Juliana Faingluz’s gaucho roots. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Zena Caffè
Address: Rua Peixoto Gomide 1901, São Paulo, 01409-002, Brazil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: Zena, which translates as Genoa in the Ligurian dialect, is a simple, happy and vibrant eatery that pays homage to Liguria; the region which is home to pesto sauce. Faithful to the region’s traditional recipes, Zena Caffè serves dishes that are fresh, healthy and quick; special mention must go to its focaccias (with their light dough and generous fillings), its gnocchi and its home-made desserts such as the splendid latte dolce fritto (a thick milk-based cream which is left to solidify before being breaded and fried, and served with the caramel-flavoured doce de leite). Go with friends and order dishes to share, as well as a jug of sangria or clericot. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Pici Trattoria
Address: Rua Barão da Torre 348, Rio de Janeiro, 22411-000, Brazil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Situated opposite the Praça Nossa Senhora da Paz, this restaurant boasts an Italian-style decor with colourful chairs and tables and windows inscribed with items from the menu. The original menu, overseen by renowned chef Elia Schramm, combines classic Italian recipes and Brazilian ingredients, resulting in a host of generous dishes which are full of flavour. Artists’ photos adorn the walls, while jazz music plays gently in the background. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Banzeiro
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Banzeiro is a breath of fresh air on Sao Paulo’s culinary scene. Chef Felipe Schaedler made the leap to this Brazilian metropolis from Manaus, where he has two other restaurants, in order to popularise the flavours and cooking of the Amazon. In this vibrantly decorated space, discover dishes—many cooked on the grill—that are contemporary, delicate and highly visual. Make sure to try river fish, such as pirarucú and tambaquià, as well as the highly unusual saúva ant with a mandioquinha foam. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Tanit
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: The design of this restaurant is a real talking point with its striking entrance, modern high-ceilinged interior, polished concrete floors and wood-panelled walls, along with intelligent use of natural light. Spanish chef Oscar Bosch creates technically skilled, carefully presented Mediterranean dishes which are adapted to Brazilian tastes, alongside local specialities. Its signature tapas, varied rice dishes and popular roast suckling pig are all worthy of particular praise. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Petí Gastronomia
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This curious restaurant will come as a surprise, as it’s located in a small glass-fronted courtyard behind a large shop which specialises in fine arts. The young chef, who has already worked in some leading restaurants across Europe, crafts delicately presented, contemporary dishes using seasonal ingredients; all the time using the latest techniques to create fine textures and well-defined flavours. The menu offers several options and is changed every two weeks. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Fitó
Address: Rua Cardeal Arcoverde 2773, São Paulo, 05407-004, Brazil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This restaurant pays homage to the culture and cooking of northeast Brazil – one of the country’s most popular cuisines. What stands out at this simple restaurant is the authenticity of the food and the enthusiasm of the owners, with the wife running the kitchen and her husband out front. The menu focuses on hearty cooking from the state of Piauí and includes daily specials and north-eastern classics such as Carne de Sol and Arroz Maria Isabel. The petiscos on the counter are well worth trying! (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Komah
Address: Rua Cônego Vicente Miguel Marino 378, São Paulo, 01135-020, Brazil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A queue of people waiting outside a restaurant is always a good sign and this is precisely what you see at Komah, a restaurant serving Korean cuisine with a modern flavour. You’ll enjoy a memorable dining experience here, thanks to the chef who delights his guests with a full range of flavours which extends from sweet to spicy. Make sure you try the Samgiopsal (roast pork belly with a gochujang sauce glaze) and the Kimchi Bokumbap (sautéed rice with kimchi and a creamy omelette). (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Lilia
Address: Rua do Senado 45, Rio de Janeiro, 20231-005, Brazil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A unique and different restaurant in which young chef Lucio Vieira demonstrates a new interpretation of hospitality. The unassuming façade, adorned with just a small poster, provides access to a steep staircase that leads guests to the upper floors with their decor of extreme simplicity. The highlight here is the updated traditional cuisine, teeming with strong flavours and always based around ingredients from the market to ensure maximum freshness and affordability. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Arturito
Address: Rua Artur de Azevedo 542, São Paulo, 05404-001, Brazil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Celebrity Argentinian chef Paola Carosella’s aim is to please the palate rather than take it by surprise. Her dishes showcase a passion for fresh vegetables and herbs in which simplicity and honesty are key. Her cooking is delicious, well executed and based around the very best ingredients. For lunch, the excellent executive menu and dish of the day are popular choices, while the dinner menu boasts clear Italian and Argentinian influence along with a contemporary touch. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: A Baianeira
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Reservations not accepted,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Simplicity is the buzzword here as the restaurant developed in a small garage that once upon a time only sold the traditional "pão de queijo". Today, the owner-chef, who has trained the entire team of women working with her, pays homage to her origins by offering family-style dishes that combine the cooking of Bahia and the northeast – Brazilian dishes that showcase technical skill and attractive presentation. The sweet potato gnocchi with cream cheese is well worth ordering. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Didier
Address: Avenida Alexandre Ferreira 66, Rio de Janeiro, 22470-220, Brazil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Run by a friendly married couple, Didier combines both Brazilian and French roots, with the female half of the partnership front of house and her classically trained French chef-husband manning the stoves. In this bright setting, reminiscent of a winter conservatory and terrace, enjoy reasonably priced classic dishes that showcase the chef’s international training in France, the USA and Brazil. He achieves great things with a limited budget, working with seasonal products and the freshest possible fish. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Artigiano
Address: Avenida Epitácio Pessoa 204, Rio de Janeiro, 22410-090, Brazil
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit cards not accepted,Terrace,Valet parking
Description: This restaurant specialises in the cuisine of the Emilia-Romagna region of Italy, serving home-made pasta and pizzas and popular ingredients from the region, such as Parma ham and Parmesan cheese. Everything here is hand-made (as evidenced by its name) and prices are reasonable. Make sure you try the roselline romagnole (pasta stuffed with ham and mozzarella and a Parmesan sauce). There’s a delightful terrace for cool alfresco dining. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Barú Marisquería
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: This small restaurant with an attractive and relaxed ambience serves fish and seafood with a focus on freshly caught ingredients cooked over the barbecue, a familiar sight on Brazilian beaches but not as popular in the city where grilled meat options are more common. Proud of his Latin-American origins, Colombian chef Dagoberto Torres also includes a choice of superb ceviche dishes on his menu. Simple presentation, yet packed with flavour! (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Ecully - Perdizes
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Tables here are set out on the old patio amid a plethora of trees, including an impressive mango tree at its centre. In this rustic yet contemporary space, the young chefs, who met each other in Ecully, France, create recipes influenced by Italian, French and Brazilian cooking. Under the same roof, they also run a wine boutique featuring over 400 reasonably priced labels (they are also importers and distributors). This is a good choice for diners wanting to eat a tasty meal accompanied by wines that won’t break the bank. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: A Casa do Porco
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Reservations not accepted,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Enjoy pork at its best! Chef Jefferson Rueda, a native of São José do Rio Pardo, takes the tastes and flavours of his youth and reinterprets them using contemporary techniques and eye-catching presentation. The welcoming setting is a combination of a bar, restaurant and small market. Don’t miss out on the sushi of pork jowl and the delicious Porco a San Zé, roasted for 8 hours in a special wood-fired churrasqueira. They don't take reservations, so customers are seated in the order they arrive. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: Bistrot de Paris
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Valet parking,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Sitting out on the front terrace of this restaurant, set in a charming little alleyway, you could be forgiven for thinking that you’re in a romantic, secretive part of Paris. It has both the atmosphere and the cuisine of a Parisian bistro; the honest cooking adheres to French techniques but with a nod to Brazilian produce. In 1990, its renowned French chef, Alain Poletto, won the 'best technique' prize at the Académie Nationale de Cuisine as a result of his research into sous-vide cooking. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: AE!! Café & Cozinha
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Booking essential,Brunch,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This is an intimate and surprising restaurant that is also particularly welcoming. Located in a district with a bohemian feel, it is run with lots of enthusiasm and passion by two chefs (Ygor Lopes and Walkyria Fagundes) trained in some of the best kitchens in Spain and Brazil. The highlight is on a contemporary Brazilian menu that is well-edited and focuses on sustainability. Here, dishes showcase a multitude of flavours and textures, and are creatively presented. Given its size, be sure to book ahead. (Last update: September 2020).

Name: El Brite di Larieto
Address: Località Larieto, strada per Passo Tre Croci, Cortina d'Ampezzo, 32043, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: If SanBrite boasts a collection of Michelin stars (a classic star for its cuisine and a green star for its sustainable approach), it’s also thanks to this agriturismo’s location in a small larch wood, where it is surrounded by the spectacular Dolomites. Opened 20 years ago and renovated over the years, this smart agriturismo is also home to a stable annexe, where its restaurant celebrates the flavours of Alpine culinary traditions in its meat and charcuterie, cheeses, creamy butter and ice cream, as well as herbs, berries and other local ingredients.

Name: Mater Terrae
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This evocatively named restaurant focuses on vegetarian and organic cuisine, which is served on its stunning terraces overlooking the rooftops and domes of the historic centre of Rome.

Name: Coltivare
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This small restaurant next to the Brandini winery has chef Luca Zecchin at its helm, a real connoisseur of Langhe culinary traditions and a disciple of Lidia Alciati (known as the “queen” of Piedmontese cuisine). It’s no surprise, therefore, that nearly all the ingredients used here are sourced locally. Some even come from the property itself, such as vegetables from the kitchen garden and eggs, all of which are used to create a variety of dishes, some of which pay tribute to the traditions of the region (don’t miss the “plin”) and others which are more personal in style, sometimes cooked over the barbecue grill. The latter is even used in some of the sweets, such as the smoky-flavoured bread and chocolate dessert. The wine list demonstrates the same affection for Piedmont, as well as featuring a selection of champagnes.

Name: Grow Restaurant
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Technique, creativity, and a focus on and respect for the past are just some of the criteria that guide chef Matteo Vergine. His modern dishes aim to reflect the ancestral flavours of Brianza and Lombardy in bygone days when hunting, freshwater fishing, growing vegetables and gathering wild herbs were all part of everyday life. This love for the region extends to the whole of Italy when it comes to the wine list, which is concise yet personal and exclusively features natural Italian wines, all of which are served skilfully and with a wealth of information by sommelier Riccardo Vergine. This interesting restaurant continues to evolve under the stewardship of these two brothers.

Name: PS Ristorante
Address: via di Petriolo 7, Cerreto Guidi, 50050, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: PS Ristorante is housed in the refurbished Villa Petriolo with its 36 luxurious guestrooms. The restaurant’s appeal is enhanced not only by the charm of the villa and its delightful garden, overlooked by the outdoor terrace, but also by the property’s delicious home-produced ingredients, such as extra-virgin olive oil, wine, Cinta Senese pork, eggs from its own hens, produce from the kitchen garden, traditional wheat and other locally sourced ingredients, all reinterpreted in modern style by the chef. More traditional fare is served in the Osteria Golpaja.

Name: Casa Format
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A sustainable complex, the vegetable garden and a lot of passion are the elements that distinguish this high-quality restaurant. The modern building is characterized by very large windows that make the most of solar energy. The cuisine is authentic, tasty and with original ideas: the ice cream whipped with a Carpigiani machine before service is a delicious example.

Name: l' Ciocio - Osteria di Suvereto
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Although this restaurant in the historic centre of Suvereto has the welcoming ambience of a traditional trattoria, its cuisine is more creative and elaborate in style (while still offering a few Tuscan classics). One of the house favourites is the “reale familiare”: a delicious cut of beef served with capers and anchovies.

Name: Saporium
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Saporium is the new fine-dining restaurant at the superb Relais Borgo Santo Pietro, an old property where the internal decor demonstrates a rare elegance, especially in the evening when hundreds of candles provide soft lighting and a romantic ambience in the dining room. In fine weather, meals are served under an elegant 13C portico overlooking the garden, with the property’s 100ha grounds and the Valle Serena as a backdrop. Much of the produce used in the cuisine designed by executive chef Hagen and transformed by resident chef Luca Ottogalli into modern, delicate dishes comes from the hotel’s own olive groves, vineyards, orchards and vegetable gardens. The focus here is on seasonal ingredients from this extraordinary region, such as the Borgo’s walnuts which are used in some of the delicious desserts. A whole host of wine-pairing options are possible thanks to the 1 000 different labels on the wine list.

Name: Vite
Address: via Montepirolo 7, località San Patrignano, Coriano, 47853, Italy
Cuisine: Cuisine from Romagna, Farm to table
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Vite is the San Patrignano community restaurant, which serves gourmet cuisine with a strong focus on locally sourced ingredients such as cured Mora Romagnolo hams, cheeses, home-grown vegetables and wine, although ingredients from further afield also feature. The professional service and positive, friendly atmosphere make this a highly enjoyable dining experience.

Name: Il Colmetto
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A practical, traditional approach to cuisine at this restaurant is accompanied by impeccable culinary techniques on the part of the talented chef, who prepares a delicious 5-course vegetarian menu for his guests. The equally interesting wine list includes a discreet selection of French labels.

Name: Radici
Address: via Henry Dunant 1, San Fermo della Battaglia, 22020, Italy
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A young, enthusiastic and professional couple has taken over the reins at this modern and welcoming restaurant, serving cuisine that is inspired by a sustainable and seasonal approach. Ingredients include herbs harvested from their own garden, as well as typical produce from the mountains and the sea, all sourced from trusted suppliers who demonstrate full respect for nature and animals. Food waste is kept to a minimum to ensure a circular-based cuisine.

Name: Villa Pignano
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A veritable Garden of Eden just 15km from Volterra, this 300ha estate is home to a restaurant with a strong zero-mile philosophy. This is backed up by its careful use of ingredients grown or produced on the estate itself, such as vegetables, olives and grains, as well as chicken, pork and honey – a sustainable approach that results in delicious, contemporary cuisine. The dishes here are fresh and full of flavour yet elaborate and modern in style (note the simpler menu at lunchtime). The interesting wine list explores Tuscany through its choice of top-quality organic labels as well as including wines produced from the estate’s own vines.

Name: Il Mirto
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated within the Botania resort with its 4 hectares of grounds extending down to the sea, Il Mirto is a vegetarian and vegan restaurant which serves two special tasting menus. Careful attention is paid to zero-mile produce, with all the fruit and vegetables grown in the property’s own organic kitchen garden, lovingly cultivated by the young, talented chef. Elegant and pleasantly relaxed atmosphere.

Name: The Chastain
Address: 4320 Powers Ferry Rd. NW, Atlanta, 30342, USA
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: Set on the verdant edges of Chastain Park and surrounded by trees, this restaurant feels like a modern oasis with charming details (think butterscotch leather booths, exposed brick elements and gas lamps). The setting is stunning, reminding one of a restored carriage house, but Chef Christopher Grossman's seasonally focused American menu with Southern nods is a solid match. Pasta dishes, also available as half portions, are a perfect start. English pea agnolotti with Georgian sweet shrimp, asparagus and spring onions in a beurre blanc sets the meal off on the right foot, while pan-roasted red snapper with grilled asparagus, a roasted half spring onion and green garlic chimichuri is a delicious follow up.

Name: Auberge de l'Abbaye de Montheron
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Located in a former Cistercian monastery that dates back to 1442, this restaurant proposes food that is very much of the moment. The original and exciting dishes draw heavily on local organic produce and heritage vegetables. Diners are won over by thoroughly modern fare that has been devised with a genuine concern for sustainability, such as suckling lamb served with pak choi and rhubarb. Appealing terrace on the edge of the forest, and a young and trendy atmosphere. A winning formula.

Name: Scalottas - Terroir
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Part of the Schweizerhof hotel, this trendy, Alpine-style restaurant focuses on regional ingredients. The concept is straightforward and simple – you can combine the dishes on the menu in any way you like. The friendly and attentive service is an added bonus.

Name: Helvetia
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In Svenja and Adrian Nessensohn (both recent graduates of fine dining restaurant Lampart's in Hägendorf), Helvetia has dedicated and friendly hosts, who make a point of using regional produce. Get comfortable in the pretty restaurant, where a relaxed atmosphere reigns, and enjoy an appealing set menu with dishes designed to be shared. In summer, make a beeline for the gorgeous terrace.

Name: Eder's Eichmühle
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This former farm house with its fantastic garden enjoys an idyllic location. Run with commitment and bonhomie by the Eder family, it’s hard to imagine the restaurant without its fish menu, very popular with the many regulars. The pan-fried sea bass in a potato crust with slow-cooked leeks and chorizo is particularly appetizing.

Name: Marktküche
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: One tip at the outset: be sure to reserve in good time – this restaurant always gets booked up, so it's hard to get a table! The clue is in the name: the cuisine takes its cue from what the market has to offer, dispensing with meat and fish. Diners can look forward to a vegetarian surprise menu made up of four to eight courses. There is also a lunch menu available on the penultimate Friday of every month.

Name: Le Tapis Rouge
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: It might have been more accurate to call this restaurant "Le Tapis Vert", given the green philosophy that underpins its sustainable culinary offering. Located in the time-honoured Grandhotel Giessbach (built in 1875) – right at the foot of the waterfalls of the same name, it boasts a wonderful view of Lake Brienz. Soak up the atmosphere as you enjoy refined modern cuisine that is created primarily using ingredients from the establishment's 2ha vegetable garden. Produce that is not immediately used is pickled, fermented or marinated. The restaurant's own home-grown ingredients are supplemented by local farms and small-scale producers. A vegetable-focused set menu and a completely vegetarian set menu are served. Dishes such as ancient spelt risotto with wonderfully aromatic and fresh vegetables and Tschingelfeld Alpine cheese hide behind names such as "Our Garden Vegetables".

Name: Le Maguet
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The Le Maguet brothers, Jonathan (serving) and Benjamin (cooking), are carrying the culinary torch of their father Olivier with their sustainable and 100% local concept! They use organic and/or wild ingredients that are of excellent quality, and draw on both traditional know-how and the most modern techniques, resulting in simple and tasty cuisine. For example, pata negra pork shoulder and salsify, slowly and perfectly cooked. Thirty years on, the dessert trolley is still the domain of their mother, Pierrette: don't leave the table without trying her tartlets!

Name: Rechberg 1837
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The Rechberg 1837 is a pleasant restaurant with a unique philosophy – it only uses regional produce that was available around 1837 (the year the house was built), i. e. before industrialisation. Innovative dishes such as slices of country pork on pea puree with fried barley and pickled onion are served in the evening, with a more traditional selection available at lunchtime. Cosy atmosphere and charming service.

Name: Schloss Wartegg
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The elevated location between Lake Constance and the Alpstein is quite something! As in the small castle hotel, the focus in the restaurant, too, is on the organic and ecological. This translates into sustainably produced ingredients and organic produce from local suppliers, plus vegetables and herbs from the hotel's own 2 500m2garden. From the terrace there is a wonderful view of the countryside and Lake Constance.

Name: Špacapanova Hiša
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Here, young and friendly chef Ago Špacapan introduces guests to the flavours of the Karst region. Having taken over the trattoria opened by his parents in 1973, he has taken the restaurant to a new creative level expressed via a well-designed tasting menu that offers a fascinating journey of gastronomic discovery dish after dish. It also features a wine cellar for tastings and ageing hams and cheese, as well as vinegars, and, lastly, a number of guestrooms, the best of which have been recently renovated and embellished with period furnishings.

Name: Gostilna Krištof
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Run for centuries by the same family, this beautiful inn has a welcoming atmosphere which is as appealing as its excellent cuisine. The latter skilfully combines local recipes with Mediterranean flavours and international influences – you won’t be disappointed!

Name: Villa Kabala
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Perched high up the hillside in the Badacsony region, with far reaching views of Lake Balaton, this period villa was once home to artist István Farkas. Now under the ownership of an ambitious and enthusiastic couple, the team here are establishing it as something of a destination restaurant. Go for the well-balanced tasting menu and paired wines – you won’t get much more local than this, with the cheese, salami, sausages, beers and wines all family made. Book a bedroom with a terrace and look forward to a fantastic breakfast.

Name: Onyx Mühely
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: The rebirth of Onyx is underway… starting with Onxy Mühely, a 16-seater test kitchen which offers dishes that will go on to form the core of the menu at the new Onyx (set to open in 2024). All guests arrive at the same time for drinks and nibbles, before being shown through to an elegant ‘workshop’ with a beautiful open kitchen and a glass-enclosed, galleried library. Diners are also invited to be critics and are encouraged to talk to the chefs and leave written feedback on the menu. Sustainability is a focus of the refined dishes, and the whole experience is interactive and engaging.

Name: Graefl Major Kétútköz
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: 25 acres of gardens and grounds surround this wonderfully restored art nouveau mansion house – and it is here that they grow, raise and rear all of the produce that is served in the dining room. If it’s in season, you will find it on the menu, from an incredible array of fruit and vegetables to game. They cure their own meats, use their own wheat for the bread, and their beer is an artisan brew. You can also stay overnight in this gloriously peaceful spot.

Name: Bramble & Hare
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted
Description: It's a farmhouse-meets-lodge vibe at Jill and Chef Eric Skokan's Bramble & Hare, where wood paneled walls and wood floors keep things rustic, and chairs and loveseats are draped with fur throws for an extra dose of charm. The couple's own farm supplies most of the inspiration for the dishes on this American menu—even down to the prosciutto they age in-house from their own pigs. Those impressive ingredients aren't gussied up in this kitchen, where a smart but straightforward cooking style allows them to truly shine. Many items are married in new and creative ways. Case in point? The salted turnips served with a pistachio purée, pickled onions and that fantastic house-cured prosciutto, delivering a fantastic surprise in a well-balanced, bright dish.

Name: Blackbelly Market
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Brunch,Car park,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Terrace,Wheelchair access
Description: Chef/owner Hosea Rosenberg is a familiar name in these parts, and Blackbelly Market is just one of the reasons why. There are plenty of spots to sip and snack here, whether at the counter facing the open kitchen, the well-stocked bar area, or the polished, dark wood tables. Take a peek at the refrigerated, glassed-in butchery room, where you may see Head Butcher Kelly Kawachi holding court. You'll taste her handiwork across the menu, and in the charcuterie boards showcasing duck rillette, pork terrine, headcheese and saucisson. Koji-cured pork is supremely flavorful, while agnolotti made of caramelized onion dough in a fragrant mushroom "brodo" is an inventive twist. For the win, order the donuts, especially the chocolate hazelnut cream with hazelnut caramel and milk chocolate-hazelnut topping.

Name: Hosu
Address: 14, Alley 40, Lane 181, Section 4, Zhongxiao East Road, Da’an District, Taipei, Taiwan
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The rustic chic room is adorned by dried flowers, antiques and cast iron furniture, paying homage to Taiwan’s country life of yesteryear. The owner-chef pledges his love to his homeland on the menu, making reference to the seasonal changes in Taiwan’s mountains, seas, rivers and plains. Dishes pivot around his childhood memories using mostly produce from sustainable sources. Chargrilling techniques are deployed prominently and to great effect.

Name: Thomas Chien
Address: 11 Chenggong 2nd Road, Cianjhen District, Kaohsiung, Taiwan
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Not only has Chef Chien got culinary acumen and all the classic French techniques, but he also cares for his carbon footprint and sustainability of food sources. By eating here, you’ll be supporting small local farms and fishing communities. His set menus use mostly local, seasonal ingredients and his lunch menus change monthly to keep them fresh. From time to time, top guest chefs are invited from overseas to broaden diners’ gastronomic horizons.

Name: Yangming Spring (Shilin)
Address: 119-1 Jingshan Road, Shilin District, Taipei, Taiwan
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,JCB,Maestro,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: On the outskirts of Taipei city sits this zen-inspired restaurant-cum-cultural space embracing culinary, tea, landscaping and creative arts. Rooms are linked by a manicured garden with rock arrangements and bonsai. Set menus honour a vegan and zen ethos; try their signature monkey head mushroom steak with plant-based meat and veggies – ask about the dish when reserving your table. Taiwanese teas complement the meal nicely.

Name: EMBERS
Address: 24, Lane 122, Section 4, Ren-Ai Road, Da'an District, Taipei, Taiwan
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Maestro,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: The owner-chef revives the embers of Taiwan’s culinary past with a seasonal 9-course menu that subverts the preconceptions about Western dining. The food displays influences of indigenous cultures, featuring native ingredients such as mock betel nut and paper mulberry leaf. The room is furnished generously with wood and the nest-like centrepiece above the bar made with steam-bent cedar is styled after hunting huts of the old days.

Name: Chez Panisse
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Wheelchair access
Description: A legendary address among the foodie set, Alice Waters’ Arts and Crafts bungalow continues to flourish as the Bay Area’s temple of Californian cuisine. The talented team of chefs here work their magic in a gleaming open kitchen that is set at the very back of the dining room and served by an aromatic wood-burning oven.Diners are privy to one nightly fixed menu of four rotating courses (three vegetable-centric on Mondays). It is a matter of chance, but rest assured the dishes will feature peak-season produce—from fresh peas, asparagus and black truffle in a spring risotto, to sweet corn and squash blossoms served with a summer preparation of pork loin.

Name: Chi Spacca
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: The carnivorous heart of Nancy Silverton’s “Mozzaplex” is as strong as ever. A modern Italian take on the old-school steakhouse, the restaurant boasts a steady menu of classics that seem to have only gotten better with age. Is there a better beginning than the indulgently cheesy focaccia di recco? Is there a chicken more compelling than the 24-hour brined and marinated pollo alla diavola? The team makes the most of smoke and live fire, as big proteins pass through the wood-burning oven. Indeed, this is hearty cooking that is seasoned boldly and keenly seasonal, served in a space that is intimate and energized all at once. A superb wine list celebrates the vast talents of Italy, and an astute, welcoming staff keeps everything flowing with ease.

Name: Pomet
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Wheelchair access
Description: The phrase "farm-to-table" is by now undoubtedly well-worn, but here the cliché takes on a literal dimension. Proprietor Aomboon Deasy is also a farmer, best known as the owner of K&J Orchards, a longtime darling of Bay Area farmers' markets thanks to its top-notch tree fruit. She tapped Chef Alan Hsu to lead the kitchen, and his menu is unsurprisingly ingredient-driven, proudly proclaiming the myriad local farms that supply it (in addition to Deasy's own). Whether it’s oysters with Niitaka pear and cider mignonette, or pasta filled with a puree of “ugly mushrooms” and sauced with a celery root miso butter, simplicity is a virtue when ingredients are this good. Case in point: the meal ends with a complimentary slice of whatever seasonal fruit is currently at its peak.

Name: Zinfandel's
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in the Hotel Esplanade, one of the most luxurious hotels in Zagreb, Zifandel's cuisine has the international stature that you would expect of a grand hotel in a capital city. The excellent menu here features an array of top-quality local and international dishes.

Name: Einer
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Wheelchair access
Description: Understated, full-flavoured dishes use original combinations alongside traditional techniques such as fermenting, pickling and smoking – and the wine matches are worth choosing. Seafood is a highlight but foragers, farms and local growers also provide top quality organic produce. The skilled kitchen ensures food waste is kept to a minimum.

Name: Natura
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: Well-chosen Finnish ingredients are used to good effect at this intimate restaurant and techniques like fermenting, pickling, salting, chargrilling and smoking all play their part. Choose from a range of colourful modern small plates or opt for the 'All Out' menu – the full range of dishes in miniature!

Name: FYR Bistronomi & Bar
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A vibrant restaurant in the barrel-ceilinged cellar of a striking 19C building; its terrace overlooks the adjacent park. Refined, modern bistro cooking includes smørrebrød and snacks at lunch and creative, generously sized dishes at dinner. Sustainability is important to the chef, particularly on issues like their carbon footprint and animal welfare.

Name: Novel
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Sit at the counter of this restaurant in the bustling Aarhus Ø harbourside development and you will be treated to an engaging evening of interaction with the passionate chefs and friendly service team; chatting with them, the sustainable ethos behind the quality cooking quickly becomes clear. Seafood and in-season game join plenty of vegetables on a menu of refined dishes that feature delicate, well-balanced flavours.

Name: Oxenstiernan
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: You can’t miss this stylish, orange-painted bistro which stands out against the greenery of a city park; in summer, dine on the terrace, under the trees. A sustainable ethos runs throughout, from the interior design to the ethically sourced produce used in the unfussy, boldly flavoured Swedish dishes.

Name: Rest.
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: This pioneering restaurant sees Chef Jimmy Øien bring together a team of young chefs and apprentices to turn items that would usually be discarded into a multi-course dining experience. Imperfect and unwanted produce is skilfully prepared in a variety of ways, and dishes are accompanied by detailed descriptions and informative explanations promoting sustainable living.

Name: Fotografiska
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Take in lovely water and city views from the top floor of this former warehouse; now a well-known photography museum. The straightforward, largely plant-based menu is supplemented in the evening by either farmed fish or sustainable meat, and the non-alcoholic drinks pairings features their homemade kombucha. They also have an on-site composting system, and the salad comes from their hydroponic farm in the basement.

Name: Tèrra
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: A zero waste restaurant with an impressive open kitchen sunk below ground level. Set menus offer creative, modern dishes inspired by the chef’s global travels. These come with original combinations, purity of flavour and a lightness of touch. Wines have a natural, organic and biodynamic focus.

Name: Moment
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: An ecologically friendly restaurant in the hamlet of Friland; the focus is on sustainability so furniture is made locally from natural wood and produce comes from its own permaculture garden or local suppliers; they also aim for zero waste. The well-priced vegetable and plant based dishes are full of flavour.

Name: JORD
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: ‘Forest to plate’ is the message here, with wild and hyper-seasonal ingredients at the fore. Some of the produce is foraged, whilst meat is often hunted by the owner in the surrounding area. The surprise tasting menu delivers a large array of creative dishes with intriguing blends of flavours and textures. Preserving, pickling, smoking and curing are all done in-house, giving new life to the local ingredients.

Name: Ark
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: It’s bright, it’s buzzing and it’s 100% vegan – and it’s also a concept that’s kind to the planet. Multi-course menus use local and foraged ingredients mixed in with some Japanese flavours; their mushrooms are cultivated on their own farm and the resulting dishes are a highlight. Service is friendly and informative. Go for the well-chosen wine pairings.

Name: Molskroen
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A table on the charming terrace of this relaxed and stylish seaside inn is the perfect spot to enjoy traditional French cuisine, as well as more modern interpretations of the classics. The chef collaborates with a local organic farmer and the restaurant’s comprehensive sustainability programme includes staff welfare.

Name: Hærværk
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Run by a group of friends, this restaurant’s ersatz industrial feel comes from a concrete floor, stark white décor and a glass-fronted fridge of hanging meats. The menu focuses on organic produce in dishes that are earthy and natural. Their ingredient options initially made them think more about sustainability, which now underpins all their actions.

Name: SOO
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Visionary owner Ragnar Sass purchased the Maidla Estate and manor house back in 2019, then added some rather smart eco-lodges in the woods and wetlands – as well as this intimate 5-table restaurant. Sustainability and ecological considerations are key, and the set dinner menu looks to the seasons and the region for its inspiration. Dishes are rich in flavour but come with a welcome lightness, and foraging, pickling and preserving all play their part. Wines are organic and natural.

Name: Fotografiska
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Brunch,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Above the Fotografiska photo gallery sits an equally striking restaurant offering picture-perfect views out across the Old Town; be sure to start or end your night with cocktails in the rooftop bar. A concept of ‘Sustainable Pleasure’ leads the way here, with a ‘leaf to root, nose to tail’ ethos and a zero-waste approach. Organic, sustainably farmed ingredients are showcased in a highly original selection of assured, understated dishes which reflect the chef’s French and Swedish training; go for the daily changing 360° surprise menu and the interesting wine pairings.

Name: Boca
Address: Gate Village Building 6, Dubai International Financial Centre, Dubai, 506772, United Arab Emirates, Dubai
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The bright, sunny look of the room is reflected in the extensive menu which careers joyfully around the Mediterranean, offering something for everyone – be sure to bring some friends so you can order with abandon. The Spanish dishes particularly stand out, such as the good-looking green herb gazpacho – the perfect refresher on a hot day.

Name: LOWE
Address: KOA Canvas, Wadi Al Safa 3, Dubai
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: An appealing, original restaurant with a trendy, pared-back style, a relaxed vibe and a sustainable ethos. The impressive open kitchen features a wood oven, a grill and a rotisserie, which play a key role in many of the global dishes. Some plates are perfect for sharing; the wood-fired sesame bread is a must.

Name: Sanjuhachi
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Toshikazu Kamei is a ‘chef of the soil and water’ who researched vegetable growing and water quality at university. He grows the vegetables himself and uses water that goes well with the dishes. Having prepared data on the water that goes best with each ingredient, he blends different kinds to achieve the right hardness and pH. The formula in the name is the deadline, set by his wife, for his becoming independent by age 37, and the plus one is his apology for missing it by a year.

Name: Kuramoto Ryori Maruto Shoyu
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Shoes must be removed,Visa credit card
Description: This Japanese restaurant is located in Nara’s oldest soy brewery. The head chef works together with the 18th generation owner and prepares a menu focused on soy sauce and vegetables. Soy sauce is used with everything from the appetisers to the sweets, such as the Miwa somen with soy sauce espuma and takikomi-gohan with unrefined soy powder. The theme is modern Japanese, and some of the dishes draw inspiration from Chinese and French cuisine.

Name: Kiyosuminosato AWA
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Great view,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Shoes must be removed,Visa credit card
Description: Seasonal crops are lined up on the zataku. Yamato vegetables and vegetables from various countries spruce up the plates. The Miuras visit farms and grow the seeds they collect. The harvested vegetables are used in local dishes they learned how to prepare in each area. You’ll enjoy items grilled on a ceramic plate in spring and summer and soy milk nabe in autumn and winter together with colourful takiawase. The menu makes you feel like you’re strolling around a market garden.

Name: AWA Naramachiten
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Shoes must be removed,Visa credit card
Description: Enjoy the locally cultivated bounty of historic Nara, in an area with many elegant townhouses. As at the head restaurant, Kiyosumi no Sato Awa, the key ingredients on the menu are traditional homegrown vegetables. The offerings include a basket of assorted colourful appetisers, tempura of Yamato vegetables, and nimono thickened with Yoshino kudzu. The culinary delights of Nara are also highlighted, such as Yamato beef with local sake.

Name: Mora
Location: Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,China UnionPay,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Mora is located on Cat Street, famous for its antique and junk market. The soothing interior adopts a cream colour scheme with subtle curvy lines. Soybeans are at the core of the menu, taking the forms of bean sauce, tofu skin, soymilk, and fermented beans, whose textures complement other ingredients in each dish well. European techniques are seamlessly melded with local flavours for a varied and interesting experience. Don’t miss their Mapo tofu.

Name: Het Seminar
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Het Seminar is an ode to nature that adopts "farm to fork" as its guiding principle. A former monastery, this upscale restaurant stands in its own grounds. From fruit and vegetables to livestock, everything is grown or reared on site – the focus is on sustainability. This approach means they only serve a surprise menu. The chef creatively showcases the harvest-fresh produce, incorporating a wealth of aromatic and tangy notes. Here, the fertility of the Dutch soil speaks for itself.

Name: De Dyck
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: De Dyck puts the spotlight on sustainability: a 5 000m² vegetable garden that supplies the majority of the fruit, vegetables and herbs; wines that are sourced within a 500km radius, and pigs that are reared on site and fed on kitchen leftovers. The decor of this attractive farm located amid the polders also reflects this focus on its natural surroundings. Freshly harvested produce and preserved ingredients are combined to great effect. Whether drawing on fermentations, creams or dishes prepared on the barbecue, this sophisticated cuisine puts a creative spin on what the local terroir has to offer.

Name: Morille
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Dennis Willems strives to source all his produce from within a 15km radius of his restaurant. It feels like nature has taken root in this cosy place – and with good cause. Ingredients harvested from his own kitchen garden, foraged in the wild or purchased from producers in the vicinity are presented in a 14-course set menu. This inspired, modern culinary approach – with its respect for micro-seasons – is an ode to Zeeland's (mostly vegetable-based) riches.

Name: Aan Sjuuteeänjd
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Sustainability takes centre stage at this cosy farmhouse restaurant with its eye-catching designer lighting. Even before it was trendy, chef Thoma was working with organic produce, mostly from his own vegetable garden. He has now even planted a food forest for the future. This ambassador of local Limburg produce proposes only a surprise menu, demonstrating his close ties with small-scale suppliers. Think rosefish from the North Sea, a beautifully grainy spelt risotto and a spicy/tangy beurre blanc sauce with nettles.

Name: Lokaal
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The name Lokaal, which can mean classroom as well as local in Dutch, is a nod to both the former school on the premises and the fresh local supplies. Whether guests prefer meat, fish or vegetarian food, the chef has access to all kinds of regional delicacies to create his modern dishes.

Name: Triptyque
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: Chef Niven Kunz and Virginie van Bronckhorst-Kunz have created a natural, relaxing ambience in this restaurant, where the decor is simple yet also elegant and luxurious, with details such as dried flowers adding an attractive touch. Kunz favours local and regional ingredients, using his creative skills to prepare dishes with a particular emphasis on vegetables. Surprising yet authentic cuisine, accompanied by a choice of excellent wines.

Name: Hof aan Zee
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Only 500m from the North Sea, this historic Scandinavian farmstead stands in the heart of the countryside. The stripped-back interior weaves a rustic spell, while the menu shines the spotlight on the rich produce of Zeeland. Seaweed, fish from the Oosterschelde, fermented vegetables, smoky flavours – superlative purity!

Name: mural farmhouse - À LA CARTE
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Credit cards not accepted,Interesting wine list,Terrace
Description: The second part of mural farmhouse is a laid-back bistro, which also places the emphasis on sustainability and regionality. Produce sourced from the surrounding area as well as from their own raised garden beds on the roof of the associated hotel WunderLocke are turned into delicious, fuss-free and expressive dishes under the leadership of chef Rico Birndt. They have a terrific selection of wines – all organic or biodynamic and from first-class producers.

Name: mondi
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Owner Pelle Kossmann and his young team are committed to implementing their own culinary ideas here. The set menu changes every fortnight and is made with select seasonal ingredients sourced from regional producers; some of the livestock and vegetables are raised or grown exclusively for this restaurant. The chefs also adhere to the principle of nose-to-tail eating. The decor is sleek and modern, with a partially visible kitchen and friendly, laid-back service. Fixed charge for table water.

Name: Wirtshaus zum Herrmannsdorfer Schweinsbräu
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit cards not accepted,Terrace,Wheelchair access
Description: "Dishes that can't be pigeonholed" – such is the name of the game for chef Olimpia Cario. In her surprise set menu, she gives free rein to her creativity, cooking up unusual combinations such as chicken, trout, egg, cucumber, corn and redcurrants. She uses seasonal produce and high-quality ingredients, often grown on her own farm. The interior itself has an eye-catching design, with a large, high-ceilinged space reminiscent of a modern rustic barn on account of the beam construction climbing up into the roof.

Name: Moosleitner
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The tradition of this restaurant has been cultivated for centuries. With their rural charm, the attractive dining rooms are cosy and inviting, and make an ideal setting in which to enjoy the Bavarian cuisine that is served here – fresh, seasonal and with a penchant for locally sourced produce. This is also a nice place to spend the night: There are well-kept guestrooms, plus a small sauna and gym facilities.

Name: Brauereigasthof Aying
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The restaurant of the picture-perfect Brauereigasthof Hotel Aying is a traditional family business. In this harmonious, upscale yet cosy setting, a friendly and welcoming front-of-house team serve excellent regional cuisine made with top-quality seasonal produce. In addition to the selection of fine wines, there are of course Ayinger beer specialities. Comfortable and tastefully decorated guestrooms available for overnight stays.

Name: Lockstein 1
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit cards not accepted,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace
Description: This really is a special place: you enter the charming kitchen through the 500-year-old farmhouse, which is run by an established mother-and-daughter team. They inject love and skill into their cooking, which takes the form of a vegetarian set menu comprising fresh dishes made using regional produce. The two pretty holiday flats are also popular.

Name: Gut Steinbach
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Restaurant HEIMAT, Auerhahn Stuben, Bayern Stuben and Tiroler Stuben – the elegant hotel of the same name, which also has a spa, offers diners a variety of restaurant option, all of which are elegant and inviting. The terrace, in particular, with its panoramic mountain view is quite an event – it's a great place to soak up the idyllic surroundings! The cuisine is seasonal, with an emphasis on sustainability; the majority of the ingredients come from within an 80km radius. The menu also features classics such as Wiener schnitzel or chateaubriand for two.

Name: Restaurant 1950
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: This fantastic restaurant is actually housed in what was once a pigpen. The modern and attractive dining area features high ceilings (the hanging herb boxes are an original detail) and an open kitchen. Here, the chefs whip up a vegetarian set menu, which can be extended to include a meat option if desired. Small cards accompanying the dishes provide information about the ingredients, all of which are sourced within a radius of 25km (except for the salt). After being seated at one of only four tables, you can relax and enjoy the friendly and informal service. Chef Simon Tress also gets in on the act front of house – he calls the restaurant his "living room", which is in keeping with the pleasingly convivial atmosphere. Appealing guestrooms.

Name: FREA
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: "Full Taste. Zero Waste" is the motto of founders David Johannes Suchy and Jasmin Suchy. Based on this idea of sustainability, their cuisine is modern, creative and entirely vegan. Choose from the refined seasonal dishes that the dedicated kitchen team concocts with plenty of finesse to put together your own three- to five-course menu – further courses are available if you would like to try more. Diners will enjoy the lively atmosphere in this trendy restaurant housed in a building on a corner plot; if you sit at the counter, you can look over the pass and see the action in the kitchen. It is also pleasant to sit on the terrace out front. The service is friendly and congenial.

Name: erasmus
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In a listed building dating from 1928, you get unusual, ambitious cuisine that is modern, well thought-out and with a clear Italian influence. Here, the approach is sustainable, almost all produce used being certified organic. The arancino aperto, salsiccia and pistachios, and the tongue of veal, Marsala, cauliflower and beetroot are great examples from the menu.

Name: Hofgut Ruppertsberg
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This estate on the outskirts of town is steeped in history. One of the cornerstones of the Bürklin-Wolf winery, it is now also a charming restaurant with a wonderful courtyard. The cuisine is French, regional and seasonal, with a penchant for organic produce. The teahouse can be booked for exclusive celebrations. The farm shop sells delicious food to take home.

Name: Berchtesgadener Esszimmer
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: What was once Gasthaus Nonntal has been transformed into a really lovely little restaurant. The food is modern and ambitious, seasonal and regional, and accompanied by Austrian wines. The regulars have a penchant for the two high "kitchen tables" which offer a view of the open kitchen.

Name: freistil.
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: In addition to an appealing modern decor featuring sleek design and warm wooden fittings, diners can look forward to a selection of regional and seasonal dishes (including vegetarian and vegan options) that can be put together to create a set menu or ordered à la carte. For overnight stays, the boutique hotel has attractive, comfortable guestrooms.

Name: Spielweg
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: First mentioned in records in 1705, the original Spielweg building, managed by the Fuchs family, makes for a wonderfully cosy setting. The charming dining rooms are done out in traditional Black Forest style and the service is extremely friendly and attentive. Diners can expect classic regional cuisine that is ambitious and full of flavour, as in the warm smoked char from the Wutach in a cold potato and leek broth. It also draws on Asian influences, cf. their wild boar dim sum with soy sauce – Asian cuisine is one of the young chef's passions.
