The lunchtime menu proposes somewhat simpler fare, making this place an ideal stop-off for a light meal during a hike. You can stay overnight in well-kept, individually furnished guestrooms.

Name: Zur Sonne
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Hanspeter Rombach attaches great importance to organic ingredients in his inviting, friendly restaurant. The cuisine is regional and classical: on the menu, for example, local venison ragout in Spätburgunder sauce or filet of organic salmon and wild gambas in pumpkin juice sauce. There are also cosy guestrooms and a pretty sauna area.

Name: Hohenhaus Grill
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This is the second restaurant of the idyllically situated Hohenhaus hotel, a magnificent property laden with history. The eatery has a classic-meets-rustic-style interior and a warm atmosphere – plus a lovely 18C tiled stove. The cuisine is seasonal and based on premium ingredients, which are for the most part sourced from the region. It is a treat to sit on the terrace and take in the view of the surrounding countryside.

Name: Alter Wirt
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This sizeable restaurant is in the centre of Grünwald. It serves Bavarian and international cuisine based exclusively on organic produce. Try the malt beer glazed roast pork.

Name: James Farmhouse
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Fresh and tasty cuisine is served here, and the menu is strongly influenced by the restaurant's own farm – for example, they have their own Husum red pied pigs, chickens and German Angus cattle. The decor is a mix of industrial chic and a charming retro style. Very friendly service. Smaller menu at lunchtime. Tip: afternoon tea with scones, tartlets etc (reserve the day before).

Name: Wolfs Junge
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The accent here is on sustainable, regional cuisine, the very epitome of “nose to tail” eating. The ingredients are sourced from selected producers with some of the vegetables and herbs grown by the restaurant itself. Serves simple midday fare such as home-made bratwurst and an ambitious, creative set menu including Angeln Saddleback, kimchi and fermented onion in the evenings.

Name: TISK
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Situated in a quiet side street of Neukölln, TISK (old German for table) calls itself a Speisekneipe (food pub) – and the description works well. It offers a young, urban ambience and modern German cuisine with pepped-up flavours. Options include set menus (e. g. with meatballs or knuckle of lamb) and roast chicken for two people.

Name: Lode & Stijn
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: This appealing spot is rather special. Decked out with lots of wood, the restaurant has a straightforward yet sophisticated aesthetic that is in keeping with the modern dishes. On the fixed menu, dishes are markedly pared down – verging on the minimalist – and have a slightly Scandinavian feel. Seasonal ingredients sourced from carefully selected producers take centre stage.

Name: STUBEN
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: For starters, the location on a 45ha estate is terrific. The small Lammershof hotel houses this restaurant, which is open daily, with its cosy dining rooms – or Stuben. In an upmarket rustic-style interior, you can tuck into the bison burger, for instance, which is made with meat from the hotel's own bison farm. Tip: In summer, make the most of the wonderful terrace.

Name: Green Beetle
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Environmental awareness and sustainability have always played an important role in every aspect of this restaurant – from the tasteful interior design to the clothing that the staff wear, and not least the food. Felix Adebahr and his team's vegetarian/vegan surprise menu will make you forget all about meat and fish, as these dishes are so flavoursome and punchy, with floral and herbal notes – the refreshing cold beetroot dish with spicy tabouleh is sure to make a lasting impression! At lunchtime, you can opt to have two to four courses, and in the evening, from four to six. The exceptionally friendly and attentive front-of-house team will happily recommend wines from their almost exclusively organic or biodynamic selection. Lovely covered terrace.

Name: Schloss Hohenstein
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This stunning castle, which is mentioned in written records as far back as the 14C, is idyllically situated in beautiful grounds. In addition to their tastefully decorated hotel, Alexandra and Andreas Rehberger also offer an appealing winter garden-style restaurant. While the chef-patron cooks up seasonal cuisine with produce from the region, his charming partner has excellent wine advice for you.

Name: Crocadon
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Chef-owner Dan Cox realised that to cook the best, he needed to first grow the best, so he spent five years establishing the 120 acre farm on which this beautifully restored barn is set. This is the epitome of ‘field to fork’, with the farm – which is run on regenerative principles – delivering much of the produce, and the rest sourced from similarly minded local suppliers. The cooking is assured and original, with dishes delivering wonderfully pure flavours.

Name: Angela's
Address: 21 The Parade, Margate, CT9 1EX, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A friendly team run this understated little bistro set just off the esplanade. Their ethos is fiercely local and sustainable and even the tables are made of compressed recycled plastic. The concise blackboard menu lists sustainable fish and a vegetarian option – no meat – and cooking is pleasingly unfussy.

Name: Apricity
Address: 68 Duke Street, Mayfair, London, W1K 6JU, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Just yards from the bustle of Oxford Street is a veritable sanctuary of calm. Chef-owner Chantelle Nicholson’s bright and welcoming restaurant comes with delightful service and a menu that showcases seasonal British ingredients from small producers with whom she’s built strong relationships. Her green credentials are omnipresent and inform her every decision.

Name: The Small Holding
Address: Ranters Lane, Kilndown, TN17 2SG, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: Two brothers run this former village pub, which has a rustic farmhouse feel. Their focus is on self-sufficiency: they grow fruit and veg and raise chickens and rare breed pigs. Rustic British meets Nordic cooking on the surprise tasting menu and dishes have bold, well-balanced flavours and lots of personality.

Name: CULTURE
Address: Custom House Quay, 38b Arwenack Street, Falmouth, TR11 3JF, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: The open kitchen takes centre stage at this old quayside warehouse. Each dish on the set menu is named after the inspiration behind it, be it a local farmer or place, and foraged ingredients also play their part. Don’t be surprised to see the occasional South African influence too though, as the chef-owner is from Cape Town. The pared-back room has a natural feel, and it’s worth checking out the glass-walled wine cellar.

Name: Oak
Address: 2 North Parade Passage, Bath, BA1 1NX, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Brunch,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: What started out as ‘Acorn’ has now matured into ‘Oak’ – but the ethos remains the same, with tasty, original vegetarian and vegan dishes served in unpretentious bistro surroundings. Well-priced small plates are designed for sharing and 40% of the produce is from their allotment. They also offer brunch.

Name: Henry Robertson
Address: Palé Estate, Llandderfel, LL23 7PS, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Set within an impressive Victorian hotel, this elegant restaurant is named after the industrialist-cum-MP the property was built for. Take in lovely views over the garden as you dine on one of two tasting menus, where attractively presented dishes reflect the seasons and keep the local larder to the fore.

Name: Coombeshead Farm
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Set on a working farm, in 66 acres of meadows and woodland, this former farmhouse and dairy offers the ultimate field to fork experience. Techniques include curing, pickling and cooking over wooden embers, and the home-bred Middle White pork and home-baked sourdough are hits. They serve a set three course menu at all times, which changes seasonally depending on which quality ingredients are available. Bedrooms have a cosy farmhouse style.

Name: Where The Light Gets In
Address: 7 Rostron Brow, Stockport, SK1 7JY, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: This large, loft-style restaurant is located on the top floor of a Victorian coffee warehouse and its open kitchen forms part of the room. The surprise menu is formed from whatever they have foraged that day and beasts are brought in whole and fully utilised. Matching wine flights focus on natural wines.

Name: Daylesford Organic Farm
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A stylishly rustic eatery attached to a farm shop: dine in the ‘Legbar’ for charcuterie and nibbles, the ‘Old Spot’ for pizzas and wood-roasted specials or the main ‘Trough Café’, where at night, candle-lit suppers step things up a gear. Everything is organic, with much of the produce coming from the farm.

Name: Petersham Nurseries Café
Address: Church Lane, Richmond-Upon-Thames, London, TW10 7AG, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: On a summer’s day there can be few more delightful spots for lunch, whether on the terrace or in the greenhouse. The kitchen uses the freshest seasonal produce in unfussy, flavoursome dishes with a subtle Italian accent and, from the sourcing of produce to the welfare of staff, sustainability is a key focus.

Name: Terroir Tapas
Address: 81 Southbourne Grove, Bournemouth, BH6 3QX, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Former ‘World Bartender of the Year’ James Fowler is at the helm of this ethical, eco-friendly restaurant. The wood-burning oven is at the restaurant’s heart, and cooking showcases the best of their farm just a few miles away. Those who book can choose between a 4 or 10 course tasting menu, while walk-ins are offered tapas-style snacks at the bar. An all-British wine list adds to the fun.

Name: Marle
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Within a Georgian country house you’ll find this charming orangery-style dining room looking out over a lake and parkland. Provenance is everything, with many of the ingredients coming from the estate’s own farm. The presentation might be modern but at its heart, cooking relies on honest, natural flavours.

Name: CHAPTERS
Address: Lion Street, Hay-on-Wye, HR3 5AA, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: A stone-built former meeting room to the adjoining chapel, CHAPTERS exudes an intimate rustic-cum-vintage style with its parquet flooring, wood panelling and leaded windows. The set menu changes every 6 weeks and local sourcing is key. Hyper-seasonal, attractively presented dishes deliver original flavours.

Name: Silo
Address: Unit 7, Queens Yard, Hackney Wick, London, E9 5EN, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: This stylish, welcoming restaurant has a zero-waste ethos, meaning everything from the furniture to the plates is made with recycled materials. The mainly plant-based menu shows great respect for ingredients; start with the amazing siloaf and aged butter (with flour milled and butter churned by them).

Name: Tillingham
Address: Dew Farm, Dew Lane, Peasmarsh, TN31 6XD, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: Nestled deep in the countryside is this 70 acre farm and wine estate with a shop, a tasting room, a restaurant and stylish bedrooms. Flavour-driven cooking focuses on pure, fresh tastes, with some produce coming from the estate. Interesting global wines, including their naturally produced selection, accompany.

Name: Inver
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A former crofter’s cottage and boat store in a beautifully isolated spot on the shores of Loch Fyne. Sit on sheepskin-covered armchairs for a cocktail in the lounge-bar, then take in the view from the contemporary restaurant, where concise modern menus are led by the finest local and foraged ingredients. Luxurious bothy-style bedrooms in the grounds complete the picture.

Name: Wilsons
Address: 24 Chandos Road, City of Bristol, BS6 6PF, United Kingdom
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Wilsons is one of those appealing neighbourhood places that works in pure harmony, with everyone from the chefs to the service team sharing the same ethos. Sustainability leads the way, with generously proportioned, highly seasonal cooking showcasing ingredients from their smallholding.

Name: WILDn
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus
Description: Sustainability is the name of the game at the luxurious Sapphire Hotel in the heart of Antwerp and the glitzy, glammed-up WILDn is perfectly in tune with this philosophy. In an elegantly revamped Belle Époque interior, Bart De Pooter adds a subtle nuance to plant-focused dishes. Veggies and seasonings are crafted intelligently and deftly and the non-alcoholic pairings are truly noteworthy. For example, butternut, guava juice and green peas are combined in a fascinating and complex recipe.

Name: Hors-Champs
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Stefan Jacobs has metamorphosed the Ernage farmstead. This gifted chef has opened a B&B, a bakery and a modern restaurant that sports a rough, untreated look. His sustainable ethos can be tasted in subtle dishes, rich in unexpected and playful combinations. A fine tribute to his region.

Name: Atelier de Bossimé
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Ludovic Vanackere’s elegant restaurant, located in his parents’ farm, is driven by a sustainable vision. All the produce is sourced entirely locally, including from his own impressive kitchen garden. Veggies take the limelight, prompting extra creativity in the winter season. A splendid establishment on the Ardennes road.

Name: Graanmarkt 13
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: The engaging Graanmarkt 13 is the spitting image of its concept store. Here, the (green) stars are the veggies, to be shared, as we (re)discover pure flavours whose multiple facets surprise and enchant. Punchy, contemporary cooking in tune with the seasons.

Name: Le Doyenné
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: What are two Australian chefs (with stints at Yard, Spring, Bones and Au Passage) doing in the heart of the grounds of Saint Vrain Castle, more precisely in the tastefully refurbished former stables? Well, they are knocking up spot-on food that is sourced directly from the estate’s huge cottage garden, which actually existed before the restaurant, using fruit and vegetables that are only harvested when perfectly ripe. A fine dining experience that mingles rural charm and gourmet delights, overlooking the surrounding countryside. Booking compulsory.

Name: Sandikala
Address: 9 rue de la Barsogue, Galan, 65330, France
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Australian-born Luke MacLeod and his wife from Tarbes fell for the charm of this old farmstead and have done it up in a tasteful country chic vein. The chef concocts delicious seasonal cuisine that allies local produce with ingredients from further afield.

Name: Ruche
Address: Domaine les Bruyères, 251 avenue de Neuville, Gambais, 78950, France
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card
Description: On the outskirts of Rambouillet Forest, chef Cybèle, who also runs the Table de Cybèle in Boulogne Billancourt, fell in love with this estate dating from 1850, where she now grows practically everything she cooks according to permaculture methods… Fresh greens thus play a pivotal role, flanked by fermentation techniques and produce from local growers. The bread, butter and yoghurt are all homemade and the wine list is rich in biodynamic and natural vintages. The interior displays a Scandinavian slant and offers five pretty guestrooms for peaceful wellness retreats.

Name: La Bòria
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: The view over the valley and the surrounding Ardèche hills, a lovely timber building, chestnut-wood tables, an indoor aromatic herb garden, the etymology of the name bòria ("small Cévennes farm" in Ardèche dialect): the tone is set! Chef Florian Descours pays tribute to his roots by cooking only fresh and local produce (such as beef from Privas, pork from Beaulieu, snails from the Eyrieux valley and trout from Andaure). A treat from beginning to end, from the beef tongue ravioli and snails with sorrel to the Ardèche lemon, Baix kiwi and Areilladou fromage frais. Hard to beat!

Name: La Coopérative - Domaine Riberach
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This former winery has retained its metal rafters, adding further cachet and charm to the spacious, inviting interior. On the seasonal menu you may find pollock steamed in seaweed with a knockout seafood stew of samphire, cockles and potatoes. The wines (organic and input free) are from the estate. Pleasant rooms for overnight stays.

Name: Le Saltimbanque - Auberge du Moulin
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This endearing establishment gazing down over the Somme Valley is in the hands of a local lad in love with his region’s produce. The several-course surprise menu showcases ingredients from sustainable farms and small-scale fishing. Suave subtle flavours for a slap-up meal.

Name: Les Jardins Sauvages - La Grée des Landes
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In the restaurant of the Yves Rocher hotel, chef Fabien Manzoni, a champion of vegetables, crafts modern, masterful and generous fare made with organic produce (except the seafood) from the garden and local growers. Vegetarians will be in Seventh Heaven, thanks to dishes such as pithivier of celeriac, Chioggia beetroot and lemon-flavoured spinach leaves with grated truffle and drizzled with truffle sauce.

Name: Auberge Sauvage
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: This former 16C presbytery is now home to a restaurant with a vegetable garden, which provides the chef with plenty of produce as well as inspiration for his surprise menus and modern cuisine occasionally imbued with Japanese touches. His yoghurt and Melonette squash tartlet is a real highlight. Natural wines.

Name: Caves Madeleine
FacilitiesAndServices: Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: A stone's throw from the town centre, this wine bar-restaurant is a little gem. Chef Martial has hooked up with the best local producers, including some top wine growers, to create wholesome, punchy cuisine that is rife with flavour, eg warm potatoes, haddock, and tarragon sabayon. Relaxed, no-fuss service – the focus is firmly on the contents of your glass and your plate. In fine weather, make the most of the pleasant terrace in the shade of a fig tree.

Name: Le Saint Cerf
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: "This contemporary bistro with a pleasant interior proposes tasty food rife with various influences, including Asian touches, skilfully handled from start to finish, without ostentation. Add to that a distinct tendency towards the ""natural"" (seasonality, ingredients) and a handful of vegetarian dishes and you get an ambassador of the Besançon's revival. "

Name: Domaine de Baulieu
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: In an elegant and modern interior with large bay windows overlooking the terrace and the surrounding nature, you can enjoy food cooked up by Maxime Deschamps. Their dishes are well crafted and make the most of local produce. A super dining experience.

Name: Le Toi du Monde
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This renovated barn in the upper reaches of Flumet offers modern, tasty dishes. The produce, some of which comes from the huge vegetable garden (practically an acre!), is seasonal and top-notch. Comfortable guestrooms and concerts every other Saturday evening. Buzzy, friendly and quirky.

Name: Scratch Restaurant
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Ardent slow-food disciples, Estelle and Andréas Baehr enthusiastically showcase premium, fresh, organic, local ingredients and shine the spotlight on producers, as well as seeking to share their culinary vision thanks to the chatty lady of the house. Intelligently devised and flawlessly crafted, the lunch and dinner surprise menus are a masterclass of hunger obliterating perfection, illustrated by grilled white and green asparagus, served with a delicate citrus-flavoured cream further enhanced by egg yolk, confit of black garlic and puffed buckwheat. Friendly casual welcome and service. Bookings essential.

Name: Jardin Secret
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Back from the rock of Monaco, Benoît Witz has hung his hat in a pretty estate in Provence. In the shade of olive groves and released from gastronomic codes, he crafts 100% authentic dishes in a style that he himself joyfully describes as “grandma’s country cooking”! Garden-fresh beefsteak tomatoes, fish of the day with summer veggies, melt-in-the-mouth chocolate cake. Scrumptious and generous – yummy!

Name: Le Garde Champêtre
FacilitiesAndServices: Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Interesting wine list,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: This former railway warehouse has been turned into a sustainable farm restaurant with greenhouses and an organic vegetable garden by a group of four partners judiciously teamed up with two local winegrowers. They serve fresh and fortifying cuisine, based on ingredients sourced locally or from the garden. A very pleasant locavore and ecological approach. A pleasant place.

Name: Ar Men Du
Address: 47 rue des Îles, à Raguenès-Plage, Névez, 29920, France
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Imagine wild moorland buffeted by the ocean with the rocky Islet of Raguenès glinting in the sunshine just a short distance away. Sustainable gastronomy is the name of the game at Ar Men Du: the ingredients are strictly seasonal, harvested from the vegetable garden or sourced from small-scale producers, and the fish is caught locally. Jérôme Gourmelen's dishes are full of flavour – beef broth with abalone, kari gosse emulsion or dashi beans.

Name: Empreinte
FacilitiesAndServices: American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: Make a stop at this establishment on a small square in the city centre. The interior is inviting, with its warm decor of untreated wooden floorboards, fabrics and vintage porcelain. Marine and Baptiste Fournier put their hearts into serving particularly polished cuisine, showcasing fish sourced from the market and vegetables from farmers. Menu-carte at lunch, "surprise" menus at dinner. Natural wines.

Name: Jampa
Address: The Community House, Tri Vananda, 46 Mu 3, Thep Krasatti, Thalang, Phuket, 83110, Thailand
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Great view,JCB,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: Chef Dingen’s inventive contemporary European menu embraces a philosophy of sustainability and zero waste. À la carte is available all day, but we recommend the exquisitely prepared Jampa Experience for lunch, which features complex natural flavours that change with the seasons. For a unique lakeside experience on Saturdays, Hideaway’s 4-course lunch, cooked over a wood fire, both tantalises the tastebuds and educates the diner about sustainable farming.

Name: Casa Nova
Address: Finca Cal Tòfol – Barri La Bleda, Sant Martí Sarroca, 08731, Spain
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Interesting wine list,Mastercard credit card,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: More than just a restaurant, Casa Nova is a mini-paradise on Earth, occupying a charming old country property that was once a poultry farm and is now run by a couple with a total commitment to sustainability and no half measures. Here, in a delightful atmosphere combining the past and present, chef Andrés Torres creates intensely flavoured, contemporary-style cuisine based around local ingredients, many of which, such as vegetables, chickens, bees, shitake mushrooms, dried tuna, wines and vinegars, are grown, reared or produced by the team here. Casa Nova is also actively involved in support programs that help to integrate those at risk of social exclusion in society.

Name: Muxgo
Address: León y Castillo 227, Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, 35005, Spain
Location: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, Spain
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Muxgo is part of the luxury Santa Catalina Royal Hideaway hotel, where the cooking is an ode to sustainable and organic cuisine championed by chef Borja Marrero. Here, he continues to produce creative and contemporary dishes based around ingredients rooted in the DNA of the Canary Islands and, first and foremost, those grown on his own farm. Dining options are centred around three regular tasting menus (Los Orígenes, Lo más profundo de Tejeda, and an “executive” menu), along with El Territorio, the latter only available for dinner from Wednesday to Friday, excluding public holidays.

Name: Zelai Txiki
Address: Travesía del Rodil 79, Donostia / San Sebastián, 20013, Spain
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Great view,Terrace,Visa credit card,Wheelchair access
Description: A superb location on the slopes of Mt Ulía, hence the impressive views from its panoramic terrace. The extensive, traditionally inspired à la carte has a strong focus on organic ingredients sourced from the restaurant’s own vegetable garden.

Name: Narbasu
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Mastercard credit card,Visa credit card
Description: A hotel and restaurant occupying the Palacio de Rubianes, an authentic 14C Asturian-style property. Attractive guestrooms and excellent cuisine with a focus on quality ingredients and flavours influenced by the surrounding area.

Name: El Visco
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,Car park,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Garden or park,Mastercard credit card,Restaurant offering vegetarian menus,Terrace,Visa credit card
Description: Part of the La Torre del Visco hotel, this restaurant is located in a secluded natural setting surrounded by its own kitchen gardens. Its two menus, one vegetarian (called Vía Verde), the other more traditional (Artigas), champion seasonality along with locally sourced meat and fish direct from the auction. The pleasant terrace boasts views of the estate, its orchards and its fields of crops.

Name: Gigas
FacilitiesAndServices: Air conditioning,American Express credit card,Counter dining,Credit card / Debit card accepted,Diners Club credit card,Mastercard credit card,Valet parking,Visa credit card
Description: This authentic Mediterranean restaurant is a rarity in the Korean culinary landscape. Recreating bona fide Mediterranean cuisine in Korea is not an easy feat to achieve because of the scarcity of particular ingredients. Nevertheless, using purely organic ingredients grown on his family’s farm, Chef Jung Ha-wan has managed to present fascinating Mediterranean fare with authenticity and direction that reflect the region's culinary tradition. What drives Gigas forward and ensures gastronomic pleasure is the chef’s dedication to sustainability. How this restaurant will take on this challenge and grow amidst Seoul’s culinary landscape is something that sparks our curiosity as much as the pleasant dining experience it offers.
